rgyud/ hrū// (74)1748 rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lag (pecad mgo 1sdecasabag :nge 9lta rngab cesabs /gra thab/ 3rig snga gas 'chang sga slo ba dngo na rat+na shī la sa mdzad/rgya gar kyi ma khan ngo/ badz+ra bo bye dang /'o tsā ba tshul dase rin chen gyis bsgyur/basbur mchan/(18) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(19)17go rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/20slob dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes ma/dzad/basbur mchan/(25) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(26)

—sgyu 1750 'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga 27rlo ba dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes ma/dzad/bsdur mchan/(38) basbur 'bras re'u mig(40)tsho 1751 rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 41slob dpon chen po ma/khas pa/ rat+na krirtis mdzad/bang ngo/'i pa/ṇ+ḍi ta ma hā pa ṇa'i rang 'gyur/bsdur mchan/(43) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(44) 1752 rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 45slo ba dpon chen po rat+na tīrtis mdzad/bal ngo/'i pa/ṇ+ḍi ta ma hā pa ṇa'i rang 'gyur/bsdur mchan/(49) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(49)tsho 1753 rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa brgyad grags pa/ 50bskyed pa'irim pa/ 50rdo rje rnam nga/ra 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gye cho ga 50slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/sgu yi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 68pad+ma badz+ras mdzad/dam tshig bsrung ba'i cho ga 69slo ba dngo/na nga/d+mas mdzad/khro bo brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ 71slo ba dngo/na dpa/la mar me ma/dzad kyis rgyud la brten nas mdzad/7 )

lha mo brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ 73dpa/la mar me ma dzad bzang ngo sa mdzad/dpa' bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i bdud rtsi bum tshosa'i cho rngon 75dpa/la mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/yab yum gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba bde sbyin dam pa zhes bya ba/ ༷ rte/rte/dpal mar me mdzad kyis ma/dzad/bdud rtsi thab sbyor zhes bya ba khro bo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur /ba'i cho can 1 /ba mo/ 78dpa/la mar spe mdzad bzang ngo/sa mdzad/sgo ma bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rin po che dri ma bye)tshod nga / cesathag (1 ba/ 82dpa la ma ra rnge mdzad kyis mdzad/rgyal po chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ 83dpa/la mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/phyogs skyong ba bcu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 85dpa/la mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/gza' chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga nyi ma bcud len/ ༷ ma sgyu dpa la mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje go cha ma zhes bya ba/ 9rtenadapa/la mar me mdzad bzang ngo sa ma/dzad/lha chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs pa'i lam ston par byed pa zhes bya ba/ 95dpa/la mar me ma dzad bzang ngo/sa ma/dzad/3

klu brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dug las rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ 98slob dngo/na mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga 100slo ba dpon chen po dpa/la mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga 110slo ba dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad bzang ngo/sa mdzad/dang/la rdo rje rnam nga/ra 'joms pa'i las la sbyar ba 'grub par nges pa'i cho ga ////rngonaslo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/mi shigs pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi tshig lag tu blang ba man ngag gis bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i tshe dang stobs bsgrub pa zhes bya ba/ 116slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/rgyud kyi bden pa'i don nges par sgrub pa rnal 'byor pa pra se na legs /bshā pa /ba—1sgyun thab/ 11sna slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/'dod nga/'i don dus la nges par bsgrub nga// 119rlo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/rgyud kyi brtan pa/ zhes bya ba'i tshig legs par bsgrub pa zhes bya ba/ 121slo ba dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/rgyud thams cad thogs pa med pa'i tshig legs par bsgrub pa/ 122mna' las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs/ ༷ ༷ 122tshong las rnam par rgyal ba sgrub pa'i thabs ༷ ༷ 123pha rol gyi sde rab tu 'joms par byed pa'i sgrub thabs/ 123slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes ma/dzad/rang rtags rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs bdun pa las kyi bye brag bcu/ 124

slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/bsgrub bya gza'i byad du gzhug pa'i 'khor lo can/ 125dpal mar me mdzad bzang ngo sa mdzad/the tshom med par 'grub pa las bsgrub bya thog gis bsad pa'i cho ga drag bzhu/pa /zhe/ma /rgya /ba/ 1rten(5dpal mar me mdzad bzang ngo/sa mdzad/bsgrub bya skrag pa'i las chu thigs zhes bya ba/ 127dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad/'gal ba skrag par byed pa'i las sna tshogs pa'i cho ga mgal ba me'i pa /bozang shes chen/bsgyu (1 ngab/ 129dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos ma dzad/gzhan gyi rig sngags gcad pa rgyun gcod sru gri zhes bya ba/ 130slo ba dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/gzhan gyi rig sngags mnan pa gser gyi ri bo zhes bya ba/ 131rlo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes ma dzad/las thams cad 'joms nga/'i ye shes 'dus pa'i tho ba zhes bya ba/ 131slo ba dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/gzhan gyi rig sngags bshig pa'i phyir bzlog pa zhes bya ba/ 132slob dngo na ye shes rdo rjes ma/dzad/gzhan kyi lus 'jig par byed nga/ rdo rje rnon po zhes bya ba/ 133slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/mu stegs can gyi rig sngags 'jig pa'i sgrub pa'i nye ba'i las phyi ma zhes /rgya /ba/ //rtenatshonaslo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/gdon thams cad brlag par byed pa rdo rje tho ba zhes bya ba/ 134rlo ba dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/lha'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 1375

slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/'byung po'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 137slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/dri za'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 138slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/tshangs nga/'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 139slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/srin po'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 140slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/sha za'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 141slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/klu'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 142slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/log 'dren gyi gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 142slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/brjed byed kyi gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 143slob dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/thru byed kyi gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 144slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/lha ma yin gyi gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 145slo ba dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/gzhon nu'i gdon rnams las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 145slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/gnod sbyin gyi gdon las thar bar byed pa'i man ngag 147slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/'byung po 'gugs pa'i bsgrub pa rdo rje be+egs kyu zhes bya ba/ 148slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/rig sngags kyi las thams cad byed du 'jug pa'i las kyi bye brag bzhi bcu

rtsa gnyis bkod pa yid bzhin nor bu 'od 'bar ba zhes bya ba/ 1goslob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/gzungs sngags kyi las ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa rdo rje be con zhes bya ba/ 15rtenaslob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/gzungs sngags kyi las grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa rin po che'i gter sgrub ces (1 ba/ 154slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/klu'i las char dbab pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun zhes bya ba/ 156dpal mar me mdzad bzang ngo/sa mdzad/klu rnams mnyes par byed pa'i chu la brten pa'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ 156dpa/la mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad/sems can bsrung ba'i las sprin dral ba'i 'byung ba gcod byed ces bya ba/ 159dpal mar me mdzad bzang ngo/sa mdzad/byis pa'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i bsgrub pa gsang ba me'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ 1ga 9slo ba dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes ma/dzad/zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyud kyi zhi ba'i mtshan don/ 161rgyud kyi rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i tshig legs par sgrub pa rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rgyas par byed pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 163mngon spyod kyi sbyin sreg gi sgo nas tshar gcad pa'i cho ga 164dbang du bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ༷ ༷ 165slob dngo na ye shes rdo ches mdzad/sems can thams cad rengs par byed pa'i las jag chings 'phrul yig ces bya ba/ 166slo ba dpo na ye thes rdo rjes mdzad/7

bsgrub bya rengs pa'i las sna tshogs pa bstan pa rlung gi zhags pa zhes bya ba/ 167slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/bsgrub bya klu rnams kyi byad du gzhug pa'i cho ga srog gcod kyi spu gri zhes bya ba/ 167dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad/tsha ba'i rims kyis dgra bsad pa'i ral gri'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ 169slob dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/sems can thams cad rmugs par byed pa'i las kyi mtha' gzi mdangs byebyecad mo zhebasgyu bya thab/ 169slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/dpal skyed pa bkra shis skyed pa nyi ma'i 'od ces bya ba dpal kun gyis brgyan pa'i mtha' 170slo ba dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/mig gi dbang po nyams nga/ gso ba'i cho ga gsal ba'i snang ba zhes bya ba/ 171slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/rna ba'i dbang po nyams pa dang de'i nad gso ba'i cho ga sgra las rnam par rgyal ba stun/sa bya ba/ ༷ 172slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/sna'i dbang po nyams nga/ dang na ba gso ba dri ma dang bral ba'i sbyong byed ces bya ba/ 17tsho slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/lce'i dbang po nyams pa gso ba'i cho ga pad+ma rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ 174slob dngo/na ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/lus kyi dbang po nyams pa dang lus na ba gso ba'i cho ga rdo rje rgyal capatshacad zhethag bya ba/ 175rlo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/

tshe zad pa bsring ba'i cho ga rgyun gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ 177slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/shi ba'i sems can spyig pa las thar bar byed pa'i ro sreg pa'i cho ga dug sbyangs gsal ba'i rnge long zhes bya ba/ 178slob dpon chen ngo/ mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/mchod rten gdab pa shi ba'i sdog pa byang bar byed pa rang byung 'jigs 1thusgyur ces/ma /ma /ba/ 181dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/sems can tshe zad pa sring ba'i cho ga bsgrub pa pad+ma dbyig sgrub ces bya ba/ 182slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes ma dzad/dal 'byor chen mo'i sgrub pa bcud kyis len pa zhes bya ba/ 183slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/lan chags dang bral bar byed pa gtor ma'i las dpag bsam gyi sdong po /zhe/ma /rgya /ba/ 1zadatsho slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes ma dzad/longs spyod dang ldan par nges pa'i dpal tshogs kyi gtor ma rin po che /spothab/thag 13pa cesabs (1 tshob/ 185slo ba dngo na ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/phun sum tshogs pa'i las nye bar sgrub par byed pa las tshogs stong rgyas zhe/ma bya /ba/ 1ma (3slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes ma/dzad/'jig rten kyi lha mnyes nga/ra byed pa don grub pa zhes bya ba/ 187dpa/la mar me mdzad bzang ngo/sa ma/dzad/skye bo sdang ba'i las myur byed chen mo zhes bya ba/ 189slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes ma/dzad/gzhan gyi lce 'bab pa bzlog pa zhes bya ba/ 1909

slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/rwasdong ba ba/sdosaskyab bye) 'bas 11zab sdo// 190slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/bran dang bza' mi gdon gyis gtses pa bsrung ba'i cho ga chen mo zhes bya ba/191slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/mi mthun pa zhi bar byed pa'i rtsi spyor dbyig gi nor bu zhes bya ba/ 192slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/nor 'grib pa dgang ba'i cho ga dpag bsam shing rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ 193slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/tshogs bdag gi sgrub pa dbul ba'i gter sbyin zhes bya ba/ 195dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad/'jigs pa brgyad las thar ba'i sgrub pa sbas pa'i ga'u zhes bya ba/ 196slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/gza' ngan pa bzlog pa'i cho ga rgya mtsho sprin zhes bya ba/ 197dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad/gza'i gdon las gol bar byed pa'i cho ga rin po che grol byed ces bya ba/ 200dpal mar me mdzad bzang ngo/sa mdzad/gza' brgyad kyi las ma grub nga/ rnams grub par byed pa'i cho ga 'dod pa pa /ba /bye /de thab /no25 /bya/ /ba/ 201dpal mar me mdzad bzang ngo/sa mdzad/rgyu skar ngan pa zlog par byed pa'i cho ga 202dpal mar me mdzad bzang ngo/sa mdzad/rgyu skar rnams kyi las sna tshogs pa sgrub par byed pa dus 'dzin bzang po /de/ma /byu /ba/ rten1nga dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad/byad stems thams cad gcod pa dang phur kha thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir badresag pa6) sha /duzab mkhye 6)bsgyu byu1 ba/ 212/0

slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/klu chen po brgyad mchod pas mi bzad pa'i nad yams drag po las thar /bshā pa /sgoḥd /ba/ rten1tshonadapal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad/klu sgrub rin po che dbyig sgrub ces bya ba/ 216dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/klu'i gdon las grol bar byed pa sbrul 'dzin bsang ba zhes bya ba/ 217dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad/klu'i gdon las thar bar byed pa'i las klu'i srog me dbal gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba klu'i rnam par 'joms pa'i snying gzer du bkod pa/ 221slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad/mi bzad pa'i nad zhi bar byed pa gser gyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ 224slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/tshe 'phel ba'i sgrub thabs rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo zhes bya ba/ 224slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/bsod nams 'phel bar byed pa'i dpal ye shes kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 228slo ba dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/—sde thabab /ba/re (sdecas /ba/ 230sgra la gnas pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba/ 230slo ba dpon chen ngo dpal mar me mdzad bzang ngo/sa mdzad/sgra la mi gnas pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba rnal 'byor pa'i 'khor rkyen drugapa thab cadathag pa mdocad nga / 235slob dpon chen po dpa/la mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad/sgra mthar gyis rnal 'byor pa'i lus sems kyi 'brel ba gcad pa/ 240slob dpon chen po dpa/la mar me ma/dzad 11

—bzang pos mdzad/rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i them yig gsang ba zhes bya ba/ 246slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(251) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(269)1754 khro bo rgyal po rdo rje gnam lcag 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs klu 'dul ba'i ngan thabs/ 270bsnyen pa'i le'u/ 270thun gyi le'u/ 273'byung po'i le'u/ 274mchod pa'i le'u/ 275char gyi le'u/ 276ser ba'i le'u/ 276dgra'i le'u/ 276bsrung ba'i le'u/ 276sngags kyi le'u/ 277rgya gar kyi bla ma mi tri pa sa mdzad/bsdur mchan/(277) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(278)1755 khro bo rgyal po rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'amathozang bye) ཿdza ga 279sngon du bsnyen pa/ 279sa blang ba'i rim pa 280sa gzung ba'i rim nga/ 280/2

lha lhag par gnas pa'i rim pa 281bum nga/ lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga 282slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i rim pa 283thig gdab pa'i rim pa 284dkyil 'khor bri zhing phyag rgya dgod pa'i rim pa 285bum pa dgod pa'i rim pa/ ༷ 287/byen byesabaka 1go ཿdza ga ༷ 287mchod pa'i rdzas kyi rim pa/ 287zugaḥdzad pa6) 1sdem pa 288gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa 288slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 290/je/ma kyi cho ga rten9ba'irgya gar gyi slo ba dngo/na chen po bla ma mi tri pas mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta bal po de ba pur+ṇa ma ti dang /bod kyi 'o/ tsā ba mgar chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(296) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(297)1756 gshin rje gshed po sgrub pa'i thabs 298rgya gar gyi mkhan ngo dī rnga/ la ra shrī dzñā na dang / lo tsā ba dbe slo nga tshu' lngams rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(300) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(301)1757 rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ 30213

slob dpon tsā gārdzu nas mdzad/dge slo nga ba ris bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(307) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(307)1758 rta mtha1)na 4) (1ba thabab cesab/ byu1 ba 308rgya gar bā rā ṇa sī'i paṇ+ḍi pu ru khot+ta ma'i zhal snga nas mnyan te/ lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slo nga nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(310) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(310)1759 ṭa/ cas1)bya/ 3) (1ba thang/ba stugab rngam nga// 311slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad/rgya gar yul bā rā ṇa sī'i paṇ+ḍi ta pu ru khot+ta ma'i zhal snga nas mnyan te/ lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang ngo/sa bla ma dam pa'i bkas legs par bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(312) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(312)1760 ṭa/ 3411zug bye) (1ngab tha pasab cesab (1 ngab/ 313paṇ+ḍi ta pra bhā ka ras mdzad/rgya gar yul ba rā ṇa sī'i paṇ+ḍi ta pu ru khot+ta ma'i zhal snga nas legs par mnyan te/lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpa/la bzang ngo/sa bla ma dam pa'i bsas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(317) bsnyur 'bras re'u mig(317)1 1

1761 'phags pa rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 318rlo ba dngo/na dpa/la mar me mdzad ye thes kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(325) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(326)1762 pa/pa/95 —1 6511zug byi) (1ngab tha ngabasag 327slo ba dngo/na chen ngo/ dpa/la ma/ra me ma/dzad ye shes kyis mdzad/bsdur mchan/(229) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(330)1763 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 331bla ma gser gling pas mdzad/slo ba dpon dī paṃ la ra shrī dzñā nas rang 'gyur du mdzad nas/ dache slo nga dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la gnang /bsdur mchan/(339) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(340)1764 khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa mi g.yo ba la bstod pa/ 341paṇ+ḍi ta dī paṃ/ la ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad/pa/ṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang lo tsā ba dge slo nga tshu' khrim/sa rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(343) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(343)1765 khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa mi g.yo ba la bstod pa/ 344slob dngo/na chen ngo dpa nga mar me mdzad ye shes kyis ma/dzad/15

rgyar gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang /lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(347) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(347)1766 /go byebyecad bka/1cab 11:re (1ngab tha ngababag 342slo ba dngo/na pra bhā ka ra tīrtis mdzad/sbyin pa/ tshul khrims kyis rang 'gyur ma/dzad/bsdur mchan/(352) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(352)1767 khro bo gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 353rlo ba dngo/na dze tā ri dgra las rnam/ par rgyal bas mdzad/pa/ṇ+ḍi ta su na ya shrī dang / lo tsā ba glog skya gzhon nu 'bar gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(355) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(355)1768 gtum po dkar po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ 356rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta rā na shrī las rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(358) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(358)17(‘9 parabakubakab pa/ :) bkamyos ngasaḍire (1ngas tha ngabathag 359rgya gar shar phyogs kyi pa/ṇ+ḍi ta chen po dā na shī las rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(36༷) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(361)1770 legs par grub par byed pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs basbus pa/ 262slo ba dngo/na byang chub mchog gis mdzad/16

༄/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'gor gyi lag len go rims jo lta ba zhes bya ba/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra nā ma dha ra ṇi maṇ+ḍa la pra kṛ rīya ya thā kra ma nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lag len go rims ji lta ba zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i cho gas rang ngam 'gro ba gzhan gyi gdon dang nad rnams las grol bar 'dod pa'i rdo rje rigs kyi sgrub pa pos phyugs lhas sam—/ shing gcig dang lha khang ngam/ lam gyi bzhi mdo'am/ khang stong ngam nags tshal gang yang rung / bsam gtan gyi khang par chag chag dang ba'i rnam lnga dang / spos dri zhim pos byug ris byas la/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa thams cad rdzogs par bshams nas/ khrus dang 'thor 'thung dang nye reg byas te/ stod g.yogs dang / smad g.yogs gtsang zhing sar pa gon la/38—3

—phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ yungs kar lag tu thogs te/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ nas bin+dha bin+dha badz+ra dh+ri 1phaṭa ces pa'i bar du lan gsum mam bcu brjod do/ /de nas bum pa bca' ste/ gser dang dngul lam ma rnyed na zangs sam sa las byas kyang rung ste/ lto ba che la mgrin pa ring ba zhabs zhum pa kha yel 2ba/ nag po ra ri med pa/ grangs lha grangs dang mthun pa drug gam/ yang na bdun nam gcig kyang rung ste/ gu gul gyis bdugs pa dang / yungs kar gyis bgegs bzlog la/ der 'o ma dang chu nyung zad blugs pa der rin po che rnams dang / dri lnga dang / sman lnga dang 'bru lngas dgang la mgrin pa gos kyi shing las byung ba'i kha tshar phun tshar ma nyams pa'i mthing shun gyis kha bsgyur ba'am/ dkar po gsar zhing gtsang bas mgul pa bcings la/ me tog sngon po dang bcas pas kha brgyan la mgul pa ras kyi steng du yungs kar dang rtswa drur je ba nyag ma bdun dang bcas pa dri zhim po'i rizheme tog phreng bas 6bcings la/ mdud pa la hūṃ 5bris pa'i ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhung bas so/ /gdugs dang ba dan kyang ngo / /de nas maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du gzhag go/ /yang khrus dang 'thor 'thung nye reg byas la/ las kyi rdo rje dang /gsang gdub dang / gdu —bu'i cho ga rnams byas la/ der rang gi snying gar nyi ma la sa bon bltas 9pa des rigs gsum 'khor dang bcas pa dmigs la/bde bar gshegs pa dam pa'i chos/ /tshogs chen bcas la phyag 'tshal lo /gtum po phyag na rdo rje la/ /khyad par du yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid 'ong mchod rdzas ji snyed rnams/ /rigs gsum 'khor dang bcas la 'bul —bhe/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /da lta sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid du stsal 11dang yi 38——(/

rang ba/ /shin tu 'gyod pas bshags shing sdom/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis gang bgyis pa'i/ /dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /byang chub snying po 1nyer gnas te/ /gang yang byang chub mchog rtogs 2 pa'i/ /bdag gis gsol ba rgyal ba kun/ /'khor lo dam pa bskor du gsol/ /bya ba thams cad byas nas ni/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan 'da' ba rnams/ bdag gis gsol ba 1rgyal ba kun/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' gsol/ /phyag 'tshal la sogs bsod nams gang / /ji snyed bdag gis bgyis pa rnams/ /ji ltar mgon pos mkhyen pa ltar/ /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo'o/ /de nas rang gis 4rang ma rtogs pa stong par bsgomacho/ a ser pos gser gyi sa gzhir bsam/de'i steng du baṃ las 'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho bsam/ de nas sum̐ las ri rab/ de 6 steng du hūṃ 37las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bcas pa/dbus dang mtshams bzhir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi dang phyogs bzhi ni gri gug bzhis mtshan pa'o/ /de'i dbus su ram̐ las stong par song ba'i ngang las chos thams cad rdul dang bral ba'i sgra byung bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa khā na lā 8ya swā hā/de las sna tshogs rdo rje ngos gabyug med pa/ de las rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgur grub / sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni sku mdog ljang sngon yid tsam khro ba/ g.yas na rdo rje rgya gram la ngos gcig med pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon dkur brten cing 'gying ba/ mgul rgyan dang dbu brgyan 9la sogs pa dang ldan pa/stod g.yogs dar la smad g.yogs dang ⑫tshi gu can bsnams 11pa'o/ /oṃ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa ki li gī lā ya muswā hā/ oṃ tā 1 sa ya tā 2sa ya badz+ra ki li tī lā muya swā hā/oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra dha rā 9ya swā hā/ oṃ pra ha ra pra ha ra badz+ra pra bhañdza nā 1 ya swā hā 38—5

zhes pa las/ dbang ldan dang me dang srin po dang rlung rnams kyi 'khor lo'i steng du go rims bzhin du rdo rje gdengs pa dang / rdo rje ka na ka dang / rdo rje be+e con dang / rdo rje tho ba rnams so/ /de rnams la go rims bzhin du rdo rje gtum mo dang / rdo rje ki li tī la dang / rdo rje be+e con dang / rdo rje tho ba rnams kyi sgur grub po/ /khro bo rdo rje gtum po smug nag bzhin khro gnyer can/g.yas pa khro bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyar te thogs pa'o1/ /lha thams cad g.yon bstan nas 'gying ba'o/ /rjo rje ki li tī la ya mdog ljang nag khro gnyer can/g.yas na rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ rdo rje be+e con mthing nag khro gnyer can/ sma ra ser po can/ g.yas na be+e con gyi rtse mo rdo rjes mtshan pa/ rdo rje tho ba mdog nag po shin tu khro ba mche ba gabyugs pa/ g.yas na rdo rje tho ba thogs pa'o/ /de nas mchod yon lag tu thogs te/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs khro rgyal rnams/ /bdag la —mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bir+ya dha ra swā hā zhes pas mchod yon gyis spyan drangs la rang la bstems la/ phyag rgya gsum gyis rgyas gdab ste/ gong ma'i sngags lnga byebarjod cing lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar la srin lag gnyis nang du bkug la phan tshun bsnol ba'i rtse mo mdzub mo'i drung du cung zad byung bar byas la/ gung mo gshibs pa'i phyi rol nas mdzub mo gnyis bkug ste/ bar nas gang tsam gyis ma reg par byas la/mje bong gnyis gshibs pa ni rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi'o/ /g.yon pa ni sdogs mdzub snying gar bzhag pa/ g.yas pa sor mo gsum bsgreng la mje chung gi zhe sen mo mjeb mos mnan pa'o/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur nang du bcings la/38—6

cung zad bsnol ba'i tshul du bcug ste/ mthe bong gnyis gyen du gshibs la bsgreng ngo / /lag pa thal mo phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo sbyar ba las/ mthe bong gnyis bsgreng ste tshigs tshu/pa bkug nas srin lag gi drung du gzugs so/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs te mthe bong gnyis bsgrengs3/ mthe'u chung gnyis nang du gzhug go/ / snyephyag rgya chen po rnams gong ma bzhin bsgoms pas rgyas gdab / de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ de nas hūṃ cholas rin po che'i thubum pa la nang 'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho las pad+ma 'khrungs par bsams la pad+ma'i steng du zla bathu/ de'i steng du sngags lngas lha lnga bskyed la ye shes kyi lha rnams mchod yon gyis sbyan drangs la bstem tsu / phyag rgya gsum gyis rgyas btab nas mchod bstod byas la/ bum pa'i steng du bzhag la/ de la gzungs thag btags la/rang dang lha'i thugs kar sngar gyi sngags lnga po gang zlos ཿpa gsal bar dmigs la/phreng ba snyim par bcug la gzungs thag nas bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra a ts+tshan+dha 9ye swā hā zhes brjod la phreng ba lag pa g.yas pas bzung la so so'i sngags bzlas pas yi ge phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas ye shes sems dpa' mnyes shing bum par ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis khengs par bsam/ thun re la glal dang dz+red pa gsang sbubs la sogs pa spangs la ma yengs par 'dzab tu dbul lo/ /glal la sogs byung na khrus sogs byas la bzlas pa bskyar/ yang na kun la thun mong du yang snying thun re la brgya rtsa brgyad dam ji ltar nus pa dbul/ de nas mchod bstod byas la/ phyi rol du dpung bzangs las 'byung ba bzhin gtor ma btang la/lus ngag gi kun spyod bya/ thun gnyis phan chod la 1 rang khrus sogs byas la mchod bstod bzlas pa bya'o/ /thun tha ma la mchod bstod gtor ma btang ba'i 38—7

rjes la bzod par gsol la/ slar yang bdag la nges par ni/ /rjes su bzung bar mdzad nas kyang / /mgon po rig dang sngags bcas pas ci bde bar ni gshegs su gsol/ /zhes thabs kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/khro bo bzhi bo rang la bsdu/ rang bdud rtsi 'khyil par bsgyur la nyal/ yang tho rangs khrus dang 'thor 'thung nye reg dang las kyi rdo rje cho ga nas bzung la thams cad sngar bzhin byas la/ me long gi ngos ltar mnyam pa la rnam lnga dang dri zhim pos byugs la sa gzung 77bya'o/ /de nas khrus dang 'thor 'thung nye reg byas la/sa gzung nyi ma nas brtsams te/ /slob ma dkyil 'khor 'jug gi bar/ /slob dpon rtogs par 'jug par bya/ /dri dang bcas pa'i zas bza' zhing / /zhes gsungs pas/ smyung 2ba la gnas pa'am/ yang dkar gsum la dris bsgos pa nyung zad tsam bza'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi dbus sam nub phyogs su ku sha'i stan la 'dug ste/ lha drug gi sgo nas rang lha lngar bskyed cing ye shes bcug nas rgya gsum gyis btab pa la/ shar phyogs nas slob ma'am yon gyi bdag pos khrus la sogs pa byas nas gos gtsang zhing gsar pa gon la me tog gi phreng ba dri zhim pos bsgos pa lag tu thogs la tsog pur 'dug ste/ mdo sde dam pa mnyan par bya/ /mdo sde 'di yi gzi brjid kyis/ /srog chags 'byung po thams cad kyi/ /mi bzad pa yi nad rnams kyang / /de dag thams cad zhi bar blta/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ /de bas rdo rje rigs mchog gis / /rnam 'joms dkyil 'khor bshad du gsol/ /zhes dang ba'i dad pa dang ldan pas lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas sngags 'chang 'greng choste/ rang gi lha'i 'khor lo nam 38—8

mkha' la bteg la/ rang bdud rtsi 'khyil par bsgyur la/ mig la hūṃ bkod la nyi zla 'bar bar bya zhing / rkang pa gnyis su hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje kha gyes par bsams la/ se gol gyi sgra brdabs shing khro bo'i lta bas phyogs mtshams thams cad lta nyuzhing rdo rje lan gsum du gsor la/ e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs rje can gyi thabs chen de/ /zhi yang sems can gdul don du//dri ma med pa'i khro bor gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das 2bdud rtsi 'khyel pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags ring 1brjod do / /de nas seng ldeng gi phur bu stod bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnam pa la smad zur gsum par 'dug pa la / na ma thurat+na tra yā ya nas/ kro dha kro dha ki li 1 khā shiya swā hā zhes bya ba'i bar lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gam brgya rtsa brgyad dam ma nus na lan gsum btab la/dbus dang mtshams bzhir gdab/ cod pan dang tsan+dan dmar pos thig le gsum dang gu gul dang / yungs kar dang / dri sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang / dbu'i gtsug tor rnams rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas brtan ma lhag gnas bya ste/ g.yas pa'i srin lag gi 7haṃ gis bkug la/ dri sngon du song ba'i rnam lngas mchod la/ spos thogs la/ skyob pa sangs rgyas la sogs kyis/ /mkhyen pa gsol ba lan gsum bya/ /de nas lha lnga'i sa dang / phyogs skyong gi gnas su dri'i thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu byas la lha lnga nam mkha' nas phab la bzhugs su gsol/ phyogs skyong rnams yid tsam mam/ yang na/ ri rgyal gnya' shing 'dzin gyi tshul lto nas/ /phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal—/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i be+ed du spyan 'dren na/ /log 'dren gzhom pa'i slad du 'dir gshegs shig /e bye hi da sha lo ka sa pa ri bā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ 38—9

zhes brjod do/ /de nas mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod cing bstod pa kun gyis kyang bstod la/ bum pa gtsang ma hūṃ'adir bca' zhing bum pa la mchod la/brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyi shu rtsa gcig tu snga ma bzhin du bzlas so/ /yon bdag dang slob ma yang khrus la sogs pa 3byed du bcug la/ gsum la skyabs 'gro sbyin / gtor ma btang la pus mo g.yas pa btsugs kye la/ dril bu gsil zhing —rdo rje dang 5spos thogs la/ rdo rje rnam 'joms bcom ldan 'das/ /rig 9sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rig rgyal khro bo'i tshogs rnams dang / /gang yang gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba mthu chen rnams/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba'i sbug bsngal bsal ba'i phyir/ /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byor pas 'dri hūṃn/ /khyod kyis gnang ri sna ba mdzad pa dang / /las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ nyi ma 'char ka sngags 'chang g.yog dang bcas pa thig ji lta ba bzhin du bsgrubs tsu la ye shes kyi thig dang las kyi thig dang / kun la slob dpon kha nub tu lta ba lhag ma'o / /seng ldeng gi phur bus dbus su btab la/ srad bu brtod sde pas bskor phyogs su/ rnam 'joms kyi gnas cha chen gcig la bskor/ mu khyud cha bran lnga pa bskor/ de nas lha snam 7la thug pa la 'khor lo'i mu khyud cha bran gnyis bskor/ de nas phyi rol rdo rje ra ba dang me ri rta babs kyi phyi rol du cha bran gnyis gnyis la bskor/ de nas 'grus thig btab la 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i 1 thig btab/ phyogs bzhir gri gug re bya/ de nas tshon bsgrubs la/phyogs tshon la shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus 38—10

mthing / 'khor lo bzhi dang gri gug sngo skya/ pad+ma rā ga dang por sngo/ de'i phyi rol ljang / de'i phyi rol dmar/ de'i phyi rol ser/ kun gyi phyi rol dkar po/ de nas 'khor lo'i dbus dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re bris tshol/ dbus su 5rdo rje rgya gram ljang sngon la ngos gcig med pa bri ༄ / byang shar gyi rtsibs la rdo rje rtse lnga pa smug nag /shar lho'i rtsibs la rdo rje rtse gcig pa ljang nag /lho nub kyi rtsibs la be+e con mthing nag /nub byang gi rtsibs la tho ba nag po bri/ 'khor lo'i mu khyud dkar po la/ gru chad ljang gu la bum pa bri/ lha'i snam gibur phyogs skyong dgod/ /de yang gsang ba'i spyi rgyud las/ /brgya byin gyi ni rdo rjer gsungs/ /me lha'i phyag mtshan me thab yin//gshin rje yi ni be+e con te/ /bden bral kyi ni ral gri ste/ /chu bdag gi ni zhags par bya/ /rlung lha'i phyag mtshan rgyal mtshan yinalta/ /ku be+e ra yi ༄ dbyug sngon no/ /dbang phyug gi ni tri shul3/ sa yi lha mo bum pa'o/ /nyi zla'i phyag mtshan de nyid do/ /de rnams gdan byas pa'i steng du dgod par bya'o/ /de nas sgo bzhir nub kyi sgor dpal be'u dang 'khor lo/ byang gi sgor gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ shar gyi sgor pad+ma dang bum pa/ lho'i sgor dung dang nya bri/ de nas rta babs la sogs sdogs par ro/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gnas ba'i rnam lnga dang dri zhim pos nye bar byugs la/ bla re dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / lhab lhub kyis dkyil 'khor gyi gnas brgyan cing / me tog sil ma gtor zhing mchod pa'i yan lag thams cad bshams la dra phur bres la/ de nas sngags 'chang bdag nyid khrus la sogs pa thams cad la / nub sgor rtsa 8ku sha'i stan la 'dug la/ las kyi rdo rje'i cho ga dang 38—11

gsang gdub dang gdu bu'i cho ga rnams byas la maṇ+ḍal blang la mtshan ma dang sta gon gyi lha bsres la/ me tog sngon po'i phreng ba thogs la rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na lā —kyiya swā hā zhes brjod cing lan gsum gsum bskor ba byas la/ me tog rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi dbu la phul/ slar rang gi mgo la bcings la/ nub sgor 'greng la khro bo'i bstod pa btang la/ bgegs tsol la zhig sngon kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ dngos grub kyi bar chad rtsom pa/ rig pa'i rgyal po drag po'i kyerdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal pa bdun du 'gas so zhes brjod cing / a mo gha badz+ra/ oṃ bye hi gebadz+ra zhes pa nas badz+ra rā ga dz+wa lā phyaya swā hā'i bar du lan cig brjod pas mtshams bcad/de nas sngags 'chang nub sgor ku sha'i gdan nyid la bsdad la/ dril bu gsil dzi7zhing spos snod thogs la/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i bdud khams thams cad bsregs/ /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad 'joms/ /log 'dren srin po ma lus gdul ba yin7/ /dpa' bo dpa' mtshan stag lpags zlon pa gsol/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so sna'atshal / /log 'dren 'joms pa'i slad du spyan 'dren gyis/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra bi dā ra ma hā kro dha sa pa ri bā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes/ brjod/ de nas mchod yon phul la/ dam tshig la ye shes gzhug pa ni ma tisbri ra badz+ra/ shu 1 tisbri ra badz+ra/ pra tisbi ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra/a pra ti ha ta badz+ra zhes pas bzhugs su gsol/ de nas dam tshig chen po de'i phyag rgya bstan te/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mje bong mje'u chung mnan la lhag ma rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i tshul du bsgreng ba'o/ /oṃ shaṃ ka re ma hā sa ma ye swā hā zhes 38—/2

brjod pa ni dam tshig chen po'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya gsum gyis gdab/ de nas bum pa sngar bzhin bzlas la gzhug go/ /dam tshig gso ste lag pa gnyis rgyab tu thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul du byas la mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis so sor 'khyud la lte ba'i thad kar bzhag la/ oṃ badzod bha ba ya swā hā zhes brjod pa rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig bskang zhing gso ba'o/ /sgu khrus gsol/mchod yon phul/ dri sngon du 'go bas kyesnarnam lnga dbul/ 'dod yon dang rin po che sna bdun dang / 'phra mchod dbul/ de nas bstod de/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong ste/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i 2'jigs byed skur ston pa/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra/ /ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha yi ye shes rol pas rab ston cing / /bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha mang po phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen sna tshogs 'joms mdzad pa/ /dug sbrul rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod / /hūṃ gtum chen 'bar ba bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /khro gnyer glog stong 'od zer 'gyur 4ba bzhin/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong bzhin du sgrogs/ /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod / /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong 5dkyil nas/ /dpa' bo'i stong 6stabs brkyang bsgum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'ba' ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung sreg )par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod / /de nas dpung bzangs nas 'byung ba bzhin/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi 8 lha tshogs bcas/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang / dbang 38—13

bo rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /zhes pa la sogs kyis phyogs skyong la gtor ma dang bstod pa bya/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas la sogs kyis 'byung po'i gtor ma btang / de nas gang zag de khrus dang 'thor 'thung dang nye reg byed du bcug la gos gtsang ma gon du bcug /dkyil 'khor dang sngags 'chang gnyis la phyag byed du bcug la/ lag tu me tog gi phreng ba dang bcas pas/rig 1sngags 'chang chen dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal las thar phyir / /rdo rje 'dzin de 'khor bcas la/ /bdag ni gus pas thuskyabs su mchi/ /zhes lan gsum du brjod do/ /de nas sngags 'chang gis dkyil 'khor gye lha la bstod par bya ste/ ji ltar sngon tshe bde gshegs pho brang du/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir rdo rje can gyis ni/ /rjes mthun phrin las khyad par gang bsgo ba/ /dam bcas phrin las de ni grub par mdzod/ /de slad bgegs dang log 'dren tshar bcad ltar/ /'gro ba nyam thag 'di ni gzung ba'i phyir/ /sbug bsngal nges bsal bde mchog la sbya ra ba'i/ /khro rgyal khyed kyis deng 'dir byin brlabs gsol / /de nas 'gro ba de rtswa ku sha'i steng du bzhag la/ gdug pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad de/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya nas hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar du brjod/ de nas las bum gyis bkru zhing / /sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ /zhes pa nas / sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ /zhes pa'i bar du khrus kyi phan yon brjod cing bkru'o/ /de nas khrus sa'i stegs bu khru ri —gsum pa la khru do stong par dbang 4su bzhag la khru phyed lha snam 5la phyogs skyong rnams bkod la/ khru gang la rta babs med pa'i sgo bzhi bris te/ dbus su rtswa ku sha bting bar 'gro ba der bzhag pa'am/ khrus sa'i stegs bu ma 'byer na/ dkyil 'khor kyi lha lnga 38—1 1

bum par yid kyis spyan drangs la/ rma bya'i sgro la sogs pa mtshan ma lnga pos 1snaphyis la/ der 4rtswa ku sha'am ras dkar po bting la/ 'gro ba der bzhag la bum pa rnams thogs te/ gang la ser sna rnams chags pa'i/ /rnam 'joms dri med mdzad pa yi/ /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ /khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du sdud mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ /khyod 4la bde legs byed par 'gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang gis bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ /khyed la bde legs byed par 'gyur/ /skyob pa gang gis byams pa yi/ /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /kha 5 gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang gis 'khor bar 6'khor ba yi/ /sems can kun kyi rten gyur cing / /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ /spyod la bde legs byed par 'gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /brgya byin bcas pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po kun kyi bde legs ni/ /khyed la rtag tu byin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyis bsams pa yis/ /spyod kyi 'dod 'dod dzogang yin pa/ /don de de ring 'grub gyur 3cig /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shog /ces brjod la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya nas na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa tsuye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā ba ta ye/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na lā /1ya shārnyi ku ru swā hā zhes khro bo bzhi'i sngags dang 'bru spel la bkru/ spyig pa dang nad dang gdon la 38—15

sogs pa dag par bsams la/ shar sgo nas bton la gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba byen la snying gar rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi phyag mtshan bskyed cing bcug la bzhag /de nas slob ma rdo rje'i rwa la 1'dzin du bcug la/ ya gcig nas slob dpon gyis bzung la/ 'gro ba 'di la nga yis bsrungs 2zin gyis/ /da ni 'di la sus kyang gnod ma byed/ /gal te 'di la gnod pa byas gyur na/ /mgo bo tshal ba brgyar ni 'gas par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod la srung ba'i 'khor lo 'am srung 5sgud gdags/ nyi ma gza' las grol ba bzhin du che ge mo 'di yang nad dang gdon la sogs pa las krol bar gyur cig /rgyal bar gyur cig /mang du brjod cing rol mo mang du yang rdung 6du gzhug go/ /de nas ras dkar po gtsang ma'i steng du bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams bzhag ste/ yungs kar dang /drur 7ba dang / bil ba dang / gi wang dang / li khri dang / zho dang /me long dang / dung g.yas su 'khyel ba dang brgyad 8byin te/ yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa'o / /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs 'gyur bar/ /bkra shis des kyang thams cad zhi bar shog /drur ⑩bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa nyu ste/ rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe ni 'phel bar shog /bil bas rgyu rkyen 'bras bur gyur pa'i chos / /'jig rten pa las 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang mchog tu grub gyur cig /gi wang dug gsum 'joms pa'i nad kyi sman/ /chos kyi chos nyid rab tu rtogs nas ni//nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang sbug bsngal bral 38—16

gyur cig /li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus nas kyang / /chos kyi rgyal srid rab brtan gyur pa ste/ /bkra shis des kyang khyod srid brtan gyur cig /zho ni kun gye snying por gyur pas na/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs nas/ /yon tan chos kyi dbyings su gyur pa yi / /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi bar shog /me long ye shes chen po'i rgya mtsho yis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu 1snabadag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang deng khyod dga' gyur cig /dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du bdag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma lus yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /ces blangs la slob ma la sbyin no/ /de ma 'byor na dkar gsum tsam mam 'bras chan 2la bkra shis brjod la sbyin/ slob mas kyang 'byor tshad kyis mchod sbyin bya/ de nas slar bum pa'i lha dang dkyil 'khor dang bum pa'i lha la gang yang bdag blo gti mug la sogs kyis bshags/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /la sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la bsdus la rang bdud rtsi 'khyil par bya'o/ /de nas chos thams cad ni gdod ma nas dag pa'o/ /rang bzhin gyis zhi ba'o zhes brjod cing rdul tshon phyags la bum pa dang / dman pa rnams chu bo'am gnas mthon por bskyal lo/ /dam pa rnams kyi gzhung bzung nas/ /sna tshogs rgyud la rab brtan te/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga ldan pa yi/ /khrus kyi cho ga brtsams pa las/ /dri med dge ba gang thob des/ /'gro kun sbug bsngal zhi nas kyang / /lam mchog rnams la zhugs gyur cig /rig 4 38—17

sngags 'chang gi slob dpon rat+na shī las mdzad pa'i rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga gzhan la phan par byed dzo7 pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra bo 3dhi dang / lo tsā ba tshul dge rin chen gyis bsgyur ba'o// //brngur mchan/3 —1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i ma/tshan bod skad du smos pa ltar brkod/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kri/ de〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na—/ je〈〈pe ༄/ /rdo rje rjam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/—1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa 2 dhā ra bhā sā dha nā ma/bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi shigs kun 'joms rdo rje 'dzin/ /khros shing gtum pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /rdo rje yon tan rdzogs btud de/ /de nyid bsgrub pa'i rim pa bshad/ /dad brtan g.yo dang nga rgyal med/ /ser sna chung zhing bla mar 4gus/ /'di la lhag par che dad pas/ /bsgrub 5pa 'di 'bad bde legs shog /dang por yid 'ong phyogs su yang / /'gro ba bsgral ba'i bsam pa yis/ /rtag tu 'di la brtson par bya/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod dang gtor ma dang / /las dang po yi 6 rnal 'byor pas/ /dmigs pa'i rten kyang — bri bar bya/ /rang nyid phyi nang khrus byas te/ /khyad par du ni lus kyi khrus/ /dri yi chu yis rtag tu bya/ /bde 38—20

ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /rang nyid zla ba sa bon bsam/ /de yi 'od kyis lkubla ma sogs/ /nam mkha'i phyogs su dmigs nas ni/ /byin gyis brlab 37 par gsol ba gdab༄ / /de nas sems can thams cad la/ /lhag par byams pa bskyed par bya/ /de bzhin snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms tshul bzhin bsgom par bya/ /de rjes rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsgom par bya/ /de la cung zad dmigs nas ni/ /rnam par rngurtog par ldang bar bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa mi dmigs kyang / /sngags kyi sgra ru bsgom kye/par bya/ /de rjes rang gi shes pa ni/ /sngags kyi phreng bar bsgom par bya/ /gsung gi rnam par rdzogs pa yi/ /phra zhing gsal pa'i rnam par ro/ /de nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de/ /gsal zhing cha ma 'dres par bsam/ /de yi 'od kyis tre'agro ba rnams/ /rnam par 'joms pa skyebyas nas ni/ /tshur la bsnyu ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /rang snying rnam par 'joms par bsgom—/ /zhabs gnyis chu 'dzin dag la ni/ /g.yon brkyang bas ni rnam par bzhugs9/ /sku ni in+d+ra m+bi la dang / /rdo rje snying po dang yang mtshungs/ /mche ba rnam par gcigs pa ste/ /spyan dmar dpral ba khro gnyer can/ /mgo skyes dmar ser gyen 'greng ba/ /gsus pa che zhing sbrul gyis brgyan/ /smad ni ba ti mnabs pa 9ste/ /sgu stod dar la yis dkris pa/ /rin po che yi dpung 1 2rgyan can/ /rang gi bdag po dbu la gnas/ /g.yas pa rgya gram phyogs gsum bsnams / /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub thugs kar 'dzin/ /sra zhing mkhregs pa'i sku dang ldan/ /'ja' ltar gsal ba'i bdag nyid du/ /bdag nyid rtag tu bsam par bya/ /dam tshig phyag rgya bcing bar bya/ /sngags 'dis byin gyis 38—21

brlab bya zhing / /gnas lnga dag tu gtug 1par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na lā snyeya swā hā/ de nas rang mdog phyag mtshan dang / /blo yis gsal bar bsgom par bya / /gsal ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du/ /bdag nyid rtag tu bsam par bya/ /de las skyo na sngags bzlas pa/ /de ni phyi dang nang gi'o/ /de la nang gi bshad bya ste/ /rang nyid zla ba rang sa bon/ /de yi mtha' ma gsang sngags rgyal/ /mu tig 'ja' dang mar me ltar/ /rnam pa de ldan zla bar bsgom/ /de la cung zhig dmigs nas ni/ /yang ni gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas/ /de dag ni na mo rat+na tra yā ya zhes pa nas/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'i bar du'o/ /de ni sgra dang bcas pa'o/ /rang snying khro bo'i tshogs spros te/ /kun kyang gsang sngags rgyal po zlos4/ /sngags kyi 'brug gi sgra dang bcas/ /phyogs rnams kun du rnam par spro/ /gdug pa can rnams bsdigs par mdzad/ /de bzhin spyo zhing bsdu ba ni/ /mtshon cha'i 'khor lo drag spyod la/ /zhi la 'od zer dkar po ste//dbang la lcags kyu dmar po'o/ /rgyas pa la ni ser po ste/ /de ltar las dang rjes mthun par/ /'od zer dag kyang spro bar bya/ /phyi ni nam mkha'i zla dkyil du/ /yi ge'i phreng ba bsam 5byas te/ /rgyud las ji skad bshad pa bzhin / /sgra la gnas pa'i bsam gtan bya/ /de ltar bsam gtan 'bum gyi bar/ /sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa rdzogs nas ni/ /las rnams kun du spyad par bya/ /de dag rab tu bshad pa rgo/ /rig sngags bcad dang bcing ba dang / /phur bus gdab cing mnan par 6bya/ /de bzhin nor sogs rgyas pa dang / /sdig sogs 7zhi dang dbang du bya/ /de la dbang du bya ba ni/ /byi ru dmar 'dra'i sa gzhi la/ /mo yi pad+ma'i dbyibs 38—22

'dra ba'i// /thab khung dag ni bca' zhing bsam/ /de nas star bu'i me bus te//me yi lha ni bdag po nyid/ /dmar po lcags kyu thogs bsams nas/ /mngon byas nas ni 'od zer spro/ /gsang sngags mjug 1la las mthun gdags/ /star bu'i 'bru dang me tog dmar/ /phub ma dag be+e brgya stong sreg3 /de yis gang 'dod de bzhin no/ /pad ltar dkar ba'i sa gzhi la/ /zla rgyas 'dra ba'i thab khung du/ /tsan+dan dkar po'i me sbar te/ /rang lha dkar po bdud rtsir ldan/ /de la skad cig dmigs byas la/ /tsan+dan dkar po'i 'o ma sbags //de bzhin dkar po'i rdzas rnams la/ /de bzhin yang ni sngags bzlas te/ /ji tsam nus pa'i sbyin sreg bya/ /sa gzhi ser zhing 'phos pa na/ /dbang chen lta bu'i dbyibs su bya/ /mkhas pas thab —ni bca' bya zhing / /star ka a ru ra yi me/ /cho ga dang bcas sbar bya ste/ /'bras bur bcas pa'i yam shing la//de bzhin ba ru la sogs kyis/ /dbang chen la gnas bcom ldan 'das/ /gser mdog 'dra zhing dbang chen 'phro/ /de la sbyin sreg stong byas la/ /gang dag 'dod pa rgyas par bya/ /de dag las kyi rim pa ste/ /rang nyid bsnyen pa rdzogs pas su/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rjes dran bya/ /gang dag gdon gyis nyen pa yi/ /cho ga la sogs bshad par bya/ /dkyil 'khor legs par byas nas ni/ /bum pa rdzas 5sogs ldan par bri/ /gsang sngags brgya dang gcig bzlas te/ /bsgrub bya dkyil 'khor steng gzhag 6ste/ /de la khrus ni lan gsum bya/ /srung 7skud mdud pa gsum pa ni/ /dpung pa'am srin lag dag la bcing / /des ni grol bar the tshom med/ /'khor lo dag gis bsrung bya ni//rtsibs bzhi'i mtshams su mtshon char ldan/ /mu khyud me ri rdo rjes bskor/ /38—23

gur kum gi waṃ dag gis kye bris nas ni/ /snga dro cho ga ldan par bsrung bar bya/ /de ltar 'di ni bsrung ba'i rgyal po ste/ /'gro ba rnams la gsang sngags rgyal pos brlab / /de rgyud de dang gzhan las gsungs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa khā na lā 27ya swā hā/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa ki li tī khā snga/ya swā hā/ oṃ tā sa ya tā ④sa ya badz+ra ki li tī lā ya saswā hā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra dha rā 4ya swā hā/ oṃ pra ha ra pra ha ra badz+ra pra bhañdza nā ya muswā hā/ bsrung ba yi'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā 8 ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā rngupa ta ye/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ sarba byā byeshe /sarba be+esmyon31/ sarba dur swa sprunyurta/ sarba durmi ti/ sarba gra ho/ sarba dz+wa re/sar+pā kā la mṛ byu1 / sarba u pa dra be+e bh+yaḥ⑫/ sarba sha byepa/ sarba pā paṃ shārnyi 1 ku ru swā hā zhes khrus kyi'o/ /oṃ sarba puṣ+ṭa 1 ye puṣ+ṭi ku ru nyu7swā hā/rgyas pa'i'o/ /o badz+ra ba nyu shaṃ ku ru swā hā zhes dbang du bya'o/ /'di rnams las dang mthun pa'i sngags kha las kyang shes par bya'o/ /'di ni rdo rje rnam ༄ bye 'joms kyi sgrub 1thabs rgyud dang 'brel pa'i las dang bcas par shes par bya'o//gzhan yang 'dir ma bkod pa rnams bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /'di ni sgrub thabs kun gyi rgyal/ /rang sems mos pa'i rjes 'brel pa'i/ /rtog pa dang bcas sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rnal 'byor rnams la phan byed yin/ /'di byas bsod nams dri med pa/ /zla ba yar ngo bzhin du 'phel gyur pa'i/ /'gro rnams mos pa'i bye brag 'grub gyur te/ /rnam par 'joms pa'i sku 'grub shog /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs las dang bcas pa slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //38—24

bsdur mchan/2༷ hūṃmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / ra / /〈〈pe 〉〉rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giṇa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/(bya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ sgo) 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mang /21 nyu‘ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉kyi/ —k+ṣe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ tshokye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatab/ tsho 〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ thu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/ tre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ dza 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ | 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ riḍa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mthugs/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje'i/ skye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tis mnan pa/ 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dbu/22 gyo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bdug 3sna 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la na/ gru 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tha/ tsho 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabazlos/ pye/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsams/ 5 khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ridza 〈〈snar 〉〉so/23 lha 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jug kye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsreg —bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spag (bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thabs/rdoshe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ skye7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabazhag dza7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabasrung /24 ri3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngal/ ༄ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gikhā/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rol/ ri 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉〉tra sa ya/ sre 〈〈pe 〉〉la ya/〈〈snar 〉〉la yā/ sne 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉da ra/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉ñdza na ye/ sre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ shetsho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bya ti/ rke1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgyun/ tsha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉srasam ni/ 4k+ṣe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dza re/ sarba ka ya la smi du/ ske〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tre pe bya/ mu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyu/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sharnyi—/ tsho1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mthus ta/ (she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ye/ rteshe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bā/ tsho—— ne+e 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 par/( hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉sgrubs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrubs/38 —25
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1676)

pa'i khrus kyi cho ga1༄go/ /'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga /chos nyid mnyam pa nyid la rab gnas kyang / /thugs rjes gtan du mya ngan mi 'da' zhing / /'dod pa'i don grub mtha' yas gzugs mnga' ba/ /dpa' brtan rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la dang por bum pa'i mtshan nyid bstan ༄ pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ nor bu yungs kar drur kyeb dang / /rin chen rma med tsan+dan bcas/ /shel dang rdo rje'i 4me tog dang / /chu yi gser ram yang na ni/ /dngul gyi bum pa dag kyang rung / /gtsang ma'i gos kyis snyedakri zhing dgang / /zhes gsungs pas/ gser ram dngul lam zangs las byas kyang rung / zhabs kyi gdub kor ni 'phang du sor gcig gi tshad du byas la gdags so / /dbus kyi dbyibs ni lhung bzed 'dra bar bya'o/ /mgrin pa'i 'phang du so trebazhi'i tshad du bya'o/ /mgrin pa'i nang gi tshad kyang sor bzhi pa'i sbubs 38—27

su bya'o/ /mgrin pa'i kha khyer phyir skyed 1pa ni sor gnyis kyi tshad du byas la/kha'i cha ga'i bshal ka sor gabyug gi tshad du bya'o/ /dbul po rnams kyis snyedangul dang gser dang zangs kyel sogs pa las bya ba mi rnyed pas de'i phyir rgyu gzhan las 4bya bar gsungs te/ bum pa pad+ma dmar po'i mdog ltar dmar zhing byi ru dang li dza dang mtshal gyi mdog ltar dmar ba dang / so btang nyes 5 pa'i nag po ra ri med par bya'o/ /lhor rgo chu phul lnga yan chod nas bcu shong ba'i tshad gar nus pa'i tshad byas te/ de nas lag pa byug spos kyis byugs te/dri zhim po shin tu bkra shis pa'i bdug pas bdugs la/ gu gul la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa ces bdud rtsi thab 6spyor gyi sngags kyis lan bdun du bzlas pas bum pa'i nang du bdugs la/ chu gtsang ma srog chags med par btsags pas bkang ste/ de'i nang du tsan+dan dang ga pur dzadang / gur kum dang dzā ti dang /gla rtsi lnga po bsres pa'i chu yang blugs nas der rin po che lnga zhes bya ba nor bu rin po che dang / byi ru dang / gser sa le sbram dang / mu tig dang / shel dag dang / sman lnga zhes bya ba bya kṛ resnadang / sreng kri dang / gi bri kar ni dang / sa hā dang / sa ha de ba dang / 'bru lnga zhes bya ba nas dang / so ba dang / til dang / mon sran dang / mon sran gre 'u rnams kyang bcug la bum pa'i khar gser ram dngul phor ram khar 9phor gtsang ma'i nang du yungs kar blugs pa'i snod bzhag ste/ ras gtsang ma kha tshar ma god pas bum pa'i kha dang yungs kar gyi snod dang bcas pa dkri zhing g.yogs la babyungs te shā /mdud pa'i steng du ba'i lci bas 11rgyas gdab pa'i tshul du glan 12 la der rtswa drur nyu— ba'i nyag ma bdun btsugs te phyag na rdo rje la dbul bar 'os pa'i me tog dmar 38—28

po dri zhim po'am/ yang na me tog dri zhim po gang yang rung ba'i phreng bas kyang bum pa'i mgrin pa bskor ba'i don no/ /dkyil 'khor med par bum pa 'ba' zhig gis 'dod pa'i las mi 'grub pas thog mar dkyil 'khor bri nas brtag dgos pas/ spyi kyergyud dpung bzangs kyis — bhezhus pa las 'dir sbyar bar bya ste/phyugs lhas shing gcig 3lha yi khang pa 'am/ /lam gyi bzhi mdo'am lgo7 khang stong nags tshal du/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bstan pa yang de nyid las / dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham pa khru zhe7bzhi'i tshad/ /tshon rtsi rnam pa sna tshogs rnams kyis bri/ /phyogs kyi lha rnams gnas ni yongs su gzung 'u/ /sgo bzhi pa la phyogs kyi rtsa yang dgram/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang sa gzhi shin tu sbyangs riṭ+wāṃshin tu 'thas par bcags pa la ba'i kyernam lnga zhes bya bash+yi/ 'o ma dang / mar dang / zho dang / gcin dang / lci ba rnams dang /spos rnams bsres pa rnams kyis bskus la thig gdab par bya'o/ /khru ④bzhi'i tshad la gru /skyebazhi par byas la phur bus legs par gdab bo/ /de'i dbus su gsang sngags 'chang khrus byed pa'i sa khru do gzhag shāsnyego/ /de'i phyi rim khru gang gi rtse khyon yod pa la cha gsum du bgos te/ dang por 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi gnas su bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni sgo khyud dang /tre mu khyud mu tig gi phreng ba dag bri'o/ /gsum pa la ni mchod pa dag bri'o/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams dgod pa yang /spyi'i rgyud gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor las/ 'di skad du/ brgya byin gyi ni rdo rjer mugasungs/ /me lha'i phyag rgya me thab yin/ /gshin rje'i phyag rgya be+e con te//bden bral gyi ni ral grir bstan/ /chu bdag gi ni zhags par bstan/ /rlung gi phyag rgya rgyal mtshan yin/ /ku be ra yi dbyug to yin/ /dbang phyug gi ni rtse 38—29

gsum gsungs/ /sa yi phyag rgya bum pa yin/ /nyi zla'i phyag rgya zlum por bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dkyil 'khor ni sgo bzhir btod rapecing / bkra shis brgyad bo dpal be'u spudang / 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / pad+ma dang / bum pa dang / dung dang / nya dag bris pas mdzes par bya'o/ /dbus su ni ku sha bting /kyezhing phyi rol thog ④tu yang ku sha dgram mo/ /steng du yang bla res legs par dgab cing me tog gi phreng ba dang /ba dan dang / dar gyi lda ldi dang / me long gis brgyan na khrus kyi cho ga bkra shis par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bum pa yang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag ste/grwa bzhir seng sdeng gi phur pa bzhi la bdud rtsi thab byespyor gyi sngags gong du smos pa bzlas shing btsugs nas/ tshon sna lnga'i 2skud pa la yang gsang sngags de nyid bzlas shing bskor bas mtshams gcad ④par bya'o/ /bshos dang gtor ma bkod 2snapa yang / dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa'i rgyud las/ bza' dang sha chang la phug la sogs bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po'i gtor ma sbyin/ /zhes gsungs te/ ma phye ba yang 'os 'os su phye ste/ sha chang la phug dag ni gshin rje dang bden bral 'khor dang bcas pa la sbyin no/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang 9bdag nyid phyi nang gi dri ma dag par byas la/ gos sar pa bgos te/cho ga brtsams pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ des ni rab bkrus gtsang ma yis ⑪/ /mdo sde dam pa mnyan par bya/ /gang dag yid /nyadage sems dwangs shing shā nya/ /gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab brgyan te/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ /mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni rang gi rgyud dag par byed mude dkyil 'khor gyi nub sgor 'greng la/ lag pa byug spos kyis 38—30

byugs nas/ rang gi lha ji ltar gnas rikyipa bzhin du bsgoms la/ mig gnyis su yi ge hūṃ 'bar ba re bsams la se gol gyi sgra phyung zhing / phyogs su bltas pas mtshams bcad bgegs bskrad nas/ slar stan bde ba la 'dug nas dkyil 'khor de yang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i lha'i gnas bzang po dpe med par dmigs shing / bum pa de yang yid bzhin gyi rgya sa—mtsho'i bdud rtsi'i chus gang bar dmigs te/ lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las/kha phye ste pad+ma'i tshul du byas pa ni pad+ma'i grugadan gyi phyag rgya yin te/ de'i sngags la / oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ye swā hā zhes brjod nas yid bzhin gyi mtsho'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po dang lo ma dang 'dab ma dang ze ba dang / snying por bcas pa dpe med par bzang zhing che ba gcig thubasams te/ mchod yon gyi snod blangs la sgreng thuzhing 'di skad du/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ / tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /pya bdag gi mumachod yon bzhes su gsol/ /mchod yon bzhes nas de nyid du/ /mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ā ha ra ā ha ra/ sarba bir+ya dha ra pū dzi te swā hā zhes brjod pas 'phags pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs par rig pa dang / bar 'dir phyir 'byeng ba'i bgegs bskrad/ a mṛ tas bsang yang na rtsa sngags sam bskrad sngags kyis so/ /lag pa g.yas pa'i mje'u chung gi sen mo (5mthe bong gis 1mnan te/ lhag ma gsum nas do tsam gyis ma reg par byas te/ /rdo rje'i tshul du byas nas bstan pa ni dam tshig chen po'i phyag rgya yin te/ de'i sngags la/oṃ shaṃ ka re ma hā sa ma ye swā hā zhes brjod nas/ gdan de la 'phags pa khro bo'i rgyal po phyag na rdo rje'i thugs kyi khyad par las byung ba/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms bhe38—31

pa zhes bya ba mdog sngon po yid tsam khro ba/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje rgya gram las rwa phyogs gcig med pa bsams k+ṣepa/ phyag g.yon pa dkur shebarten cing 'gying ba/dbu rgyan rtse bran can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ na bza' stod g.yogs dar la smad g.yogs tshi gu can mnabs thupa/ 'khor rigs kyi lha dpag tu med pa dang gshegs par dmigs shing / rtsa ba'i phyag rgya lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar la srin lag gnyis nang du bkug ste/ phan tshun bsnol ba'i rtse mo mje bong dang mdzub mo'i drung du cung zad 'byung bar byas la/gung mo gshibs khyophyi rol nas mdzub mo bkug rngul nas gang tsam gyis ma reg par byas te/ mthe bong gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis kyang gshibs khu pa ni rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dz+wartsa ba'i phyag rgya las thams cad byed do/ /de'i sngags la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa khā na khā byeye swā hā/ de nas mchod pa rnam pa lnga rim bzhin du dbul ba nizhe/ / dang por byug spos dbul te/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i byug spos 'di/ /bdag gis sbyidad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba be+er+ya dha ra pū kyedzi te swā hā/ de nas me tog dbul te/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di/ /bdag gis ⑪dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /de nas bdug pa dbul te/ shing gi khu ba yid du 'ong / /dri yis rgyas pa bdug pa'i mchog /bdag gis shā1dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /lha 7 —bshos dbul te/ sman rnams khu ba yi gar 'ong / /dri yis rgyas pa lha yi zas/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes 38—32

nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /'di yan chad kyi sngags ni gong mar smos pa gong ma bzhin du sbyar ro/ /de'i 'og tu mar me dbul te/ gdon tshornams 'joms shing bkra shis la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba/ /lha rjas bzang po'i zhun lhamar 'di/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ā lo ka ā lo ka sarba bir+ya dha ra pū byedzi te swā hā/de nas gdon rnams la gtor ma sbyin par pya bya ste/ /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzangs lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas su/ /thal sbyar de dag la ni gsol ba 'debs / /bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa rnams/ /gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /sems can gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yul gang gnas dang / /gang dag shar nub nyi ma'i khyim gnas dang / /chu bo kun dang chu yi ngogs rnams dang / /rin chen gnas su'ang gnas ni bcas pa dang / /dze+eng dang mtsho dang lu ma ltang lteng dang / /khron pa dang ni ngam grog chu mig dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer nags tshal dang / /khong 5stong dag dang lha yi gnas dag dang / /lha khang mchod rten 'dug gnas bste gnas 6dang / /mu stegs gnas dang glang chen khang pa dang / /gang dag rgyal po'i dkor khong ྅gnas pa dang / /srang dang khyams dang lam kha'i bzhi mdo dang / /gang dag shing gcig po dang lam po che/ /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /gang dag seng ge glang chen dred kyi gnas/ /'jigs pa'i sa dang 'brog na gnas pa dang / /38—33

gling bzang nyurnams su gnas ni bcas pa dang / /gang dag lhun po dur khrod gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu thugs dgyes dri dang phreng 2ba dang / /bdug pa gtor ma mar me bstod gus 'bul/ /'di dag bzhes nas bsnams dang gsol mdzod la/ bdag gi las 'di'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /1lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba las kha phye ste bkan pa ni gtor ma sbyin pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de'i sngags la srin po rnams la krang ke re/ sha za rnams la/ mi tsi mi tsi/'byung po rnams la gung gung / thams cad la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba chotarja uṅga te sga ra ṇa i 5rma ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ de ltar gdon rnams la gtor ma byin nas khuphyogs skyong rnams la mchod pa lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las/ sor mo dbus ma gsum bgyed 3de/pad+ma'i tshul du bya'o/ /de'i sngags la/ dbang ldan gyi phyogs su ru dru dāya swā hā/dbang po'i phyogs su sha krā tsuya swā hā/ me'i phyogs su asna 7ye swā hā/ gshin rje'i phyogs su bep+ta nyu1ye swā hā/ bden bral naphyogs su rak+ṣa sa a bye nyu pa ta ye swā hā/ chu lha'i phyogs su me ga a sha nā ngaya swā hā/ rlung lha'i 7phyogs su bā ༷ya be+e 1 swā hā/ ku be+e ra'i phyogs su yak+ṣa bibye nyu8re swā hā/ steng gi phyogs su a di t+yā ya nyu9swā hā/ nyi ma'i'o/ /zla ba'i tsan+d+ra ya swā hā/ 'og gi phyogs su dṛ thi bye swā hā/ sa'i lha mo'i'o/ /de ltar phyogs skyong rnams kyang mchod de/bzlas brjod bya ba'i dbang du mdzad nas/ lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms bzlas nas su/ /rgyal po rtag tu khrus gyis shig /ces 'byung ba'i don ni de ltar 'phags pa 'khor dang bcas pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / 'byung po thams cad la 38—34

—mchod pa byas nas/ bum pa'i nang du 'phags pa spyan drangs pa de nyid kyang srog dang bcas pa lta bur 1dmigs te/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa la yi ge'i phreng ba rnams bkod de bzlas so/ /lha'i sku dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / yi ge'i phreng ba la dus gcig tu dmigs pa ni 'jig rten na za 'og la sogs pa'i gding ba khra bo la lta ba dang 'dra'o/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor chung ngu'i nang du yi ge'i phreng ba 4mang ba ji ltar bkod ce na/sems goms pa rnams la mi rung ba med de/ chu nyung ngu shin tu dang ba'i nang du nyi zla dang / gza' skar la sogs pas brgyan pa'i nam mkha' thams cad snang ba bzhin no/ /rgyal po zhes pas 'dzin du zad do5/ /gzhan yang khrus kyi sbyor ba bya ba'i dbang du mdzad nas/ mdo sde 'di yi gzi brjid kyis/ /srog chags dag ni thams cad kyi/ /mi bzad pa yi nad rnams kun/ /de dag thams cad zhi bar lta / /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar bzlas brjod kyi grangs tshang nas phyogs bcu'i lha rnams dga' bar bya ba'i phyir/ tshigs su bcad pa yang bsgrag par bya ste/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg — bya za ba'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /phyogs mtshams gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /ma mo'i gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi 38—35

bdag /sna tshogs gdon gyi 1tshogs bcas la2/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /bden pa gsung — ba gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon dang bcas pa la/ /mchod pa bkyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /tshig srung 5gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /rlung gi phyogs 5kyi gdon bcas la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal—/ /gnod sbyin lag na be con thogs/ /nor srung gdon gyi bdag po ste / /byang phyogs gdon dang bcas pa la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal / /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /dbang ldan phyogs kyi gdon bcas la/ /mchod pa bkyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'og gi klu ste sa yi lha/ /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po ste/ /dam tshig shes pa'i gdon bcas la/ /mchod pa bkyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /steng gi lha tshogs thams cad dang / /zla ba nyi ma gza' chen dang / /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod pa bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /de nas shu ti dang ba'i rnam lnga chu dang sbyar ba la/ bdud rtsi thab cesbyor gyi sngags gong du smos pa btab ste/ khrus byed pa'i lus bskus 7te/ dril nas khrus byas te gos sar pa bgos nas/ dkyil 'khor degyi sgor 'dug ste/ de la srung /sheb chen po bya'o/ /de nas gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa byin te/dkyil 'khor bskor du bcug la/ gus pas phyag byas la/ cho ga bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rtswa ku sha bkram pa'i steng du bde bar 'dug la/gsang sngags zlos ⑩pas bum pa blangs te/ gzungs sngags bzlas shing khrus byed du bcug la phyi nang gi dri ma thams cad ma lus par dag par bsam mo/ /38—36

shin tu bde legs dang bkra shis dang / rgyal bar gyur cig ces ju1bya ba'i tshig dang rol mo'i sgra skad rab tu snyan pa dang yang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /yungs kar dang / zho dang / drur 3ba dang / li khri dang / me long dang / dung dang / bil ba'i 'bras bu dang / gi wang rnams kyang slob ma'i nang du ras khri'u bting ba'i nang du bzhag ste/ de 4bkra shis 'don pa'i lag tu bzhag nas rdzas de rnams re re nas blangs shing sbyin no/ /de nas byab pa bya ste/ rma bya'i steng du zla ba'i steng du gzungs sngags 5bsams la/ des byab cing gzungs ring brjod pa'i gsham 6la che ge mo'i sarba byā bye 7la sogs pa sbyar ro/ /de nas bsrung ba bya ste/ skud pa la bsrung ba byas la gdags/ gzungs ring 8 bris la de la rab gnas byas pa gdags so/ /de nas yang bsrung ba bya ste/rdo rje phyed de'i lag tu byin nas zhi ba dang dga' ba'i sems kyis longs shig 9snaces bya ba'i tshig kyang brjod par bya'o/ /rdo rje phyed po de la bzung nas gdon thams cad las thar nas ldang ste/ zla ba sgra gcan 'dzin gyis bzung 7ba las thar ba bzhin du lus sdig pa dang bral ba'i dbang du mdzad nas/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rnged par byed/ /rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste/ /dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan/ /sems can dbang po nyams pa dang / /tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang / /phun sum tshogs min gang chags dang / /lha rnams rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang / /mdza' sdug skye bo sdang ba dang / /bram ze la sogs gtses pa dang / /phan tshun mthun pa ma yin dang / /nor 'grib pas ni gnod pa dang / /mya ngan ngal las gnod pa dang / /'jigs pa dang ni phongs pa dang / /gza' dang rgyu skar byad stems 38—37

dang / /mi bzad gdon gyis nyen pa dang / /mya ngan ngal shalkulas byung ba yisathu//rmi lam sdig pa mthong na yang / /cho ga 'di yi phan yon gyis/ /de dag las ni thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shepa'o/ /de nas 'byor na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /yang gzhan du na 'di ltar bya'o/ /byams pa che dang snying rje che/ /mnyam par ldan par byas kyang rung / /de yang zhi bar shes bya ste/ /nang gi sbyin sreg dam pa yin/ /'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //baspur mchan/27 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i dbu'i mtshan smos pa ltar bkod/ 2〈〈snar 〉thartan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dur/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma / tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ 6〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dgor/28 77〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaskyed/ 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+ku/ gru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dang zangs/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaras/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thabs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gisar/ re〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabam/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacing ste/ lha1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga na/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dur/29 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khye'i/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zang gis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamado/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ ṅku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung / spyo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7shing / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'i/she7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7ra/ khe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mthu/ /) 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ska / ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7gi/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dang / d+ku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kukhor lor/ /༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sto da/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge 'o dpal be+e/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagading / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dag 〈〈co 〉7thog 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thabs/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉wā yis/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacad/cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanagod/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ba/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ska sa gtsang ma yin/ 13〈〈pe 〉(yi/1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang zhing / 1)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/31 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉glonos/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7rgya/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mid+ma/ sgo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lkeg38—38

༄/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/—1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa sna na bi bye 2nā ma/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ las rnams bzhi po mthar phyin pa/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgu la 'dud/ /bum mang bca' bar mi nus la/ /phrin las rnam pa bzhi po yi/ /bum gcig cho ga bstan par bya/ /rgyud nas phrin las rnam bzhi gsungs/ /bum gcig cho ga rnam pa bzhi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /bum gcig cho ga bcu gnyis 'gyur/ /zhi ba dkar dang rgyas pa ser/ /dbang ni dmar dang drag po nag /bum pa mgul chings gzungs thag sogs/ /las dang mthun par 'gyur byas te/ /gu gul tsan+dan dud pa dang / /las bzhi yi ni sngags dang ni/ /shin tu bsdus pa'i sngags kyis ni/ /bum pa bdug cing bsang ba bya/ /rgyu bzang bum pa tshad ldan nang / /sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge ni/ /so so'i tshon byus bris nas ni/ /38—45

sgu gsung thugs ni gang byed pa'i/ /yi ge rdzas dang bcas pa ni/ /ras su gtums te bum nang gzhug /nad dang mtshon dang mu ge yi/ /bskal pa de dag sel byed cing / /sman lnga rin chen 'bru lnga yis/ /bum pa yang ni dgang bar 1bya/ /tshul khrims dang ldan mchog yin phyir/ /dri dang snying pos bum pa bkang / /de sogs bum rdzas sna tshogs btsalathu/ /bum pa rnams ni rgyan gyis brgyan / /bum pa la ni gdugs bu dbub/ /zhi ba yi ni maṇ+ḍal ni/ /pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad pa/ /rgyas pa rin chen ser po sna tshogs can/ /dbang la pad+ma dmar po lcags kyus mtshan/ /drag po la ni mthing nag rtsibs brgyad do//bum gcig cho ga bsdus pa yis/ /gzhan gyi don ni byed gyur 1na/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bshams nas ni/ /zhi ba'i maṇ+ḍal shar du bri/ /rgyas pa'i lho dang dbang gi nub/ /drag po byang du bri ba ste/ /bum pa yang ni de der dgod/ /mchod dang gtor ma rgyas par bsham/ /ku sha'i stan ni gding 0bya ste/ /slob dpon smyung bar gnas pa'am/ /yang na dkar gsum zas la brten/ /gtsang ma'i gos sogs khrus byas te/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug byas te/ /badz+ra bcu yis mtshams bcad de/ /rang snying bsil la hūṃ dgod de/ /de 'od bde 5gshegs spyan drangs te/ /mkha' la gsal bkod bdun rdzogs bya/ /chos nyid ngang gnas de rjes la/ /drag po'i t+t+waṃ sgra stong zil gnon/ /stong gsum g.yo ldan mkha' 'byung bsam/ /de rjes hūṃ 'od ldan pa ni/ /nam mkha' la ni bsam par bya/ /de las yo baṃ lo sum̐ chad/ /de dag rim gyis zhu gyur pas khye/ /rlung mtsho sa ri rgyal por 'gyur/ /de steng s+dzahūṃ baṃ zhu bas/ /zla nyi pad+ma'i gdan du gyur/ /de steng hūṃ babs zhu gyur pas/ /sna tshogs pa yi rdo rje la/ /38—46

phyogs gcig yu bar gyur par bsam/ /de 'od bde gshegs mtha' dag bsdus//de gyur rdo rje snying po'o/ /sku ljang sbyan gsum phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa rdo rje rgya gram pa/ /ngos gcig yu bar 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /g.yon pa sdigs lngamadzub thugs kar 'dzin/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar gyis bzhugs/ /dbu skra gyen badze+es 3snaklu rigs brgyan/ /mche gcigs phyag rdor sprul pa bsgom/ /de nas bum pa'i nang du ni/ /a zhu bas ni bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /de steng a zhu zla ba bsam/ /de steng so so'i kha dog dang / /ldan pa'i yi ge hūṃ bsam mo/ /gsung sgrub de la dmigs te sgrub / /de zhu sna tshogs rdo rje la/ /phyogs gcig yu bar gyur par bsam/ /kha dog las dang mthun pa'o/ /thugs sgrub de la dmigs te sgrubakru/ /de zhu rdo rje snying po ni/ /sngon lta bar 3ni bsam par bya/ /de nas ye shes spyan drangs te/ /hūṃ 'jigs bcas lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas / /rig sngags gsang sngags kun gyi bdag po ste/ /khro rgyal rdo rje 'dzin gyi rab sprul pa'i/ /khro rgyal rdo rje snying po gshegs su gsol/ /ha ra ha ra badz+ra bi dā ra shā tsuya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra badz+ra pra bhañdza nā ya swā hā—/ sngon lha'i ye shes spyan drangs te/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis gnyis med bya/ /badz+ra brgyad dang tī la lnga/ /badz+ra bdun sogs brjod byas pas/ /sku gsung thugs sogs byin gyis brlab/ /thugs hūṃ las byas bde gshegs bkug /na masma man sngags sogs kyis/ /khro bo la ni dbang bskur bsam/ /na mo rat+na tra yā yas/ /bum pa'i lha la phyag kyang bya/ /mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag mchod / /de mchod sku ni gsal bar bsgom/ /sku sgrub de la dmigs te sgrub9 / /de nas gzungs sngags rim pa gsum/ /mos pa'i bye brag bzlas par bya /38—47

des skyo gtor btang ye shes dbyung / /dam tshig bum lha 'od du zhu/ /rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal bya/ /de nas gzungs mchog ces 1bya ba ni/ /kun khyab gzungs chog bzhin du bya'o/ /yang na 'di ltar bya ba ste/ /shis brjod mang du byas nas ni/ /byab cing bsrung ba'i cho ga bya/ /rgyud kyi sbyor tshig la sogs pa/ /khrus chog rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar bum gcig ma'i cho ga bsdus pa'am/ dgos pa'i bye brag gis shes par bya'o/ /bdag blo shin tu dman gyur kyang 5/ /rgyud 'di nyid dang mi 'gal ba'i/ /las bzhi'i bum gcig cho ga 'bad/ /'bad pas dge ba ci bsags pa/ /'gro rnams re 'dod bskang bar shog /kun kyang 'di la 'jug gyur cig /slob dpon chen po rat+na krirtis mdzad pa'i/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā pa ṇa'i rang 'gyur ro// //drag po'i gtso bum 'di skad do/ /cis kyang mi chod mi shigs pa/ /bden pa sra ba brtan pa ste/ /thams cad du ni thogs pa med/ /thams cad du ni ma pham pa/ /shes rab thugs kyi rang bzhin te/ /sems can thams cad skrag par byed/ /sems can thams cad 'jil bar byed/ /rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed/ /gdon rnams thams cad brlag par byed/ /sems can thams cad rengs byed pa/ /tī li tī la'i sngags dang ni/ /tra ta ya yi sngags sogs kyis/ /phrin las drag po'i las mthar phyin/ /khro rgyal rdo rje rnam 'joms mthus/ /drag po'i bum chu 'di yis ni/ /dri ma thams cad dag gyur cig /phrin las drag po mthar phyin shog/ //38—48

1753༄7/ /rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa/ṣ+ṭṛ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa maṇ+ḍal bi bye nā ma / bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdug bsngal la sogs dag par mdzad pa ste/ /rnam par 'joms pa khro bo rnams kyi rje btsun nyid/ /dpal ldan yid khros log lta gcod pa'i dpal/ /rdo rje bsnams pa las 'joms 'jigs —byed pa'i/ /le'u'i grangs la ringes pa'i snying po ste/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi rtsa bar 'di gsungs thog ma'o/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor cho ga las kyi rim pa nyid/ /'di nyid du ni rnam par bshad par bya'o/ /sa yi cho ga go rims ltar/ /gzhan gyi las kyi rim 5par dbye/ /sa stegs 'dom gang gru bzhi la/ /phyogs mtshams ma nor legs par mnyam/ /'khrul ba med pa'i blo yis bya/ /dpangs su chag gang brtsig 6par bya/ /srad bu mnyam ldan sum 38—50

sgril ladzo/ /byin kyis brlabs te g.yas nas gdab/ /cha chen cha bran mkhas pas dbye/ /tshon sna lnga yi phye ma la/ /byin gyis brlabs — —la legs par dgod/ /dang po pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ /gnyis pa'i cha la 'khor lo brgyad/ /mu khyud rdo rje'i ra 4ba dang / /gru chad snam bu gnyis pa dang / /sgo dang sgo khyud ldan par bri/ /de nyid kha dog nges par ni/ /pad+ma dkar po 'khor lo chodamar/ /mu khyud bzhi pa 9dkar po la/ /rdo rje rnams ni lcags dang mtshungs/ /gru chad gnyis ni ljang gu la/ /snam bu dang po ser po ste/ /de bzhin gnyis pa dkar po che/ /sgo bzhi so so'i rigs dang sbyar/ /lha rnams so so'i phyag mtshan ni/ /so so'i gnas su dgod par bya/ /de nas slob ma dbang bskur ba'i / /dgos pa dag ni tshang ba la/ /dkyil 'khor grub 7pa'i rdzas nyid ni/ /seng ldeng phur pa sor brgyad pa/ /bzhi pa phyogs kyi bzlas pa bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni ngos bzhir gdab/ /tshon sna lnga yi skud pas sbrel/ /gser dngul zangs lcags bum pa nyid/ /tshad dang ldan pa dag pa la/ /gtsang ma'i gos kyis dkris shing dgang / /'bras bu 'dab mar ldan pa yi/ /kha rgyan 9 ldan pa lnga nyid la/ /so so'i mtshan ma btab la gzhag /las kyi bum pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /rdo rje rgya gram de bzhin no/ /sgrub po 11bdag nyid mdun du yang / /mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor bsham/ /nya dang bu ram sran chung 'bras/ /khre dang tshe la sogs pa yi/ /gtor ma gsum ni g.yas na gzhagaki /de nas phyi nang khrus byas te/ /gtsang ma'i gos ni rab gon la/ /dri zhim zas 1 ni mur bzhin du/ /sems bskyed pas ni gzhan don mchog /bdun po yongs su dag par bya'o/ /de nas srung —ba'i 'khor lo nyid/ /ji ltar dmigs pa 38—51

mkhas pas sgom1/ /dri chab byin gyis brlabs la gzhag— /hūṃ hūṃ zhes pas rngam pa dang / /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ zhes pas/ g.yas brkyang ba yi gar gyis ni/ /g.yon brkyang stabs kyis g.yon nas bskor/ /bgegs rnams bskrad pa'i sbyor ba bya/ /phyogs bcur khro bo ti ra yi / /nga rgyal ldan pas bsrung dang bcings5/ /mtshams la sogs pa mkhas pas bshad 9/ /de nas lha rnams bskyed pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor dbus kyi lte ba'i steng dz+wa/ /hūṃ yig sngon po'i 'phro 'du las/ /mchod dang don gnyis rdzogs par byas/ /'dus pas gtso bo'i phyag mtshan ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rje chongos gcig med/ /dbus su rnam par bsam par bya/ /de rjes sngags 'di rnam par brjod/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya / na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta/ bha ku la bi sho dha nā 9ya swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod pa yis/ /rnam 'joms nyid kyi sku ru 'gyur/ /de nyid dam tshig phyag rgya ni/ /lag gnyis rdo rje bcings pa las/ /gung mo gnyis ni gshibs mu nas bsgreng / /gshin rje gshed kyi phyag rgya ste/ /gsang sngags 'di ni 11legs par ni/ /byang shar mtshams su gshin rje'o/ /o ya mān+ta kā nyu ya swā hā/yang snying lag gnyis sor mo dgod/ /snying gar rtse mo sprad pa yang / /oṃ a nadhe swā hā/ zhes pas shar du mtha' yas bskyed/ /g.yon pa khu tshur dkur brten 1/pa/ /g.yas pa nu ma'i thad kar bzung / /oṃ a mṛ te pa 5ba re hūṃ/zhes/ pas shar lhor bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa las / /g.yon pa'i mthe bong sbrel byas la/ /oṃ sum+bha ni ki ra ban+dha ri swā hā/zhes pas lho ru gnod mdzes bskyed/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa las/ /mdzub mo gnyis kyis srin lag mnan/ /gung mo sor mo mje'u chung bsgreng / /38—32

oṃ sti na ste rtebadz+ra kro dha na gro dha swā hā/ zhes pas lho nub sngon mthong nabaskyed/ /snga ma'i phyag rgya lta bu la/ oṃ h+ya shrī —snab swā hā/ zhes pas nub tu rta mgrin bskyed—/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcangs pa las/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur gnyis bsgrengs ④la/ /oṃ a pa ra dzi ta sa ta 3swā hā/ zhes pas nub byang gzhan gyis mi thub bskyed/ /lag gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa las/ /mthe bong mthe'u chung gung mo ni/ /gshibs te so sor bsgreng trebyas la/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bān pa ti 7 swā hā/ /zhes byas byang du gtum po'o/ /de nas so so'i phyag rgya bskyed/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcangs pa dang / /g.yas pa bcangs te spyi bor gzhag /lag gnyis khu tshur snying gar brtsegs 3/ /g.yas pa'i mthe'u chung g.yon pas bcangasaXshe / /lag gnyis brdebs pa'i tshul du bya/ /de ltar rim pa nges pa yis / /gru chad la ni go rims rkabazhin/ /sngags 'dis 7rgyal chen bzhi rim par gsal bar bskyed par bya'o/ /oṃ j-i ta rābye ya 3swā hā/ oṃ pi rū bhā kā nyu ya swā hā/ oṃ bi rū pak+ṣa ye swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇa ya saswā hā/ zhes pa rgyal po bzhi ru bskyed/ /de yi phyi rim snam bu la/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad po'o/ /de yi phyi rim snam bu la/ /phyogs skyong ba ni de bzhin no/ /sgo bzhir sgo ma gzhan dang mthun/ /de dag sgu mdog phyag mtshan ni/ /gtso bo'i sgu mdog ljang ser la/ /g.yas pa rgya gram phyogs de ni/ /thugs kar bzung ste g.yon pa yang / /bum pa dku 7la brten pa'o/ /yang na phyag gnyis bum pa ni/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes kha bcad la/ /phyag gnyis bzung ste thugs kar 'dzin/ /mtha' yas zhal gsum sku mdog mthing / /phyag drug nges med mtshon cha la/ /g.yon gyi 'og mas 1 rtse dgu ni/ /thugs kar 'dzin la nges pa'o/ /bdud rtsi 38—53
