'khyil pa sku mdog dmar/ /zhal dang phyag gnyis sngar 'dra la/ /'og mas she rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin/ /gnod mdzes mdog ser sngar bzhin la/ /'og mas tho ba thugs kar 'dzin/ /mi g.yo ba ni ljang gu la/ /rdo rje dbyug tho thugs kar 'dzin / /rta mgrin dmar po pad+ma 'dzin/ /gzhan gyis mi thub sngon po la/ /rin chen 'bar ba thugs kar 'dzin/ /gtum po smug nag rtse dgu 'dzin/ /gshin rje sngo nag zhal gsum pa/ /phyag drug nges med mtshon cha la/ /'og ma gnyis pos be con 'dzin/ /de nas gru chad rgyal po bzhi/ /dkar ser dmar dang ljang gu la/ /be+e con pi wang chu srin dang / /rin po che yi dong tse'o/ /lha mo rnams kyi sgu mdog ni/ /gsal byed ma ni sngon mo la/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dpal be+e'u 'dzin/ /dbyangs can ma ni dkar mo la/ /rang rtags g.yas pa 'khor lo'o/ /mdangs can ser mo pad+ma'o/ /'od ldan mthing ga rgyal mtshan no/ /skyes chen dmar mo gdu 2bu 'dzin/ /dri med ma ya dmar mo la / /rang rtags g.yas pa bum pa 'dzin/ /yid bzangs —ljang gu 'bud 4 dung 'dzin/ /yid gzhungs ljang ser g.yung drung 'dzin/ /phyogs skyong rnams kyi sku mdog ni/ /brgya byen dkar la rdo rje gdengs/ /me lha dmar po rin chen phreng / /gshin rje mthing ga dbyug to bsnams5/ /bden bral ljang gu ral gri'o/ /chu lha dmar po klu zhags bsnams/ /rlung lha dud ka 6be con 'dzin / /gnod sbyin ser po rin chen 'dzin/ /dbang ldan dkar ser tri shu la/ /nyi zla dkar po u dusmrar / /sa yi lha mo ser mo la/ /phyag na rin chen bum pa bsnams/ /sgo ma'i phyag mtshan sgu mdog ni/ /lcags kyu dkar la lcags kyu 'dzin/ /zhags pa sngo la de bzhin zhags/ /lcags sgrog 97dmar mo 38—pya4

be+egs sgrog thu 'dzin/ /dril bu ljang ser dril bu 'dzin2/ /de ltar sku mdog gsal bsgoms 3la/ /ye shes dbang bskur dgug gzhug bstem 4/ /de ltar gzhal yas gsal dmigs la/ /snying po rgyas dang bsdus pa dang / /shin tu bsdus pa gang mos la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du dbul bar bya/ /rdo 5rjes mchod pa lnga yang dbul/ /bsnyen pa'i dus su dmigs pa gsum/ /legs par brtags te mnyes par bya/ /sgrub pa bum pa nyid la'o/ /de nas bstod pa dbul ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi dbyings nas lha rnams ni/ /spyan drangs bum pa'i nang du bstem/ /bskul tshig 'di skad brjod par bya/ /na mo sems ni rgya che mchog tu rab bskyed de/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos dbyings mngon 'gyur ye shes sgu brnyes te/ /sgu gsung thugs su legs par 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gsung rab bcu gnyis 'phags lam rgyal ba'i bka'//bcom ldan shes rab pha rol phyin la sogs/ /rnam dag dbyings kyi dam chos gshegs su gsol/ /sa bcu'i rgyal tshab chos la mnga' brnyes shing / /snying rje chen pos brtson 'grus go gyon pa/ /shes rab thabs kyis khams gsum 'dren mdzad pa/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' gshegs su gsol/ /mi mjed 'jig rten 'dzam gling 'dir/ /dpal tshogs bkra shis gzhal yas khang / /bla med mchod pa'i rgyan 6bshams te/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan bshams nas/ /spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba ni/ /bzhi bcom drug ldan 'khor ba mya ngan 'das—/ /nams kyang rdo rje lta bu'i sku mnga' ba'i/ /lus ngag yid gsum nyon mongs thams cad 'joms/ /'gro 'dul thugs rjes byin rlabs 7bsam mi khyab/ /bcom ldan rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yang / /'dir gshegs 'gro 38—55

ba'i don phyir mchod pa bzhes/ /sems can nyon mongs gshin rje'i dra ba la/ /ye shes thugs kyis 4gshed dang dra ba 'joms/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa 'byung ba yi2/ /khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed po yang / /'dir gshegs 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod pa bzhes/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ma mtha' yas thug pa bzhin / /'gro ba'i las dang nyon mongs mtha' yas la/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs 5sprul pa mtha' yas kyis/ /ji ltar 'dul ba bzhin du 'joms mdzad pa//khro bo'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas kyang / /'dir gshegs 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod pa bzhes/ /sems can dug gsum nad kyis gdungs pa la/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char 'be+ebs pa/ /thabs la mkhas pa mdzad pa sna tshogs kyis/ /sems can ma lus dbyings su sbyor mdzad pa/ /khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi thab muspyor yang / /'dir gshegs 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod pa bzhes / /rnam thar gsum gyi mnga' mdzad ye shes stobs/ /nyon mongs dug gsum ma lus gnon khyemadzad phyir/ /phyag mtshan rdo rje tho ba 'bar ba bsnams/ /mdzes pa'i sgu mdog gdul thabs cir yang ston/ /khro bo'i rgyal po gnod mdzes stobs po che/ /'dir gshegs 'go ba'i don phyir mchod pa bzhes/ /dbyengs las mi g.yo 'khor ba'i mtha' mi g.yo/ /mtha' la mi gnas thugs rjes 'gro don mdzad/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba'i mtha' gcod cing / /sems can rnams kyi dpal dang mgon gyur pa/ /khro bo'i rgyal bo mi g.yo mgon po yang / /'dir gshegs 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod pa bzhes/ /ye shes thugs kyi 'khor ba'i mtha' yi bar/ /thugs rje myur bas rta gdong phrin las mdzod / /'gro don mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar mnga' ba yang / /rtag tu rta mgrin 38—56

rgyal po gsung du sprul/ /khro bo'i rgyal po dbang gi rta gdong yang / /'dir gshegs 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod pa bzhes/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mtha' gnyis ma yengs dbyings la dbang sgyur zhing / /thugs rjes tsho7phrin las dbyings su 'dus ma mdzad/ /sku yi yon tan rdzogs pas dbang phyug che/ /khro bo'i rgyal po dbang phyug gtum po yang / /'dir gshegs 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod pa bzhes/ /rin chen las grub ri rab ngos bzhi nas/ /bsod nams tshogs ldan dpal ldan rgyal chen bzhi/ /gling bzhir 2 gnas pa'i sems can thams cad la/ /ji ltar 'tsham pa bzhin du don mdzad pa'i—/ /dpal ldan rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas kyang / /'dir gshegs 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod pa bzhes/ /dus bzhi tshad med bzhi dang mnyam sbyor ba'i / /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan ye shes tshogs rdzogs te/ /mchod pa mang po'i sprin dang bcas nas ni/ /mchod pa'i lha mo mang po gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje dang ni rin chen pad+ma dang / /sna tshogs las grub rdo rje rgya gram 'bar/ /phyag rgya chen pos bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon/ /phyogs bzhi 1phyag rgya chen po gshegs su gsol/ /zhi ba dkar po 'od kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /pad+ma dkar po phyag na dpal be'u bsnams/ /'joms byed dkar po phyag na 'khor lo bsnams / /gnyis med don la thugs sbyor gshegs su gsol/ /lho phyogs rgyas pa ser mo'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rgyas pa sngon mo phyag na pad+ma bsnams/ /'od ldan mthing ga phyag na rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /gnyis med don la thugs spyor gshegs su gsol/ /nub phyogs pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /dkar sham dmar mo phyag na gdu bu bsnams/ /mdangs can dmar mo phyag na 38—57

—bum pa bsnams/ /gnyis med don la thugs spyor gshegs su gsol/ /byang phyogs phrin las drag po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /yid gzhungs ljang gu phyag na bud dung bsnams/ /yid bzangs ljang ser phyag na g.yung drung bsnams/ /gnyis med don la thugs spyor gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs skyong ༄1'jig rten dbang ldan dang / /thugs rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dgyes pa 2che brgya byin dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa yang / /'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /sbyin sreg bdag po dka' thub ral pa can/ /drang srong brtul zhugs spyod pa kun gyi rje/ /me yi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yang / /bstan pa bsrung ba'i be+ed du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /bdud gcod bdud la mnga' mdzad bdud kyi rje/ /bdud gcod 'chi bdag mang po kun gyi gtso/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yang / /bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /thod rgal 'jigs pa chen po'i skyabs mdzad pa/ /nad gtong mdangs 'phrog srin po kun gyi rje/ /srin po'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yang / /bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'akro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /char sprin lo tog chu la dbang byed pa/ /lha chen chu lha snyem pa kun kyi rje/ /chu lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yang / /bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /srog 'chang dbugs kyi bdag po dbugs kyi gzungs / /srog 'chang rlung lha rig 4'dzin kun gyi rje/ /rlung lha rig 3 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa yang / /bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na//38—pya8

'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' ba/ /gter 1sbyin gter 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yang / /bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'go ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /bgegs la mnga' mdzad dngos grub mchog ston pa/ /log 'dren tshar gcod lha rnams kun kyi rje/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yang / /bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /'od chen 'jig rten gling bzhir snang mdzad pa/ /gza' skar stong gi lha mang kun gyi rje/ /lha yi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yang 2/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /sa la mnga' mdzad sa bdag kun gyi rje/ /sa yi lha mo brtan 1ma yang / /bstan pa bsrung ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /gnyis med don la rig pa shar mdzad cing / /thugs dam rgyud bsgul lcags kyu phyogs bcur 'bar/ /zhi ba bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad dkar mo'i sku/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /yon tan rgyas pa gser 'od 'od zer 4'phro/ /log 'dren bgegs 'ching zhags pa phyogs bcur 'phen/ /yon tan tshogs rgyas 'ching byed zhags pa ma/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /thams cad dbang sdud dmar mo lcags sgrog sdom/ /grub pa sbud 5cing 'byung po'i tshogs rnams sdom/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i lcags 6sgog ma/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /sna tshogs las las 7grub pa'i ljang gu dgyes/ /bde 38—tsa9

gshegs 1tshogs mnyes 2mchod pa'i dril bu 'bar/ /las dang nyon mongs bdud 'dul thal byed ma/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod cing gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ.e bye hi bha ga bān/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka ya dṛ byu ho/ sa ma ya ho/sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra saṃ gu sha dzaḥrtse / badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi hoḥ37 / de nas gnyis su med par bstem pa dang / /ye shes dkyil 'khor dbyer med bsres/ /brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ /hūṃ rin chen sna bzhi grub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /ma chags pad+ma 'bum gyi gdan bting ste/ /rin chen khri dang nyi zla gsal ba'i rgyan/ /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rmyernam sprul te/ /bdag cag dad pa'i yid kyis mngon 3sprul te/ /rim bzhin bde yangs nyid du bzhugs su gsol/ /badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha lhanabye / phyag btsal ba ni/e ma ho9/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thugs ni rab tu rgya che ste/ /'gro ba kun la khyab mdzad rdo rje rnam 'joms nyid la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho⑫/phyogs bcu'i khro bo rgyal ba rnams/ /nyon mongs dug gsum sdug bsngal gyis/ /gzir ba'i 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /phrin las drag po'i dregs pas 'dul mdzad pa//phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho11/ phyogs bzhi dpal ldan rgyal chen bzhi/ /srid rtse rin chen mtha' yas nas/ /dri med bdud rtsi'i char 'be+ebs pa'i/ /phyogs bzhi'i nyu— yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho—/ phyogs kyi lha mo bkra shis brgyad rnams kyis/ /thugs mchog 'gro don ma lus bdud las rgyal/ /thugs rjes dbang bskur chos sgra shes rab thabs/ /mi mthun phyogs la yon tan bkra shis pa/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma hos/ phyogs bcu 'dul ba'i dbang 38—60

—phyug sku sprul pa/ /phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams mang po tshar gcod cing / /mtho ris gnas nas 'khor los ༄1sgyur mdzad pa/ /phyogs skyong chen po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho༄2 / tshad med bzhi po mthar phyin lhun grub rtags/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi ngang du thugs rjes sprul/ /'gro drug sems can gnas nas sprul mdzad pa'i/ /sgo skyong 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas mchod pa lnga phul te/ /slob ma dkyil 'khor 'jug pa nyid/ /cho ga ji ltar 'dod bzhin brtsam/ /de rjes dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bstod pa nyid ni 'di skad dbul/ /hūṃ bcom ldan rdo rje rnam par 'joms/ /thugs rje nyi zla'i 'od pas 'tsher/ /ngan song thams cad rnam par sbyong / /de nyid sgrib pa sel mdzad pa/ /pad+ma 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor la/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i rtsibs ma brgyad / /nang gi snying po rdo rje gtso/ /dpa' bo thub pa bzhugs pa yibye /sgu gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 4dang / /phrin las bzhi yi khyad par gyi/ /pad+ma 'khor lor bcas pa la/ /rol mo 5sil snyan rnams kyis mchod/ /rin chen stegs bu 'di dag ni/ /gru bzhir ldan zhing sgo bzhi gdod4/ /dbus kyi pad+ma ge sar la/ /bcom ldan rdo rje rnam par 'joms/ /sku mdog ljang ser 'od zer 'bar/ /rgya gram phyogs med thugs kar 'dzin/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /shar phyogs gtso bo mtha' yas ni/ /sku mdog mthing ga 'bar ba'i 'od/ /phyag drug mtshon cha sna tshogs te/ /rdo rje rtse dgu thugs kar 'dzin//de la bstod de 7mchod pa 'bul/ /shar lho khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag drug mtshon cha sna tshogs te/ /rdo rje rgya gram thugs kar 'dzin/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /lho phyogs khro bo gnod 38—61

mdzes ni/ /sku mdog ser po 'bar ba'i 'od/ /phyag drug mtshon cha sna tshogs te / /rdo rje tho ba thugs kar 'dzin/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /lho nub khro bo mi g.yo mgon/ /sku mdog ljang gu 'bar ba'i 'od/ /phyag drug rdo rje dbyug to thugs kar 'dzin/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /nub phyogs khro bo rta mgrin ni/ /sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar/ /pad+ma brtsegs 3pa thugs kar 'dzin/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /byang phyogs gtum po dbang phyug ni/ /sku mdog smug nag 'bar ba'i 'od/ /phyag drug mtshon cha sna tshogs te/ /rdo rje rtse dgu thugs kar 'dzin/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /byang shar gshin rje gshed po ni/ /sku mdog sngo nag 'bar ba'i 'od/ /phyag drug mtshon cha sna tshogs te/ /be+e con 'bar ba thugs kar 'dzin/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung / /sgu mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag mtshan phyag na be+e le bsnams2/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /sku mdog ser la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag mtshan phyag na pi wang bsnams / /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi ra bzang / /sgu mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag mtshan phyag na chu srin bsnams / /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras / /sku mdog lngang gu 'od 'bar ba/ /phyag mtshan phyag na dong tse brtsegs / /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /shar phyogs lha mo dkar sham ma / /sku mdog mthing ga 'od 'bar ba47/ /phyag na bkra shis gdugs 'dzin cing / /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /shar smad lha mo dbyangs mkhan ma/ /38—62

sgu mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na bkra shis 'khor lo bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /lho stod lha mo mdangs can ma/ /sku mdog mthing ga 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na pad+ma 'dab brgyad bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /lho smad lha mo 'od ldan ma/ /sgu mdog mthing ga 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na bkra shis rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /nub stod lha mo skyes chen ma/ /sku mdog dmar la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na bkra shis bum pa bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul / /nub smad lha mo dri ma med/ /sku mdog dmar la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na yid bzhin nor bu bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /byang stod lha mo yid bzangs ma/ /sgu mdog ljang gu 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na bkra shis bud dung bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /byang smad lha mo yid gzhungs ma/ /sgu mdog ljang la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na gser gyi nya mo bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /shar phyogs lha dbang 7 brgya byin ni/ /sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na rdo rje gdengs pa bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /shar lho drang srong me lha ni/ /sku mdog dmar la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na rin chen phreng ba bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i rgyal po ni/ /sgu mdog mthing ga 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na gshin rje'i dbyug to bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /lho nub srin po bden bral ni/ /sgu mdog ljang gu 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na ral gri rnon po bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /nub phyogs chu lha'i bdag po ni/ /sku mdog dmar la 'od 38—63

zer 'bar/ /phyag na klu yi zhags pa bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul / /nub byang rlung lha dbang ldan ni/ /sku mdog dud ka 'od zer 'bar / /phyag na rin chen be+e con bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul / /byang phyogs gnod sbyin ku be ra/ /sku mdog ser la 1'od zer 'bar / /phyag na gnod sbyin dbyug pa 'dzin/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul / /tsobyang shar dbang ldan bgegs kyi bdag /sku mdog dkar ser 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na tri shul snyertse gsum bsnams/ / de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /4steng phyogs nyi zla tshangs pa ni/ /sgu mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na ut+pal 'bar ba rnams5/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul / /'og phyogs sa yi lha mo ni/ /sku mdog ser la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag na gser gyi bum pa bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /shar sgo'i rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ /sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag mtshan phyag na lcags kyu bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /lho sgo rdo rje zhags pa ma/ /sku mdog sngon mo 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag mtshan phyag na zhags pa bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /nub phyogs rdo rje lcags sgrog ma / /sku mdog dmar la 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag mtshan phyag na lcags sgrog bsnams / /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /byang phyogs rdo rje dril bu ma/ /sgu mdog ljang ser 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag mtshan phyag na dril bu bsnams/ /de la bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /de la 6dbang bskur cho ga las/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i dbang rnams sbyin/ /bzod gsol smon lam gdab pa nyid/ /de nas lha rnams so so yi/ /thugs ka'i sa bon la 7bsdus te/ /gshegs 28—61

gsol dmigs med rgyas btab la/ /de nas dga' ston dbugs phyung ste/ /rig pa'i las dang gzengs yang 1bstod/ /de nas gtor ma byin brlabs te/ /mgon po'i gtor ma btang ba ni/ /sngags kyis spyan drangs ye shes gzhug〈 /paṃ las gyur pa so so yi/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan so sor dmigs/ /de nas 'dzab dang bsten pa 'bul④/ /de yi sngags ni 'di dag bzlas/ /rdo rje lce las yang dag phyung / /oṃ e bye hi ha na ha na bhin+da srebadz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e bye hi badzā 3na la byen+da 3na maṇ+ḍa la buzlu sarba bhasmi saku ru sarba duṣ+ṭṛ 9hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e bye hi badzā bhekā la daṇ+ḍa ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e bye hi badz+ra ki ri ṭi ste nyumirak+ṣa sa de / 2ba ta ye swā tā/ oṃ e h+ya hi nā ga badz+ra ā na ya sarba dha na dha n+ya/ sarba na ma ni mugh+ra nyu1lo ka ra dha ra 6sarba nā ga na ra ni tsa badz+ra dha ra ya/ sa ma yā ma nu s+thā mur a kasbyo a kasbyo a+yobarnya ban+ta ha ra ha ra pra ṇa na tsom hā ts+tsha da thuhūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e bye hi badz+ra a ni la ma hā bai ga /ā na ya sarba dubye hu)hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e bye nyi ku be+e ra yak+ṣu bye ba ta ye swā hā/ oṃ e bye hi bye dhu bye na badz+ra shu la swā hā/ oṃ e bye nyi na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā māṃ༄ 1/ oṃ phri nyi bh+yaḥ25swā hā/ oṃ e bye hi na maḥs man+ta budhe na maḥ / he shor+ya pra to byi ti ra mā 2paya swā hā/ lha rnams so so'i phyag rgya yis—/ /mchod yon la sogs gtor ma la/ /sngags ni bdun tsam cig 25dag gis / /nges par 'bul dang bstabs / ༄nipar bya'o/ /de nas mgon po mnyes pa yi/ /tshig 'di rnams kyang brjod par bya'o/ /hūṃ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzangs lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon kyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa yang / /bdag gi pus mo sa la 38—65

btsugs nas su/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsan nas phan gdags phyir ni 'dir spyon cig /dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ mchod par bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste bsreg 1bya za ba'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod par bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gshin rje nge con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod par bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod par bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod par bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 2'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod par bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to thogs/ /nor srung rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang phyogs gdon kyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod par bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po gdon gye bdag /byang shar gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod par bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /steng gi lha tshogs thams cad dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod par bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'og gi klu ste sa yi lha/ /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po ste/ /dam tshig shes pa'i gdon bcas la/ /mchod par bgyid cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /38—66

shar gyi phyogs nas brgya byin 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan 'byung po'i bdag po lha dang ni/ /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen bo dang / /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang / /ri yi lha rnams gnod sbyin tshogs dang bcas/ /so so so sor phul ba 'di dag kun/ /so so so so'i phyogs su bzhes nas kyang / /sde dang dpung bcas bu smad 'khor bcas dang / /gtor ma bdug pa me tog bdug spos rnams/ /rab tu dgyes nas bzhes te bsnams nas gsol/ /de nas 'byung po bgegs la yang 1—/ /gtor ma dag ni sbyin par bya/ /hūṃ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas 3dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi yul gnas dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim gnas dang / /ri rnams kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu yi mdo rnams dang / /rin chen gnas na gang dag gnas pa dang / /rdzing dang mtsho dang lu ma lteng ka dang / /khron pa dang ni ngam grog du chu mig dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer nags tshal dang / khang stong dang ni lha yi khang pa dang / /gang dag gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten dang / /mu stegs spyi gnas drang srong sde gnas dang / /gtsug lag khang chu glang chen khang pa dang / /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /srang dang khyams dang grong gi 'dun thus dang / /gang dag lam chen dang ni shing gcig dang / /dur khrod dag dang nags tshal chen po dang / /seng ge glang chen dred kyi gnas rnams dang / /dgon pa nags chen rab tu 'jigs pa dang / /gling ma bzang po dag na gang gnas dang / /rab tu 38—67

dgyes shing go go gnas rnams su/ /me tog phreng ba byug spos bdug pa dang / /bstod 1dang mar me gtor ma gus 'bul bas/ /'di dag bzhes nas so sor gnas nas gsol/ /bdag gi las 'di'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /de nas rigs —drug so so'i gtor ma gtang — bhe/ /dbang rdzogs bkra shis smon lam gdab / /dkyil 'khor bsdu ba mkhas pas brtsam/ /khrus kyi cho ga ji lta bar//khrus byas rol mo'i las bya'o/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga /slob dpon ye shes rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// // ༄7/ /4dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes 2yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung khu/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub dz+waphyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bkyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis ramagron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog bdag gis spyad par bgyishe / /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /bum pa slob ma lhag gnas bya/ /maṇ+ḍal dag la rnam lngas byugs/ /de nas me tog rnam lnga dgod/ /mchod dang 'byung po gtor ma bshams1 / /rin chen bum par rtsa kyelnga blugs/ /gang yin mtshan bris ras mgul bcing rta/ /dri zhim 'bras bcas shing gis brgyan / /baṃ las rin chen bum pa bsam/ /de mgrin nyi zla rang sngags bsam / /de las 'od 'phros bdud rtsi gzhug /de nas ci rigs par ni bzlas—/ /slob ma khrus byas bshags sogs bya/ /de ni lhag par gnas pa'o/ /38—68

zhag gi don ni 'di lta ste/ /maṇ+ḍal byugs la mchod pa dang / /gtor ma bshams la ༄1snga ma bzhin/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal dag la ni/ /lha gang yin pa'i mtshan ma dgod/ /bdag nyid bskyed nas dkyil 'khor mtshan/ /gang yin lha ru bskyed par bya/ /de la mchod dang bstod pa bya/ /de nas sngags kyang ci rigs bzlas/ /de nas bum pa gong bzhin no/ /de nas slob ma khrus byas la//rigs mthun dar gyis gdong yang dgabaldu/ /slob dpon la ni phyag kyang bya/ /yol ba'i nang du rdo rjes drangs7 / /de la me tog gtor du gzhug /gdong g.yogs bkrol ce la chu dbang bskur/ /de nas sngags dang bsgom pa'i lung / /byin la mchod dang gtor ma btang / /lha gshegs mtshan ma bsdu bar bya/ /de ni sku yi dbang bskur ro/ /pad+ma badz+ra bdag gis mdzad pa spri rdzogs so// //༄7/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i nges pas ni/ /mi smra ba dang mi bya nyid/ /sba ba dang ni de bzhin mchod/ /tshim bya yid la rnam par bsgom/ /mkhas pas gsad 4bya rmongs bya nyid/ /brgyad po 'di dag bsrung byas na/ /dam tshig tu ni yongs su grags/ /byu zhig mi ṣ+ṭasnasmra zhe na ni/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi rang bzhin canaphyo/ /dam tshig spyod dang 'dre ba dang / /brdzun du smra ba rtsub pa'i tshig /'khyal tshig gang yang smra mi bya/ /ci zhig mi bya zhe na ni —// /phra ma srog chags 'tshe ba dang / /gtam gzhan rnams ni brnyas pa dang / /sgyu — 7dang phrag dog nga rgyal dang / /rku dang g.yo ni bya ba min/ /ci zhig sba bar bya zhe na/ /rang sngags sngags kyi nor bu 38—69

dang / /chang dang rdzas kyi 'du ba dang / /bden dngos spyod dang grol ba dang / /dngos grub mtshan ma sba bar bya/ /ci zhig mchod par bya zhe na/ /byis pa nad pa bud med rgan/ /dman dang mgon med smad pa dang / /bsnyen gnas dka' thub kyis nyon mongs/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun dag kyang mchod/ /ci zhig tshim par bya zhe na/ /slob dpon med dang pha ma dang / /lha dang zhing gi bdag po dang / /dur khrod pa yi 'byung po dang / /mkha' 'gro ma rnams tshim par bya/ /ci zhig bsgom par bya zhe na/ /dkon mchog gsum dang de bzhin bdag /phyag rgya ye shes rang gi ngos/ /cha bcas pa dang cha med pa/ /bla ma sngags kyang bsgom par bya/ /ci zhig gzhom par bya zhe na/ /chags dang gti mug de bzhin sman/ /le lo de bzhin mi dga' dang / /dad pa med dang de bzhin brkam/ /dbang po'i gdon yang gzhom par bya/ /ci zhig rmongs par bya zhe na/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed dang / /sdang dang phra ma can dang gdug /rgyal po 'khor dang sdig can dang / /mi srun 17dag kyang rmongs par bya/ /dam tshig 'di dag bsrung bar bya/ /bsrungs nas dngos grub ster —bar byed/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa ni/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang / /byang chub sems kyang gtong cimi bya/ /gnod par byed la byang sems bskyed/ /rdo rje'i spun 5la bsnyen bkur bya/ /dad pa med pa rab tu smodatre/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya/ /zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te/ /bla ma la ni yon 7yang dbul/ /dngos po'i khyad par gang dang gang / /mnyes phyir de la dbul bar bya/ /de bzhin bza' ba'i bye brag rnams/ /phongs 9pa med par dbul bar bya/ /gal te de la brnyas 38—70

gyur na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas dang mtshungs/ /dus min 'chi bar 'gyur ba ni/ /glen pa dgra dang rkun po dang / /de bzhin gdon dang rims kyis thebs—/ /rgyal po'i chad dang phra men dang / /me dang chu dang stag dang dug /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar ltung / /sems ni khro bar mi bya zhing / /nam yang shes rab nyams mi bya/ /rtag tu khyod ni de ltar srungasaju1/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //byed/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro bo brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas gnas khang yid dang mthun par dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ thog mar sa'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin rdzogs par byas la/ de nas sta gon gye cho ga ji ltar rigs par byas la/ de nas thig dang tshon gyi cho ga ma nor bar rdzogs par byas la/bum pa dgu la lha so so'i mtshan ma gdab/ dkyil 'khor rtsibs brgyad pa ser po bri/ lte ba ljang gu rtsibs mchan dmar po mu khyud dkar po la rdo rje ra ba nag por bya'o/ /gru chad ljang gur bya/ sgo rigs dang 'dra ba la me ri dang /rdo rje'i ra ba mdzes pas bskor ba bri bar bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i mtshan ma bri/ rtsibs la khro bo brgyad kyi mtshan ma'o—/ /go rims ma nor bar bri bar bya'o/ /de nas bum pa rnams lha so so'i gnas su bzhag ste mchod pa dbul bar bya'o/ /so so'i bum pa la khro bo so so'i phyag rgya bcing / spyan drangs la sngags kyis — gnyis su med par bsnyims la / de nas ye shes sems dpa' dang gnyis su med par bsre bar byas la/38—71

de dag gi sku mdog dang / phyag mtshan dkyil 'khor gyi bi bye nas 'byung ba bzhin gsal bar bya'o/ /lha so so'i thugs ga nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis kyi bar na sngags so so'i rang sgra dang bcas pas dmigs la/ dbus kyi gtso bo rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa shar du ①mtha' yas / shar lhor 3 bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ lhor gnod mdzes/ lho nub tu khro bo mngon mtho/ nub tu rta mgrin/ nub byang du gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ byang du gtum po/ byang shar du gshin rje/ sgo rnams su sgo ma gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar so sor bum pa'i nang du gsal bar bskyed la/ sgrub pa po bdag nyid kyis khrus byas gos gsar ༄ —pa gyon la nye reg dang 'thor 'thung la sogs pa byas la bzlas pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /lha so so'i thugs ka'i nyi zla'i bar gyi sngags kyi rang sgra dang / bdag nyid kyis brjod pa'i sgra dang 'khor bar dmigs te bzlas so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa chobadz+ra pā ṇa thuye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 6pa ta ye/ oṃ ma tha ma tha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dhu na dhu na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dha ra dha dza ra badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ dhā ra ya dhā rur ya badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa rtebadz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ stson+da sbyin+da badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bum pa re re la stong phrag re bzlas te/ brgya brgya'i bar du pū dza lnga lnga dbul lo/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis 0 lha 'od du zhu chu dang gnyis su med par bsre bar bya'o/ /de nyid las 'od 'phros pas rang gzhan gyi don sdogs par bya'o/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i cho ga nas 'byung ba bzhin du bskur ro/ /bkra shis gsol/ bgegs rnams las rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir dang hūṃ/chus brab pa dang / rma bya'i sgos byab pa dang / me long gis phyi snyeb dang / drur 1 38—72

bas brdeg par bya'o/ /sarba gra he swā hā/ sarba dur swasna hūṃswā hā/ sarba bi /5 kalpa swā hā/ sarba dzā re swā hā/ de ltar 'di dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas nad dang gdon la sogs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /khro bo brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad kyis rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa sdogs so// //༄7/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pas sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas gnas khang yid dang mthun par lha mo brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/sa chog ④dang sta gon la sogs pa rdzogs par bya ste/ stegs bu gru bzhi tshad dang ldan pa la thig btab la/ tshon dgye ste/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dmar po la lte ba sngon po pad+ma bcas pa mu khyud ser po la/ a dkar pos sabaskor ba khyams dang sgo rigs dang 'dra ba bri ba'o/ /bum pa dgu rgyan rnams kyis legs par brgyan pa la gtso bo nas brtsams te/ lha so so'i phyag mtshan gur gum dang mtshal bsres la gdab po/ /sgo bzhi la seng ldeng gi phur pa bzhi btsugs la dar le brgan gyi cod pan gdags so/ /de nas lha mo dang gtso bo dang de dag so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nas 'byung ba bzhin/ spyan drangs la so so'i bum pa'i nang du bzhugs su gsol te/ lte ba'i bum pa las rdo rje rnam 'joms sgu mdog sngon po phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar bum pa 'dzin pa/bum pa'i kha sna tshogs rdo rjes bcad pa/ sku la rat+na'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa / dbu la don yod grub pas brgyan par bsgom/ shar du pad+ma la mu tig 38—73

dkar pos phyag gnyis thugs kar dpal be'u 'dzin pa'o/ /shar lhor 'joms byed dkar mo 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /lhor rgyas pa sngon mo phyag gnyis pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /lho nub tu rnam rgyal sngon mo ①phyag gnyis stag gi rgyal mtshan bsnams pa'o/ /nub tu lha mo dkar sham dmar mo phyag gnyis gdugs 'dzin pa'o / /nub byang du mdangs can ma gedamar mo phyag gnyis gser gyi bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du yid gzhungs ma ljang ser phyag na dung bsnams pa'o/ /byang shar du yid bzangs ma ljang ser phyag gnyis na g.yung drung 'khyil pa bsnams pa'o/ /lha mo de dag kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /dbu la don yod grub pa'am rnam 'joms kyis brgyan pa'o/ /las dang rdo rje nges par rdzogs pa rnams rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas de dag gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ā li'i phreng ba las so so'i sngags kyi rang sgra grag snapar dmigs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhin du so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ mchod pa dang bstod pa dang /'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa la sogs pa byas la/ de nas bdag nyid khrus byas la gos sar pa gyon te bzlas pa brtsam par bya'o/ /de yang bum par lha so so'i thugs ka'i sngags kyi rang sgra dang / phyi rol du 'byung ba sna tshogs pa'i rang sgra dang / bdag nyid kyis brjod pa'i rang sgra dang gsum la dmigs la/ oṃ ma tisbi ra badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shu tisbi ra badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tisbri ra badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta 4badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a mo gha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ e bye 3hi badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ shī rgyu badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dha sa bya badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bum pa re la brgya rtsa brgyad phul te/ mchod pa lnga'i rdzas rdo 38—74

rje'i chus bsang gtor byas te dbul ba dang / gtso bo dang lha mo brgyad kyis ju1 drangs te/ so so'i spyan drang ba dang / bzhugs su gsol ba dang / phyag btsal ba dang / bstod pa bya'o/ /de ltar rdzogs nas phyogs skyong rnams dang bgegs rnams kyi gtor ma btang la bstod pa tsabya ste/ rnam dag byerjes su dran par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang / rdo rje dril bu dang chu dang / cod pan la sogs pa'i dbang bskur la/ ba lo sgra sna tshogs pas btang ngo / /de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu bkra shis gsol/ bla ma la yon 'bul lo/ /lha mo brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba/ dpal mar me mdzad bzang chepos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //༄༄/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dpa' bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas sa'i cho ga la sogs pa sngon du song bas/ sa stegs gru gsum me long gi ngos ltar byas la/ thig gdab ste dbus lte ba mu khyud kyis bskor la lte ba ljang gu mu khyud dmar po sna tshogs pad+mas bskor 3—/ gru chad ljang gu bar khyams gnyis pa dkar ser sgo dang sgo khyud du bcas pa bris la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa la gi wang gis mtshan ma 'u rdo rje rgya gram phyogs gcig med pa btab la las thams cad pa'i bum pa la sgu dkar gyis ṭ+wāṃsna tshogs rdo rje bris la byang du bzhag /pū dza ji ltar 'byor pa dang ba gelo bsham/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje bcings la mthe bong bsgrengs la srin lag sbyar te mdzub mo phyis nas/ nas gang gis trem reg pa byas la mje'u chung blang 38—75

la—/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na khā ༄1ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i thu bum pa'i nang du paṃ dang saṃ las pad+ma nyi ma brtsegs pa'i steng du t+t+waṃ las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang ser phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa rdo rje rgya gram phyogs gcig med pas kha bcad pa/ thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyis brgyan pa/zhal yid tsam khro ba yan lag sbrul rigs bzhis brgyan pa bskyed do/ /de'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas don gnyis byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra dzñā na hūṃ swā hā/hūṃ zhes brjod pas ye shes sems dpa' ཿ'dra ba zla ba'i gdan la bskyed la ④de nyid la mchod pa dang gtor ma bya'o/ /de'i thugs ka'i hūṃ la dmigs te/bdag nyid khrus bya ba dang / gos brje sreb la sogs pa bya ste/ snying po brgya rtsa brgyad/ bsdus pa la stong phrag gcig /shin tu bsdus pa la stong phrag bzlas te/ slob ma la srung bye bhe skud gdags pa dang / dam tshig dang tsasdom pa 'bogs pa la sogs pa bya ste/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug /gzungs nyi shu rtsa gcig bklag 8 tu gzhug /de nas lha ngo bstan/ dbugs dbyung 9 /gzengs bstod/ dbang bskur/ lag tu rdo rje dang dril bu'i sgras dkyil 'khor bskor/ dbang rdzogs par byin la gos brje —/ zas kyi rnal 'byor bya'o / /de yang mchod pa dbul ba dang / gtor ma btang / dkyil 'khor bsdu/ bkra shis gsol/ slob ma la chos bshad/ slob mas bla ma la yon dbul/ bden pa'i tshig brjod do/ /dpa' bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i bdud rtsi bum pa'i cho ga dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //38—76

༄7/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yab yum gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas gnas khang yid dang mthun par sa'i cho ga la sogs pa sngon du song bas/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa yab yum gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ sa stegs gru bzhi pa me long gi ngos ltar byas la thig btab la tshon dgye ste/ dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa dkar po/ mu khyud ser bo mdung rtse gsum pas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rim pad+ma bcu drug pa dmar po/ mu khyud ser po phur bus bskor ba/ gru chad ljang gu mu khyud dang bcas pa mtha' kyem me ris bskor ba/ grwa byernams su bum pa bzang po bri bar bya'o/ /de ltar bris la dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' zhum rnams su shu gu brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba gzugs so/ /de dag kyang ras kyi skud pa sgril mas sbrel lo/ /mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis la rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa 'khor lo dang pad+ma'i steng du gzhag go/ /bum pa gnyis la yang dar tshon sna lngas bhel lo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi kho ra khor yug tu rtswa ku sha gsar pa bting ba'i steng du spos chu dang 'o ma'i chus bsang bar bya'o/ /de nas khrus kyi cho ga nas byung ba bzhin du nye reg dang 'thor 'thung la sogs pa byas la /④bdag nyid lag pa gnyis khong stong du sbyar la mthe bong gnyis bslang la mthe'u chung nang du bskum la/ oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā 5pa ta ye badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa 6brgyad brjod pas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ser po rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ dar kyi cod pan dang mu tig gi dra bas brgyan pa/ dbu la 38—77

rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyis brgyan pa/ thugs ka nas khro chung me ltar 'bar ba/dpag tu med pa 'phro ba yab zhal bgrad kyeljags 'gyu ba phyag g.yas bum pa'i steng na khro bo'i zhal gnyis phyung ba/ g.yon rdo rje dang lcags kyu lhan cig tu 'dzin pa bskyed do/ /de nas lag pa'i sor mo bsnol srin lag gnyis bsgrengs la mthe bong dang / mdzub mo gnyis sbyar la/ oṃ badz+ra dha zhe༄ra tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ces brjod pas yum lu gu rgyud ma sku mdog dmar mo rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa g.yas lcags sgrog rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa bsnams te yab la 'khyud pa g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pas chu rgyun 'be+ebs pa yab kyi bum pa dang gnyis med du bskyed do/ /de nas sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pa bzhis phyogs bzhi nas mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la bgegs zhi bar bya ba'i don du gtor ma re re btang / de nas yab yum kyi ye shes sems dpal la dmigs la shug pa re la rgyud re bton 4la/ g.yas na sa gcig cig la bskor ba5/ de ltar bzhi rdzogs pa dang re re la dbang du gyur pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de'i du ba la slob ma bdugs te khrus re yang bya'o/ /de nas dbang lugs bzhin du bskur ro/ /gtor ma btang /dkyil 'khor bsnyu/ bkra shis gsol/ khrus re yang bya'o/ /slob mas bla ma la yon dbul lo/ /yab yum gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba bde sbyin dam pa zhes bya ba dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa sdogs so// //༄7/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs kyi khro bo 6bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pa'i gang zag sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas gnas khang yid dang mthun par rigs kyi khro bo bzhi'i nga 38—78

rgyal dang ldan pas sa'i cho ga la sogs pa sngon du song bas dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa rab tu mnyam pa la/ thig dang tshon kyis —1lugs bzhin byas la/ dbus su gru gsum nag po la zla gam dmar po mu khyud ljang gus bskor ba 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa ser po rtsibs mchan rnyidamar po mu khyud dkar po sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra bas bskor ba/ sgo bzhi rigs dang mthun pa khyams dang 'dod yon gyis mdzes par byas la mu khyud dang me ri dang thod skam dang / rdo rje'i ra bas mdzes par byas pa bris la/ lha so so'i mtshan ma gdab bo/ /de nas bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lnga la las thams cad pa'i sngags kyi phyag rgyas bsangs la/gtso bo dang khro bo bzhi'i mtshan mas btab la/ lha so so'i gnas su bzhag go/ /shing gdug pa can las 4byas pa'i phur bu bzhi la dar mthing nag gi cod pan gdags / oṃ tā sa ya tā sa ya badz+ra tī li tī lā zheya swā hā/ zhes shar sgor btsugs la rdo rje rigs kyi las thams cad pa'i khro bor bskyed do/ /oṃ stson+dha stsornya ma hā tī li tī lā 9ya swā hā/ zhes pas phur bu gcig lho sgor btsugs la rin po che'i rigs kyi las thams cad pa'i khro bor bskyed do/ /oṃ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa dzoli shī li tī lā bye/ya swā hā/ zhes pas pad+ma'i rigs kyi las thams cad pa'i khro bor bskyed la shenub sgor gzugs so/ /oṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha kro dha tī li kri lā 7ya swā hā / byang sgor btsugs la las kyi rigs thams cad pa'i khro bor bskyed do/ /dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhi la gtor ma sha sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa bzhi bzhag /gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag ji ltar 'byor pa bsham/ phyogs skyong ba dang bgegs la sogs pa'i gtor ma btang zhing bar chad bsal ba'i spyor ba bya'o/ /de nas sngags pa bdag nyid kyis bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor 38—79

bsangs te/ lag pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa ltar bya ste/ g.yon 'khor lo'i snod thugs kar 'dzin par byas la shar gyi bum pa la dmigs te/ oṃ tā sa ya tā sa ya badz+ra tī li tī khā 1ya swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad brjod pas/ khro bo badz+ra kri li tī lā rduya mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje rtse gsum pa gdengs pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas cho'akhor los mtshan pa'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyel pa/ thod pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rigs lngas dbu brgyan 3pa/ spyan gsum pa zhal bgrad snyepa zhing chen gyi yol bas bskor ba la dar nag gi 'phur lces brgyan pa/ stag dang gzig dang / gcan gzan kyesna tshogs pas sku smad brgyan pa bum par bskyed do//lho phyogs kyi bum pa la dmigs te/ oṃ khyun+dha stson+dha phyam hā shī li tī lā rmyeya swā hā zhes brgya rtsa brgyad brjod pas tī la ya ser nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ g.yon phur bu thugs kar 'dril dzob/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa snga ma bzhin du bskyed do/ /nub kyi bum pa la dmigs la g.yas pa sdong po ltar byas la/ g.yon phur pa ltar byas la/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa li gī li tī khā tso1ya swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad brjod pas dmar po shā li tī lā 1 ya dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas me 'bar ba/ g.yon phur bu thugs kar 'dril nyu5ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa snga ma bzhin du bskyed do/ /byang du g.yas na / ⑫rin po che'i dbyug to 'phyar ba ltar byas la/g.yon phur pa ltar byas la/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha kro dha shī li tī lā ⑫ya swā hā zhes brgya rtsa brgyad brjod pas gtum po tī la ya mdog ljang nag g.yas rin po che'i dbyug to thod pas mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon phur bu thugs kar 'dzin pa snga ma dang 38—80

'dra bar bskyed do/ /dbus su rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas 'khor lo g.yon phur pa hūṃsnabasnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ oṃ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā 2ya swā hā bskyed do/ /de nas lha so so'i sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ gnyis su med par bstems la ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje kha gyes pa'i bum par hūṃ/ de la so so'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i rang sgra la dmigs la/bzlas pa brtsam rtepar bya'o/ /oṃ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā 5ya hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha bad+dhā brnya/ ha na ha na a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa ces bum pa re re la stong phrag gsum bzlas te/ brgya brgya'i bar du pū tredza dbul go/ /de ltar rdzogs nas slob ma la las kyi bum pa'i khrus nas gtor dz+wal/ gos gsar pa gon la phreng ba dang me tog bzung la dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang / me tog gang la phog pa'i lha ngos bstan pa dang / dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma sil snyan sna tshogs pa dang bcas pas nags tshal kyi gling du bskyal lo/ /de nas slob ma'i don du drag shul spyod pa'i sbyin sreg lan bdun bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu—/ bkra shis gsol/ sbyin sreg thal ba 3mnan las byas la sbyar/ bla ma la yon dbul tshogs ji ltar rigs pa bsags/ bzlas pa ji ltar bya ba'i lung bstan pa bzlas pa la dus thams cad du brtson par bya/ srung 9ba'i 'khor lo yang mgul du gdags so/ /bdud rtsi thab 7sbyor zhes bya ba khro bo bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bsgur ba'i cho ga zab mo dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //38—81

snga / /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgo ma bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas/gnas yid dang mthun par sa'i cho ga la sogs pa sngon du song bas sgo ma bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ sa stegs dkyil 'khor gru gsum mnyam zhing chags kyis 'thas par byas te thig btab la tshon bkye sheste/ dbus pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa ste lte ba ljang gu pad+ma rigs kyi mdog lte ba'i mu khyud nag po rdo rje ra ba dkar pos bskor ba/ gong ras dmar po mu khyud ser po sna tshogs pad+mas mtshan pa/ sgo bzhi rta babs su yod pa bris la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa lnga la rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lha so so'i mtshan ma btab la so so'i gnas su bzhag /sgo bzhir phur bu bzhi la dar le brgan gyi con pan btags la gzugs/ de yang ras kyi skud pa la rma bya'i mdongs kyis sbrel lo/ /pū dza' bye brag lnga lnga bsham/ phyogs skyong ba'i gtor ma'i tshogs legs par bshams la / de nas dbus kyi bum pa la rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa 2sku mdog ljang gu rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de nyid kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drangs la bzhugs su gsol ba dang / de nas lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang lcags sgrog dang dril bu'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ badz+ra saṃ ku sha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha swā hā/oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi swā hā zhes so so'i bum pa la dmigs te/lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu brjod pas shar phyogs kyi bum par pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/dzaḥrdolas lha mo mdog dkar mo'i lag na lcags kyu thogs pa zhal bag tsam khro ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ skra ser po gyen la badze+es 4pa/ spyan dmar po 5 bskyed do/ /lhor hūṃ las lha mo ser mo rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ phyag na rdo rje 38—82

zhags pa rtse gsum pas mtshan pa thogs pa thod 1pas brgyan pa bskyed do/ /nub tu baṃ las lha mo dmar mo phyag na be+egs sgog nyi zlas mtshan pa bskyed do/ /byang du hoḥlas lha mo ljang ser lag na dril bu dgrol ba bskyed la/ de dag gi snyeng gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du so so'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ ye shes sems dpa'i snying gar so so'i sa bon la so so'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i sngags kyi rang sgra la dmigs te/ bdag nyid kyis khrus byas la bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ dza ye swā hā/ oṃ 2bi dza ye swā hā/ oṃ a dzi te swā hā/ oṃ dzā la swā hā zhes so so'i bum pa la dmigs te/ khri phrag re bzlas te stong gis mchod pa 'bularte/ sbyan drang ba dang bzhugs su gsol ba dang / phyag btsal ba dang bstod pa re 3bya/de ltar bzlas pa byas la lha so so 'od du zhu 6chu bdud rtsir gyur pa las lha mo rngu grangs med pa 'phros pa las/ phyi nang gi dbang bdag la bsgur bar dzudamigs la / de nas slob ma bskyed pa la sogs pa byas la dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dbang bsgur bar bya'o/ /de nas ba bo gtang 9/ bkra shis gsol/ dkyil 'khor bsdu/ slob mas bla ma la yon dbul/ sgo ma bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i dze+echo ga /rin po che dri ma med pa zhes bya ba dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas/ gnas khang yid dang mthun par sa'i cho ga rnams rdzogs par byas la/rgyal po chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs la/ sa stegs gru gsum mnyam zhing 38—83

chags kyis 'thas par bya zhing / de nas thig le'u tse kyedagur btab la le'u khutse lnga pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ dbus kyi le'u rngo —tse dkar po shar ljang lho nag po/nub dmar po byang ser po de'i bar gyi rtsig pa sngon po la gser gyi dong tse brtsegs nga / grwa rnams su bum pa dmar po dpag bsam gyi shing dang / nor bu'i nang na chu 'bab 4pa bri/ gru'i dum bu ljang gur bya/ sgo rim 5dang 'dra ba bris la bum pa lnga la sogs pa tresku mdog mthun pa'i tshon kyis bsgyur la/ so so'i phyag mtshan btab la so so'i gnas su bzhag la skud pa sngon dmar kyis sbrel la / phyogs mtshams su me long gi phreng ba dang / dar sna dang / dril bu g.yer kha'i 7dra bas byes so/ /steng nas ras dkar po'i gdugs kyis bkab la/rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan par bya'o/ /shog bu la rgyal po chen po bzhi'i gzugs bris la mda' la btags la gnas su gzugs so/ /de nas bgegs bskrad pa la sogs pa byas la dbus kyi bum pa la dpal rdo rje rnam 'joms sku mdog dkar por gyur 8te bum pa'i phyag rgyas sbyan drangs te sngags brgya rtsa brgyad brjod la pū dza la sogs rdzogs par dbul/ de nas shar phyogs kyi bum par rā dza yul 'khor srung spyan drangs te/ lag pa g.yon pa pi wang len pa ltar byas la oṃ j-i (snaswā hā zhes pa brgya brjod pas bum pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du seng ge'i gdan gyi steng du/ yul 'khor srung 1ljang gu rin po che'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa/ dar kyi lhab lhub dang bse'i rmog zhu gsol ba/ phyag g.yas pas pi wang 'dzin pa g.yon gyis len pa bskyed do/ /lho'i bum par 'phags skyes po spyan drangs te/ bskyed pa ni lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo dang gung mo 13sbyar te bsgrengs la/ oṃ bī swā hā zhes brgya brjod pas/ 'phags skyes 38—84

po sgu mdog nag po dar gyi lhab lhub dang rin po che dang bse'i rmog zhu gsol ba/phyag na ral gri bsnams pa snga ma bzhin du bskyed do/ /nub kyi bum par srun mi bzang spyan drangs te bskyed pa ni g.yon pa'i mdzub mo zhags pa ltar bya ste/ oṃ k+ṣa swā hā zhes pa brgya brjod pas spyan mi bzang sgu mdog dmar po dar la sogs pas brgyan pa/ sbrul mgo bdun gyis bskor ba 1spyan dmar 2la 'bur ba/phyag na chu srin dang zhags pa bsnams pa bskyed do/ /byang gi bum pa la rnam thos sras spyan drangs te bskyed pa ni/ lag pa gnyis kyis mthe bong gze mo'i rna ba ltar byas la/ oṃ be+e swā hā zhes brjod pas rnam sras mdog ser po gser btso ma 'dra ba dar la sogs pas brgyan pa phyag na ne+e'u le'i rkyal pa gser gyi dong tses bkang phyab bskyed do/ /de nas sgrub pa po bdag nyid kyis khrus byas la/gos gsar pa gyon te/ bzlas pa bya ba ni lha de dag gi snying ga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sngags kyi rang sgra la sogs pa dmigs te/ oṃ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ oṃ ha ra ha ra/oṃ sa ra sa ra swā hā/ oṃ mā ra ya swā hā/ oṃ be+e dā ra ya swā hā zhes bum pa re la khri phrag re so so'i las kyi sngags bzlas shing de nyid mchod pa la sogs pa bya ste/dbang bskur ba ltar dbang bsgur ro/ /gtor ma gtong 6ba la sogs pa spyir 'dra'o / /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bsgur ba dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa sdogs so// //༄7/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs skyong ba 7bcu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas gnas khang yid dang mthun par phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor 38—85

bzhengs te/ sa'i cho ga la sogs pa dbang bskur ba bzhin byas la/ dkyil 'khor gru gsum shin tu mnyam zhing legs par byas 1la thig btab ste/ dbus su gru bzhi pa dmar por bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol du snam bu gru bzhi pa rin bo che'i khang bu bcu dang bcas pa bri'o/ /sgo ni rigs dang mthun par bris la bum pa bcu gcig rgyan rnams kyis brgyan la/ lha so so'i gnas su bzhag ste/ bcu po'i mgul bar dar sna tshogs pas dz+rel rma bya dang me long gis bri'o/ /gtso bo'i bum pa la gzungs thag bzhi btags la/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi rdo rje bzhi la brtod 2la bzhag go/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' rnams su hom bcu brtsigs la bgegs rnams kyi ming byang dang bcas pa bya ste ci rigs pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /mchod pa'i bye brag ci 'byor pa dang / rab tu gtsang ma'i ba lo chen po bcu gcig gis 4dkyil 'khor gye mtha' ltam bskor la bzhag go/ /gtor ma de dag re re la lha bshos dang mar me dang spos dang shog shog gi gdugs re dang /dar dmar po'i ba dan dang / rma bya'i rgyal mtshan dang / seng ge re gzugs so / /zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang drag shul gyi snying po ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brten par bya ste/ de nas bgegs bsal ba la sogs pa'i cho ga rdzogs par byas la dbus su rdo rje rnam 'joms sku mdog dmar por bsgyur la bya'o/ /de yang dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang sngags kyis spyan drang ngo / /de nas phyogs skyong ba'i 6so so'i phyag rgyas so so'i bum par spyan drangs te go rims kyis 7snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so/ /oṃ i swā hā/ oṃ a swā hā/ oṃ ya swā hā/ oṃ ri swā hā/ /oṃ yi swā hā/ oṃ bhu swā hā/ oṃ i swā hā/ oṃ a swā hā/ de dag gi mtha' yang dza dang hūṃ dang phaṭa dang ste/ sde bzhi zhi rgyas kyis dbye'o/ /de 38—86

ltar so so'i bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du brgya byin ser po lag na rdo rje thogs pa btsun mo dang lhan cig tu glang po che zhon pa bskyed do/ /me lha ni drang srong gi cha lugs dang dbyu pegu dang / ril ba spyi blugs dang / bgrang phreng dang blugs gzar thogs pa mdog dmar po ra la zhon pa bskyed do/ /gshin rje mdog nag po rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa be+e con thogs pa ma te la zhon pa bskyed do/ /lho nub kyi bum par bden bral mdog dmar po mche ba gcigs 2༄pa/ lag na ral gri thogs pa mi la zhon pa bskyed do/ /nub tu chu lha mdog dkar po rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ pad+ma dang zhags pa thogs pa bum pa sngon po'i steng na 'dug pa bskyed do/ /nub byang du rlung lha mdog dud ka bsil yab thogs pa 'khor lo la zhon pa bskyed do/ /byang du ku be+e sgo — ra mdog sna tshogs pa dbyug to thogs pa rta la zhon pa bskyed do/ /byang shar du dbang ldan mdog dkar po la mgrin pa sngo ba glang mchog sngon po la zhon pa lag pa bzhi la sbrul se ral khar thogs pa gcig gis ral gri gcig na mdung rtse gsum pa / g.yas yum dka' thub zlog 4ma la 'khyud pa lag pa gcig gis dam pa sbyin pa bskyed do/ /steng du zla ba ni mdog dkar po pad+ma thogs pa bskyed do/ / sringang pa la zhon pa mdun du bud med rnga ma'i bsil yab thogs pa 6bskyed do/ /de nyid kyi bum par nyi ma mdog dmar bar bskyed do/ /lag pa na pad+ma thogs pa bskyed do/ /yang dbang ldan gyi 'og ste 'og gi phyogs su sa'i lha mo lte ba man chad dmar mo yan chad gser las grub pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa lag na rin po che'i 7gter gyi bum pa thogs pa/ sbrul la zhon pa bskyed do/ /de ltar bskyed la a las byung ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ so so'i 38—87

snying po thugs ka'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhugs pa de nyu/ de kun kyi snying ga nas so so'i sngags kyi phreng ba la dmigs la/ bzlas pa brtsam par bya'o//na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā 3bheya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ brnya brnya/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ be+e ga ra ṇa ③ / a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa shel/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ tiṅga le/ da ha da ha/ te dzo ba thuti/ ti li ti li ban+dha ban+dha swā hā zhes bum pa re re la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ mchod pa dang / phyogs skyong dang gtso bo la bstod pa la sogs pa ci rigs par byas la rol mo dang /sil snyan rnams kyis rab tu mnyes par bya zhing spos dang 'o ma la sogs pas mchod pa'am sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas slob ma las thams cad pa'i bum pas khrus chu nas bton nas gos gsar pa gyon te maṇ+ḍal dbul ba la sogs pa bya ste/dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / me tog gtor ba dang / gang la phog pa'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan bstan cing / de nyid kyi snying po brgya rtsa brgyad zlos su gzhug go/ /de nas sgra rnam pa sna tshogs dang bcas pas dbang bskur bar bya'o//dbang bskur ba bzhin du cho ga'i lhag ma ma lus par bya'o/ /de nas yang mchod yon la sogs pa phul nas gtor ma'i cho ga rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas byin gyis brlab pa yang tshul bzhin du byas la gtor ma de dag la dar sna tshogs dang gdugs dang bcas pas snang gsal spang ste ṣ+ṭhari mthon po'am nags tshal stug por bskyal lo/ /dung la sogs pa'i sgra sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang / sgrub pa po rnams kyang rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa la/ lag pa dang rkang pa'i gar dang ldan pas nyi ma rtse shar la bskyal/ nang du log la bgegs mnan pa'i cho ga bya/de nas bkra shis gsol/ dkyil 'khor bsdu/ bla ma la yon dbul lo/ /bsod 38—88

nams rdzogs pa'i don du ston mo bya/ cho ga'i lhag chad kha bskang —khye ba'i don du yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ lha rnams slob ma dang gnyis su med par bstem/ snying pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i nang du bzhugs par bya'o/ /slob mas bla ma la yon phul la dga' ba dang yi rang bar /thu bya'o/ /phyogs skyong ba bcu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /dpa la rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gza' chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas gnas yid dang mthun par gza' chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te sa'i cho ga la sogs pa sngon du song bas sa stegs gru bzhi pa la shin tu mnyam par bya ste/ thig btab la tshon rtsi sna sogs pas dkyil 'khor le'u thutse dgu pa la so so'i mdog dang mthun pa sgo bzhi dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /de nas bum pa dgu la so so'i mtshan ma btab la gnas su gzhag par bya'o/ /grwa rnams su phur bu dang rdo rje skud pas sbrel la mkhas pas gzugs so/ /de ltar byas 5pa so so'i gnas su mtshan ma bris te/ ngos bzhir 6rdo rje dang rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / rgya gram bri'o/ /dbus su rnam 'joms/ shar du pa ba sangs / nub tu zla ba'i mtshan ma/ lhor phur bu/ byang du lhag pa/ shar lhor mig dmar/ lho nub tu sgra gcan 'dzin/ nub byang du nyi ma/ byang shar du spen pa'i mtshan ma bri'o/ /sgo rnams su lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgog dril bu bri'o/ /de nas so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drangs te/ lag pa gnyis 'khor lo ltar byas la/ oṃ na maḥdz+watsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa 8ye hūṃ zhes brjod pas/38—89

dbus su rnam 'joms sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bskyed do/ /lag pa g.yas pa bkan la pad+ma'i tshul du bstan la/ na mo ra ti bi ya sarba swa ta lha kyeta ka ra nyi ti ka swā hā zhes brjod pas/ shar gyi bum pa la pa ba sangs mdog dmar po rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bskyed do/ /lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs la mthe bong dang mdzub mo sbyar te zla gam gyi tshul du bstan la/ na ma ཿtsabye 2ya shi ta ha pra bha ba ma li ni swā hā zhes brjod pas/ nub tu zla ba mdog dkar po ngang pa la zhon pa lag pa na pad+ma thogs pa drung na bud med rnga yab thogs pa bskyed do/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur bcangs la/ lag pa g.yas pa dam pa sbyin pa'i tshul du byas la / na mo de ba gu ru bha ki sha ya sa ra sa / kyeh+ye na ha ga ri ri swā hā zhes brjod pas / lhor phur bu sku mdog dkar po zla ba'i steng na 'dug pa dar ser po'i stod g.yogs gyon pa/ lag pa g.yon pa 4/na glegs bam thogs pa/ g.yas chos ston pa 'dra ba bskyed do/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa brang du bzhag 5la/ na mo yu bā rā dzā treya sarba satwa pa tsa la ya swā hā zhes brjod pas/byang du gza' lag pa mdog ser po rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon ut+pal / g.yas dam pa sbyin pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la 'dug par dzabaskyed do/ /g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la mdzub mo dang gung mo mtshan ma'i 8tshul du byas la/na mo bhu su ta rak+ta 9ma bya sri ya garta a pa ra na ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/shar lhor mig dmar mdog dkar po rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas ral gri g.yon chad gri thogs pa bskyed do/ /lag pa g.yon bkan la snod kyi tshul du bstan la/ na mo bye sha ma ge'u smra shi dza li ta a tsa sha swā hā zhes brjod 17pas/38—90

lho nub tu sgra gcan mdog dud ka mi'i mgo la ro smad sbrul du 'khyil pa lus mig gis khengs pa/ g.yas mda' gzhu g.yon rin po che'i snod 'dzin pa bskyed do/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la/ mthe bong gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang stezi1/ nam mkha'i tshul du bya ste/ oṃ ma ka sho pa ya swā hā zhes brjod pas/nub byang du nyi ma mdog dmar po rta la zhon pa lag pa gnyis pad+ma thogs pa bskyed do/ /g.yas thal mo'i tshul du byas la na mo bha hing ga ma ma hā yā 2na ka sa swā hā zhes brjod pas/ byang shar du spen pa mdog nag po gos dmar po gyon pa g.yas ral gri g.yon zhags pa thogs pa bskyed do/ /sgo rnams su gzhan dang mthun pa'i sgo ma bskyed do/ /khyams rnams su rgyu skar rnams bskyed/ de dag la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥye shes sems dpa' dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang gnyis su med par bstem par byas la/ ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs te bsnyen pa bskyar ba ni/ oṃ shu swā hā/ oṃ so swā hā/ oṃ z-i 4/swā hā/ oṃ bu swā hā/ oṃ saṃ swā hā/ oṃ ra swā hā/ oṃ a swā hā / oṃ sa swā hā/ de dag re re la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa bya ste/ gza' brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pa'i gtor ma la yang bstod do/ /de nas mchog gi bzlas pa brtsam 5par bya'o/ /so so'i bzlas pa bum pa la dmigs te/ oṃ ma hā kā le be+e ga ra ṇa a dzi 6te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ti ṭi ti ṭi ting ga le da ha da ha te dzo 7ba ti/ ti li ti li hūṃ phaṭa swā hā zhes pa re re la stong phrag re re bzlas so/ /gtso bo ni so so'i las dang spyor/ las su byed na gong ma'i so so'i snying po la khri phrag re bskyal la yang sbyar ro/ /dbang bskur na tha ma rnams kyis bya'o/ /brgya brgya'i bar du gza' rnams la pū dza bya'o//38—91

dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis gza' rnams mnyes par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams —1/khrus byas te/ gos gsar pa gyon la bskyed pa la sogs pa sngon du byas/dkyil 'khor du bcug ste me tog dor ba la sogs pa dang / dbang bskur bar bya'o / /de nas khrus byas la gza' chen po brgyad kyi ba dzi gtang tsongo / /de'i 'og tu phyogs skyong dang bgegs kyi gtor ma sgra sna tshogs pa dang ldan pas btang la / dkyil 'khor bsdu ba dang bkra shis gsol ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /gza' chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga nyi ma bcud len bya ba dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas gnas khang yid dang mthun par me tog sil ma bkram la sa chog la sogs pa sngon du song bas rgyu skar rnams kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad la dkar po lte ba sngon po/ mu khyud pad+ma'i phreng bas mdzes par bskor ba/ khyams dar dmar bo la shar nas brtsams nas sna tshogs yid du 'ong ba'i khang bu bdun bdun gyis bskor ba sgo bzhi mu khyud sna tshogs skar ma'i 'od 'khrug pa bri'o/ /de nas gtso bo'i mtshan ma dang / pad+ma rnams la gza' brgyad kyi mtshan ma dang / khang bu rnams su shar nas brtsams te4/ mdung dang / mda' bo che dang / 'khor lo dang / gtun shing dang / phub dang /ral gri dang / rnga yab dang / me dang / chu dang / sa dang / rlung dang /rgyal mtshan dang / sbud pa dang / rdo rje dang / me long dang / bse kha 38—92

sbyar dang / dngul gyi phreng ba dang / zhags pa dang / mda' dang /lcags kyu dang / sin dhū —1snara'i sol ba dang / seng ge dang / wa dang /byi la dang / glang po dang / bya rgod dang / ri skyegs dang / rma bya rnams bri bar bya'o/ /de nas bum pa nyi shu rtsa dgu la rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ so so'i mtshan ma dri sna tshogs pas btab la/ phyogs su gzhag go/ /phyogs mtshams rnams su phur bus 'khor bar gzhag go/ /de dag gi bar bar du'ang tshon sna tshogs pa'i sgud pas stel lo/ /bdug spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa ༄ bsham mo/ /de nas gza' dang ༄ rgyu skar gyi gtor ma dang / phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma tshul bzhin du bsham mo/ /de nas yan lag bdun pa sngon du song bas so so'i bum par sngags dang phyag rgyas bskyed do/ /shar gyi bum pa dang po nas brtsams te smin drug sngudakar po zhal gcig phyag stong dang 5ldan pa phyag g.yas 6na mdung bsnams pa/ zhal nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab pa/ khyi dkar po 7la zhon pa bskyed do/ / de bzhin du gzhan 3sna'adra ba la snar ma mdog ser ljang phyag na mda' bo che nya la zhon pa/ mgo mdog dkar smug 'khor lo sre mo la zhon pa/ lag mdog dkar rjo gtun shing bsnams pa glang la zhon pa/ nab so mdog dkar po 11phyag na phub ba lang sal zhon pa/rgyal mdog dkar ser phyag na ral gri khyung la zhon pa—/ skag sngon po rnga yab bsnams pa rta la zhon pa bskyed do/ /lho phyogs su mchu mdog saser ba lag pa brgya stong grangs med pa rin po che'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa/ phyag rnams na me bsnams pa bya la zhon pa bskyed do/ /gre mdog sngo skya phyag —na chu/ glang po 8la zhon pa/ dbo 9mdog dmar skya phyag rnams na sa/ stag la zhon pa/38—93

me bzhi mdog dkar po phyag na rlung / rin po che sna bzhi'i khri la gnas pa/nag pa mdog nag po phyag rnams na rgyal mtshan g.yag la zhon pa/ sa ri mdog ser po phyag na sbud pa/ gser kyi gdan (1la bzhugs pa/ sa ga mdog dud ka phyag rnams rdo rje gdengs pa/ sbrul la ④zhon pa bskyed do/ /nub tu gzi brjid chen mo mdog dmar phyag rnams (sheme long / glog la zhon pa'o/ /spyon mdog ser skya phyag rnams na bse kha sbyar/ dred la zhon pa/ snrubs khusku mdog dmar ser phyag rnams na dngul gyi phreng ba/ rlung la zhon pa/ chu stod mdog sngon mo phyag rnams na zhags pa/ 'brug la zhon pa'o/ /chu smad mdog ljang sngon phyag rnams na ba dan bsnams pa/ ce srung la zhon pa/ gro bzhin mdog smug po phyag rnams na lcags kyu bsnams pa/ seng ge la zhon pa'o/ /byi bzhin mdog dmar skya phyag rnams na sin dhū gera'i sol ba/ wa la zhon pa/byang du mon gru mdog ljang gu phyag rnams na seng ge dkar mo/ dom la zhon pa'o//mon dre mdog mthing ga phyag rnams na be+eng mo/ sprin la zhon pa'o/ /khrums stod mdog ljang ser phyag rnams la 6byi la khra mo bsnams pa/ ngang pa la zhon pa'o/ /khrums smad mdog ljang sngon phyag 1na glang sngon po bsnams pa/ ra la zhon pa/nam gru mdog mthing ga phyag rnams na bya rgod ser po/ bum pa la zhon pa'o/ /tha skar mdog ljang dmar phyag na ri skegs khra mo/ rnga mo la zhon pa'o/ /bra nye mdog dung ser rin bo che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ phyag brgya stong na rma bya sngon po 8bsnams pa/ zhal gabyug pa zhal nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab pa rus sbal zhon pa bskyed do/ /de dag kyang sa bon kun las byung ba 'od zer brgya stong dpag tu rnged pa 'phro ba bskyed do/ /sngags ni oṃ sa swā hā/ oṃ lo swā 38—94

hā / oṃ ta lkuswā hā/ oṃ pha swā hā/ oṃ ke swā hā/ oṃ saṃ swā hā/ oṃ ghu swā hā/oṃ khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ nye swā hā/ oṃ si swā hā/ oṃ ye swā hā/ oṃ wu 2swā hā/ oṃ i swā hā/ oṃ gi swā hā/ oṃ ra swā hā/ oṃ ru swā hā/ oṃ bha swā hā/ oṃ te swā hā / oṃ ram̐ swā hā/ oṃ ri swā hā/ oṃ rda swā hā/ oṃ khri swā hā/ oṃ sma swā hā/oṃ lam̐ swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ swā hā/ oṃ dha swā hā/ oṃ na swā hā/ oṃ nya swā hā/ zhes go rims kyis so so'i ye shes sems dpa' rnams bsnyim ༄ la/ bum pa zhal gyi bdud rtsi chu bo'i rang bzhin du dmigs so/ /de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa'i bye brag ci rigs par byas la/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/de nas slob ma gos gsar 4pa gyon la/ khrus nas bton 5la dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang / me tog phog pa'i las kyi lha ngo bstan pa dang / dbang bsgur bar bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma'i cho ga rgyas par bya'o/ /gtor ma chu klung chen por bskyal lo/ /dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing slob ma bum pa'i chus khrus bya zhing bkra shis gsol ba dang / tshogs ji ltar rigs par bsag go/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje go cha ma zhes bya ba/dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gang dag stobs dang yon tan 'phel bar 'dod pas/ lha chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pas/ gnas khang yid dang mthun par sems bskyed pa dang / tshogs bsags 7pa ci rigs par byas la/ sa'i cho ga dang sta gon ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du byas la/ sa stegs 'dom gang ba 38—95

la sa chags la sogs pa legs par byas la thig btab la cho ga rdzogs par bya ste/lte ba sngon po mu khyud ser pos bskor la/ /pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud pad+ma sna tshogs pa/ gru chad ljang gu/ khyams dang sgo rnams su ldan pa bris la dbus su gtso bo'i mtshan ma'o/ /shar du tri shu la rtse gsum pa/ nub tu pad+ma / byang du 'khor lo/ lhor rdo rje gsum pa/ shar lhor mda'/ lho nub tu glang po che'i mche ba/ nub byang du zhags pa/ byang shar du mdung thung bri'o / /sgo rnams su sgo ma'i mtshan ma legs par bris la bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dgu la lha so so'i mtshan ma btab la/ mgul chings la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa51/ gu gul la las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis btab la bdugs 2la bzhag go/ /grwa dang ngos rnams su seng ldeng gi phur pa sor brgyad pa la dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan btags la gzugs so/ /de nas mchod pa'i bye brag dang / lha brgyad la gtor ma brgyad la sogs pa bshams la/ de nas tshogs bsag pa'i rten nam mkha' la sprul la sems bskyed pa la sogs pa'i dge spyor gyi yan lag rnams byas la/ gtso bo la sogs pa lha so so'i bum par spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes bum pa'i ngo bor gnyis su med par dmigs la gtso bo'i sngags dang phyag rgya snga ma rnams dang 'dra'o/ /de nas 'khor gyi lha rnams man+t+ra dang mu tras ri1spyan drang ba ni/ g.yon pa mgo 4thod pa thogs pa ltar byas la/ g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum 'dud 5pa rtse gsum pa ltar byas la/oṃ ru swā hā zhes brjod 6pas ma hā de ba mdog sngo skya/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/g.yas tri shu 7la rtse gsum pa g.yon thod pa thogs pa/ skra badze+es 8shing mig 'bru tshugs su lta 9ba/ mche ba gcigs pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan sna tshogs pas 38—96

brgyan pa bskyed do/ /yang lag pa g.yon pa kha'i thad kar pad+ma ltar byas la/g.yas pa mje bong bkan pa snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ oṃ swā hā zhes brjod 1pas tshangs pa dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa g.yas dung bsnams pa/ skra badze+es 3—shing mche ba gcigs pa 'jigs pa'i nga ro can bskyed do / /lag pa g.yon pa 'khor lo ltar byas te/ g.yas pa dbyug to 'phyar ba ltar byas nas/ oṃ bhi swā hā zhes brjod pas khyab 'jug dud ka zhal dgu mche ba gatshigs pa/ dbu skra thor tshugs gcig tu 'khyil rngub/ lte ba man chod sbrul du 'khyil byab/ lus kun spyan mig gis khengs pa zhal gdangs pa/ steng 5ma lha zhal dkar po yod pa/ g.yon 'khor lo g.yas rin po che'i dbyug to 'phyar ba bskyed do/ /lag pa g.yas kyi mthe bong dang mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad la lhag ma gsum nas gang gis ma reg par byas la/ oṃ i swā hā zhes brjod pas brgya byin ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum pa/ g.yon phreng ba 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bskyed do/ /lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gnyis dang gung mo gnyis sbyar ba bkug la lhag ma mda' ltar byas la/oṃ shaṃ swā hā zhes brjod pas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug mdog smug po/ zhal gcig hūṃphyag gnyis pa g.yas mda' g.yon gzhu bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bskyed do/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la mdzub mo gnyis glang po che'i mche ba ltar byas la/ oṃ ga swā hā zhes brjod pas tshogs kyi bdag po mdog nag po sbrul ma rungs pa rnams kyis lus la brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa glang po che'i mche ba g.yon pa 7glang po che'i ko ba thogs pa rab tu 'jigs pa sna glang po'i sna dang mtshungs pa rab tu bskyed do/ /lag pa gnyis rab tu brkyang 38—97

ba / oṃ bhi swā hā zhes brjod pas nag po chen po mdog nag la yan lag rags pa / skra g.yengs la so rno ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas g.yon zhags pa thogs pa bskyed do/ /lag pa gnyis mdung 1gsor ba ltar byas la/ oṃ ga swā hā zhes brjod pas smin drug gi bu mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis mdung 'dzin pa bskyed do/ /de ltar bskyed pa la mchod pa lnga phul ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug gi las bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa ci rigs par dbul lo/ /lha chen po brgyad la bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas lha chen po brgyad kyi so so'i sngags so so'i bum pa la khri phrag re bzlas la ye shes sems dpa' dang 'phro 'du sdogs par byas la/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang ldan pas slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug ste/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha rda ma hā satwa 7badz+ra dhā ra ā dzñā4pā ya ha ha ho/ gdong g.yogs te me tog dor ro/ /de nas gdong g.yogs bkrol 5la so so'i bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ro/ /de nas lha chen po brgyad la bstod pas bstod la gtor ma btang / slob ma khrus nas bton 6la 'jig rten pa'i lha rgyab kyis phyogs pa las 'dod pa'i don ster bar gsol ba gdab/ de nas mchod pa lnga phul te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams ya hi gats+tsha 7zhes gshegs su gsol/ dkyil 'khor bsnyu bkra shis gsol/lha chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs pa'i lam ston par byed pa zhes bya ba dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa sdogs so// //༄7/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bsgur bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po dam tshig dang 38—98

ldan pas gnas khang yid dang mthun par me tog sngon po la sogs pa sa 1 'phags pa rnams mngon 2par mchod nas sa'i cho ga la sogs pa rnams sngon du song nas/ sa stegs gru gsum legs par byas la cho ga bzhin du thig legs par btab la/ de nas tshon btang ste/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dkar po lte ba sngon po/ mu khyud sna tshogs pad+ma'i phreng ba khyams dmar po sgo bzhi rigs dang 'dra ba/ phyi'i mu khyud sbrul 'bar ba rab tu 'khyil pas 'khor bar bris la/bum pa brgyad gtso bo'i bum pa dang dgu la so so'i mtshan ma bris la/ rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa gzhag go/ /de nas mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa dang /klu gtor la sogs pa yang bsham mo/ /de ltar bshams la tshogs sogs —pa'i rten nam mkha' la sbrul la tshogs bsag /de nas so so'i mtshan ma dang ldan pas bum pa'i nang du gtso bo snga ma dang 'dra bar bskyed/ 'khor gyi klu rnams ni lag pa rnams sprul mgo gdengs pa ltar byas la/ oṃ phuḥswā hā zhes brjod pas mtha' yas mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa smad sbrul du 'khyel ba dbu la rin po che dang sbrul mgo bdun gye gdengs ka yod pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas zhags pa g.yon pad+ma bsnams pa bskyed do/ /de dag kyang gdan pad+ma'i sdong po'i steng na nyi ma dang zla ba'i steng du bskyed do/ /phyag rgya snga ma dang 'dra ba la lho phyogs su oṃ ba swā hā zhes brjod pas 'jog po mdog dkar po g.yas zhags pa g.yon pad+ma thogs pa snga ma dang 'dra ba bskyed do//nub tu oṃ rgyu swā hā zhes brjod pas karko ṭa 4dmar po phyag mtshan snga ma dang 'dra ba bskyed do/ /byang du oṃ pha swā hā zhes brjod pas u li ka mdog dmar skya snga ma dang 'dra ba phyabaskyed do/ /shar lhor oṃ phi swā hā zhes brjod pas nor rgyas mdog 38—99

ser skya snga ma bzhin du bskyed do/ /lho nub tu oṃ phe swā hā zhes brjod pas dung skyong sngo skya bskyed do/ /nub byang du oṃ paṃ swā hā zhes brjod pas pad+ma sngo skya bskyed tsho do / /byang shar du oṃ phe 2swā hā zhes brjod pas ba su —na mdog dmar sngo snga ma bzhin bskyed do/ /de dag kyang sa bon phu las yang dag par 'byung ba rab tu mdzes par bskyed do/ /de nas de dag la mchod pa lnga lnga dbul lo/ /de nas so so'i ye shes sems dpa' dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs chodagug gzhug byas la bum chu klu'i ngo bor zhu bas chu bdud rtsir dmigs la so so'i yum gyi mgul nas 'khyud pa'i thugs ka'i yi ge phuḥzhes 'od ldan pa la dmigs la snying po rgyas bsdus gang mos pa la brgya phrag gcig /klu'i snying po re re la khri phrag 5bzlas so/ /de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa re bya'o/ /de nas slob ma smyung 6bar gnas par byas la 'o mas gdong bkrus la lag tu klu shing 'bras bu dang bcas pa thogs la dkyil 'khor du bcug la dam tshig dang sdom pa dbog7 /de nas bum chu bdud rtsi'i ngo bo dang ldan pas dbang bskur ro/ /de nas gtor ma btang / maṇ+ḍal bsdu/bkra shis gsol lo/ /klu brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dug las rgyal ba zhes bya ba slob dpon mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho ga bum pa sgrub par 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po dam tshig dang ldan pas gnas khang yid dang mthun par sa gzhi rnams legs par mnyam ster/ byug spos la sogs pa rnams kyis 9chag chag btab la dkyil 'khor la brten pa dang / maṇ+ḍal la brten pa gnyis gang mos su bya'o/ /38—/00

—dkyil 'khor la brten na dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bzhin bya'o/ /maṇ+ḍal la brten na khru gang gi maṇ+ḍal sngon po zlum zhing dbus yid tsam mtho ba la chags legs par bya zhing mnyam pa'i steng du bum pa gser ram dngul lam zangs sam lcags las 1sgrub pa po 'byor pa'i khyad par kyis bya'o/ /de yang pad+ma dmar po'i mdog ltar dmar zhing byi ru dang / mtshal bzang po'i mdog ltar dmar zhing nag po ra ri med cing shin tu 'jam par bya'o/ /de yang tshad dang ldan par bya ste/ zhabs kyi gdub krol dpangs su sor gcig gi tshad du bya/ stegs la sor gnyis/ lto ba lhang bzed dang 'dra bar bya/mgrin pa ni dpangs su sor bzhi phyir gyed pa kha khyer gyi 'dab ma la sor gnyis/mar bcal ba la nas gang dpangs de dang mnyam/ kha'i bu ga ni sor bzhi'i tshad du bya'o/ /sto ba'i tshad ni rab la phul nyi shu rtsa gcig /'bring po rnams su bcu gcig dang / bdun dang bre gang shong bar bya'o/ /tha ma ni phul bzhi dang phul gang khyor bzhi shong bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i bum pa chag pa dang /zhom pa dang / gas pa dang / nag po ra ri dang / thag thug med pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni dbang bskur 'jug pa'i rkyen dang byin rlabs 4su nges pa'o/ /de lta bu'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du/ chu rab tu gtsang ma srog chags med pas bkang ste/ dung dang nor bu dang mu tig mig ma phug pa dang /byi ru dang gser dang rin po che lnga dang / gi ri ga ni dang sing hā dang / bya kṛ 5dang / sa hā dang / sa ha tshide ba la sogs te sman lnga dang / nas dang 'bras dang / mon sran gre'u dang / go dang til te 'bru lnga dang / tsan+dan dang / ga bur dang / gu gul dang / gla rtsi dang / spos sbyar ma ste dri 38—101

lnga / ka ra dang / bu ram dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar dang lan tshwa la sogs te snying po lnga dang / man shel dang rdo rje dang / me tog dmar po rab tu dri zhim pa rnams kyang drugs la/ de nas dri dang ldan pa'i chu la sngags bzlas la bum pa bsangs te/ tsan+dan dmar po la sogs pa'i dri zhim zhing bkra shis pa'i rdzas gang yang rung bas lha rnams kyi mtshan ma legs par bris la ras dmar po dri ma med pas 1mgul pa bcing ngo / /ku sha dang shug pa la sogs pa'i shing lo ma can me tog dang 'bras bur ldan pas kha rgyan 2la tshon sna lnga'i ras skud kyis dril te/ mdud pa byas la de'i steng du ba dmar po'i 4lci bas rgyas btab zheste/rtswa drur 6ba nyag ma bdun dang rma bya bdun bzhugs so 7/ /de dag gi steng du rin po che'i snod chung zhing mdzes pa'i nang du yungs kar dang til dkar po dang /a lo — ka'i phye ma rnams blugs la gzhag go/ /de dag ma blugs pa'i gong du ni gu gul la bdud rtsi thab 9spyor gyi sngags/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod la bdug par bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa po bdag nyid kyis gos gsar pa gyon te/lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du chu gtsang ma drugs la de nyid a yongs su gyur pa las/zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du dmigs la/ lag pa 1 snagayas pa'i sor mo gsum rdo rje rtse gsum par dmigs te/ oṃ sho dadhe oṃ sha tan ye swā hā zhes brjod pas g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus su gtor la de nas g.yas pa'i srin lag chu nang du bcug la / de nyid la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du dmigs la/ bdag nyid kyis hub gsum btung ngo / /de ltar nye reg dang 'thor 'thung byas la bdag nyid khro bo ti rīdhi 1ri'i gzugs kyis langs la t+t+waṃ hūṃ zhes brjod pas rkang pa g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa phur pa nadamigs pa dang / mig g.yas pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 38—/02

steng du hūṃ sngon po 'phred la nyal ba dmigs/ g.yon pa ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ dmigs la rab tu sdang ba'i mig gis bgegs rnams la dbang ldan nas brtsams te/ lkuhūṃ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i rtsig pa dang / ra ba dang / dra ba dang / gur dang / sa gzhir 27 dmigs par byas la phur bu dang tho ba thogs pas kyang mtshams gcad par bya'o/ /de nas phur bu'i yungs kar blangs te/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha gro dha tī li shī lā 1ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pa dang bgegs bskrad/ yang bdud rtsi thab chosbyor du dmigs te/ hūṃ hūṃ/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mngag gzhug pho nya'i las mdzad pa/ /khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yi/ /yungs kar dag la mngon par bsngags5/ /phyogs rnams kun du gtor byas na/ /bgegs kyi sbyor ba rgyun chod cig /de nas bdud rtsi thab 9spyor gyi sngags dang 7/ phyogs mtshams kyi sngags brjod cing gtor la bskrad do ༄8/ /nad pa la byed na gang 9gi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa dang ldan pa'i sa nyid la dbus su khru do khru phyed / pa'i sa 'bru 1sna tshogs pas bkang la bzhag go/ /de nas sngags pa bdag nyid kyis khrus bya ste/ bum pa'i nang du dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drangs te/ de nas lag pa'i sor mo tshanang du bsnol te/ khu tshur bcangs la mje bong dang gung mo dang mthe'u chung rnams gshibs 1 te/ bsgrengs la nas re re las ma reg par byas la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā mu pa ta ye badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa snyeya swā hā zhes pas rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan gsal bar dmigs la/ bum pa'i nang du paṃ yongs su gyur pa las/bdud rtsi lnga'i chu rgyun dag pa a+yolas pad+ma dkar po'i ze 'bru dang / sdong por 38—/03
