oṃ āḥhūṃ su pi 1tri zhes pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo chen po rdo rje 'bar ba sku mdog dbyar gyi char sprin ltar sngo nag tu gnas pa/ khro gnyer rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin gcigs pa/ mche ba gcigs pa/ spyan gser btso ma ltar dmar ser/smin ma dmar po gyen du bskyod pa/ mchu sder rdo rje gnam lcags las byas pa/'dab gshog nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ zhal gsum/ spyan dgu/dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes 2bhepa/ sbrul gyis rked chings byas pa/ thod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ g.yang gzhi rlon pa stod la gsol ba/ stag gi g.yang gzhis chosham thabs byas pa/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can thod du byas pa/ klu'i rgyal po tak+ṣa ka rked 5chings byas pa/ klu'i rgyal po sog ma med gdan khrir byas pa zhabs kyis gzir ba/ yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ bar ma gnyis g.yas ral gri g.yon seng ldeng gi phur bu bsnams pa/ g.yas tha ma na gnam lcags kyi tho ba/ g.yon lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ rdo rje gnam lcags kyi phreng ba se ral khar byas pa/thod pa skom ke rlon gyi phreng bas do shal byas pa/ me'i ser ba phab nas klu'i gnas bsregs pa/ sku las 7ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ sprin nag 'khyil pa'i nang na 5bzhugs pa cig 9tu bdag bsgom mo/ /de ye shes lngas dbang bskur/sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab po/ /de nas rdo rje sna nan bya ba ni bdag bskyed pa'o/ /de nas gzhan khobaskyed pa ni mdun du paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du mo las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūṃ sngon po las dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed de1 / de nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drang /oṃ su pi mutri badz+ra durnye ma hā gro dha/ maṇ+ḍa la ma hā te ā be sha ya a 5ā/ phyag 38—271

rgya bzhi bya'o/ /de nas phyi nang gi mchod pa sngags kyis dbul lo/ /de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la khro bo la dbul lo/ /oṃ su pi lhatri badz+ra dudhe ma hā kro dha ba bo bhuñdza/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi sa ma ye swā hā/ de nas bstod pas bstod do 5/ /hūṃ me dpung sprin nag 'khyil pa'i klong dkyil nas/ /klu rgyal sog med 'khyil pa'i gdan stengs nas/ /khro rgyal rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba ni—/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rdo rje'i gshog pa can/ /rdo rje'i zhegashog pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /rdo rje sder chen gdengs pa ni/ /gdug pa'i klu rgyal snying 'dar cod pan sa la 'brul bye/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi gad rgyangs drag po yis / /klu gdon gdug pa'i snying 'dar mgo bo 'gas/ / kha sbub ༄pebasgyel te khrag sgyugs gas nas 'chi/ /rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mchu bdar nas/ /klu gdon gdug pa'i snying khrag khong nas 'jib/ /ral ba kham nag gyen du g.yengs nas kyang / /me yi ser bas klu yi pho brang 'joms/ /gshog pa gser gyi spu gri brdabs 4nas kyang / /rgya mtsho gshags khunas klu rnams dum bur gtubs/ /sgro 'dab rdo rje lcags kyu 'bar ba yis/ /gdug pa'i klu rnams ma lus snying nas 'dren / /g.yas kyi phyag rgyas mibyugs pa yis/ /lha chen brgyad kyi mgo bcad nas / /ban+dha kyethogs pas dbu la brgyan/ /g.yon gyi phyag rgyas byugs pa yis//klu chen brgyad kyi snying phyung nas/ /rus sbal khog pa bkang nas gsol/ /g.yas kyi shes rab ral gri yis/ /klu rnams ma lus gtub par mdzad/ /g.yon pa seng ldeng phur bu yis/ /klu rnams ma lus rtsad nas gcod/ /g.yas na gnam lcags tho ba yis/ /sa bdag pho mo rdul du rlog /g.yon pa lcags kyu zhags pa yis/ /bka' 'das dgra bgegs 'ching zhing sdom/ /rdo rje 38—272

'bar ba'i ba spu nas/ /mkha' lding mtshon cha'i char bab nas/ /gdug pa'i klu rnams brlag ñtshapar mdzad/ /sku stod zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol nas kyang / /srid pa'i ma tshogs 'dar khyazhing sdud/ /sgu smad stag gi sham thabs gsol nas kyang / /gdug pa'i klu la stag ltar mchong bar byed/ /phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi sprul pa'i sku/ /khro chen 'bar ba che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bde gshegs gtum po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan klu gdug 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ su pi tri badz+ra dun+ta ༄ ma hā kro dha mi li mi li chohūṃ phaṭa/ces bsnyen pa bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i le'u i this// //sgrub pa'i dus su phyag rgya dang po gnyis klu'i gnya' ba dang mkhrig 6ma nas bzung ste/ mchu snying gar btsugs te khrag 'jib par bsam mo/ /klu gzir zhing bskrad de tshar bcad pa ni/ rabs chad kyi thod pa'am lcags snod 7du/bag zan las t+t+waṃklu'i gzugs sna tshogs byas/ yungs kar dang mtshon bdar ( ba'i phye ma dang / bdug pa'i dzas sna tshogs dang / sngags phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin dang skyebacas pas tshig cing skad ngan thon te bros so/ /phyag rgya ni maze bong gnyis sbrel te nam mkha' lding gi gshog pa bzhin du byas te/ oṃ tram̐ s+t+waṃ khro ⑪hūṃ phaṭa/ de yis rgya mtsho gshegs nas klu gton 1sate lcags kyu bsgril ma'i phyag rgya byas te hūṃ nā ga t+t+waṃ dza/ gnya' ba nas bzung nas 'ongs par bsam/oṃ badz+ra pa ti ga ru ḍa hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥr tsi sri dza hūṃ phaṭa/ phyag rgya ni mje bong gnyis rtse sprad de bsgrengs7/ mdzub mo gnyis gabyug la gcig 'khyud/ srin lag gnyis nang du bskum/ mthe chung gnyis thad kar brkyang ste/ dpral ba'i 38—273

thad kar phyag rgya byas te/ mtshog 1ma'i thad kar lan gsum bskor te dgol bas de nyid du nam mkha' la sprin nag po dang sngon po 'khrigs shing mtshon cha'i tshub ma phyogs kun nas langs te/ gnas thams cad tshig ste/ mi bzod nas cho nges 'debs shing / a la la khro bo'i rgyal po ci bsgo ba nyan no zer nas skyabs su song bar bsam mo/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ bi phu le pra ba re nā ge ma hā nā sne ga z-i da ya a brte dz+wa la dz+wa la/ sarba nā ga z-i 4da ya ne+e/ tī mi tī mi/ nā ga gu la bi dh+wabe+e lhani/ ha na ha na/ sarba nā ga z-i 6da ya ni/ dha ra dha ra/sarba duṣ+ṭa nā ga bha ba na ni/ pa tsa ya 7pa tsa ya/ sarba duṭ+wān nā gā nānashe/a kra ma a kra ma/ su min+t+ra 9ya/ sa ga ra bi ma le/ bi tra me ma hā nā ga te dza ba re swā hā/ de nas klu skrag par bya'o/ /thun gyi le'u i thi⑩// //gnyen ltaklu rigs dang gdon phal pa la/ glang ru rta rkang dang nya mgo bya rtug dang / skra shad dang gu gul nag po dang sbyar la bdug par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ seng ldeng dang lcags kyi phur bu la sum 'bum bzlas te snying gar gdab par 1 bya'o/ /budha ya/ oṃ tī li mi li/ tsan+d+ra tsadh+ri bat+ta 1 ya swā hā/ phur pa'i sngags so/ /yungs kar dang til dang ske tshe dang tshon phye dang bye ma la sum 'bum bzlas te/ brab cing gzir ba dang tshar gcad mapar bya'o / /mna' bsgags te phyis mi ldang bar bya'o/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ dza ta dza na nā ga bi dza tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha mes tsa ra si ti swā hā/ de lta bu ni gsad 7las thams cad la bya'o/ /'byung po bskrad cing gsad 7par 'dod na/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas dgug par bya/ bdag gi dza' 'od zer gyis klu'i khong du bstem par bya'o/ /28—271

khong du thim pa'i dza' 'od zer smug nag tu gyur pas/ klu la me 'bar te klu dang bsdongs klapa'i 'byung po rnams kyang 'thab cing skad 'byung ste 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /ma hā ru dra ru dra 3tha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ phyag rgya ni sor mo nang du bskum ste 1gung mo gnyis rtse sprad de bkug ste rgyag par bya'o/ /gang zhig klus gzir ba la stag gi mche ba dang / mtshon bdar 5ba'i phye ma dang / glang rong 6nag po'i chu nang du bskol lo/ /gar na bar bsgu bar bya'o/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /yang na khye'i gcin la bya'o/ /'byung po'i le'u ste i thi) // //klu la mchod pa bya zhing dug dbyung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor 'dom gang gru bzhi la/ /klu'i gzugs kyis dgod par bya'o/ /de bzhin klu sman mtshon pa bsag /de nas klu rnams spyan drangs la/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi 8bya ba sarba bit+ta 9nā ga rā dza sum̐ bha ni hūṃ/ rgyal sras thugs rje'i mchog mnga' ba'i/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal ba dang / /mtho ris thar pa bsgrub 7pa'i phyir/ /gsang sngags dam las 1 ma 'da' zhig /khyod kyi sems las 'das gyur te/ /byang chub bde ba bskyed pa dang / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal zhi ba'i phyir/ /khyod la rab tu skrag par bya/ /thams cad bde ba'i sa bon te/ /bde ba thams cad 'grub pa yin/ /dam tshig 'di las 'das gyur na/ /'chi bdag gi ni gsal shing ltar/ /rdo rje'i mtshon cha rnon po yis/ /khyod kyi yan lag gcod par 'gyur/ /oṃ swa ta badz+ra tre+e ka ra dra ba dra ba bi dru ba pi 1)ya na shan na ha na 2hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags des klu'i sems kyi 38—275

dkyil 'khor la 'khor bar sgong gis song bar bsam mo/ /sngags des klu'i sems la yod pa'i sgrib pa byang nas/ chos thos pa'i sems byang chub tu brtan par gyur nas/ sngon phyag na rdo rje'i bka' rjes su dran nas/ slob dpon yin snyam nas tshur mi gnod par stong grogs byed par 'gyur ro/ /ci bsgo ba nyan par 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i le'u i thi1// //de bzhin du char dbab par 2'dod na/ klu sgrub pa dang mchod pa gzhung bzhin byas/ pad+ma kha gsum maṇ+ḍal la/ /klu yi gzugs kyis dgod 5par bya/ /dbus su khro bo de nyid bsgom/ /'khor gyi klu rnams mchod cing bstod / /dam tshig dran te 'be+ebs par 'gyur/ /de yis phebs par ma gyur na/ /thod pa shin tu dkar ba la/ /sog med bskyed la gzir bar bya/ /lcags sam rabs chad thod pa ru/ /klu gzugs brubs te bdug 4cing gzir/ /de yis rab tu 'bab par 'gyur/ /char gyi le'u i thi5 /ser ba la thal chen dang dug dang yungs kar dang sbyin sreg byas pa'i thal bas bya'o/ /ser ba'i le'u i thi6 //dgra la chu skol gyis bya'o/ /dgra'i le'u i thi3 // //bdag bsrung ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bya'o/ /gzhan bsrung ba ni skud pa dang sngags dang rdzas kyis bya'o/ /bsrung ba'i le'u i thi // //38—276

nā ga tsit+ta rak+ta 1pi pa do sa ma ye swā hā/ klu'i snying khrag dbul lo/ /o nā ga ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ nā ga da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa/ nā ga pa tsa pa tsa t+t+waṃ phaṭa/nā ga ṭā li kri la ya 2/t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ nā ga shasti dza la mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ klu brdung ba'i 4sngags so/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ klu 'dul ba'i ngan thabs bal po'i man ngag rgya gar gyi bla ma mi tri pas 5mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/27༷ mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉lhar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉g.yo/ /khro bo chen po rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagacad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipa/271 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pri/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉sa/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhi/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉 sked/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lom/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasreg pa/ sku la/ 3/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skogig 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gigazhan/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes// 15〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pri/ 15〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas bi sha yā yin272 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pri/ sde〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro btang ngo / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rje/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉thabul/57〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skabs spubs/ tsu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadabs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabashags/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya/spyo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉than da/273 sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thog —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradral/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pri tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dun te/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste dang po'o/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'khrig 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpong / 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rdar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadug 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsho/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaton/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tha/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgreng /274 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatshogs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7me/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhan sa/38byed277

༄ / /khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'gor gyi cho ga1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ gro dha rā dza a gu dz+wa la a kha bi ra dza badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la bi bye nā maskya/ bod skad du/ khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /khro bo rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba 4la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtum drag 'jigs pa'i sgra skad 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /rje btsun de la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi dkyil 'khor cho ga bri/ /dad pa dang ldan pa / dam tshig dang rang gi brtul zhugs bsrung ba rnam par rtog pa med cing rgyud gcig pa/ bla ma dang rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba la mchog tu gus pa'i slob ma yon tan dang ldan pas/ dang po maṇ+ḍal dang tshogs kyi mchod pa chen po byas nas/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas bla ma khro ba med pa sngags dang phyag rgya dang rgyud la mkhas pa/ thos pa'i pha rol tu son pa/ rgyud 'dir dbang thob pa/ dam tshig dang / sdom pa dang ldan pa des khro bo bskyed 38—279

—la bsnyen pa la thug par byas nas/ su pi tri'i —1sngags 'bum bzlas pa bya ba ni sngon du bsnyen pa/de nas rgyud gzhan nas gsungs pa'i gnas yid du 'ong ba/ gang yang rung bar song nas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i chus 2 gtor te/der dkyil 'khor byas te/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byas te/ rang gi khro bo dang lha mo mchod la/ 'byung po thams cad la gtor ma byin nas/ sa'i lha mo las blang ba ni/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par byas snete dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes brjod la/thal mo sa la brdabs pa las/ sa'i lha mo sku phyed tsam 'thon jenas 'dug pa las—/ ngas 5sems can gyi don du dkyil 'khor byed pas/ bdag la sa byin cig ces brjod pa las/ khyod dkyil 'khor kyi bdag po yin pas/ dkyil 'khor kyi sa zhes brjod nas sa la thim par bsam mo/ /sa blang ba'i rim pa'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnal 'byor du gnas te/ de nas sa'i lha mo nam mkha' la gshegs par bsgoms la/ sa brko 6ste sa'i ro rnam 7lnga bsal la/der rin po che lnga dang 'bru lnga dang ldan pa'i bum pa gcig la slar rang gis sa dgang ngo / /de nas dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur du spos chu'i chag chag dang ba'i rnamyo/ pa lngas byug go/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon kyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 38——280

gnas nas/ stong pa nyid sngon du 'gro bas lha'i nga rgyal bya'o/ /sa gzhi thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin las/ hūṃ 7las rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsgoms nas/de'i dbus su nga rgyal gyis gnas par byas la/ lha'i rīng rgyal can dag gis dkyil 'khor bris par ༄ —gsol ba btab nas/ dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mig tu ma dang / a las grub pa'i nyi ma dang /zla ba 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas par bsams te/ rkang pa'i 'og tu hūṃ las rdo rje rgya gram 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa bsgoms nas langs te/ byang shar gyi mtshams nas bskor ba byas te/ rdo rje'i lta ba dang / rdo rje'i 'gros dag gis bgegs gzhom par bya'o/ /de nas yang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug nas/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i nga rgyal du byas nas/ de'i snying gar gnas pa'i sa bon las byung ba'i khro bo'i phur bu bskyed nas/ bdag gis ske nas bzung nas phyogs bcur phur bu gdab par bya'o/ /oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/sarba duṣ+ṭhan saphaṭa/ tī la ya kri la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra tī la ya / badz+ra dha rod 5a dzñā pa ya ti sarba bispyo 7kā ya bāñtsit+ta badz+ra shī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ces bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis gdab par bya'o/ /sa gzung 8ba'i rim pa'o—/ /de nas dkyil 'khor kyi dbus su khru gang ba'i dkyil 'khor zlum por byas la / lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i dri'i thig le byas la/ der me tog gi tshom bu bkram la sa bon las lhar bskyed la/ nam mkha'i lha bstems la/ ye shes kyi lha spyan drangs la/ nam mkhar bgegs 9bskrad nas bstems nasarka /38—281

mchod bstod bdud rtsi myangs la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ hūṃ bcom ldan rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba ni/ /rig sngags bdag po phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /de nas byin brlabs gnang ba lkumadzad par gsol/ /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs/ /lha rnams bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /dkyil 'khor byin brlab ri dngos grub mdzod/ /len gsum brjod do/ /lha lhag par gnas pa'o/ /de nas gser dang dngul la sogs pa'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa 'am/ yang na gnyis la sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du rang gi mtshan nyid bri/ las kyi bum pa la pad+ma'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje bri bar bya'o/ /gtso bo'i bum par sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin po che lnga/ dri chu bdud rtsi lngas bkang la/ bum pa gzhan du'ang de bzhin te/ mgul chings ras zung gcig gis bcing bar bya'o/ /me tog phreng ba dang gdugs kyis brgyan te/gdugs dkar po re re dbub par 4bya'o/ /tsu ta la sogs te 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i shing gis kha brgyan par bya'o/ /de nas gtso bo'i bum par pad+ma'i sku bskyed / phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan par byas la/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstims la/ mchod bstod dang bzlas pa bya/ dam tshig gi khro bo dang /ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gnyis 'dres pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas bum pa gzhan du yang shes par bya'o/ /las kyi bum pa la pad+ma'i steng du las thams cad pa'i khro bo bskyed la/ ye shes bcug la mchod pa dang bzlas pa byas nas/ ma zhu bar skur bzhugs par bsgoms nas thum grub bar du bgegs 38—282

ma rungs pa bsrung bar gsol ba gdab bo/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o / /de nas slob ma shar phyogs su maṇ+ḍal phul la der 'dug la/ rdo rje slob dpon byus 3༷gtso bo'i nga rgyal byas la gsol ba gdab bo/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas thu/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol / /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la sprul ④/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma'i lag pa nas bzung nas/bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bgyi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /gang dag de bzhin ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun kyis /snyegasang sngags kyi/ /tshogs mchog bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad gyemed brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med pa/ /skyob pa rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba yis /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad 3pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang 'di yis bcom/ /de nas kun mkhyen thob pa'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de nas nyan par rna ba rugatod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byed du bcug ste/38—283

de nas bya ba'i rgyud la sogs pa dang thun mong gi sdom pa dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i phas pham pa bcu bzhi dang / sdom pa dpog pa la sogs pa dag kyang bya'o/ /de nas slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri'i thig le byas te/ rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang pad+ma dag bskyed de/ de dag gi ste bar sa bon gsum bsam zhing / o snyahūṃ zhes gnas gsum du rdo rje gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas mchod de so shing me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags kyis btab la sbyin no/ /slob mas rtse 'cha' zhing rtsa ba brud la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dor ro/ /zhi ba la sogs te las dang dngos grub kyi rtags shes par bya'o/ /srung ༄1sgud la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i mdud pa bor te/ dpung pa g.yon pa la gdags par bya'o/ /de nas ku sha la las thams cad pa'i sngags kyi sa byin la/shar lho mtshams su mgo bstan la nyal te rmi lam dran par bya'o/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i rim pa'o zu de nas yol ba'i nang du log la mchod bstod dang bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas nang par dkyil 'khor kyi lha nam mkhar bteg la thig gdab par bya'o/ /tshon sna lnga'i skud pa so sor stong pa nyid las yi ge lngar gyur par bsam de nas de dag gcig tu bsgril la/ gser la sogs pa'i snod du bzhag la bdud rtsi lnga'am/ spos chus bsangs te g.yas g.yon dbus dang gsum du oṃ āḥdh+ri gis rim par bkod de bzhag /de ni dam tshig gi skud pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi skud pa 'od du gnas par bsams te/ rang gi mig gnyis su nyi ma 38—284

bsams te/ de'i steng du dzaḥdamar po bsam/ de nas mig gi rdzi ma 'dren pas—/ ye shes kyi skud pa dzaḥs ①drangs nas dam tshig gi skud pa la gzhug go/ /de nas mchod pa lngas mchod do/ /ye shes kyi skud pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas slob dpon nub tu 'dug nas/ skud pa rdo rje'i khu tshur g.yon pas bzung la/ gtso bor bsgoms la/ lte bar khya tshur bzhag la dzaḥgasum gyis slob ma'i lag tu g.yas pas 3drangs te byin la/ tshangs pa'i thig dang po gdab bo/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes gyen du btab pa'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'gro ba'i don gyi 4dus la bab po bar bskul lo/ /de nas tshangs thig gnyis pa yang de bzhin du gdab par bya'o/ /de nas kha dog gcig pa'i skud pa las thams cad pas byin gyis brlabs la sa'i thig btab la/de'i steng du ye shes kyi thig btab la snga ma'i thig byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi thig la mchod pa byas la slar gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas tshangs pa'i thig dang po btab la bya rog rjes gnyis lho byang du bri'o/ /de nas gnyis pa btab ste/ des zur bzhi'i bya rjes btsal lo/ /dang po shar gdab/de nas nub gdab/ de nas byang / de nas lho gdab/ de nas me rlung gi 5gru gdab / srin po dang dbang ldan gdab/ de nas cha chen nyi shur btab na bde ba yin/ de la dbus kyi pho brang dang sgo rta babs dang bcas pa'o/ /rdo rje ra ba me ri gnyis bco brgyad ma gtogs phyi nas btsal ba 6thig gi rim pa'o/ /de nas tshon sna lnga'i rim par bzhag ste/ stong pa nyid las yi ge lnga las bskyed de/ dri dang bdud rtsis bsangs la/ de nas snga ma bzhin du ye shes 38—285

tshon 'bar ba'i lta bas snga ma bzhin du bkug la bsnyim lahūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra phyas ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes bzlas/ de nas byang shar mtshams nas dkar po drangs te/mdzub gang bla ma'i lag pa g.yon pas bri'o/ /de nas/ chos dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste/ /sems can khams kun sgrol byed pa/ /rgyal ba rdo rje gnam lcags mchu 'bar (/ nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi ④gnas/ /zhes brjod de/ des chomachod la rin po che'i snod kyis bkab la gzhag go/ /de nas dbus nas bri bar bya ste/ rdo rje rtse lnga rgya gram rdo rje ra bar ldan pa/ de ni dbus kyi dkyil 'khor yin/ /de nas phyi yi zlum po ni/ /'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i lte ba bya/ /de yi phyi rim rdo rje'i ra ba bya/ /gru chad snam bu bzhi dang ldan / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /dril bu dang ni 'phan la sogs/ /me tog phreng ba rnams kyis brgyan/ /grwa thurnams dang ni sgo khyud du/ /rdo rje rin chen spras pa dang / /de bzhin zla ba phyed pas brgyan/ /rdo rje'i 1phreng ba dang pad+ma'i phreng ba bya'o/ /mtshan ma dgod pa yang rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte ba la rdo rje dril bu dgod par bya/ shar kyi rdo rje'i rtsibs rtsa la ral gri bri/ lho'i rdo rje'i rtsibs rtsa la seng ldeng gi phur bu/nub kyi rdo rje'i rtsibs rtsa la gnam lcags kyi tho ba/ byang gi rdo rje'i rtsibs rtsa 5la lcags kyu zhags pa dgod de/ de dag ni spunang gi phyag rgya dgod pa'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu dgod pa ni/ khro bo bcu'i phyag mtshan dgod de rgyud gzhan dang mthun/ 'khor lo'i grwa bzhir nang gi lha mo bzhi'i phyag mtshan dgod—/ lha snam kyi gzhir phyi yi lha mo bzhi'i phyag mtshan dgod/ sgo bzhir sgo srung 11bzhi'i phyag mtshan dgod de rgyud gzhan dang mthun/ dkar po ser po 28—286

dmar po dang / /de bzhin du ni ljang dang sngo/ /sngon bo nang du shes bya ste/ /'di ni tshon gyi rim pa yin/ /shar phyogs su ni dkar po che/ /lho phyogs su ni ser po che/ /byang ni snasnaljang gu yang dag ldan/ /dbus kyi sa yi cha nyid ni/ /nag po mig sman bcag dang mtshungs/ /'di dag ni dkyil 'khor bri zhing phyag rgya dgod pa'i rim pa'o /de nas bum pa dgod de/ gtso bo'i bum pa dbus su dgod/ las kyi bum pa byang shar mtshams su gzhag ste/ khyod kyis bgegs bsrung ba gyis shig ces brjod nas/ bispyo ta kṛ ta bzlas—/ bum pa gzhan rnams ༄ ni dang po lha 4gang bsgoms pa'i phyogs su gzhag go/ /de nas sbyin sreg gi cho ga ni/ sgrub pa'i thabs su rgyas par bshad pas 'dir ma bris so/ /de nas mchod pa'i rdzas ni/ me tog snod ni brgya 'am stong ngam bcu'o/ /bdug spos dang mar me dang dri chab dang / zhal zas kyi snod brgya 'am/ stong ngam bcu las nyung du mi rung ngo / /ar+ghaṃ 5dang zhal bsil dang rol mo'i bye brag rnam pa sna tshogs pa dung dang / rdza rnga dang / 'khar skurnga dang / pi wang dang /gling bu dang / ḍa ma ru dang / dril bu g.yer ka 3dang / pheg rdob pa dang / rnga rings la sogs pa yang 'byor tshad do/ /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla re dang / 'phan dang / sprin chen po la sogs pa yang bri'o/ /slob 38—287

ma'i grangs dang bstun pa'i gtor ma du 'byor pa dang / gzhan yang lha rnams la 'bul ba'i tshogs kyi rdzas dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / ras zung dang bcas pa mchod rdzas 'byor tshad pa yang gzhag go/ /mchod pa'i rdzas kyi rim pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor cha rkyen thams cad phun sum tshogs par shes nas ni/ de nas rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gu rus khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i nga rgyal byas te/ me tog gi phreng ba sngon po blangs te dh+ri bzhi'i sngags zlos shing rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor te/bltas la phreng ba de bcom ldan 'das la phul la/ yang gar bya ba'i tshul gyis rang gi mgo la bcings nas phyag bya'o/ /rang lha'i rnal 'byor du 'jug par bya ste / dang por khro bo gnod mdzes kyis bgegs bsal ba'i sbyor ba sngon du byas nas bla ma mchod pa dang / stong pa nyid dang / ye shes kyi yan lag bsgoms nas / 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang / gzhal yas khang bsgom 1pa dang / dam tshig bskyed la ye shes spyan drangs shing cibastems la/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba yan chad byas la/ gtor mas 'byung po thams cad tshim par byas la/de nas sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyis bsgom par bya'o/ /ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang bsres nas bsang gtor dang mchod pa dang bdud rtsi myang ba dang / ras zung thams cad dbul bar bya'o/ /mchod pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas rang dbang blangs la/ dkyil 'khor lha la dngos grub thams cad 38—288

bsgrub pa'i phyir/ sems can don mdzod cig ces gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /yang / rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams ni gzhug par bkyi/ /zhes rtse mo nas 'byung ba bzhin du gsol ba btab la dpal mchog dang po nas 'byung ba'i glus snanye bar bsgul ba zhes bya ste/nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa'i rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje 'dzin par bdag sgrubs 2shig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun kyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs shig /nyes pa med pa rtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid bdag sgrubs shig /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems su bdag sgrubs snyeshig /dngos grub chen po mchog gi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal bas rgyal/ /grub pa'i rdo rje che gsal ba/ /rdo rje snyems par bdag sgrubs 4shig /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid de//'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs kyi khudakyil 'khor yin/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ /khyed kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzad/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes/ /bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni/ /kun 38—289

gyis dri ma med mthong shog /de nas bden pa bsgrag par bya ste/ shes rab thabs dang dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa'o/ /mgon po khyod kyi bden pa des/ /bdag gi 'dod pa skongs gyur cig /de nas slob ma phyi rol na gnas pa'i drung du/ las kyi slob dpon gyis mar me gdong g.yogs spos chu rnams bshams te/ slob ma re re nas bkug la maṇ+ḍal phul lag na me tog thogs pa'i slob mas gsol ba lan gsum gdab bo/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /gtso bo khro bor bcas pa yi/ /la sogs pa brjod cing 1bsams la/ gdong g.yogs la/ rdo rje nas bzung ste nang du gzhug /de nas slob dpon gyis/de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi ri byeganas zhes pa la sogs pas gsol ba gdab bo/ /khyod su yin zhes kyang dri'o / /dkyil 'khor gyi lha la sgo bzhi nas phyag byed du bcug /de nas slob ma rnam par snang mdzad du bskyed la/ de nas ā sdekhaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ rdo rjer gyur pa'i yid kyis su/ /byang chub tshogs ni rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /lag pa stong pas mi bya'o/ /zhes me tog 'dzin du bcug la/ shar sgor stan 5la hūṃ gis gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba zhwabasngo ba'i bar du byed du bcug la/ de nas sdom pa sbyin par bya ste/sangs rgyas chos 7dang dge 'dun te/ /zhes pa nas mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi ba'i bar dang / gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brangs nas/ /sngags pas 'di dag spangs nas ni/ /dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur gyi bar du phog la/ slob mas gtso bo 'di ni 38—290

bdag la gson 2nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod kyi bar du brjod la khas blang ngo / /de nas oṃ āḥ bibyān+ta kṛta chohūṃ gis bsangs la/ de nas sarba yo ga dzistot+pā 5da yā mi zhes pas rnal 'byor du sems bskyed la/ de'i snying gar hūṃ las rdo rje bskyed de/ su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho/ bo bye ༄tsit+ta badz+ra sidh+ya ya thā chosu khaṃ zhes brjod de/ snying gar rdo rje gzhag go/ /dus 'dir khyod nyid ni sangs rgyas grub par gsungs/ gang zhig 'di nyid ma mthong ba'i/ /mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /bag med smras na nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan gnas par bya'o/ /rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba'i deng / /khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs mdzad de/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bkas te gshegs/ /de nas pad+ma'i snod nas dri dang bdud rtsi lnga'i chu sbyin mgor rdo rje bzhag la/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg gyepar byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub thob/ / 'thungs shig rdo rje chu 'thungs shig3 /oṃ badz+reṅka hūṃṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyis 9rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba nga yin kyis/ ngas gang gyis shig bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa'i las ma byed cig /khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par che'i dus byas nas/ sems can dmyal bar skyes par gyur ta re/ dam chu blud pa'i rim pa'o / /tshide nas slob ma a mi de bar bsgoms la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par gyur cig ces brjod nas man ngag ji lta ba bzhin du ye shes dbab bo/ /de nas mthong ba — — dri bar bya'o/ /de 12nas me tog dor ba ni/ ji ltar de bzhin bsod nams lha'i/ /rigs kyi bye brag 'di 38—291

la'o / /rigs kyi nang na 'di bzang ngo / /de yi dngos grub 'di 'byung bas/ /de yi bsod nams rjes 'byung ba'o/ /de 'dra ba'i lkudakyil 'khor 'di la'o/ /zhes brjod nas me tog dor bar bya'o/ /pra t+t+waṃts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ thuzhes brjod par bya'o//lha gang la 'be+ebs /—pa dang / sku'i stod smad la sogs pa'i bye brag gis dngos grub bzang ngan dag 'byung bar shes par bya'o/ /me tog dang ltas ④kyi rim pa'o / /gdong g.yogs dgol ba ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyikhya/ /mig 'byed par 6ni brtson mdzad de/ /rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /te badz+ra pā byu/ oṃ badz+ra ga shan tsakyu tsakyu pra be+e sha phaṭa/ ces pas gdong g.yogs dgrol lo/ /de nas/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos)/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /bya ba la sogs pa brjod la lha ngo bstan to / /de nas bum pa rnams kyi chu 17lhan cig tu bsdus la/ slob ma'i spyi bor dbang bsgur ba sbyin te/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa spyi bor chu blugs la rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pas brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas dbu rgyan stong pa nyid las bye dz+rī māṃ 1 khaṃ dh+ri las rigs lngar bskyed do/ /sangs rgyas lnga der bcug la slob ma'i mgo la bzhag la/ oṃ rat+na ku la mu dra a bhi ṣispya 11mi zhes brjod de dbu rgyan kyi dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rdo rje stong pa nyid las paṃ las a mi de bar bskyed/ bkug la mchod de gyur pa las rdo rjer byas la sbyin no/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya a bhi ṣiṣ+ṭha mi zhes pas lag tu sbyin no/ /de nas dril bu stong pa nyid las don yod grub par bskyed pa dang / bkug la mchod de slar dril bur byas la/ lag pa g.yon par dril bu gtad nyu la/ oṃ a bye pa ti a bhe 38—292

ṣi.ā+oṃ hūṃmi zhes bdag po'i dbang sbyin no/ /de nas rdor dril ṭaganyis slob ma'i mgor bsnol te bzhag nas/ ming gi dbang rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin chos kyi rnam par snang ba'i bdag nyid sbyin par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣispya mi badz+ra nā ldum a bhi ṣe ka ta zhes byin la kye dpal che ge mo zhes lha gang la me tog babs pa'i zhabs kyis mtshan pa'i ming gi dbang bskur ro/ /'di ni rig pa'i dbang lnga'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba sbyin par bya ste/ bdag gzhan don ni rdzogs byed pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang yin te/ /thugs rje'i 4 bdag po sprul du gsol/ /zhes zhus pas de nas hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' chobaskyed la mchod de slar rdo rjer bskyed la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag nyid bdag /phyag na rdo rje'i skyes bu'o/ /zhes brjod nas rdo rje sbyin no/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /rtag par khyod kyis gzung ba yin/ /rgyal ba'i byang chub mchod par gyis/ /zhes dril bu g.yon par sbyin no/ /srid pa 6ngo bo nyid las dag /brjod la dkrol lo/ /de nas lhag par lha'i sku phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa sbyin te/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sbug bsngal chen po zhi bya'i phyir / /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed/ /ces brjod la gzhal yas khang dang lha'i rnam par dag pa bstan te/ gdams ngag bzhin no/ /de nas rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ /'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du rdo rje'i 'khor lo dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma dang / las 38—293

kyi bar du bskur ro/ /de nas dngos grub kyi brtul rmyezhugs sbyin par bya ste/'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /phyag na rdo rje'i lag na 'dug /rtag tu khyod kyis gzung 2bar gyis/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /de nas slob ma sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i skur bskyed la bla gos kyi mtha' ma lag pa g.yon pas bzung ba'i khu tshur snying gar bzung la/ g.yas pa mchog sbyin du byas la/lung bstan par bya ste/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'phags pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ /rdo rje 'dzin par lung bstan gyis/ /shes rab kyi lung bstan sbyin no/ /de nas gsang ba'i ye shes bslab pa ni/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na yang sdig med do/ /de bas 'dod chags bral bar bya/ /khyod ni nam yang ma kyibyed cing / /bde chen zeg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad shi ba yong min te/ /sdug bsngal bsris pas mya ngan 'das / /srid pa gtan du dngos grub 'gyur/ /rang bdag choyongs su bor nas ni/ /dka' thub spyad par mi bya ste/ /ji ltar bde bar bsgrubs nas ni/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar slob dpon dkyil 'khor ni/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi phrin las can/ /sangs rgyas dang ni byang chub sems/ /snying rje'i dbang gis sems can don/ /khyed kyis byedakyil 'khor cho ga dag /brtson par bri dang rgyud la ni/ /nyan dang bsgrub pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes gnang ba sbyin no/ /dbang dag rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang / bla ma la sgra sna tshogs dang / rol mo'i bye brag gis mchod nas bskor ba byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi 38—2971

lha rnams rang gi snying gar bkod la/ tshogs dang nang gi sbyin sreg gis tshim par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge brgya pa gdon/ /bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥs gshegs su gsol lo/ /dkyil 'khor phyags ṭ+wāl dman ma la sogs pa gtor ma dang rol mos chu bo chen por dor ro/ /bdag gis dkyil 'khor cho ga legs sbyar bas / /bsgyur ba bsod nams gang thob pa/ /de yis khams gsum 'gro ba kun/ /dpal ldan gnas su 'gro bar shog /nor bar gyur na mkhyen pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gnam lcags 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la bzhugs pa'i bla ma be+e tri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta bal po de ba pur+ṇa ma ti dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mgar 2chos kyi bzang pos bal po'i yul du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o— /38—295

༄/ /gshin rje gshed po sgrub pa'i thabs/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ya mā ri sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ gshin rje gshed po sgrub pa'i thabs/ mgon po gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /klu la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis 'jigs/ /mgon po gshin rje gshed phyag 'tshal/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /bde ba'i stan la mnyam 'dug ste/ /dh+ri ni sngon po snying gar dgod/ /des bskyed mchod pa'i khyad par gyis/ /gus pas gtso bo yang dag mchod/ /byas nas de yi mdun du ni/ /sdig pa bshags pa la sogs bya/ /'gro kun dngos po med pa yi/ /de bzhin nyid du gsal por blta/ /snying ga'i sa bon gyur tshon byung //zhabs kyi pad+ma g.yon brkyang zhing / /khro gnyer g.yo bas 'jigs pa'i gdong / /khrog sru mgo skyes ser la mdzes/ /zhal gsum lce ni 'dril 1ba la/ /'jigs byed mche ba gcigs pa can/ /khrag gi mig can gsus po che/ /char sprin 38—298

sngon po lta bu'i mdog /nyi ma'i dkyil du gnas pa yi/ /ma he la ni gnas pas mtshon/ /mi'u thung lta bu stag lpags mnabs1/ /bde byed la sogs dregs pa 'joms/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer mdangs chen pos/ /nam mkha' ma lus kun du 'gengs/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba drag po 'bar/ /'jig 3pa'i bskal pa'i me lta bu/ /'khor lo ral gri gtun shing dang / /gri gug sta re zhags pa bsnams/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa min pa yi/ /lha yi phyag drug rtag tu bsnams/ /'jigs mdzad khror bcas rab tu grags/ /bdud ni 'dul byed gshin rje gshed/ /gur ni hūṃ gis bkang byas pa/ /'jigs dang bral nas bsgom par bya/ /stong phrag nyi shu'i phyed du ni/ /sngags rnams sngags rig pas rtag tu/ /bzlas te lus sogs ma yengs pas/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /'di sngon bsnyen pa'i cho ga ste/ /gsang sngags grags 4par byas pa bstan/ /de ni shin tu mang ba'i phyir/ /las dang rjes mthun ma bstan te//de ni dngos grub gang 'dod pas/ /rgyud dang bla ma'i man ngag las/ /las kun grub pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /dpa' bos 'bad pas shes par bya/ /bla ma bzhed pa'i cho ga rtogs pa las/ /bdag gis sgrub thabs byas pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu myur du ni/ /'jig rten thams cad kyis ni thob par shog /'phags pa gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud las 5gsungs pa'i phyogs gcig pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //khro bo'i rgyal po'i klu rnams kyi/ /kha dog la sogs mi dran gang / /de phyir de yi ched du ni/ /de dag kha dog dbyibs kyang bshad/ /dga' bo rigs ldan nag po ste/ /sgra 6ni bcings nas gnas pa yin/ /tak+ṣa ka ni 38—299

gser mdog ste/ /rna ba'i rgyan du 'bad pas byas/ /pad+ma chen po lag gdub ste / /gser ni bsregs pa lta bu'i mdog /mchod phyir thogs su byas pa ni/ /karko ṭa ste dkar po yin/ /ba su ki ni ske 7 rags te/ /pad+ma dmar po dri med mdangs / /rkang gdub pad+ma dung yin te/ /kun du ban+d+ra ka yi mdog /rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //oṃ āḥkro dha ka ya mān+ta ༄2snaka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ dīḥbye ༄ ཿbi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa// //bsdur mchan/298 —1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄sa/ /gshin rje gshed po sgru ba pa'i thabs bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mos/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gril/299 rte 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasnams/ sne〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skarajigs/ ḍa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mche'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gragaphya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phro/ ne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉skra/3༷༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zos/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sras gro dha kā ya man+ta/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉1/38—300

sngag /rta mgrin gyi grub thabs/tsho ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ h+ya shrī wa sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa rta mgrin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde sbyin bcom ldan rta mgrin ni/ /g.yon brkyang zhabs kyis yang dag bzhugs/ /khams gsum rang bzhin gsum sbyan gsum/ /de la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por sngags ni rab tu brjod/ oṃ swa bhā ba be+e shudhaḥ sarba dharmā swa bhā wa be+e shusgolhartsu2 / lan gsum brjod pas snang srid kyi / /dngos rnams thams cad dag par bsam/ /khyad par rang lus shel sgong ltar/ /rang snying ram̐ ser 'od 'phros pas/ /nyi dkyil steng du tweḥshedamar po/ /de las phyogs bcur 'od 'phros pas/ /zhags pa lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rta mgrin bla ma la sogs pa/ /mdun du spyan drangs rang snying ga /s+thāḥ5las mchod pa'i lha mo ni/ /bdug spos ser mo 38—302

phyag na spos/ /me tog ma ni ut+pal bsnams/ /sgu ni rab tu mthing gar bzhugs / /mar me ma ni sku mdog dmar/ /phyag na rin chen sgron ma 'dzin//dri chab ma ni ljang gu ste/ /lag na hugaser gyi bum 'dzin ma/ /zhal zas ma ni sku mdog dkar/ /lag na rngugaser gzhong bdud rtsis gang / /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe t+pahūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra nai bi bye ke āḥhūṃ swā hā/ gang yang bdag gis dus kun du/ /sdig pa bgyis par gang gyur pa/ /skrag nas rmi 'drar 'chags bkyid cing / /deng ④nas brtsams te 'byung mi bgyid/ /dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung sa/ /thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /de thob lam la gnas bkyid cing / /dam pa'i skyabs gsum la skyabs mchi/ /de rjes tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom6bhe/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa kophodz+wahaṃ/ lan gsum 'ubarjod bya ting 'dzin gyis/ /chos ni thams cad stong par bsam/ /de yi ngang las mkha' dkyil du/ /re ser 'od 'phros nyi dkyil du/ /de steng yi ge hūṃ las ni/ /'phros 'dus rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /rdo rje ra ba sa gzhi gur/ /de yi dbus su nyi dkyil 'khor/ /de steng yi ge zlo thudakar bsam/ /de las tre'od zer byung bas ni/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang byang / /dung dang bai ḍūr+ya dang shel/ /gser las grub pa'i (3rim pa bzhin/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /gser gyi ka ba brgyad kyis bteg /rin chen du mas steng ni phub/ /rin chen du ma 1—'phyang ba'o/ /yang na thod pa'i gzhal yas khang / /stong gsum stong chen rgya khyen tsam/ /steng ni zhing gis rab tu bkab / /gru bzhi pa ni rab tu bkod/ /seng ldeng ka ba brgyad ni gnas/ /38—303

thod pa brgyad kyis ka zhu tshobargyan/ /phyi dang nang ni rab tu gsal/ /rang ni ram̐ ser gasbug tu bsgom3/ /ram̐ las 'od zer 'phros 'dus pas/ /nyi dkyil steng du s+thāḥdamar po/ /de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi/ /don byas 'phags pa mchod nas ni/ /slar yang 'od ni dīḥl thim/ /de nyid zhu bas thog ma nas/ /bsags pa'i sgrib gnyis ye shes kyi/ /mes ni rab tu bsregs par bsam/ /ye shes me las 'od 'phros 'dus/ /sngar bzhin rab tu bsgom par bya/ /rang ni bcom ldan dpal rta mgrin/ /dbu gsum phyag drug sku mdog dmar/ /dbus dang g.yas dang g.yon dang ni/ /dmar dang dkar dang nag po yi/ /spyan gsum dbu steng rta mgo can/ /ljang gu gsum ni rab tu 'thon/ /tshems gcigs zhal nas 'brug ni sgrogs/ /thod skam thod byas thod rlon brgyan/ /yan lag brang 'gros rab tu brgyan/ /stag gi sham thabs ④ glang lpags khyen/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon na khrab/ /g.yas kyi gnyis pas rngu gser zhags bsnams/ /g.yas kyi tha ma seng ldeng dbyug /g.yon gyi gnyis pas 6ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon gye tha ma sor mo las/ /bya khyung bye ba bye ba 'gyed / /zhabs ni drug gis klu rnams mnan/ /bskal pa'i me ltar dbus na bzhugs/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga ru/ /oṃ āḥphroṃ dkar dmar dang gnag /snying ga'i rdo rje rtse lnga las/ /'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas/ /rnam/ snang mi 'khrugs 7rin 'byung dang / /tshe dpag med dang don yod grub/ /mdun gyi mkha' la spyan drangs la/ /oṃ dang hūṃ dang ṭ+wāṃ dīraḥ.a/ /spyi bo dpral ba rna ba g.yas/ /ltag pa rna ba g.yon pa ru/ bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bsgur bsam/ /snying ga'i rdo rje rgya gram las/ /be+egs kyu lta bu'i 'od 'phros 38—304

pas—/ /ye 7nas grub pa'i rta mgrin ni/ /nyi dkyil bzhugs pas spyan drangs la—/ /rgya gram ljang las 'od 'phros pas/ /lha mo lngas ni mchod pa 'bul2 / /rgya gram de yi chang pa la/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrab tu gsal/ /dzaḥ las rta mgrin spyan drang bya/ /hūṃ gis rab tu gzhug par bya/ /baṃ gis rab tu bcing bar bya/ /hoḥs ni de la gzhug par bya/ /bsgom pas dub par gyur na ni/ /bzlas pa yang ni brjod bya ste/ /a tshar ka tshar bkod byas la/ /sde tshan dang bo'i jebacu gnyis pa/ /sde tshan lnga pa'i lnga pas zhebargyan/ /de nyid kyis ni gsum pa bzung / /sde tshan gsum pa'i gsum pa blang / /sde tshan bdun pa'i gnyis par sbyar/ /sde tshan gnyis pa'i dang po blang / /sde tshan dang po'i bcu gnyis pa/ /sde tshan bdun pa'i gnyis pa sbyar/ /sde tshan bzhi pa'i dang po bzung / /drod kyi yi ge bzhi pa blang / /mthar gnas pa yi dang po bzung 2/ /sde tshan gnyis pa'i gsum pa blang / /mthar gnas yi ge gnyis pa sbyar/ /sde tshan dang po'i gsum pas ḍa7brgyan/ /mthar gnas bzhi po gzung 8bar bya/ /drod kyi bzhi pa blang byas la/ /sde tshan dang po'i lnga pa sbyar/ /mthar gnas gsum pa blang byas la/ /sde tshan dang po'i lnga pa sbyin/ /lan gnyis su ni brjod par bya/ /drod kyi bzhi pa gzung byas la/ /sde tshan dang po'i drug pa sbyar/ /sde tshan lnga pa'i lnga pa sbyin/ /sde tshan lnga pa'i gnyis pa blang / /sde tshan gsum pa'i dang po sbyin/ /sa bon yi ge 'od 'phros pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs rta mgrin du/ /bzlas pas dub na ye shes ni/ /sems dpa' mdun du spyan drangs la/ /lha mo lngas ni sngar bzhin du/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod par bya/ /de rjes bstod pa yang ni brjod/ /gshegs phyir dzaḥdzaḥlan gsum brjod/ /38—305

rang ni rta mgrin bsgoms pa yis/ /snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /twelkuḥdamar po las phyogs bcu ru/ /phyi nang snod bcud 'od zhu bas/ /thams cad rta mgrin rang bzhin du/ /'od ni rang gi lus la bsdu/ /dam tshig ye shes sems dpa' la/ /de ni trī3ཿla rab tu bsnyu/ /de ni dkar la yungs kar tsam / /de ni rab tu dmigs mi bya/ /gsal la mi rtog gcig tu bsam/ /lha yi bu dang lha klu dang / /bdag gzhan sdug bsngal zhi ba dang / /bgegs rigs gzhan ni 'dul ba dang / /lha 'dre ma rungs 'dul ba dang / /lha 'dre mthu chen klu ma rungs/ /ser ba bsrung bar 'dod pa yis/ /yungs kar brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ /gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pa yis/ /rang ni yi dam lha ru gnas/ /snying gar dī1ཿdmar phyogs bcu yi/ /'od 'phros sems can rta mgrin bsgom/ /gtor ma'i steng du spyan drangs la/ /gtor steng baṃ dmar po ni bsam/ /de las 'od 'phros baṃ la thim/ /gtor ma rnam par dag bya'i ④phyir / /sarba ka ri lan bdun brjod/ /de nyid bdud rtsir bya ba'i phyir/ /na maḥsarba ta thā 5ga ta a ba lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ nyi shu rtsa gcig ces brjod la/ /yang na lan bdun tshan bzhi brjod/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 6dpal rta mgrin kyi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon nā gārdzu 7nas mdzad nga rdzogs so// //dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba'o// //38—306

1758༄7/ /rta ma—na gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/zhe sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ha ya shrī ba sā dha rgo nā ma / bod skad du/rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rta mgrin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde bar gshegs pas dgongs shing rtogs pa'i phyir dngos po thams cad ni 'di ltar gdod ma nas ma skyes shing mi gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas ri rab spyog brgyad pa rin/ po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin can/ de'i dbus su dpag tshad stong gi tshad tsam kyi 'od kyi phung po der nye bar gnas la/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa sngon du 'go bas lus dang ngag dang yid byin gyis brlab po/ /de nas nam mkha' khyab pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sprul la/ /de nyid du dh+ri yig 'bar ba'i rnam pa bsam par bya'o/ /de nas/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāñtsit+ta badzā zlo/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes pa 'di phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la 38—308

sogs pa ye shes kyi rnam pa spyan drangs la bzhugs so/ /yang gnyis pa la hūṃ yig gis rta mgrin bskul zhing spyan drangs la bzhugs so/ /gsum pa la hūṃ yig gis bdag nyid rdo rje rta mgrin gyi rang bzhin can te/ sku mdog dmar po 'jigs par mdzad pa1/ spyan gsum pa/ sma ra dmar ser can/ drag po / gsus pa 'phyang ba/ mche ba gcigs shing tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa / mgo bo'i phreng ba dang ral ba'i cod pan can/ 'od dpag med spyi bor bzhugs pa/ zhal gnyis pa/ rta zhal sngon po tī ṭī'i 2sgra sgrogs pa/srid rtse'i mthar thug pa'i tshangs pa'i sgo nga'i rtse rta zhal gyis mnan pa/ sbrul brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ mi'u thung gi rnam pa can/ stag gi pags /pa'i sham thabs can/ rgyan kun gyis brgyan pa/ lha dang lha ma yin thams cad bsdigs sngupa dang dbyig pa 'chang ba'o/ /sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyi kha dog spro ba dang bsdu ba sngon bzhin bsam par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bsgoms pa las yid bzhin gyi snyenor bu dang / bum pa bzang po dang / dpag bsam gyi shing dang bcud len 6la sogs pa'i dngos grub kyis grub 7pa mngon sum du 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /rtog pa bdun brgya pa nas gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //rgya gar bā rā ṇa sī'i paṇ+ḍi 8pu ru ṣet+ta ma'i zhal snga nas mnyan te/ lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan 9bzang pos nyang ro 'khris kyi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// //38—309

bsdur mchan/308 tshomatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉༄7 rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ldu〈〈pe 〉〉 ཿ/309 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ khu〈〈snar 〉〉nā'i yi ge'i/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉spags/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabag ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉to/gyi/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nepa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga ṇa si'i paṇ+ḍi ta/⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉dpal/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1685)38wa 310

sngag /rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs jes bya ba/ 1༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ha ya shrī ba sā dha rgo nā ma / bod skad du/rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rta mgrin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar gsungs pa'i cho gas — sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la ye shes haṃ yig dmar po las skyes pa'i 'phags pa rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum pa/ phyag brgyad pa/spyan gsum pa/ g.yas pa dang cig —shos kyi zhal ni sngon po dang dkar po'o/ /sbrul kyis brgyan cing 'gying bas bzhugs pa/ zhal dang po khro bo'i mig gis blta ba/ g.yas kyi zhal ni ljags 'dril ba/ g.yon gyi zhal ni tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can no/ /g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na rdo rje dang / dbyig pa dang / phyag rgya dang mda'o/ /g.yon kyi phyag bzhi yis sdigs mdzub dang / rang gi nu ma la reg pa dang / pad+ma dang gzhu'o/ /cod pan la mi bskyod pa bsam mo/ /'di ni rta mchog ye shes zhes phyabya ba'i 38—3/ 1

1760ra༅/ /rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/tsho sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ h+ya shrī ba sā dha rgo nā ma2/ bod skad du/rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ rta mgrin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rta mgrin gyi ni sgrub pa'i thabs/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad bya/ /dang po re zhig sngags pas yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su bdud rtsi lngas byugs la ji ltar 'dod pa'i stan la nye bar 'dug ste/ rang gi snying ga'i t+t+waṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la nye bar spyod pa thams cad kyis yang dag par mchod pa dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang /sdig pa bshags 4pa la sogs pa byas te/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥ5sarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuljaphokhuhaṃ / oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho7haṃ zhes yang dag par brjod do/ /'di'i sngags kyis rang dang gzhan stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte 38—3/3

ba'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la thod pa bdud rtsi dang bcas pa der bsam par bya'o/ /der hūṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las bsam par bya ba'i sangs rgyas ni drag po tshozhal bzhi pa zhabs bzhi pa/ g.yas pa'i zhabs brkyang ba/g.yon pa'i zhabs bskum pa'o/ /dpa' bo phyag brgyad pa/ lha mo bzhis yongs su bskor ba/ gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyi bdag nyid 2chen po rta mgrin ni/ sku mdog dmar po mche ba rno ba gcigs pa sbyan gsum pa/ rtsa ba'i dang g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal ni dmar po dang / /sngon po dang dkar po'o / /spyi bo'i rta'i zhal gyi rnam pa de'i kha dog ni shing pa lā sha bzhin no/ /thod pa khrag dang sha chen pos gang ba sngags rnams kyi dbang bskur ba rab tu sbyin par bya'o/ /rta zhal la sogs pa'i dbu la rgyan thams cad rdzogs pa/ mgo bo'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas kyi phyag rnams kyis be+egs kyu dang /mda' dang / thod pa dang rdo rje'o/ /g.yon pa rnams 4na zhags pa dang /gzhu dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / dril bu'o/ /'dir sgrub pa pos de 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das su bsgom par bya'o/ /mchod pa'i bdag nyid bdud rtsi lngas yang dag par mchod par bya'o/ /mdun du bzhugs pa'i lha mo rdo rje rta ma 'jigs ma chen mo dhī5ཿyig las yang dag par byung ba zhal gcig ma/ phyag bzhi ma g.yon na gzhu dang thod pa bdud rtsi dang bcas pa'o/ /g.yas kyis 'umada' dang rtse gsum mo/ /sna tshogs pa'i sgu yid du 'ong ba'i gzi brjid can/rgyab tu bzhugs pa'i lha mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma haṃ las yang dag par byung ba/g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / zhags pa chen po 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yas na thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang / dbyig pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang ba'o/ /ka pā la'i 38——314

gdan gyi tshu dbus na bzhugs pa sku mdog dmar mo 'bar ma chen mo mtshan ni phag mor brjod do/ /g.yas su ni rdo rje khros ma thod pa'i gdan la yang dag par bzhugs ma/ dhī geḥlas yang dag par byung ba'i lha mo sgu mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yon na dug gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / zhags pa'i rgyal mtshan no/ /g.yas su ḍa ma ru dang / dbyig pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang ba'o—/ /g.yon du bzhugs pa'i lha mo kha dog dkar mo phyag na — rdo rje can te/'dab ma bzhi rnams la bzhugs pa'o/ /rta mgrin 'khor bcas la mchod par bya'o / /lha mo thams cad kyi dug dang / dri chu dang bcas pas so/ /zhabs 'od kyi phreng ba la bzhugs shing mgo bos brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa mche pa rno ba gcigs pa 'jigs par mdzad pa/ gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyi bdag nyid can no/ /sngags kyi rgyal po rjes su dran na der 'di'i sngags ni/ oṃ ha ya shrī ba tweḥ.a haṃ a ha saṃ saṃ hūṃ hūṃ swā hā/ sngags 'di 4bsam par bya'o/ /rtag tu bzlas pa rjes su dran pas/ 'bum phrag gnyis dang bye ba phrag gcig gis de nad med par 'gyur ro/ /gang yang sngar bsags pa'i sdig pa 'joms pa dang /dus thams cad du rnal 'byor kyi dbang phyug gis bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di nyid kyi lha mo rta gdong ma ni brtan pa sa'i dngos po dang / byams pa 'phro ba'i sems dang me long lta bu'i rnal 'byor ro/ /g.yas g.yon gyi lha mo ni chu dang / snying rje dang mnyam nyid dang me dang dga' ba dang / /so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin no/ /lha mo glang gdong ma ni rlung gi dngos po dang btang snyoms kyi sems su dran zhing bya ba rjes su grub pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /sna tshogs pa'i gzugs ni sna tshogs pa'i tshul du brjod do/ /kha dog sngon mo ni gnyis su med 38—315

par byed pa chos kyi sgra sgogs pa bsdigs ⑨par mdzad pa'o/ /kha dog ser mo ni dri ma med par rtogs so/ /kha dog dmar mo ni chos rnams la chags pa'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhabs bzhi'i rnam dag ni 'phags pa'i rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa bzhi'o/ /rta'i gdong pa ni gzhan pa med pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin 'di chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang / lam rnam par dag par gzhol bar mngon par brjod do/ /rgyu'i de nyid gang la lta ba dang / 'bras bu'i de nyid kyi phyag rgya ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thar pa la spyan gsum gyis gzigs pa'o/ /thog ma med pa'i ye shes kyi sems dud 'gro'i zhal du bstan to//yid sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor pas ri ltar rtag tu gnas par bya'o/ /rgyud thams cad kyi snying po bla na med pa rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta pra bhā ka ras mdzad pa sdogs so// //rgya gar yul bā rā ṇa sī'i tsopaṇ+ḍi ta pu ru ṣet+ta ma'i zhal snga nas legs par mnyan te/ lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bla ma dam pa'i bkas gtsug lag khang chen po dpal thar pa gling du bsgyur ba'o// // 38—316

—thabs zhas bya ba/1༄go/ /'phags pa rta mgrin bsgrub par 'dod pas thog mar sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā bi shudheḥsarba dharmāḥ3swa bhā ba bi shusgo3 —haṃ zhes lan gsum mam bdun brjod pas snang srid kyi dngos po 'di thams cad dag par bsam mo/ /khyad par du bdag gi lus shel sgong dag pa lta bur rnam par 4dag par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying gar ram̐ ser po cig las 'od 'phros shing 'dus pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam mo/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge tweḥ5dmar po cig bsam mo/ /de las 'od zer zhags nga/ lta bu 6dang lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpal rta mgrin dang bla ma la sogs pa mdun du spyan drangs la rang gi snying ga'i yi ge dīḥ7las mchod pa'i lha mo bdug spos ma phyag na spos thogs pa dang / me tog ma phyag na ut+pa la thogs pa dang / mar me ma phyag na rin po 38—318

che'i sgon me thogs pa dang rmye/ dri chab ma gser gyi bum pa'i 2snanang du ga pur gyi chus bkang ba thogs pa dang / zhal zas ma gser gyi gzhong pa'i nang du bdud rtsi ri rab tsam thogs pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang 1dpal rta mgrin dang bla ma la sogs pa la mchod la sngags 'di rnams brjod do/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥthu hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe s+dzahūṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ne+e bi bye sgo.āḥhūṃ swā hā/ de nas 'di skad ces thu brjod par bya ste/ gang yang bdag gis dus kun du/ /sdig pa bgyis par gang gyur pa/ /skrag nas rmi 'drar 'chags bgyid cing / /deng nas brtsams nas 'byung mi bgyid/ /dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung tsu/ /thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /de thob lam la gnas bgyid cing / /dam pa'i skyabs gsum la skyabs mchi/ /de nas byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang /tshangs pa'i gnas rnams rim gyis bsgom8/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra (swa bhā ba āt+ma kolha haṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod la ting nge 'dzin gyis chos thams cad nam mkha' lta bur stong par bsam/ de nas nam mkha'i dkyil du ram̐ ser po las 'od 'phros pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor cig rngu bsam/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ mthing ga las 'od 'phros pa las skrurdo rje rtse lnga pa cig bsam/rdo rje rtse lnga pa de las 'od phyogs bcur 'phros pas rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba sa gzhi gur du bsam/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūṃ 6dkar po cig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas shar phyogs —dngul las grub pa/ lho bai ḍūr+ya las grub pa/ nub shel dmar po las grub pa/ byang 38—3/9

gser las grub pa/ sgo bzhi yod pa/ gser gyi ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa rin po che bai ḍūr+ya'i ljon shing gis steng phub 1pa/ rin po che'i 'phan du ma 'phyang ba'i gzhal yas khang du bsgom pa'am/ yang na thod pa'i gzhal yas khang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgya khron tsam/ steng zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhis bkab pa/ sgo bzhi yod pa/ seng ldeng gi ka ba brgyad la thod pas ka zhu byas pa'i ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa phyi nas bltas na nang gsal ba/ nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang cig tu bsgom mo/ /sgrub pa po rang gi sems yi ge ram̐ cig 4tu bsgom/ ram̐ ser po de las 'od 'phros shing 'dus pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor cig bsgom/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang s+thāḥ5dmar po cig tu bsgom/ trīḥ6dmar po de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sems can gye don byas/ 'phags pa mchod nas slar 'od de yi ge dhīḥ7la thim pas juḥ8de nyid 'od du zhu ba las tshe thog ma med pa nas nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad ye shes kyi mes bsreg par bsam / ye shes kyi me 'od 'phros pa dang / 'dus pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin dbu gsum phyag drug pa/ sgu mdog dmar po/dbus dmar ba/ g.yas dkar po/ g.yon mthing ga /spyan gsum pa/dbu gsum gyi steng na rta mgo ljang gu gsum yod pa/ tshems gcigs pa zhal re re nas kyang 'brug stong stong ldir 9ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i 7thod can/thod pa rlon pa'i phreng bas se ral khar brgyan pa/ sbrul dkar nag gis yan lag brgyan pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs byas pa/ glang po che'i ko rlon gos su gyon pa/ phyag drug la g.yas pa dang po rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/38—320

g.yon dang po na dung chen khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na gser gyi zhags pa bsnams pa/ g.yas tha ma na seng ldeng gi dbyug tho bsnams pa / g.yon gnyis pa na 7ral gri/ g.yon gyi tha ma na sor mo lnga la maze bo che nas bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs kyi bya khyung ga ru ḍa dkar po bye ba 'gyed pa—/ mdzub mo nas rdo rje'i rigs kyi mthing ga bye ba 'gyed pa/ gung mo nas rin po che'i rigs kyi ser po bye ba 'gyed pa/ srin lag nas pad+ma'i rigs kyi dmar po bye ba 'gyed pa/ mthe chung nas las kyi rigs ljang gu bye ba 'gyed pa/zhabs drug gis rteklu thams cad brdzis pa/ rdo rje'i gshog pa re re nas bya bye khyung ga ru ḍa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bye ba 'gyed pa/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i ye shes kyi me'i snyeklong dkyil na 5bzhugs par bsam/ yang na bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po/ phyag g.yas na seng ldeng gi dbyug to/phyag g.yon pa na tresdegs mdzub 'phyar ba/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa phyag mtshan bsgom/ lce rdo rje rtse lnga par bsgoms la/ sarba ka ri zhes bya ba'i yig 'bru rdo rje rtse lnga pa la dgod/ snying ga g.yon par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po bsam/ snying ga g.yas par 7zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje rgya gram ljang gu cig bsam/ spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du oṃ dkar po cig bsam/ mgrin par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du s+dzadamar po cig bsam/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ mthing ga cig bsam/ snying ga'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa las 'od kha dog lnga pa rdolcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad dang / bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs shepa dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / tshe dpag rnged 38—321

dang / don yod grub pa de rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs la/bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis oṃ zhes pas bdud rtsi'i chus spyi bo 1 nas dbang bsgur bar bsam/ hūṃ zhes pas mi 'khrugs 3pas dpral ba nas dbang bsgur bar bsam/ t+t+waṃ /zhes pas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis rna ba g.yas pa nas dbang bsgur bar bsam/ khyu ཿzhes pas snang ba mtha' yas kyis ltag pa nas dbang bskur bar bsam mo/ /a zhes pas rna ba g.yon pa nas don yod grub pas bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bar bsam mo/ /snying ga'i rdo rje rgya gram las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas de 3nas grub pa'i dpal certa mgrin nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa cig spyan drangs la/ rgya gram ljang gu las 'od 'phros pas mchod pa'i lha mo lnga byung bas snga ma bzhin du mchod par bya'o/ /rgya gram gyi chang 7ba la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbasams la dzaḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus dpal rta mgrin spyan drangs la8/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' la phog 9pas bdag la zhugs/ baṃ las 'od 'phros pas bcings 6/ hoḥlas 'od 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' dgyes pa'i tshul du bzhugs par bsam/sku la gtad la bsgom pas dub na sa bon gyi yi ge la gtad la sngags 'di bzlas so / /o badz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī ba hu lu hu lu nyehūṃ phaṭa ces khaci mang du bzlas so/ /sa bon gyi yi ge las pa 2'od 'phros pas nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa thams cad 'phags/ pa rta mgrin du gyur par bsam/ bzlas pas dub na ye shes pa mdun du bton la lha mo lngas snga ma bzhin du mchod do/ /tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ 'phags pa rta mgrin la bstod pa/hūṃ sku mdog chags med nub kha'i dmar thag 'dra/ /'bar ba'i dbu la ral pa 38—322

gyen du badze+es/ /ma rig tshangs pa kha sbub gnon pa'i lha/ /pad+ma rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes ha ya shrī 3ba rta mchog dpal/ /zhal nas 'brug stong di ri ri/ /tshems gcigs tsam na tshems nang nas/ /gdug pa'i me stag sa/kham kham 'bar/ /khro rgyal dbang gi rta skad tser tser mtsher / /zhes bstod/ mkhyen par gshegs par bya ba'i phyir dzaḥdzaḥzhes lan gsum brjod do/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/ bdag nyid rta mgrin du bsgoms pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du yi ge s+thāḥ 4 dmar po las phyogs bcur 'od 'phros te/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang nang bcud kyi 'jig rten la phog pas 'od du zhu nas kun rta mgrin gyi ngo bor bsam/'od de dag thams cad rang gi lus la bsdu/ dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes sems dpa'i rta mgrin dmar po la bsdu/ dīḥthudamar po thig le dkar zhing 'tsher ba yungs kar tsam cig la bsdu/ yungs kar tsam po de yang mi dmigs par bsgom ste gsal la mi rtog thupa byug tu bsgom mo/ /lha'i bu'i bdud 'dul bar 'dod na/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa thogs pa'i phyag la mchod pa bya/ lha klu mthu bo che thams cad dbang du sdud par 'dod na dung chen thogs pa'i phyag la mchod pa bya / — bdag dang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal zhi bar 'dod na zhags pa thogs pa'i phyag la mchod pa bya/ byis pa'i gdon bco brgyad dang / bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang / lha 'dre ma rungs pa thams cad 'dul bar 'dod na ral gri thogs pa'i phyag la mchod pa bya/ lha 'dre mthu bo che thams cad bran bzhin du 'khol bar 'dod na/ seng ldeng gi 8rta thogs pa'i phyag la mchod pa bya / klu ma rungs pa thams cad gdul 9bar 'dod na/ bya khyung thogs pa'i 38—323

phyag la mchod pa bya/ chu 3grong khyer ram yul du byung ba bzlog par 'dod na/seng ldeng gi 2phur bu sor brgyad pa la rta mgrin gyi sngags sngon du 'bum bsnyen pa byas la las kyi dus su yang 'bum byas te btab na chu'i rgyun bzlog byepar 'gyur ro / /shwa bzlog par 'dod na zangs dang lcags la 'brug gi gzugs bris la seng ldeng gi phur bu sor brgyad pa cig rtel sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab la shwa sar btab na bzlog thupar 'gyur ro/ /ser ba bsrung bar 'dod na yungs kar la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab la yungs kar la cha'i nang du dril la phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dkyil dang tredagu ru sba/ gdong zlog dzosnal bye ma la sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la 'brug dang / sprin dang / glog rgod bye pa'i sar btab na ser ba bzlog ḍapar 'gyur ro/ /'bras dang gag pa dang / lhog pa ⑫ kun la 'jim pa la sngags btab ste byugs na zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mi nad dang /phyugs nad dang / yams kyi nad la seng sdeng gi phur bu sor bzhi pa la sngags stong phrag bdun bzlas la phyogs bzhir btsugs la snga dro'i dus su chu gtsang ma la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ khang thog nas gtor na yams nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas bdag nyid dpal rta mgrin du bsgoms la snying gar dhī1 ཿdmar po las 'od shārtaphyogs bcur 'phros pas sems can thams cad rta mgrin du bsgoms la/ yang rta mgrin gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rta mgrin du gyur pa de gtor ma'i steng du spyan drangs te/ gtor ma'i steng du baṃ dmar po cig 1bsam/ baṃ 2de las 'od 'phros te/ slar baṃ la thim pas shel dmar po las grub pa'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba cig bsam/ rang rta mgrin du bsgoms pa'i snying ga'i 38—324

byāhūṃḥdamar po de'i 'od hūṃnam mkha' la 'phros pas/ s+thāḥ dkar dmar ser sngo4/gnag 'od byung bas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pas gang bar bsam/ de nas gtor ma rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir sarba ka ri zhes lan bdun brjod par bya'o / /gtor ma nyid bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab phyapa'i phyir/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod par bya ste/ yang na tresngags bdun tshan bzhi brjod la 3chu la gdab po/ /ye shes kyi chos skyong la nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod par bya'o/ /phyogs skyong 'jig rten pa la yang sngags bdun tshan bzhi brjod do/ /yang na oṃ āḥhūṃ twe8ཿzhes nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod par bya'o/ /'phags pa rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/318 7mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te brkod/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha bi shudhe sarba dharma/— 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pho/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dag pa lta bur rnam pa/ra/ lta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ཿ/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄ra/ dz+wa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkaḥ/319 ri1sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dang / 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ridang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhu pe ā—/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉t+yā/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rices/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄zung / 8〈〈pe 〉'ams/ kyis bsgom—/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rems kyis bsgo mas/ spyosna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gibadz+ra/ kho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipho/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skogig pa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thru/ sa〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7su/32༷ hūṃ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ltag 2sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/ da 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhu/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzacigazhe 6 me —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉hri/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'dir/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge 'i/321 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7na/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / ——〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyang / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gime'i/38byed325
