༄7/ /tsha tsha gdab pa la sogs pa'i cho ga bsngo/gas so// 1༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo be+e ma la usbyi ṣa'i gzungs dang / rgyud dag las rtsa t+ya dang / tsha tsha gdab pa la sogs pa'i cho ga /ā tsār+ya dharma tīrti dang / badz+ra krirti dang / badz+ra bo bye la sogs pa las thos nas/ slob dpon de dag gis lung bstan te/ gtan la phab par byas pa'o/ /de la dang po tsi t+ya gdab pa'i sa gzhi ni/ khang pa'am / yol bas bskor ba'am/ ra ba la sogs pa gang 'byor pa'i nang bde bar dkyil 'khor du bya ba'i sa brtag pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi zabs su khru gang brkos 'a/ sa rnag byung na bzang / rus pa dang gyo mo la sogs pa byung na yang / de dag ma lus par bsal te sa brkos pa de'i dbus su/ gser dang dngul dang zangs dang kham pa gang 'byor pa snod sbyar ma'i nang du rin po che dang /'bru nang sman sna lnga dang spos dag blugs nas/ kha bcad de bzhag la sa 28—— /92

bzang pos bkang ste/ de'i steng du dkyil 'khor 'dom do gru bzhi 'phang du khru gang pa legs pa cig byas la/ dkyil 'khor de'i ngos gcig kyang khru gang gru bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor chung ngu gnyis gnyis mgo snyoms te/ dkyil 'khor chen po dang 'byel bar byas te2/ dkyil 'khor de'i steng du za 'og dang / ras la sogs pa gang 'byor pa'i bla re 'dom phyed dang gsum/ khru bzhi pa yan chad 'dom gang yang yan chad bye/ 'phan brgyad yan chad du 'byor pa gdags/phyogs bzhir rgya‘pa mtshan bzhi gzugs/ bla re de'i dbus su dar ram/ ras sam shog bu srid du 4mda' gang / zheng du khru gang lhag tsam grwa sbyar/ phyogs bzhir mchod rte na dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / 'phang lo bdun dang ldan pa re res bres te/ de'i bum pa'i dbus nas thad kar bi ma la uṭī ṣa'i gzungs sngags (radi gur kum gyis bri/ de'i sngags la/ oṃ na maste ya dhī kā ṭ+wāṃ/sarba ta thā ga ta z-i da ya gar+bhe/ dz+wa la dz+wa la dharma 5dh+wa tu gasgo/ che ge mo/ saṃ bha ra ā yuḥsaṃ sho dha ya/ sarba pā paṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ sa marnyoṭī ṣa bi ma le bi shubye/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ i baṃ saṃ dzaḥswā hā/ de nas mchod rten de'i 'phang lo'i steng du bi ma la uṭī ṣa'i gzungs 'dis gdugs lta bur 'khyel bar gur kum kyis bri/ de'i sngags la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā ṭ+wāṃ/ ma hā cis ma ṇi dz+wa la na sā ga ra/ gaspyi re ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ ā yun+dha ra/ ā yun+dha ra/san+dha ra/ san+dha ra/ k+ṣa ṇa k+ṣa ṇa/ k+ṣi ṇi k+ṣi ṇi/ k+ṣu rku k+ṣu rku/ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā sa ma ye/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ma hā bhu ba na sā ga re/ saṃ sho dha ya rmā/ / sarba sat+t+waṃ sh+tsa/ bha ga ba t+t+waṃ/ sarba pā paṃ/ bi ma le/ dza ya dza ya dza ya lasnye/ sgu ṭa sgu ṭa/ sgo ṭa ya sgo ṭa ya/ bi ga te/ ā ba ra ṇi/ bha ya 38—/93

ha ra 1 ṇi/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ mṛ 2kyu daṇ+ḍa dha re/ a bha ya pra de / uṭī ṣa bya ba lo ki te/ sa man+ta mu khe/ sa man+ta bya ba lo ki te/ ma hā mā ye/ ma hā pā sha dha re / a mo gha bi ma le/ ā kaste ya/ ā kar+ṣa ya4/ ā karje ya ā kaṣ+ṭha ya/bhā ra ghā ra/ saṃ bhā ra saṃ bhā ra/ idh+ri ya/ bi sho dha ni/ bhū ṣi ta byu dzi5/ma hā mu dru bi lo ki te/ dza ya dza ya/ sidhe sir+bhe/ budhe bur+bhe6/ bo dha ni bo dha ni/ saṃ bo dha ni saṃ bo dha ni/ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ saṃ sho dha ni saṃ sho dha ni/bi sho dha ni bi sho dha ni/ ha ra ha ra/ ma ma sarba pā pa8/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ku la bhu dze/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha/ pra sa ran+tu/ ma ma pubye/ bi na bye tu pā paṃ/sarba kilbi ṣaha re ma ṇi bi shur+bhe/ sho dha ya/ bi ma le/ bi ka si ta pad+me / ka ba tsi ta bhu dze/ ṣat+pā ra mi tā/ pa ri pū 11ra ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga tospya ṣa bi ma le bi lo ki te swa hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta gu h+ya/ a byeṣ+ṭha na a byeṣ+ṭṛ rta te swā hā/ oṃ ā yurda de swā hā/ pu jud de swā hā/ puju bi lo ki te swā hā/ puju 1 a ba lo ki 7te swā hā/ mṛtru daṇ+ḍi ྾swā/ hā/ ya ma daṇ+ḍi swā hā/ya ma dru ti swā hā/ saṃ ha ra ṇi swā hā/ saṃ bha ra ṇi swā hā/ san+dha ra ṇi swā hā/pra ti sa ra ṇi swā hā/ o dzo 9ba ti swā hā/ te dzo ba ti swā hā/ 2 dza ya ba ti swā hā/ rtasarba ta thā ga te mu dra a dhiṣ+ṭha ṇa a byeṣ+ṭṛ te swā hā/ mchod rten de dang / gdugs de las ye shes kyi 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phro zhing 'khrigs pa bre/ de'i gzhi'i dbus su dar ram shog shog gang 'byor pa las/srid du mda' gang tsam zheng du khru gang lhag tsam la/ gzungs gnyis ka sdogs par bri zhing 'od zer 'phro ba dang ldan par byas te/ dbus kyi mchod rten ring bsrel can de la mi reg tu gdags/ de nas dkyil 'khor de'i steng lci ba 38byed/9

gtsang ma dang / tsan+dan dang / gur kum la sogs pas bsgus la/ de'i steng du dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ngos gcig la re'u bcu bcu/ re'u gcig la yang chag/ gang dang / tshon do'i thad du brtsis te/ cha mnyam par byas la/ srad bu ring thung cha mnyam pa cig tshon sna gcig gis thig btab ste/ re'u brgya dang ngos gcig kyang re'u gnyis gnyis yod pa dang / spyir brgya rtsa brgyad du sbyar1/re'u re re'i steng du yang rtsa t+ya gzhag pa'i bzhi natsan+dan dang spos chu gang 'byor pas dkyil 'khor zlum po re re bya/ de nas las kyi bye brag las shar phyogs la sogs par gong thabs gsum gdeng / 'phan gdugs ci rigs par bres la/steng —dbus ma'i steng du rtsa t+ya su 'degs 5pa 'dug /de'i g.yas kyi stan la bi ma la uṭī ṣa'i gzungs sngags klog cing 'dug la/ de'i mdun du dkyil 'khor cig byas pa'i steng du mchod pa sna lnga dgram/ dbus su bum pa'am/bya gang 'byor pa gcig spos chus bkang la/ de'i nang du sman dang 'bru dang rin po che sna lnga lnga 6bcug la kha bcings te/ de'i mgul nas srad bu gtsang ma gcig btags la sngags gnyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad bsam pa'i rgyud mnyam par bklag go/ /de la sman lnga ni sau ha dang / bya 1 7dang / ki ri kargo ka dang /sa ha dang sa ha de ba'o/ /'bru lnga ni til dang / bal sran dang / 'bras so ba dang / nas dang gro'o/ /rin po che sna lnga ni byu ru dang / gser sa le sbram dang dung dang / mu tig dang shel te9/ ming gis smos pa 'di rnams las dngos su ma 'byor na/ gang 'byor pa de rnams las sna lngar sbyar ro/ /g.yon gyi stan la shes rab tshul brgya lnga bcu pa klog pa cig 'dug la/ yo byad gzhan ni gong ma bzhin sbyar la dharma lan cig yan chad tsi t+ya 'debs kyi bar du 38— 95

——— rdzogs nga/ra bklag /dkyil 'khor kyi steng du tsi t+ya la sogs pa 'god pa'i gos dang / 'bob gtsang mar gsol la/ khrus legs par byas pas 'god2/tsi t+ya 'debs pas bdag nyid rang gi lha'i tshul du ting nge 'dzin mnyam par 4byas te bi ma la uṭī ṣa'i snying po'am/ 'og nas tsi t+ya gdab pa'i sngags rim gyis 'byung ba gang yang rung ba des/ bsam pa'i rgyud dang ldan par byas te mchod 5cing rtsa t+ya gdab bo/ /tsi t+ya btab pa des thal byung du dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 6bzhag ste/ dang por mchod rten lugs ma sha ri ram yod pa cig dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi thig rgya gram yod nga/'i steng gzhag /gzhan gyi las kyi khyad par gyis 'god de/ zhi ba ni byang shar mtshams nas shar lho mtshams su phreng gcig rdzogs par bkod la shar nas nub tu bgre'o/ /rtsa t+ya gcig btab ste / ri'u dbus su bzhag pa dang / dar dang shog shog gang 'byor pa'i rgyal mtshan chung ngu chu srin gye mgo'am/ tog zlum po gang 'byor pa dang bcas pa dang / 'phan phran chung ngu re re gzugs mchod pa sna lnga yang rim bzhin du dbul zhing dgram/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga ni bshos dang mar me dang / spos chu dang / bdug spos dang me tog go/ /de bzhin du rtsa t+ya re re btab cing 8mchod nga/ tshang bar dbul/ dbus kyi 'khor lo'i steng mchod rten btab zin nas ma/tha'i tsi t+ya brgyad dang shar lhor bskor zhing byang gi bar du rim bzhin dgod / de nas tsi t+ya 'debs pa de bstan/ dbus ma'i steng du 'dug ste/bsam pa'i rgyud dang ldan pa/ phyogs bcu dus/ gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spyan drangs la/ dung phor la sogs pa gang 'byor pa'i nang du rin po che sna bdun dang / sman dang 'bru sna lnga dang / tsan+dan 38— /96

——dang / ga pur dang / gur gum dang 'di rnams las ci 'byor nga/ bcug ste / ar+gha'i chu lan gsum du sbreng zhing bsam pa'i rgyud dang ldan pas dbul/de la rin po che sna bdun ni byu ru dang / gser dang dngul dang zangs/ dang lcags so/ /de nas kun du bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung rnam/ par 'dzags pa kun nas gang bar byin gyis brlab cing mchod do/ /de'i 'og tu rtsa t+ya de dag thams cad shel sgong yongs su dag pa'i tshul du rang bzhin gyis rnam nga/ra dag cing gsal te/ de dag gi dbus su sngags mang nyung gnyis ka'am/ yang na rigs so so'i snying po gang gabyug po yang rung ste/ kha dog gser btso ma bzhin du dwangs shing 1'tsher ba de las 'od zer sna tshogs byung bas/ 'jig rten gyi khams nas 2nam mkha'i mthas klas pa kun du khyab napar sems can gyi don mdzad cing / re ba skong bar byen gyis brlabs nas/ be+er 'dus pas bdag gi spyi bor zhugs par dmigs nas/ bdag gi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag ste/ shel sgong yongs su dag nga/'i tshul du bsam / de bzhin du yon bdag gson gshin gang yang rung ba'i gzugs brnyan du dmigs nas/ de'i spyi gtsug tu ye shes kyi 'od zer shin tu 'phro ba dag /tshul gong ma bzhin du zhugs shing de'i las dang / nyon mongs pa la sogs pa de dag thams cad rnam par dag ste/ shel sgong ltar rab tu gsal bar dmigs/ yon bdag ji lta ba bzhin du 'khor thams cad la yang dmigs shing byin gyis brlab/ de bzhin du chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nas nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can thams cad la tshul gong ma ltar byin gyis brlab po/ /de nas bi ma la usbyi ṣa'i sngags kyi snying po nyi shu rtsa gcig yan chad 28— /97

——— — byeda'adzab ci ran cig bya/ de'i 'og tu yon bdag dngos sam gzugs brnyan gang yang rung ba de tshul bzhin du lus bsrungs la/ bi ma la usbyi ṣa dang tshul brgya lnga bcu pa bklags 1pa'i sngags chab cho ga bzhin du btab cing dbang bskur ba/spyi bo nas blugs par 2bya'o/ /de dang dus gcig tu sngags mkhan cho ga shes pa cig yod na/ phyogs bcu'i mgon po yang tshul bzhin du dgug cing asgo gsol te / mchod pa sna lnga la sogs pa dang gtor ma bzang du sbyar la rim bzhin du phul te/ 'phags pa thugs dam can khyed kyis mchod pa 'di dag bsnams la/sbyin bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba dag la khyed kyis bsrung zhing 4bskyab pa dang /don bsgrub cing byin gyis rlobs shig ces bsgo'o/ /de ltar sngags mkhan cho ga shes pa med na/ mchod rten bskor zin pa'i mjug 5la phyogs bcu'i gtor ma sbyin zhing bsngo'o/ /de nas rol mo sna tshogs kyis drangs la 'khor thams cad kyis mchod rten de dag la 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phro bar bsam zhing /lan brgya rtsa brgyad du bsam pa'i rgyud ma nyams par byas te bskor/ de lta zin nas yang sbu t+ya 'debs pa'i cho ga shes pa des/ mchod rten de dag las 'od zer byung ba de bdag gi spyi bor zhugs pa nas/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gyi spyi bor zhugs pa'i bar du snga ma bzhin du byin gyis brlabs la/ bla na med pa'i mchod nga/ dang / yon ci 'byor nga/ yang skabs 'dir dbul 7lo/ /de nas ar+gha tshul bzhin du gsol te/ bsngo ba dang smon lam rgyas par byas la 'phags pa rnams dang / mgon po dag slar gshegs par gsol lo/ /tsi t+ya'i yo byad la sogs pa kha dog dbye ba ni/ las gang byed pa'i khyad par las kha dog dkar po la sogs pa bzhin du byas te/ de la zhi ba'i cho ga ni kha dog thams 38 — /98

cad dkar por bsgyur ro/ /rgyas pa'i cho ga ni yo byad thams cad kha dog ser por bsgyur ro/ /dbang gi cho ga ni yo byad thams cad kha dog dmar por bsgyur ro / /mngon spyod kyi cho ga ni yo byad thams cad nag por bsgyur rtazhes so/ /tsi t+ya 2'debs pa dang / yon bdag dang / tsi t+ya 'debs pa'i las mi thams cad skra bkru zhing khrus bya ba dang / gos sar pa la sogs pa ci 'byor gyis zung du bsgo 4bar bya'o/ /tsi t+ya 5'debs pa dang / bskor ba'i mi rnams la thog ma nas tha ma'i bar du gzhan gyis ma reg par gyis 6shig /mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bya ba rdzogs so// //༄༄/ /mchod rten gcig gdab pa'i cho ga la/ las gzhan ni gong ma dang 'dra/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshad ni khru gang bzhi pa yan chad la/ 'phang yang khru gang byas la/ de'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gcig bri ste/ de'i dbus su gzhag /tsi t+ya 7de'i nang du sha ri ram dang rin po che ci 'byor pa yang gzhug go/ /mchod rten gcig gdab pa'i cho ga'o // // ༄7/ /mchod rten gnyis gdab pa'i cho ga la/ las gzhan ni gong ma dang 'dra/ de la dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu ni chur khru do zheng du khru gang /'phang du yang khru gang ba zhig byas la/ khru gang gru bzhi pa'i re'us bcad de/de'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re bris la de'i dbus su mchod rten gzhag/mchod rten de gcig gi dbus su bi ma la uṭī ṣa'i sngags mang nyung gnyis ka gur gum gyis bris te gzhug /mchod rten gcig gi nang du gzungs de gnyis ka 38— 99

yang gzhug pa'i steng du/ de'i bum pa'i nang du sha ri ram gcig bcug la dbyung du rung bar byas te mchod pa zin nas phyir yang dbyung bar bya'o/ /mchod rten gnyis gdab pa'i cho ga'o // //1byed/ /mchod rten gsum gdab pa'i cho ga la/ las gzhan ni gong dang 'dra/ dkyil 'khor gye tshad ni chur khru gsum/ zheng du khru gang / 'phang du khru gang byas la/ khru gang gi re'u gsum thig gis bsnyams te/ de gsum gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re bris la/ de'i steng du mchod rten gzhag /de la bzhag pa'i go rims ni/ dang por dbus su gzhag go/ /mchod rten gsum gdab pa'i cho ga'o // //nabyed/ /mchod rten lnga gdab pa'i cho ga la/ las gzhan ni gong ma dang 'dra'o/ /de la dkyil 'khor gyi tshad ni stegs bu khru gang gru bzhi pa 'phang du yang khru gang ba zhig byas la/ de'i grwa bzhir yang de dang 'dra ba re re byas la/dbus kyi stegs bu gru bzhi dang mtha' 4ma'i stegs bu bzhi'i grwa bzhi dang sbyar bar bya/ de nas stegs bu dbu ma'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'am/bcu gnyis pa cig bris te grwa 6bzhi'i stegs bu'i dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab ma grangs bcu drug pa zhig na ni/ pad+ma 'dab ma bcu gnyis pa bri/ dbus kyi bcu gnyis pa zhig na ni/ mthar brgyad pa bris te/ de'i dbus su mchod rten gzhag /mchod rten bzhag pa'i go rims ni/ dang po dbus su bzhag nas/mtha' ma bzhi ni shar nas lhor bskor thabs su gzhag go/ /yang rnam pa 38—500

gzhan du na dkyil 'khor grwa ma sbyar bar phyogs bzhi ngos ngos sbyar te bya'o/ /grwa bzhir dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lhung bzed re re spos chus bkang ste/ mchod do/ /mchod rten lnga gdab pa'i cho ga'o // //1༄za/ /mchod rten dgu gdab pa'i cho ga la/ las gzhan ni gong ma dang 'dra / de la dkyil 'khor gyi tshad ni ngos gcig la khru gsum grwa bzhi 'phang du khru gang ba zhig byas te/ khru gang gru bzhi pa re'u thig gis bcad la/ dang por dbus su de nas shar nas lhor bskor thabs su mtha' gzhag par bya'o/ /mchod rten dgu gdab pa'i cho ga'o // //4ra༅/ /mchod rten bye ba gdab pa'i cho ga la/ sngags 5bye ba bris pa'am / phyag rgyar btab la mchod rten bye ba btab pa'i nang du bcug na mchod rten thams cad 'bar ro/ /de nas mchod rten gcig nas bye ba'i bar du snga phyir btab pa de dag mchod rten chen po gcig gi nang du bcug ste/ 'phan shing la 'phan rings bsgrang 3ba ni/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgu gdung gi mchod rten 'phul ba zhes bya'o/ /mchod rten bye ba gdab pa'i cho ga ste / mchod rten gdab pa'i cho ga'o// //༄za/ /mchod rten dang tsha tsha gdab pa yan chad nas bye ba gdab pa la sogs kun kyang / bsam pa'i rgyud dang sngags ni 'dra ste/ dang por rdo rje gnod sbyin kyi cha byad/ phyag rgya dang sngags su ldan pas bdun yan chad nyi shu rtsa gcig man chad du chu la bsngags te/ 'jim pa dang yo byad yan chad la 38—50/

gdab po/ /de la rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje bcings pa bsdoms 1te mthe bong gnyis gshibs pa bsgreng / mthe'u chung gnyis kyang gzhibs te cung zad kyis mi sbyar bar byas la/ mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba las mche ba'i tshul du bya ba 'di ni rdo rje gnod sbyin kyi las thams cad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de'i sngags la/ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ 'dis btab pas thams cad gtsang mar bsams 4pa dang / bgegs la sogs pas mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ shudhe 5na du sho dha ya/ zhes 'dis btab pas/ thams cad gtsang mar bsangs par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas par bya ba'i sngags la/ na maste ya dhī kā māṃ/ dzi nā māṃ6/ badhe re dra yā na/ shu bha na 7akhyo bh+ya mṛ ta pañtsa ban+de a haṃ/ a ba lo ki tai/ na maste ya dhī/ nughā māṃ9/ sarba ta thā ga tā 7māṃ/ tat+ya thā/ oṃ susgre susgre nuste/ shadhe dādhe/ 1 shi shi bi ni/ ra ku le/ya sho ya sho ba ti/ te dza pote dzo ba ti sarba bud+dhāṣ+ṭṛ te swā hā/ mu dra gdab pa'i 'jim pa'am sngags bri ba'i tshe sngags lan bdun gdab pa'i sngags la/ na maḥs man+ta busgye ṭ+wāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā māṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/'bi 'bi bya ba'i sngags la/ oṃ badzod bha ba swā hā/ tsi glut+ya phor bu dang / sāts+tsha'i skol phor gyi nang du bye mas gdab pa'am/ snum gyis bsku ba'i sngags la oṃ badz+ra dhā tu gabye sru hā/ tho bas brdeg cing gdab pa'i sngags la/oṃ badz+ra muṅgā ra ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ/ tsi t+ya 8phor bu nas dbyung ba'i sngags la/ oṃ dharma rasne swā hā/ 'khor lo dang dbu zhu gsol ba'i sngags la/ oṃ pra mārda na ye swā hā/ tsi t+ya 19dkyil 'khor du bzhag pa'i sngags la/ oṃ su phra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ cho ga de ltar byas na rtsa t+ya gcig btab pas bye ba snyed btab 28—bye02

—par 'gyur ro/ /skye ba thams cad du skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor byas pa'i lag pa 'jim pa can gyis gang na bskus na nad mjo'i rnam pa bco brgyad la sogs pa nad thams cad ma lus pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku dang mchod rten gyi cha dbye ba bshad pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i gaṅgā'i klung gi 1bye ma snyed thams cad kyi sku ni rnam pa gnyis te/tshe blangs pa'i sku dang / chos kyi sku'o/ /del tshe blangs pa'i sgu ni yab yum las skyes pa'i 2mig dang yid tshim par byed pa/ dag par byed pa skrun par byed pa ste/ sku tshigs re re zhing sred med kyi bu'i stobs dang ldan la/ tshigs re re yang bsod nams brgya'i mtshan gyis brgyan pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan zhing dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus mdzes par byas pa mthong na blta bas chog mi shes shing mi mthun pa rnged pa dang /blta bar bya ba bla na med pa ni bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshe blangs pa'i sku'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis thugs su chud par zad kyi/ rang sangs rgyas bse ru lta bu dag dang / gnas brtan shā ri'i bu la sogs pa nyan thos chen po rnams nam 5chad ni/ su yang rgya chen yang dag par rab tu ston par ji ltar byas kyang nus pa med de/ 'di lta ste/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ste/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun 38—503

po'i chos 'di dag dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi dang / tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang /bsam gtan bzhi dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / lam bzhi dang / snying rje chen po dang / btang snyoms dang / bsru/nga ba med pa gsum dang / dkon mchog gsum dang / bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gsum dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang /rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad dang /mthar gyi rtaganas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / zad par gyi skye mched bcu dang / mi slob pa'i chos bcu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / las bdag gis bya ba mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang /ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i stobs dang / dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang/ 'chi 'pho dang bye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / zag pa zad par mkhyen pa'i stobs so/ /ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / rtag tu gnas par bya ba drug dang /ma 'dres par bsgom pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / nyon mongs pa med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / smon nas shes pa dang /shes rab kyi mthar phyin pa dang / 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang /38—bye0/

mi sdug pa dang / dbugs rngub pa dang / 'byung ba dran pa dang / dro bar gyur pa dang / rtse mo dang / bzod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi chos kyi mchog dang / mthong ba'i lam dang / bsgom pa'i lam dang / mi slob pa'i lam dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yan lag bcu gnyis dang /phung po lnga dang / skye mched bcu gnyis dang / khams bco brgyad dang /dbang po nyi shu gnyis rnams yin no/ /zab cing mchog tu zab pa'i chos 'di dag ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis gsungs pa ste/ gang rang rang gi mtshan nyid dang / spyi'i mtshan nyid rjes su rtogs nas nyid kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thugs su chud de/ dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams dang / mu stegs can sna tshogs dge spyong dang / bram ze gabyug pa 1dang /rgyu ba dang / kun du rgyu ba dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan te/sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba rnams btul nas 'khor grangs med pa khrag khyeg brgya stong dang / mya ngan las 'das pa 'jigs pa med pa'i grong khyer du zhugs so//sangs rgyas kyi sku bshad pa sdogs so// //de nas mchod rten gyi don bshad de/ bsags par bya ba yin pas bsags pa'o/ /yang na bsags su rung ba'i phyir yang bsags pa zhes bya'o/ /yang na don gyi skabs su 'dir dran par bya ba yin pas na dran pa zhes bya ste/38—505

de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sku'i bdag nyid dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang /yang dag par spong ba dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam gyi yan lag dang / ye shes dang / stobs dang /ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / snying rje chen po zhes bya ba'i yon tan de dag yun ring po nas thabs kyi bye brag gis 1bsags pa dang / sngon yang dag par ma bsgoms kyang / don gyi skabs dag tu 'dul ba rnams kyis dran par bya ba'i phyir na bcigs pa zhes bya ba'am/ dran pa zhes bya ste/ de dag gi gzugs brnyan la mchod rten zhes bya'o/ /chos kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan zhes bya'o/ /de'i bang rim bzhi dang / bum rten dang / bum pa dang /pu shu dang / srog shing dang / 'khor lo brtsegs ma bcu gsum dang /char khebs 4rnams ni mchod rten gyi dbyibs yin no/ /de la bang rim dang po na 5dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi ste/ 'di ltar lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / tshor ba dang / sems dang / chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'o/ /bang rim gnyis pa ni yang dag par spong ba bzhi ste6/ 'di ltar sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spang ba'i phyir brtson pa dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi 8babyad pa'i phyir brtson pa dang / dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa'i phyir brtson pa dang / dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams gnas par bya ba'i phyir brtson pa'o/ /bang rim gsum pa rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ste/ 'di ltar 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / sems kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / / dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa'o/ /bang rim 38—506

byed———sde— bzhi pa dbang po lnga ste/ 'di ltar dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grub kyi dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin kyi dbang po dang /shes rab kyi dbang po'o/ /bum rten ni stobs lnga ste/ 'di ltar dad pa'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang / dran pa'i stobs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs so/ /bum pa ni byang chub kyi yan lag bdun te / 'di ltar dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / chos rnam par 'byed pa dang / dga' ba dang / shin tu sbyangs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /pu shu ni lam yan lag brgyad pa ste/ 'di ltar yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /srog shing ni shes pa bcu ste/ 'di ltar kun rdzob shes pa dang / /pha rol gyi sems shes pa dang / chos shes pa dang /rjes su rtogs par shes pa dang / sdug bsngal shes pa dang /1 kun 'byung shes pa dang / 'gog pa shes pa dang / lam shes pa dang / zad pa shes pa dang / mi skye ba shes pa'o/ /'khor lo dang po ni gnas dang / gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs so/ /'khor lo gnyis pa ni las bdag gir mkhyen pa'i stobs gsum pa ni bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa mkhyen pa'i stobs so/ 'khor lo bzhi pa ni dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs so/ /'khor lo lnga pa ni mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs so/ /'khor lo drug pa ni khams sna tshogs 38—507

—— —— —— ————byed—byed—mkhyen pa'i stobs so/ /'khor lo bdun pa ni thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs so/ /'khor lo brgyad pa ni sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i stobs so/ /'khor lo dgu pa ni 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs so/ /'khor lo bcu pa ni zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs so/ /'khor lo bcu gcig pa ni ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang po ste/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor rnams la chos ston pa na/ slob ma thams cad mthun par gus par nyan pa la dga' ba'i 1 sems mi 'byung ba'o/ /'khor lo bcu gnyis pa ni/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gnyis pa ste/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor rnams la chos ston pa na/ slob ma thams cad mthun par gus par mi nyan pa la khong khro ba mi 'byung ba'o/ /'khor lo bcu gsum pa ni ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum pa ste/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor rnams la chos ston pa la slob ma 2la gus par mnyan la/ la la gus nga/ra mi nyan pa rnams la dga' ba dang / khong khro ba gnyis mi 'byung ba'o/ /char khebs ni snying rje chen po ste/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'dul ba'i rgyud smin pa dang / ma smin pa dang / da ltar smin pa rnams kyi don dpyod byung / 'jig rten la phan pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sku ma/ 'u/sa/ nga/ dus/ kyi khyad nga/ra dag tu yang dag 'dzin 4'di ni mchod rten gyi rang bzhin no/ /de las gzhan pa'i rdo rings dang / jem skas dang / chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / dril bu dang / gdugs/ dang / zla ba dang / dar gyi cod pan dang / ba dan la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i rkyen du 'bab pa'i mchod 28 —508

———pa'i yo byad dag kyang yod de/ de la rdo rings rnams ni mi 'jigs pa bzhi bstan te/ 'di ltar zag pa zad pa dang / yang dag par sgogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / bar du gcod pa'i chos rnams phyin ci 1log par bstan pa dang /nges par 'byung ba'i lam phyin ci ma log par bstan pa'o/ /jem skas kyis ni bsrung ba med pa bzhi bstan te/ 'di ltar sku'i phrin las yongs su dag pa dang /gsung gi phrin las yongs su dag pa dang / thugs kyi phrin las yongs su dag pa dang / 'tsho ba yongs su dag pa'o/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan rnams kyis ni/bdud kyi rgyal mtshan bsnyal bar bstan te/ 'di ltar lha'i bdud bsnyal ba dang /nyon mongs pa'i bdud bsnyal ba dang / phung po'i bdud bsnyal ba'o2/ /'chi bdag gi bdud bsnyal ba'o/ /me tog gi phreng bas ni bla na med pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po bstan to/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi bshad pas/ 'jig rten bzhi la phan 'dogs par bstan to/ /'di ltar so so'i skye bo la phan 'dogs pa dang / rgyun du zhugs pa la phan 'dogs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba la phan 'dogs pa dang/ phyir mi 'ong ba la phan 'dogs pa'o/ /dril bu rnams ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs bstan te/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pas tshegs chung ngus stong gsum gyi stong chen por tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su chos bstan pa'i sgra skad kyis kun du 'gengs pa'o/ /gdugs kyis ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi spyi bor gyur par bstan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa sems can rkang pa med pa dang / rkang pa gnyis pa dang / rkang mangs dang / gzugs can dang / gzugs med pa rnams kyi mchog ces bya bar gyur pa'o/ /zla bas bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba bstan te/ gang 38—bye09

༄/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig bsrung ba'i sgrub thabs/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya rak+ṣa sā dha rgo/bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig bsrung ba'i sgrub 2 thabs / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer dri ma med pa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /gang 'dod dngos grub sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi rdul la ni/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rgyal sras thu bo rnams la yang / /dngos kun phyag byas 'od zer gyi/ /dri med snying po sgru ba thabs bshad/ /bkra shis yid 'ong bde gnas su/ /khrus byas bde ba'i stan la 'dug /gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / /byang chub sems ni babyed pa dang / /sdom bzung tshad med bzhi la gnas/ /rang snying a las 'od byung bas//bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /nam mkha'i ngos la bsam par bya/ /phyag 38—bye/3

byedabyed— — —'amyodrol mchod pa la sogs bya/ /de nas stong pa'i ngo bor bsam/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā na /badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho1haṃ/ de nas las rjes/ dran nga/ra bya/ /a las zla ba rdo — jer bskyed/ /de yis ji ltar 'dod rgyal pos/ /bgegs rnams bskrad nga/ngari byas nas ni/ /de dbus nam mkha' gru gsum zlum/ /gru bzhi ri rab rnacha/ par bsam/ /gru bzhi sgo dang rab ldan pa/ /'od dang ldan pa'i khang pazari bsgom/ /lte bar pad+ma zla ba la/ /a dang rma mu hriḥhūṃ las/ /a las nongari bu 'bar bar gyur/ /sku mdog sna tshogs ma nges la/ /zhal gcig phyag gaḍi)sa rgyan dang ldan/ /g.yas pa skyabs sbyin g.yon nor bu/ /mtshan dang dpe byang) tshogs pa dbus/ /g.yas su 'jam dpal non po la/ /rgyab tu shākya thub pa nying) / /g.yon du seng ge sgra bsam bya/ /mdun du phyag na rdo rje bsgom/ /mdun gyi cadam mkhar 4ye shes bsam/ /byin brlabs dbang bsgur bsam par bya/ /maspyozi da bstod legs par 5rdzogs pa dang / /rtse gcig yid kyis bsgom par bya/ /de (pas spyo na snying po bzlas/ /gtsug tu bzlas dang smin phrag bzlas/ /snying ga rdo)da du bzlas pa'o/ /nye ba'i snying po/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mu dra a byeṣ+ṭṛ te swā ṭā/ de nas gtor mas mchod nas gshegs/ /bdag nyid smon 6lam nyid bya :ṅgeng / /snang ba sgyu ma bzhin du sbyang / /'di byas ngal ba'i bsod nams kyis/ / /'di byas ngal ba sdig pa dag /dri med 'khor lo'i sgur gyur shog /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig bsrung ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs rgya gzari gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra — shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //28—3/ /

1776༄༅/ /sāts+tsha lnga gdab pa'i cho ga bzhugs/ 1༄7/ /de nas khrus byas gos gtsang bgos/ /spos kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi bya/ /mchod rten lnga gdab 2gro ga la/ /'khor lo bya ru sdogs par bya/ /ba dan gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sogs/ /me tog phreng bas brgyan pa ni/ /dbus dang grwa la bzhugs su gsol/ /bum pa gang ba bzhi la ni/ /byin gyis brlabs la phyogs bzhir gzhag /rma bya'i sgro lnga'i mu men dang / /spos kyi sdong po snod bzhi yang 4/ /grwa la legs par gzhag par bya/ /mchod yon spos dang me tog tshogs/ /mar me dri dang lha bshos dang / /rol mo sna tshogs reg byas mchod/ /a las byung ba'i ngo mtshar mchog /thugs ni nam mkha' sangs rgyas nyid/ /gtsug tor dri med snying po'i mchog /yid bzhin nor bu khyod phyag 'tshal/ /shes rab mchog gyur 'jam pa'i mgon/ /a la la ho ngo bo'i chos/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog 'byung ba/ /'jam pa'i mgon la 38—bye/6

phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub/ thugs rje'i mchog tu gyur pa ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur mtshungs/ /shākya thub par phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snying rje chen po'i mchog gyur pa/ /dri med dag pa'i snying po'i sgu / /'od zer 'bar bas gsung dag nga// /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod / /bdud rnams 'joms pa'i rdo rje can/ /thugs kyi rdo rje yid bzhin tshul / /nad rnams sel ba sman pa'i mchog /phyag na rdo rjer 2phyag 'tshal bstod / /sdig bshags bsod nams rjes yi rang / /'khor lo bskor dang myang mi 'da'/ /bsngo dang gsol gdab 'dod don zhu/ /gang 'dod pa yi las la 'jug /rgyun dang nar mar tshogs bsag bya/ /dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dang por sems bskyed la gang la dmigs pa'i bsam rgyud dang bcas par bya'o / /dang por bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang /gtsug tor dri ma med pa la sogs pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsams la/ mchod pa rgya chen po dngos su dbul lo/ /de rnams kyis kyang bdag dang bum pa nad pa'am gang la sgrub par byed pa de la byin gyis rlob par gsol ba gdab pas byin gyis rlob par bsam mo/ /bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa de la rang yang khrus bya/ gso spyong la sogs pa gtsang mar byas la gzungs tshar brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so/ /de nas gang la dmigs pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab par bsams la khrus bya'o/ /bsam rgyud dang bcas pas so// //

chog batha/gas/1༄7/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gal te cho ga bya bar 'dod na des khrus byas la gos btsang ma bgos/ spos kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bya'o/ /snying po'i rig sngags gro ga la bri bar bya'o/ /mchod rten lnga gdab par bya/ /rig sngags 'di yang mchod rten gyi nang du gzhug par bya/ mchod rten ni grwa bzhir gzhag par bya/ gcig ni dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gzhag par bya/shing bu btsugs te ba dan dmar po dpyang bar bya'o/ /me tog gis gtor bar bya/ bum pa gang ba bzhi gzhag /grwa bzhir pog phor bzhi dang / tu ru ska 5dang / a ka ru dang / gu gul gyi dud pas bdug par bya'o/ /spos kyi mchod yon gyi snod bzhi gzhag par bya/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i sngags 'di gnyis kyang lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya/ dkyil 'khor la bskor bar bya'o/ /nad kyis btab pa/ gnod pa/ nad tshabs che ba/38—bye/9

—— ——byedatshe zad pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi bas 'jigs pa/ rgyal po dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis 'jigs pa/ bu 'dod pa rnams dkyil 'khor la mngon par phyogs par gzhag go/ /rma bya'i sgro lngas byab par bya'o/ /mchod rten gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod par bya'o/ /cho ga 'di lan gcig byas na bskal pa 'bum du byas pa'i las kyi sgrib pa 1med par 'gyur ro/ /kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri ma med par snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po dang / dam tshig la rnam par blta ba'i gzungs sngags 'di bris la mchod rten gyi nang du gzhug go/ /mchod rten gsar pa'am/ rnying pa bcos pa yang rung // de'i nang du gzhug /spos dang byug pa yang dbul lo/ /gzungs/ kyi sngags zlos shing brgya rtsa brgyad bskor bar bya/ nyin zhag re la nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum dran par bya'o/ /de nas nyi ma shar ba dang shar phyogs su spos kyi dkyil 'khor bya/ nyi ma la 4logs su me tog gis gtor ro/ /a ka ru dang / tu ruska'i 5du bas bdugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bya'o/ /mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad btab la rig sngags kyi snying po bris te mchod rten gyi nang du bcug /dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhag na gaṅgā'i klung bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dgu'i bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sgu gdung ring bsrel mchod rten re re'i nang du bcug par 'gyur ro/ /snying po 'di bris la gzhug go/ /gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //28—520

bsdur mchan/519 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatsang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhugs/4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyang / 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du ru ka52༷ ༷77〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dang bral nas sgrib pa/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wa'od zer/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ste/ 47〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wal/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du ru ka'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (17༷4)38wa 521

༄/ /gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs chog bzhugs/1༄4/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs kyi cho ga /dang por ba'i lci ba sa la ma lhung bas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas la/ de la tsan+dan dang gur kum la sogs pas gtor la/me tog sil ma'ang gtor ro/ /de'i steng du gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i yang snying gur kum mam/ gi waṃ gis me tog dkar po 'byung ba'i myu gus gro ga la bris2/de la dkyil 'khor du bcug pa'i sāts+tsha 4lnga'am/ bdun nam dgu tsam byas la/maṇ+ḍal gyi me tog phung po'i steng du gzhag /de nas mchod rten re re la lha bshos la 5sogs pa mchod pa rnam pa lnga re re bshams la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bskor ba ltar gzhag /yang maṇ+ḍal gye steng du 6gser dngul la sogs pa rin po che'i bum nga/ bzhi tsam dang / skyogs la sogs pa'i snod bzhi tsam a ka ru dang tu ruska 1 la sogs nga/ dri bzang pos bkang la/ phyogs mtshams rnams su 28——522

—byed——gzhag go/ /de nas mchod pa bshams pa rnams sku gzugs dang sāts+tsha /la sogs pa dkon mchog la 'bul 2zhing / bsod nams kyi yan lag rnams tshang bar bya/ de nas mchod g.yog gcig bdag gis bzlas brjod ma zin gyi bar du a ka ru la sogs pa'i spos dri zhim po bsreg du gzhug /bzlas pa'i dus su gtam gzhan dang ma 'dres par bya/ bzlas pa zin pa dang yang snying po 'ba' zhig bzlas shing bskor ba brgya rtsa brgyad bya/ de ltar zin pa dang /rin po che'i snod rnams kyi chu kun las cung zad bsdus la/ nad pa la cung zad blud cing khrus bya/ de ltar byas na glo bur ba la sogs pa'i nad tshabs che ba las kyang thar bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe zad pa las ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /las kyi sgrib pa chen po rnams kyang byang bar 'gyur te/ de dag la sogs pa phan yon dpag tu med pa ni de nyid kyi cho ga rgya chen po las shes par bya'o/ /cho ga gang byed kyang 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma gsum mam bzhi gtung 4bar bya'o / /slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i gtsug tor dri ma med pa'i gzungs kyi cho ga rdzogs so// //38—523

0ba 'ab(byebakabs zab//1༄7/ /gcan zan dang la sogs pa ni rgyu de phan gdags pa'o/ /kun nas sgor 'jug pa la sogs pas ni bzlas pa'i grangs gsungs te lan stong ni shi ba la phan gdags pa'i bzlas brjod kyi grangs so/ /khri ni 'chi ba blu ba'i tshes brgyad nas nya'i bar du dge slong la sogs pa gang zag bcus byed pa'i grangs so//'bum ni bsnyen pa'i bzlas brjod kyi grangs so/ /'bum bris te mchod rten gyi nang du bcug ces pa ni snying po 'ba' zhig gur kum dang gi waṃ dang tsan dan la sogs pas sngon bzhin bris na tsha tsha'i nang du bcug pa'o/ /'bum tshang nas mchod rten chen po gcig gi nang du bcug ste/ shing bu bsgreng zhing rgyan btags nas mchod do zhes pa ni 'bum gter chen po'i ring bsrel lo/ /de la mchod rten gyi rim pa ni/ ri 'am thang ngam ljongs gang dag /dur khrod la sogs yangs pa med/ /yid 'ong gnas su rgyal ba yi/ /sgu gdung mchod 28——525

—byedarten brtsig nga/ra bya/ /yang na sa 'am rdo dag la/ /mkhas pas tshul bzhin brko bar bya/ /sa 'am rdo 'am shing dag gam/ /yang na tshogs pas brtsig par bya/ /de la sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten ni khri 'phang bcu gsum yan chad/sum cu rtsa gnyis man chad do/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi dgu yan chad bcu gcig man chad de char khab dang tog kyang med do/ /dgra bcom pa'i khri 'phang bzhi yan chad do/ /'khor lo lnga pa'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa nas phyir mi 'ong ba'i bar gye khri 'phang gsum kho na'o/ /'khor lo bdun pa'o/ /so so'i skye bo'i khri 'phang gnyis 'khor lo bzhi'o/ /de la sangs rgyas kyi sgu gdung cha brgyad du bgos pa'i mchod rten chen po brgyad ni grong khyer ser skyar rgyal po zas gtsang gis yon bdag byas nas dpal lha las babs pa'i mchod rten brtsigs so//yul ma ga dha dbus 'gyur tshal du rgyal po ma skyes dgras yon bdag byas nas byang chub chen po'i mchod rten brtsigs so/ /grong khyer rtsa mchog tu gyad rnams kyi yon bdag byas nas cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten brtsigs so/ /yul bā ra ṇa se ru ser skya'i rgyal po tshangs byin kyis yon bdag byas nas dpal chos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod rten brtsigs so/ /yul yangs pa can du rgyal po li tsa byi gzhon nus yon bdag byas nas dpal ka ni ka'i mchod rten brtsigs so/ /yul mnyan yo/da du rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis yon bdag byas nas dpal bkra shis sgo mangs brtsigs so/ /yul chang ger rgyal po 'dun 'dzin ta las yon bdag byas nas/ dpal 'od can gyi mchod rten brtsigs so/ /yul ti ka tsa shir rgyal po in+d+ra ba mis yon bdag byas nas mchod rten pad+ma can brtsigs so/ /slan chad kyang de dag gi rjes su 'brangs te brtsigs par bya'o/ /de la byang 28—bye26

————— ————— —— ———————chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi tshul du brtsigs na/ sgu gdung gi rmang yod na rmang rten ji ltar mtho ba bzang po rten med na bang rim dang po'i sum cha'i tshad do/ /de'i steng du dge bcu ni phyir bskyed pa dang rngams bang rim dang po'i rngams phyed do / /gnam 'phang phyi la bang rim dang po'i ngos tshad do/ /de yan chad srog shing ste bang rim dang po'i bzhi gsum gyi tshad do/ /bang rim bzhi 'phang mnyam mo/ /bang rim rngams kyi phyir tshad dza 'phang ngo / /bum rten khye 'phang gi tshad do/ /bum pa ni bang rim dang po'i sum gnyis kyi tshad do/ /stod kyi skyed ni bang rim gsum pa dang mnyam mo/ /bre rten gyi rgya ni bang rim bzhi pa'i lnga cha gcig go/ /bre ni bang rim bzhi cha gcig go/ /de gnyis ka'i 'phangs ni bang rim gyi sum gnyis dang bang rim gye phyed do/ /bang rim bzhi shar dang lhor gsal khung bang rim nyid kyi brgyad cha'o/ /srog shing gi rtsa ba bang rim bzhi pa la reg go/ /'khor lo bcu gsum gyi 'phang du bang rim dang po'i bzhi gsum gyi tshad do/ /'khor lo dang po ni bre'i zur bzhi la slebs so/ /de bzhi chas 'khor ba'i tshad ni 'khor lo bcu gsum pa'o/ /bcu gcig po yang de'i rim gyis gzhol ba'o/ /rtseg par thams cad ni ci mdzes su bya'o/ /thugs rjes mdo gzungs 'phang lo chung ba dang mnyam mo/ /de'i smad du rngams kyi bzhi gsum ni 'jam po nyid stod du bzhi cha cig ni phreng ba'i sung/ bcu drug pa'o/ /de'i steng du 'khor lo bcu gsum pa nyid kyi shing phyed tshad yang rtse phra ba bang rim nyid kyi 'phang phyed do/ /yang srog shing 'phang du bre ched tsam steng du zla ba'i rtse mo gdugs dang mnyam srog shing la bskor te rtse mo dgrad do/ /gdugs ni 'khor lo bdun pa dang mnyam mo/ /gdugs khabs 'khor lo drug 38— 527

——pa dang mnyam mo/ /za ra tshags ni bre'i 'phang dang mnyam mo/ /yang srog shing 'phang du bre'i sum cha'i tshad kyi steng du nyi ma zla ba las khyad g.yung tsam mo/ /nyi ma'i steng du tog gi uta nga/ la gsang ba'i tog bu 'dra ste ci mdzes nyi ma dang zla ba dang tog thams cad kyi zur la bya mi 'chags par bya ba'i phyir lcags kyi thur ma rnon po gser rtabar bya'o/ /tog be+e ser po nyi ma ni dmar po/ zla ba ni dkar ngo// gdugs khabs ni dkar po'o/ /gdugs ni sngon po gdugs kyi phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i phyag rgya bri'o/ /thugs rje'i phul ni dmar po'o/ /thugs rje nyid dang shes bcu ni ser po'o/ /sgog shing ni dmar po'o/ /mchod rten kyang dkar po'o/ /dge bcu yang ser ngo 'o/ /rmang dang rmang rten ljang khu'o / /mchod rten brtsig pa'i rim pa'o/ /da ni mchod rten gyi bum steng du gdung ma bzhi rgya gram du bri bar bya'o/ /de ji ltar 'tsham pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i zheng gi bzhi bri'o/ /de'i steng du rdo leg bam so btang ba'i 2so phag legs par gzhib ngo// /de'i steng du bkris pa'i rtswa mun dza btubs pa dang /bsres pa'i dri bzang po'i chus sbrus nas gro phye dang shing bal bkal bas bsre bar bya'o / /rgya ji tsam yod pa'i bcu drug gam brgyad kyi cha ni 'phangs su bya'o/ /gnyer ma dang sgo 'bur med pa'i gru bzhi par bya'o/ /de nas thig gdab pa dkyil 'khor chen po bkod pa'i rgyud las/ skyon med ras bal 'jam pos ni/ /shin tu gtsang ba'i bu mos ni/ /shar du bltas/ nas dgu bsgril du/ /sngags 'di brjod cing bkal bar bya/ /oṃ a no t+yā a nu ga to ya/ sarba dharma pa ram̐ pa ra/ sarba dharma/ a nan ta ya/ ma su par pa tha sarba dharma hūṃ/ shar nub lho 28——pya28

byang tshangs thig gdab/ /tshangs dang ngos dang gru chad gdab/ /nang gi phyed kyang phyed tshad gdab/ /rgyab tu phyed phyed tshad btab nas/ /lnga pa phyi nas cha re gdab/ /drug pa dbus kar rgyab ma bkas/ /bzhi rgyab phyogs bzhir dbus cha bzhi/ /re re yang ni bzhi bzhir bsgo/ /des ni sgo'i dkyil 'khor ro//pho brang ci bder sgrub par bya'o/ /de'i rgyab tu cha gnyis kyang / phyed cha re rer bskor ba ni pad+ma rdo rje 'od phreng dang / mchod pa bgos pa'i sa gzhi ste zhes pa'i tshul gyis thig btab nas sa tshon bkye bas gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang dra shar dang zla mdzes dang ba dan la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa bri'o/ /phyi rol du ra ba rim pa gsum ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang rdo rje sngon po'i phreng ba dang dmar ser me 'od 'bar ba thams cad du zlum po drang ba'o / /dkyil 'khor de la lha'i rten dgod par bya ste/ sgu'am tsa ka li'am phyag rgya'am ming yig kyang rung ste/ tshon ma lus par bris nas dgod par bya'o/ /de'ang byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam par sel ba'i rgyud las/ phung po lnga dang bcwa brgyad khams/ /'byung bzhir bcas pa'i lus kyi ni/ /dkyil 'khor chen po 'di bltas nas/ /mi de myur du grol bar 'gyur zhes so/ /de nas lus dkyil 'khor ci lta ba gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor la'ang lha nyi shu rtsa bdun du nges so/ /de'ang gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor ni rnam par snang mdzad la sogs gtso bo yab yum la lha mo nyi shu rtsa drug gis bskor ba'o/ /rig sngags kyi dkyil 'khor lha mo dang byang chub sems dpa'o/ /gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor la lha mo dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo'o/ /'on kyang nyi shu rtsa bdun de dag kyang phyogs dang kha dog gi bye brag gi lha re re yang bzhi bzhir 38—bye29

— — — ———byed—byed——byed byeda'agyur la/ de ltar na rigs 'dus pa'i lha brgya rtsa brgyad do/ /de nyi shu rtsa lngar 'du zhing dgu dang lnga dang gcig kho nar yang nges so/ /de brgya rtsa brgyad do dbang du byas nas dbus su rnam par snang mdzad chen po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad zhabs brgyad pa yum dang bcas pa'o/ /g.yas su/ nyi ma rnam par snang mdzad do//g.yo/na du zla ba rnam par snang mdzad/ shar du mi bskyod nga/ la rigs bzhi dang spyan ma la sogs pa bzhi dang / gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi dang /la se la sogs pa bzhis bskor ba'o/ /de kho na bzhin du lho dang nub dang byang du yang shes par bya'o/ /de ni dbus kyi pho brang ngo/ /de yang sgrib pa rnam par sel ba'i rgyud las/ thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyi/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rnam snang mdzad/ /mdog skya byang chub mchog gi rgya/ /zhal bzhi pa la phyag brgyad do/ /rig pa kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /zla ba nyi ma rnam snang mdzad / /nyi ma zla ba 'chang ba'o/ /phyog bzhi pho brang dbus su ni/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma'i rigs/ /las kyi rigs rnams so/ sor yang rang rig sangs rgyas sras/ po dang / /spyan ma bdag mo gos dkar sgrol/ /gzugs sgra dri ro lha mo dang / /sgeg mo gar phreng glu ma rnams/ /phyogs mdog rigs kyi phyag rgya can/ /g.yon pa rang rtags rgya 'chang ba/ /ldem bag zhi ba'i tshul du bsam//zhes pa dang / yang byang chub sems dpa' sum cu gnyis/ /lha'i snam bur dgod par bya/ /rig pa'i lha mo khro mo che/ /mos pas sgo la dgod par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i rgyab tu lha rnams la/ bskal bzang sems dpa' bcu drug go/ /sgo bzhir lha mo bzhi'am khro bo bzhi dbus kyi gtso bo la yang gzungs kyi tshul du bsgrub pa la lha mo bzhi'o/ /rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi 38——bye30

tshul du bsgrub pa la rigs bzhi nyid do/ /yang dbus su rigs lnga mtshams su spyan ma la sogs pa bzhi dang pho brang gi dbus su gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa bzhi dang sgo bzhir lcags kyu ma la sogs pa 'am yang na khro mo bzhi'o/ /sgo'i nang gi lha rnams 1la byang chub sems dpa' zung re te brgyad do/ /rten dag bkod nas dkyil 'khor yol ba dmar po dang bla re sngon pos bya'o/ /cod pan dang ba dan dang rgyal mtshan dang gzugs la sogs pa ngos re re yang brgyad brgyad mngon par 'du bya ste legs par bgod/ de'i steng du khri bcas nas g.yon gyi bdag po gang de'i gos la sogs pa dang gzugs brnyan bzhag par bya'o/ /de ni dkyil 'khor gyi rim pa'o/ /de ni dkyil 'khor de la mchod par bya ste/ lha'i grangs kyi mchod pas dkyil 'khor de yongs su bskor nas sgrub ༄ po phyogs bzhir bzhugs te/ ji ltar bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor rin po che sna tshogs kyi gzhal yas khang par lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad byug gis dmigs nas rang bzhin gyis lha bcug ste/ nam mkha' zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i oṃ yig las 'phrul pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod par bsam zhing / gzhung gzhan du gsungs pa'i tshigs bcad dang sngags du mas mchod cing bstod par bya'o/ /sal 4snyan du ma'i tshogs bkrol zhing bkra shis kyi glu du ma dang smon lam du brjod par bya'o// //'byor ba rab kyis ni ro dang ro'i snod brgyan cing ro bcug nas ro'i lho'i phyogs su sa legs par bstar ba'i dkyil 'khor khru bzhi nas bcu drug gi bar du ci rigs par bya ste/ khru bzhi pa mtho gang nas khru gang gi bar du brtsig par bya'o/ /de la mkhas pas thig 'di ltar gdab bo/ /tshangs thig zur ngos legs btab 38—bye3/

—— — byed——— — ———— —— — — byed —byedanas/ / /zur bzhi lo ma gdab nga/ra bya/ /cha chen bzhi ru 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas gsu/ma gsum bgos nas/ ni/ /cha chen bcu gnyis 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas gnyis su bgos nas/ ni/ /cha chen nyi shu bzhi ru 'gyur/ /de nas cha bran bgos nas/ ni/ /tshangs pa'i thig gi ngos gnyis kyi/ /cha chen dang po'i phyed du bsgo/ /phyi'i cha phyed de bzhin bgo/ /cha chen gnyis pa'ang ched du bgo / /nang gi cha phyed de bzhin bgo/ /cha chen gsum pa'i mtha' la gcig /cha chen bzhi pa'i phyi nang gi/ /cha re btab cing lnga pa phyed/ /cha chen drug pa lha rnam 'gyur/ /cha chen bdun pa phyi nang gi/ /cha re gdab cing dbus gnyis/ bzhag /cha chen brgyad pa phyed du bgo/ /phyi yi cha phyed de bzhin bgo/ /cha chen dgu pa bzhi ru bgo/ /cha chen bcu pa phyi nang gi//cha re gdab cing dbus gnyis bzhag1 /cha chen bcu gcig phyed du bgo/ /cha chen bcu gnyis khor yug 'gyur/ /phyogs gsum du 'ang de bzhin no/ /sgo cig phyed na tshangs thig dang / /phyogs gcig zur thig gdab byas nas/ /tshangs pa'i thig gi ngos gnyis su/ /cha chen lnga lnga bgo byas nas/ /cha chen bcu ru 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas gnyis su bgo byas nas/ /cha chen nyi shur 'gyur ba yin/ /de nas cha bran bgo bar bya/ /tshangs pa'i thig gi ngos gnyis/ kyi/ /cha chen dang po phyed du bgo/ /phyi'i cha phyed de bzhin bgo/ /cha chen gnyis ni phyed du bgo/ /cha chen gsum pa'i mthar cha gcig /cha chen bzhi pa lha snam 'gyur/ /cha chen lnga pa phyi nang gi/ /cha re gdab cing dbus gnyis bzhag /cha chen drug pa phyed du bgo/ /cha chen bdun pa bzhi ru bsgo/ /cha chen brgyad pa phyi nang gi/ /cha re gdab byung dbus gnyis bzhag /cha chen 28 —5 32

dgu pa phyed du bgo/ /de nas bskor ba rim gnyis bya/ /gsum nga/ mtha'i cha phran bskor/ /cha chen bcu pa khor yug 'gyur/ /sgo gsum pa so/gas byed 'dod na/ /phyi nang dkyil 'khor gang yin pa'i/ /tshad kyi rim pas bya ba ni/ /cha phran dbri dang bsnan par bya/ /de nas blo dang ldan pas tshon sna ma lus nga/sa/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa rim pa gnyis sam yang na rim pa gcig kho na bri'o/ /der sngon du bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor lha gang mos pa dgod par bya'o/ /gal te rim pa gnyis bris na bar khyams la 'jig rten skyong ba bcu dgod par bya'o/ /de yang brgya byin dkar po rdo rje 'chang / /me lha dmar po me thab 1'chang / /gshin rje sngon po be+e con 'chang / /bden bral sngon skya ral gri 'chang / /chu bdag dkar po zhags pa 'chang / /rlung lha ljang ser ba dan 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin ljang sngon dbyug pa 'chang / /dbang phyug ljang skya rtse gsum 'dzin/ /sa bdag mi ni bum ljang ser/ /nyi zla tshangs pa dkar ser ni/ /'od 'phro 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /lha de dag gi sngags sam phyag rgya'am sku dgod par bya'o// //38—533

rigya/ /'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis tshi thub ma jes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya si tā 2ta pa tre a pa rā dzi ta nā ma no pi kā/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can 4la phyag 'tshal lo / /‘p+ta mo gdugs dkar can bsgrub 5par 'dod pas/ gnas dbe+en par khrus byas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rang skad cig gis lha mor bsgred pa'i o gyi 'od kyis 'phags ma ri khrod ma dang sangs rgyas la sogs pa spyan drangs la phyag bya ste/ mchod pa la sogs pa'i bdun rnam dag gis tshogs bsags nas/tshangs pabe+eri gnas bzhi dang / ye shes kyi tshogs bsag par bya'o/ /de'i ngang las snying ga'i oṃ las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pa las gdugs dkar mo 6 oṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer sgu phra mor 'phros 'dus pa las bdag nyid lha mo gdugs dkar can sku mdog dkar mo zhal gabyug phyag 38—535

gnyis pa/ spyan gnyis las byams pa dang snying rje'i 'od zer 'phro ba/g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon gdugs dkar mo 1bzung ba/ pad zla'i gdan la zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs shing sgeg pa'o/ /de dbu rgyan dang rna rgyan la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras par lta'o pa/ /spro na ri khrod ma dang legs ldan gyis bskor bar bsam mo/ /de la oṃ gyi 'od kyis ye shes pa dgug gzhug byung 4dbang du bya'o/ /de nyid la dbang bskur la/ bai ro tsa nas dbu rgyan no/ /de'i thugs kar 'phags ma mtshon gang ba oṃ dang bcas par blta'o//de nyid las skyo bar gyur na ye shes kyi lha mdun du bkug la phyag dang mchod bstod byas/ nas thugs ka gnyis su oṃ la sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs nas/zhal dang lte bar 'gal me ltar 'khor bas rang gzhan thams cad kyi nad gdon la sogs pa bsregs par bsams nas/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/bi sha de bi sha de/ bai re be+e re/ badz+ra dha ri/ ban+dha ban+dha ni badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa/hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ bye ban+dha phaṭa swā hā/ 'bum la sogs pa bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas thun mtshams su mdun gyi ye shes pa la dmigs pa'i mdo dang / lha mo legs ldan la gtor ma btang nas/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor bya'o/ /'phags pa gdugs dkar mo can gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad nga rdzogs so// //lo tsā ba 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //38—536

༄/ /'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa gdugs dkar mo can gyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya si tā ta pa tre a pa rā dzi ta ba bo ta bi bye nā ma / bod skad du/ 'phags pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa gdugs dkar mo can gyi gtor ma'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags ma thugs rje'i rang bzhin can/ /'byung po kun la mnga' mdzad ma'i/ /khro mo'i sgu la phyag 'tshal nas/ /stong bzlog 4gtor ma bshad par bya/ /ba bo gzhal yas khang bsam bri/ /pho brang zlum por bya ba mchog /sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram la/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyis bskor/ /de bzhin 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad de/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir ldan/ /kha dog 'jig rten pa dang mthun/ /sgo rgyan la sogs de bzhin no/ /de nas lha rnams dgod par bya/ /dbus kyi pho brang zlum po dang / /yum chen gdugs dkar 'khor lo dang / /tshangs pa lha yi gtso bo dang / /gsol kha'i pho nya las 38—pya38

byed pa/ /sring mo ming por bcas pa'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra bzhi la/ /rgyal chen bzhi po rim bzhin dgod/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad po la/ /brgya byin gshin rje klu chen brgyad/ /gnod sbyin rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ /phyogs bzhi dag tu dgod par bya/ /me lha srin po rlung lha dang / /lha chen brgyad rnams mtshams bzhir dgod/ /de bzhin 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ /'byung po dang ni gza' gdon dang / /sa bdag dang ni lha ma yin/ /rim pa bzhin du phyogs bzhir dgod/ /mi 'am ci dang mkha' 'gro ma/ /ma mo'i tshogs dang nam mkha' lding / /rim pa bzhin du mtshams bzhir dgod/ /lto 'phye dang ni rnal 'byor ma/ /klu yi gdon dang 'byung po'i tshogs/ /dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir dgod par bya'o/ /de nas g.yos kyi rnam pa ni/ /rak+ka dang ni bo de tse / /lung thang dang ni lha yi mig /phreng ba za ba rnams la sbyin/ /'bras chang rgun chang la sogs pa/ /zas su sems 'phrog rnams la sbyin/ /'o ma zho dang kha ra ni/ /srog rnams 'phrog la sbyin par bya/ /shing thog rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /'bras bu za ba rnams la sbyin/ /bong rtsi zas sgyugs za la'o/ /bdug pa za ba spos sna tshogs/ /mngar gsum sbyar ba mngal za la'o btsos dang rjen pa sha sna tshogs/ /sha za ba la sbyin par bya'o/ /sbrang rtsi mchil ma 'thung ba la'o/ /khur ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa'o/ /gtor ma za ba rnams la sbyin / /lag pa 2sbyin sreg za ba la'o / /rkang dang rkang mar bcas pa ni/ /rkang za ba la rab tu sbyin/ /'bru ni rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /lo thog za ba rnams la sbyin/ /thang skyes chu skyes me tog rnams/ /me tog za ba rnams la sbyin / /la phug sgog btsang la sogs pa/ /mi gtsang za ba rnams la sbyin/ /28—539

tshil ni rul dang ma rul ba/ /tshil za ba la sbyin par bya/ /bya mo'i sgo nga 'byor thang pa/ /zas su snabs za ba la sbyin/ /sha rul yibs sums song ba rnams/ /rnag za ba la sbyin par bya/ /bya pho las byung 1sgo nga 'di/ /ngar snabs za ba rnams la sbyin/ khrag rnag mang po ji snyed pa/ /zas su khrag 'thung rnams la sbyin/ /sha rnams btsos pa'i zhag rnams ni/ /zas su zhag za rnams la sbyin/ /bu ram shing kun sbyar ba ni/ /btsas pa za ba rnams la sbyin//ga pur gur kum la sogs pas/ /zas su dri za ba la sbyin/ /kun gyis lhag ma bsdus pas ni/ /lhag ma za ba rnams la sbyin/ /chu sna mang po bsdus pa ni/ /stor khung 'thung ba rnams la sbyin/ /sha dang khrag dang sgog btsang rnams/ /bgegs rigs 'khor du gyur la sbyin/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nu yi/ /rgyud kyi gdams nga/sa gtor ma sbyin/ /'di yis nye bar mtshon pa ni/ /kun la mkhas nga/sa shes par bya/ /de la lag pa'i thal mo khong stong du sbyar la/ oṃ swa bhā ba bi shud+dhā / sarba dharma4ཿswa bhā ba bi shuzlolha5haṃ/ zhes pas phreng ba'i dri ma sbyang ngo / /lag pa'i thal mo khong stong du 6sbyar la sor mo rnams rtse sprad de/tshigs zur can rin bo che'i sgrom bu ltar byas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga to 7bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba ta da khaṃ uṅga te sga ra na 8nyi saṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ phreng ba rgya chen por sprul la rnam pa mi 'gyur ba'i bdud rtsi'i zas phun sum tshogs par bsam mo/ /lag pa thal mo sbyar ba phyir bkyed de/ mthe bo gnyis bsnol te kha phye la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis gang mos su bsgyur 7ro/ /lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs nas mdzub mo bsgreng ste/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ saṃ bhā ra saṃ bhā ra hūṃ gis 'dod yon la sogs pa thams 28—5 0

cad longs spyod nus par bsam mo/ /lag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bstan la / g.yon mchod sbyin gyis snod 'debs 1pa'i tshul du byas nas/ oṃ dzñā na a ba lo ki te/ na maḥs man+ta spa ra ṇa rasmi 2bha ba sa ma ya/ ma hā ma ni du ru du ru/ z-i da ya dza la ni hūṃ zhes brjod pas mgron rnams kyis so sor thob cing /tshim par bsam mo/ /lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar la/ sor mo rnams nang bsnol te/ mthe bong gshibs nas brkyang la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ/gra te shwa ri dza la ni sa ma ya swā hā/ zang zing dang chos kyi sbyin pa'o/ /de nyid dbang du bsnyu'o/ /bstod cing phrin las la sbyar ro/ /gtor ma thams cad de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de nas rang las kyi lha mo'i thugs ka'i oṃ gyi 'od kyis gtso 'khor rnams spyan drang bar bya ste/ hūṃ bcom ldan gdugs dkar 'khor bcas rnams/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /mchod yon zhal bsil bzhes nas kyang / /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /na maḥs man+ta budha māṃ / ga ga na pra ba ra saṅka 5ram̐ pad+ma le sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu/ /'byung po gza' gdon sa bdag dang / /lha min mi'am mkha' 'gro ma/ /ma tshogs mkha' lding 'dir gshegs shig /lto 'phye che dang rnal 'byor ma/ /klu yi gdon dang 'byung po'i tshogs/ /spyan 'dren mchod 'bul snyan gsan 'bebs/ /thugs dam rgyud bskul gshegs su gsol / /oṃ e bye 6hi lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gye dam tshig la bstem par bya'o/ /de nas gtso mo ri khrod ma legs ldan 'jig rten pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa la rnam pa lnga dang / 'dod yon lnga lha mo brgyad la sogs pas khyad par mchod la/ rgyud kyi bstod pa bya'o/ /de'i rjes 38—5//

byed byedal gtor ma thams cad kyi phud kyis gtso mo la mchod de/ de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams la tshig 'di rnams kyis sbyin par bya'o/ /hūṃ 'jig rten mes po tshangs pa dang / /de yi btsun mo tshangs ma dang / /tshangs pa'i rgyal mo gtsug phud dang / /dkar mo'i 'od dang mchog 'od dang / /rin chen 'od dang snang ba'i 'od/ /sprin gyi 'od dang kun du 'joms/ /tshangs pa srid pa 'dzin la sogs/ /tshangs pa 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bstod de mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su phreng ba za ba la/ / rak+ka bo de tse 1las ni/ /gzhi blangs pa yi gtor ma ni/ /'jig rten dkon pa'i sman rnams la/ /snying po la sogs sbyar ba 'di/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ /bsngos shing tshim pas dgyes gyur byug /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /tshe srog 'phrog rnams bzlog tu gsol/ /nyes pa thams cad bzlog pa dang / /tshe srog bar chad bzlog 2tu gsol/ /sring mo bzhi dang ming po gsum/ /rnam par rgyal ba mi pham ma/ /gzhan gyis mi thub dril bu ma/ /rgyal bar byed dang sbrang rtsir byed/ /don kun grub dang rgyal byed ma/ /ming sring 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su gcin 'thung zhes bya la/ /'bras chang rgun chang la sogs pa/ /'bru dang bcud du sbyar ba 'di/ /sring mo ming po 'khor bcas kun / /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed 5la phrin las zhu ba ni / /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyis/ /bza' nyes pa dang bri nyes pa/ /sgom nyes pa la sogs pa yi/ /nyes pa ma lus zhi ba dang / /tshe 38—5 2

srog srung 1zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung 4/ /btsun mo rdo rje yangs byed ma/ /dri za pho mo shugs 5chen dang / /ut+pal dang ni tsan+dan sogs/ /zur phud lnga la sogs pa yi/ /dri za'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la//phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su srog 'phrog ces bya la/ /'o ma zho dang kha ra dang / /sman dang bcud sbyar gtor ma 'di/ /dri za 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /dri za'i gdon tshogs bzlog pa dang / /tshe srog bar chod bzlog tu gsol/ /rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ /btsun mo rdo rje 'dul mkhas ma/ /'khor ni grul bum mgul mdzes dang / /mgul nges dang ni ma nges dang / /kun du lha dang mngon shes ldan/ /bum lho can dang 'dod pa mchog /grul bum rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su 'bras bu za ba la/ /shing thog sna tshogs gzhi blangs pa'i/ /'bru dang sman du sbyar ba 'di/ /grul bum 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /grul bum gdon tshogs bzlog pa dang / /tshe srog bar chod bzlog tu gsol/ /rgyal po chen po — mig mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ nub phyogs rgyal po mig mi bzang / /btsun mo rdo rje myos byed ma/ /klu yi rgyal po rnams lung dang //38—bye/3

byedapad+ma chen po rgya mtsho dang / /ma gros 1'od zer rgyal ba dang / /glog chen 'byin dang rin chen 'od/ /sog ma med la sogs pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su sgyugs pa za ba la/ /sbrang rtsi la ni sbyar ba yi/ /rtsi dang bcud du sbyar ba 'di/ /mig mi bzang ni 'khor bcas la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /klu yi gdon tshogs zhi ba dang / /tshe srog bar chod bzlog tu gsol/ /rgyal po chen po /rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /btsun mo rig ma phreng ldan dang / /gnod sbyin 'dzin dga'i ring po dang / /mig mi bzang dang nyi 4seng ge/ /seng ge dal rdob ser skya dang / /gnod spyin rgyal po la sogs pa/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul / /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su bdug pa za ba la /sgos sogs dri dang spos sbyar 'di/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin 'khor bcas la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /gnod sbyin gdon tshogs zhi ba dang / /nad dang sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol/ /brgya byin 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ shar phyogs dbang ldan brgya byen dang / /dri za'i rgyal po tam+bu 5ra/ /yid 'ong yid dag 'od sbyangs dang / /'jam snyan 7dbyangs dang nyi zer dang / /yid 'phrog gtso bo la sogs pa/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul / /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su mngal za zhes bya la//mngar gsum rtsi sman sbyar ba 'di/ /phyogs skyong dri za 'khor bcas la/ /28—5/

bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /dri za'i gdon tshogs bzlog pa dang / /tshe yi bar chod 1bzlog tu gsol/ /gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/gshin rje long ba'i rgyal po dang / /ded dpon rje mo sring 2mo dang / /ma mo dang ni lha ma srin/ /dus mtshan dang ni sha za mo/ /gshin rje'i rigs kyi gdon rnams la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma ni/ /zas su sha za zhes bya la/ /btsos dang sha chen gtor ma 'di/ /gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /gshin rje'i gdon tshogs bzlog pa dang / /pha rol rig sngags bzlog tu gsol/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ klu rgyal dga' bo nye 4dga' bo/ /mtha' yas 'jog po stobs kyi rgyu/ /rigs ldan dung skyong pad+ma dang 5/ /chu lha nor rgyas la sogs la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su mchil ma 'thung ba la/ /bong rtsi bcud du sbyar ba 'di/ /klu yi rgyal po 'khor bcas la / /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /klu gdon thams cad zhi ba dang / /klu dug rig sngags bzlog tu gsol/ /gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ gnod sbyin rgyal po ku be+e 6ra/ /'brog gnas mched lnga gang ba bzang / /nor bu bzang dang lag brgya pa/ /lnga rtsen lnga brtsegs phyis la ser//gnod sbyin rgyal po la sogs pa/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /38—5/pya

——————tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su gtor ma za ba la/ /khur ba sna tshogs bcud dang sbyar/ /spyan gzigs sna tshogs bcas pa 'di1/ /gnod spyin 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /gnod spyin gdon tshogs bzlog pa dang / /rkyen ngan bar chod bzlog 2tu gsol/ /me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ drang srong me lha byin za dang / /gnas/ mchog gnas brtan a ko ta/ /gau 4ta ma thogs pa'i dpal/ /gar ldan dang ni phreng ba can/ /drang srong dpal sbyin la sogs pa/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /bsreg 5bya za ba zhes bya ba/ /'bras kyi lag pan la sogs dang / /'bru dang bcud kyis/ sbyar ba 'di/ /me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba shi/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /drang srong gdon tshos/sa zhi ba dang / /dgra bgegs thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /bden bral 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo 6ba ni/bden bral srin po bum rna dang / /gdong pa bcu la khros pa bzhin/ /mche ba zangs mdog drag po la/ /rab gtams dang ni 'jigs pa ltar/ /srin po drag byed la sogs pa/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis nga/'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su rkang za zhes bya la/ /rkang dang rus pa sna tshogs dang / /khur ba la sogs sbyar ba 'di / /srin po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /srin po'i tshogs rnams bzlog pa dang / /28—5 /6

—tshe srog bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /rlung lha 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/rlung lha bai dur 1ram pa dang / /phreng ba can dang 'jig rten sprin/ /rlung gi lha dang 'jigs 2byed dang / /tshangs chen dang ni kun du mgyogs/ /rlung lha rnam par 'thor byed dang / /rlung phyogs gdon la sogs pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su lo tog za ba la/ /'bras dang nas dang snye ma dang / /gang du 'bru gtsang byas pa 'di/ /rlung lha 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /rlung lha'i gdon tshogs bzlog pa dang / /lo nyes la sogs gdon rnams bzlog /dbang phyug chen mo 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni / dbang phyug ma hā de ba dang / /btsun mo u ma de ba gnyis/ /dga' byed dbang phyug j-iṅgi ri/ /tshogs bdag gzhon nu smin drug dang / /pa tra ba la nādhi 4kar/ /ma hā kā la sha ri sogs/ /de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul / /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su me tog za ba la/ /chu dang thang las byes pa yi/ /me tog rtsi bcud sbyar ba 'di/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /lha yi gdon tshogs zhi ba dang / /rims nad thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /'byung bo'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ 'byung po'i bdag po dbang ldan dang / /log 'dren sna 'dren mdung thung dang / /gshol mda' can dang gtun shing dang / / 'khrug byed snya 5drag yang dag 'gugs/ /'byung po 38—5/7

byed———byed—— ———'khor bcas la so/gas nga/sa/ /de la phyag 'tshal mchod nga/ 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su mi gtsang 1 za ba la/ /'byung po'i kha zas sgog tsong dang / /la phug 'bras la sogs pa la/ /rgyu dang rkyen du sbyar ba 'di / /'byung po 'khor dang bcas/ pa la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed 'a/ phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /'byung po'i gdon tshogs bzlog pa dang / /bgegs kyi bsam ngan bzlog tu gso/la/ /gza'i rgyal ngo/ 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/gza' chen byi tri pa tra dang / /zla ba nyi ma gza' lag can/ /pa ba sangs dang phur bu dang / /spen pa dang ni mig dmar dang / /sgra gcan 'dzin la sogs pa la/ /de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis/ pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su/ tshil za zhes bya la/ /phyi tshil nang tshil la sogs pa/ /bcud dang len du sbyar ba 'di / /gza' gdon 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /gza' yi gdon tshogs bzlog pa dang / /ltas ngan mtshan ngan bzlog tu gsol/ /sa bdag rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ sa bdag rgyal po phag mgo can/ /sa bdag hong 4phan je se dang / /be sna lag chen tsang 5 ku dang / /rtsang kun 'khor dang parta li/ /sa bdag brtan ma 'a/ sogs la/ /phyag 'tshal bsten bkur mchod nga/ 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su snabs za zhes bya la / /bya yi sgo nga la sogs pa'i/ /srid pa'i rgyu dang sbyar ba 'di/ /sa bdag 'khor bcas thams cad la/ /bsngos pas tshim/ zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las 28—— 5 /8

———— —zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /sa bdag gdon tshogs bzlog pa dang / /tshe dang dbang thang spel du gsol/ /lha ma yin gyi rgyal bo 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ lha min rgyal ngo/ thags 1bzangs ris/ /rab gsal dang ni zhi ba'i mchog /thag pa sri dang khra chen po/ /dus kyi 'khor dang dri med po/ /lha min rgyal ngo/ thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su/ rnag za zhes bya la/ /sha sums rul pa pa la sogs pa/ /rgyu dang rkyen du bsags/ pa 'di / /lha min 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi / /lha min gdon tshogs zhi ba dang / /lo skeg zla skeg bdud skeg dang / /khram skeg la sogs bzlog tu gsol/ /mi'am ci'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ mi 4byu'i rgyal po ljon pa dang / /chos ldan chos skyong chos/ bzangs dang / /lha min phung byed la sogs pa/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su ngar snabs za ba la/ /de pho'i ngar sgong sbyar ba dang / /mi ci'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la / /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /gzhan gyi spyor ba ngan pa dang / /bsam ngan thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ mkha' 'gro ma tshogs de bi ra/ /ha pad+ma dang su ka ri/ /bi hi bi dang bi ma ka /be bo ka dang karti ka /ba kar ta dang mu ha ka /mkha' 'gro chen mo thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /28—5/9

byedabyed — ——tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su khrag 'thung zhes bya la/ /khrag sna brgya yi gtor ma 'di/ /mkha' 'go chen mo 'khor bcas la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /mkha' 'go'i gdon tshogs zhi ba dang / /mdangs 'phrog thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bsngo ba ni/ ma mo 'dzin mo dze+e ma 1 ka /rdo rje gzhon nu lu gu rgyud/ /pad+ma'i mig dang rigs gser phreng / /rdo rje shugs ldan brgya ldan ma/ /rdo rje pad+mo'i 4'od phreng ma/ /ma mo'i gdon tshogs thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su zhag za zhes bya la/ /zhag dang bcud du sbyar ba 'di/ /ma mo 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /ma mo'i gdon tshogs zhi ba dang / /srog 'phrog sdug bsngal bzlog tu gsol/ /nam mkha' lding 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po la/ /gser mig can dang yan lag 'du/ /rna bdud dang ni 'jigs par 'gro/ /'dab brgyad dang ni gtsug phud can/ /shugs ldan bzang dang yan lag ldan/ /nam mkha' lding gi 'khor bcas la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul//tshad ma mchis/ nga 'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su btsas pa za ba la/ /bu ram shing kun la sogs pa'i/ /bcud dang bdud rtsi sbyar ba 'di/ /mkha' lding rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ /baspos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /mkha' lding gdon 28 —— pya 50

tshogs bzlog pa dang / /tshe yi bar chad skyab 1tu gsol/ /lto 'phye'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ lto 'phye'i rgyal po chen po ni/ /mgyogs chen dang ni du ba can/ /la ba can dang hu ta ka /shu bar ka sna sna bzang dang / /dpung bzangs dang ni 'jigs chen dang / /lto 'phye'i rgyal po la sogs pa/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su dri za zhes bya la/ /ga pur gur kum sug smel dang / /li shi dzā ti la sogs pa'i/ /dri dang sman du sbyar ba 'di/ /lto 'phye 'khor dang bcas nga/ la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /lho 'phye'i gdon tshogs zhi ba dang / /gdon gyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /srin ngo/ 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ rnal 'byor srin mo nag mo dang / /sbal mig mo dang rta nag mo / /srin mo nag mo gnod sbyin mo/ /be con 4nag mo la sogs la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su lhag ma za ba la/ /kun gyi lhag ma'i tshogs sbyar 'di/ /srin mo 'khor bcas thams cad la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /ma mo srin mo'i gdon tshogs dang / /mi nad phyugs nad bzlog tu gsol/ /klu'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ gaṅgā'i lha dang sin+d+ra'i lha/ /byams ldan lha dang dbyangs can lha/ /zla ba can dang ya mu ta/ /kun gyi lha dang mgyogs chen lha/ /mtsho steng lha la sogs pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul / /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su gtor khung 'bab 538ke 35/

byed—— ——— —— ——— ——————byed——————————sde—— byeda'athung la/ /chu sna brgya rtsa brgyad dang ni/ /bcud dang rtsi ldan sbyar ba 'di/ /chu rlung 1sna tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /chu rlung gnas pa'i bgegs gdon dang / /tshe srog bar chod bzlog tu gsol/ /phyogs bzhi'i bgegs/ chen 'khor dang bcas pa la bsngo ba ni/ shar phyogs khams kyi bdag po dang / /lho phyogs sprin gyi sgron ma dang / /nub phyogs bgegs rgyal rdo rje dang / /byang phyogs pi nā ya ka la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /tshad ma mchis pa'i gtor ma 'di/ /zas su mi gtsang za ba la/ /khrag dang sha sna sbyar ba 'di4/ /bgegs chen bzhi po 'khor bcas la/ /bsngos pas tshim zhing dgyes gyur cig /khyed la phrin las zhu ba ni/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /phyogs bzhi'i bshegs tshogs zhi ba dang / /bsam spyor ngan pa bzlog tu gsal / /'byung po ma lus khyed rnams kun / /so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di/ /rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas su / /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang / /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang / /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas lhan cig tu/ /gtor ma me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang / /bdag gi las 'di'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /ces brjod nga/ra bya'o/ /de nas bh+yo 'bag bzhi byas pa'i mdun du bskor bzhi drangs la/ de bh+yo sngags kyis bsngags te phyogs bzhir bskyal — lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas la mchod pa dang / rgyud kyi bstod pa la sogs nga/sa bstod nas bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas kyis me tog thogs la/38—552

rgyal mtshan nam/ sku dang dkyil 'khor bcas pa la yang stod pa byed cing bskor ba bya/ nad gdon zhi ba'i gsol ba gdab/ bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa basbu/ gtor ma gnod byed kyi phyogs su btang la/ bkra shis brjod par bya'o/ /de ni mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dang / byad ka dang / phur ka dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs la sogs pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /char chu yang dus su 'bab pa dang / rtsi bcud dang / lo tog la sogs pa'i 'bru thams cad rgyas pa dang / mi phyugs thams cad 'phel ba dang / mchog tu dge bar 'gyur ro/ /tsan+d+ra go mis 'phags pa yi/ /rjes gnang dngos su/ thob gyur nas/ /gtor chog bshad rgyud la brten brtsams/ /dge des 'gro kun bde thob shog /'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can gyi gtor ma'i cho ga /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad nga/ rdzogs so// //tho ling gi gtsug lag khang du dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o / / //38 —byebye3

༄7/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas drung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa jes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ta thā ga toṭ+wā ṣa si tā ta pa tre nā ma a pa rā dzi ta dhā ra ṇi sā dha na ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs/ nga/'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma rdophyir bzlog pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tsha'/ lo// /mthong dang ma mthong la sgrol caba'i/ /gdugs dkar yum la phyag 'tshal te/ /bdag gzhan don de thob bya'i phyir/ /lo 'dab tsam byug 5gas/la bar bya/ /de la ‘ 'phags pa gdugs/ dkar mo can bsgrub par 'dod nga/'i rna'/ 'byor nga/sa/ gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par dang ngo/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod nga/ bshams la shā khrus bya ste/ lus la dris byugs nas gos gtsang ma bgos te/ stan bde ba la gnas par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po bsams te/ de las 'od 'phros pas phyogs 28———pya 56

—bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang 1 'phags pa gdugs dkar mo can dmigs te/ phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa rim pa bzhin du 2bya'o/ /de nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms te stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar stong pa nyid las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po bsams te/ de nyid las 'od zer 4phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'gro ba'i don byas te5/ tshur 'dus pa las gdugs dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan par gyur te/de las 'od zer lha mo'i sgu dang bcas pa 'phros ‘pas 'jig rten thams cad du nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las dgrol 7te tshur 'dus pas 'phags pa gdugs dkar mo can sgu mdog dkar mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/phyag dang po gnyis kyis / gdugs dkar po 'dzin pa/ sprul pa'i dbu stong phyag stong mnga' ba/ spyan bye ba phrag brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu la mi phyed rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad pa / bdag dang gzhan 'jigs pa thams cad las skyob pa/ phyag rgya'i tshogs kyis kun nas yongs su bskor te gnas par bsams te / mchod pa'i tshogs rnams byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar rja ཿlas ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang sems kyi 'byor pa'i ྾rgyan dang ldan par bsgoms pa'i nang du seng ge snye la sogs pa'i gdan rnams bskyed pa rka la/spyan drang ba spyoni snying ga'i oṃ gyi 'od kyis 2 bsgul te dmigs pa rnams mchod yon gyis bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o / /de yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags pa gdugs dkar mo can 2 phyag rgya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / sprul pa'i tshogs rnams gsal bar dmigs te/ gzhung las 38—5bye7

— byung 1ba'i phyag rgya dang bstod pa sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod do/ /de nas gsol ba btab 2ste bzlas pa ni bdag dang ye shes kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzlas pa'i yi ge mu tig gi rdog po lta bur bsams te/ spro ba dang bsdu ba'i spyor 4bas bzlas pa'i skyon spangs te bzlas pa 5bya'o/ /de yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal bar dmigs shing sems can gyi don dran pas bzlas pa snye bya'o/ /de nas 8ngal lam gtong bar 'dod na bzlas pa yid kyis 'phags pa gdugs dkar mo can la phul te/ bdag las kyi lha mos 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang bstod pa bya ste / bzod par gsol zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba / bsngos nas gshegs su gsol lo//de nas lus bsrung bar bya ste ldang bar bya'o/ /langs nas kyang mdo sde zab mo bklag pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /rtag tu 'phags pa gdugs dkar mo dran par bya'o / /phyag 'tshal bar dmigs shing 'byung po'i kha zas spangs te bsgrub par bya'o / /srung rka ba dang / 'khrul 'khor dang / bzlog pa dang / sbyin sreg dang / bgegs bzlog cing gzir ba dang / dmag dpung gzhom pa dang /dngos grub bsgrub pa dang / ser ba srung ba dang / sri'u gso ba dang /gtor ma btang ba dang / mdze nad gso ba dang / 7'jigs pa skyob rta pa kun dang po'i phan yon las 'byung ba ltar thams cad bya'o/ /bdag 'dra sablo dman so so'i 6skye bo yis/ /'phags ma mchog 7 la chu yi thigs tsam bstod/ /'di las skyes 1 pa'i bsod nams gang byung bas/ /bdag dang sems can kun gyis mchog thob shog /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa zhes 38 —558
