1784ra༅/ /'khrul 'khor/dzo ༄go/ /bdag nyid bsnyen pa thob pas 'khrul 'khor 'ching bar 'dod na / dur khrod kyi ras la khrag dang dug dang lan tshwa dang ske tshe la sogs pa'i khu bas 'khor lo mu khyud gnyis la bskor ba bris te/ nang ma'i lta ba la bsgrub bya'i ming sa bon gyi ye ge bris pa'i phyi rol du/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ nas hūṃ bye ban+ta'i bar du bris pa'am mthar che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa ces bri'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa la thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags mā ra ya dang bcas par dgod do/ /de nas grog mkhar gye sa dang / ba lang gi gci ba dang / dgra'i rkang rjes kyi sa/ bgegs kyi chu phar 'gram gyi sa las 4gzugs brnyan byas te/ de'i snying gar 'khrul 'khor bcug ste dong gru gsum du gzhug go/ /de nas bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bya5/ 'khor lo bsgrub byar bsams pa'i rten la phyag rgya'i tshogs la sogs pa kun bkug cing bcug par byas 6la/ tshangs pa dang dbang po 38—564

1785༄༅/ /bzlog pa'i thabs 1༄7/ /dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang pha rol gyi dmag nabazlog pa ni bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor du byas te/ phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas par bsgoms nas / mdun du 'chi bdag gnas par bsgoms te/ phyag rgya'i tshogs kyis de la bsnun pa'i spyor ba bya ste/ tshur 'dus pas bdag ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus la phan gdags 1par bsams te/ thams cad 'joms pa bzlas par bya'o/ /ngag bzlog pa ni grog mkhar gyi sa dang / ba lang gi gci 4ba la bsgrub bya'i ming gzugs byas la/ de'i snying gar sngar gyi 'khrul 'khor bris pa'i mthar/che ge mo mā ra ya ban+dha ya nan bya ba bcug ste bkod nas bcug nas/ gzugs kyi khar thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i yungs kar dang phur bus btab ste/ de nas mchod rten rnying pa'am/ lha khang gi jem pa'am lam rgya gram du bzlog5 /bsgrub bya'i yul gyi phyogs su tsha tsha'i 'og tu'am/ yang 38—566

178( ༄7/ /bgegs bzlog cing gzir ba'i thabs 1༄go/ /bgegs bzlog cing gzir ba ni bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor du byas te/ grog mkhar gyi sa dang / dur khrod kyi thal ba dang / chu phar 'gram tshur 'gram gyi sa las bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan byas te/ 'khrul 'khor snga ma ltar bris pa'i mthar che ge mo'i 'byung po mā ra ya nan bya ba bkod de/de'i snying gar bcug nas de la bdag gi thugs las phyag rgya'i tshogs spros pas bsgrub par bya ba'i 3 rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i rnga mo la bskyon te/bkug ste gzugs brnyan la bcug ste/ bcings nas la chas dril te gres 4mas dkres la/ thod nga/'am kham phor kha sbyar sar pa ru bcug ste/ tshangs pa dang /dbang po dang / legs ldan drag po la sogs pa la gtor ma byin nas 'byung po 'di dag gi dbang du gyis shig ces bsgo la/ lha khang gi them pa'am/ lam rgya gram mam/ mchod rten rnying pa'i 'og dong gru gsum du bcug la/ bye ma'am 28——568

༄ga /dmag da6nga gadzam pa'i thabs/3 ༄4/ /pha rol gyi dmag dpung gzhom par 'dod na/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas 'khrul 'khor mu khyud gnyis pa snga ma ltar ram/ras dmar po lta bu la bris pa'i mthar che ge mo'i tshogs dang / de dag gi srung ma'i ming gi mthar ban+dha ya nan bya ba bris nas phyag rgya'i tshogs kyis de'i srung 2ma dang / dmag dpung rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis bkug nas bsnyims te/bcings nas 'thab mtshams su snga ma ltar gnan 4par bya'o/ /yang na pha rol kyi dmag 'ong ba la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis 5mi thub pa'i gzungs rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te rim gro dang mchod pa bya ste/ grong khyer thams cad kyi sgo'am/ grong ngam/grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i gnas su gzugs so/ /yang na rin po che'i byang bu'am/ gro ga'am/ shog bu la gzungs 'di bris te/ lhar bskyed 38—571

—cing sbyan drang ba 1 dang / mchod pa chen po byas nas bskor bar byas3/tshangs pa dang dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa la gtang ngo / /che ge mo'i dmag dpung choms shig pa zhes —pas kyang bskul te/ de ltar gzungs du mar bris te/ spyi gtsug tu gdags pa dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te/ dmag dpung gi mdun du bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor du bya ste/nga rgyal dang ldan pa phyag rgya'i tshogs dang / tshangs pa dang dbang po la sogs pas bskor te/ gnas par bsams 5shing phyar te 'gro bar bya'o/ /rtag tu mchod cing gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /des ni pha rol gyi dmag tshogs rnams zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dmag dpung gzhom pa'i thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/571 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te brkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra srung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatags/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamanan/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/572 1〈〈snar 〉〉drangs pa/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staXr ba bya/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagator ma btang / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉ces / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasam//38—572

1788༄ga /dngos grub grub pa'i thabs/ ri 1༄4/ /dngos grub bsgrub par 'dod na/ gnas yid dang mthun zhing bkra shis par gro ga'am ras la gzungs 'di bris te/ gdugs kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags pa'am/ yang na rin po che'i sgrom du bcug ste/maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bzhag nas sam dngos grub kyi rten pa dmar ser gyi zho'am/mar khu'am yang na chang ngam/ zan la sogs pa bzhag nas lha'i rnal 'byor byas te gsol ba btab la/ tshangs pa dang dbang po la sogs pa la gtor ma sbyin te/yang gsol ba btab nas dngos grub gsol bar dmigs te bsgom zhing bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas nam zhig na du ba dang / dro ba dang / 'bar ba kun byung nas 'thungs sam/ zos na tshe ring ba dang / dbang che ba dang /rigs rgyas pa dang / nam mkhar 'gro ba la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na bu 'dod pa gang la las gzungs 'di bris te/ gdugs sam rgyal 28—574

1789༄༅/ /'jogs pa las skyob pa'i thabs 1༄go/ /yang 'jigs pa las sgrol bar 'dod pas/ gzungs 'di bris te gdugs sam rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags la grong ngam grong khyer ram skyes pa'am/ bud med kyis/ ri mchod nga/ dang / bskor ba bya ste/ gsol ba btab nas tshangs pa la sogs pa la mchod pa dang gtor ma byin te/ gzungs 'di brgya'am stong du bzlas brjod bya ba dang / bris te lus sam mgul du btags / nas rtag tu 'phags ma 4 gdugs dkar mo can yid la byed pa dang gsol ba 'debs shing bzlas brjod byas na rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs pa la so/gas nga dang / lha'i gdon la sogs pa dang / mdangs za ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs nga/ dang / gdon thams cad kyis byas pa la sogs pa dang / nad dang rlung dang mdzas nga/ la sogs pa dang / gcan gzan sbrang bu tre ma la so/gas pa 'a/sa grol ba dang / rims/ nad thams cad grol bar 'gyur ro/ /38——— 576

1790༄༅/ /ser ba srung ba'i thabs/1༄tsho/ /ser ba srung bar 2'dod pas/ 'khrul 'khor snga ma ltar brgyad byas te/ tha mar ser ba'i 'byung po mā ra ya ban+dha ya nan/ bya ba bkod nas bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor byas nas/ phyag rgya'i tshogs kyis bkug bcings nas/ kham phor ram thod par bcug nas/ bsrung bar bya ba'i yul gyi phyogs mtshams bzhir dong gru gsum du4snga ma ltar mnan te/ tsha tsha btabs nas mchod rten brgyad byas te/5 de gzungs 'di bris te mchod cing bskor 6ba byas nas gzhag pa dang / yungs kar la sngags 'bum la sogs pa bzlas te gzhag nga/ dang / gzhan du yang bskor 7ba dang tshangs pa la sogs pa la gtor ma byin te/ gsol ba gdab pa dang / snang srid kyi lha 'dre dang / bar snang gi lha dang / gnod sbyin kun dang / yul de'i lha dang klu la sogs pa la mchod pa dang gtor mas 8tshim par byas nas gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas gzungs la 38—pya78

1791༄༅/ /nad gdug pa can gso ba'i thabs/ shā༄7/ /mdze la sogs nga/ sa bdag gi nad gso ba ni/ dang po lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par byas la/ bsgrub bya 'phags pa gdugs dkar mo'i spyan sngar sems babyed pa dang / skyabs su 'gro ba bya ste/ gzungs bris nas gdugs sam rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te/ mchod bstod bya zhing mdun du gdugs dkar mo can phyag rgya'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsams te/ rtag tu khrus bya zhing bzlas brjod bya ba dang / thun mtshams su tshangs pa la sogs pa la gtor ma byen la gsol ba gdab pa dang / gnod par byed pa la yang gtor ma byin te gso'/ ba gdab par bya ba dang / gdugs dkar mo'i srung nab gdags shing tha mar thams cad 'joms pas bskrad byung gzir ba dang / kun sngar bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /de lta bu'i gang zag la ni dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad du 'byung po dang / ro langs dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang /38——580

rims dang / shu ba dang / g.yan pa dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / mdze dang / phol mig dang / g.yan —1pa la sogs pa gzhung gi phan yon de yang sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ma gtogs so/ /rkyen las gyur pa thams cad la/phan yon ji ltar bshad pa bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nad gdug pa can gso ba'i thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/580 41mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wal/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasung /581 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉smonos/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1718)38wa 581

༄4/ /gtor ma gtang 2bar 'dod pas/ snod gtsang zhing mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba'i nang du zan dang / khur ba dang / chan dang /'bru'i tshogs dang / shing thog dang / rin po che'i tshogs dang / sman dang ldan par bya ste/ de nas bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor pas a kā ros sbyangs te/nam mkha' mdzod kyis spel la/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsams te/ de'i phyogs rnams su dīḥlas pad+ma'i tshogs bskyed pa la phyogs skyong ba bcu la sogs pa chos kyi srung 4ma dang / khyad par du tshangs pa dang / dbang po dang legs ldan la sogs 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drang bar bya'o/ /yang 'byung po'i gtor ma gnyis pa la lha'i gdon la sogs pa dang / zas su mdangs za ba kun la sbyin par bya'o/ /de yang lce rdo rjer bsam zhing / sbu gus bdud rtsi thams cad ngoms shing tshim par bya ba dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga char bzhin du 5'byung 28—kye82

༄rgya/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ta thā ga tobyā ṣa si tā ta pa tre nā ma dhā 2ra ni bi bye nā ma / bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/'phags ma 4gdugs dkar mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor nus pa chung gyur zhing / /bsnyus pa la mos sems can la/ /tsaṇ+ḍa 5bdag gis legs basbus te/ /gzungs kyi cho ga dgod par bya/ /dang por sngags pa dam tshig ldan//byang chub sems ldan rab sbyangs te/ /cho ga bsnyus rgyas mkhas pa yis/ /maṇ+ḍal chag chag btab steng du‘/ /dri yi byug pa legs bsgos te/ /dang por dbus su pad+ma ni/ /'dab brgyad ge sar bcas pa bri/ /de yi phyir ni bcu drug pa / /bris te sgo ni gcig pa bya/ /de dbus rin chen khri steng du7/ /bum pa mtshan nyid ldan pa gzhag /rgyan dang dri yi sa chus gang bya'o/ /de nas mchod 38—584

dang gtor ma bsham/ /dang po byang chub sems bskyed la/ /bdun po rnam par dag pa yi/ /sngon 'gros lha mo bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas bzlas dang gtor ma dang / /mchod dang bstod pa la sogs bya/ /bum pa mi dmigs je 1las ni/ /rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang / /dkyil 'khor cho ga nas gsungs pa/ /rim pas babyed pa rdzogs par bya/ /byin brlabs ye shes spyan drang dang 2/ /de rjes mchod pas mchod par bya/ /bstod dang gsol gdab bzlas pa bya/ /phar 'phros 'od kyis lha mchod la/ /tshur 'dus bdag gi sdig pa dag /ngo bo chu la rnam pa lnga/ /yang na bzlog pa'i rnam par bya/ /de nas legs ldan chen po la/ /gtor ma rgyas par byin nas ni/ /slob ma khrus byas stan la 'dug /thun mong khyad par sdom pa kun/ /phog la lha la mchod bstod bya/ /de nas thams cad 'joms pa yi/ /sngags kyis slob ma bsrung bskrad la/ /de nas bum pa'i chu yis ni/ /slob ma'i mgo nas blugs pa dang / /bkra shis tshigs bcad brjod par bya/ /sdig sgrib dag ste rang gi ni / /rigs kyis dbu la brgyan par bya/ /de nas me tog mchod nga/ dang / /dbu rgyan la sogs byas de nas/ /rang gi 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ /bla ma la ni yon phul la/ /rang gi dam tshig brjod par bya/ /bla mas dkyil 'khor la srung ba'i/ /dam tshig rgyas par bsgrags nas ni/ /byur bsal la sogs rdzogs par bya/ /de nas srung 4ba'i 'khor lo yang / /cho ga ltar bris bsngags 5par bya/ /mdor bsdus maṇ+ḍal 'dab brgyad pa/ /byas te gong ltar cho ga bya/ /shin tu bsdus la bum par ni/ /lha mo nyid sgu rdzogs par ni/ /byas te smon lam la sogs bya/ /de nas khrus sogs rgyas par bya/ /des ni phyi nang gnod 38—bye8pya

thug /rims bsrung ba'i cho ga1sngal/ /lha mo gdugs dkar mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor pas 2rims bsrung bar 'dod na/ dang po mchod pa dang gtor mas rims kyi 'byung po tshim par byas te/ bden pa'i stobs kyis brjod pa dang gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas gdugs dkar mo'i gzungs bris te/ bsgrub par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su de gdugs sam rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags te / mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams te / rang nyid lha'i rnal 'byor du byas te/ thun bzhir bsgom 4bzlas bya'o/ /de yang nyin mtshan dus drug tu gdugs dkar mo 'khor dang bcas pa la gsol ba gdab pa dang / mchod bstod dang bskor ba byas te/ bum pa'i chus bkru zhing / bsrung ba yang gdags par bya'o/ /dpal tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / mgon po la yang gtor ma byin te gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas bsgrub 38—587

༄༄/ /gor srung ba'i cho ga1sngal/ /lha mo gdugs dkar mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyugs nad srung 2bar 'dod pas/ dang por gor gyi 'byung po la mchod pa dang gtor mas tshim par byas te/ de nas bsgrub bya rnams la thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad byung gzir ba dang / srung ba'i 'khor lo btags te khrus bya ba dang / 'phags pa gdugs dkar mo can sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ mthar mchod bstod byas te/ gor zhi ba'i gsol ba gdab pa dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa mchod pa dang gtor mas tshim par byas te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de yang bar skabs su gdugs dkar mo dang srung ma'i tshogs la gsol ba gdab cing / snyim pa sbyar te bsrung bar bya'o/ /khyad par du gor gyi 'byung po la 'byung gtor gyis mnyes par bya'o/ /de ltar thun bzhi'i sbyor bas rtag tu bsgoms pas mthar phyin pa dang / 'jig rten pa dang 38—589

sngal/ /rnal 'byor pa zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ dang por sa gzhi shin tu kha dog dkar ba dag pa la thab khung zlum po rgyar khru gang zabs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer sor bzhi pa dang ldan par bya ste/ de la dri dkar pos byug pa dang / me tog dkar po gtor bar bya'o/ /de yang dbus su pad+ma'i steng du rdo rjes mtshan pa bris te/ kha khyer yang rdo rjes bskor bar bya'o//de nas thab khung du 2bud shing brtsig pa dang / mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams te/ zhi ba'i rdzas til dang / mar dang / ku sha dang / drur 4ba dang / nas dang / gro dang / dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs pa bsags te/ rang nyid khrus byas te/ gos gtsang ma bgos nas/ stan bde ba la pad+ma'i 'dug stangs sam/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis kha shar du bltas te gnas par bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid sgrub thabs las 'byung ba ltar lha'i rnal 38—59/

'byor byas te/ de nas ma hā shu n+ya dza 1tā dzñā nas/ thab dang rdzas rnams stong par byas te/ ram̐ las thab khung 'bar ba'i gzhal yas/ khang du bsams te/de'i dbus su seng ke nyi ma pad+ma'i steng du/ sngar bzhin du cho ga'i yan 'a/ga gsum gyis gdugs/ dkar mo can 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa bsang zhing byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun du ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs te/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ sreg rdzas rnams gdugs dkar mo'i snying pos bsreg par bya'o/ /rjas de rnams re re yang bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig tu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /mthar yang mchod nga/sa mnyes shing tshim par byas nas bzod par gsol te dge rtsar bsngos nas ye shes/ kyi lha gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /de lta bu'i zhi ba'i cho ga yang nad dang gdon la sogs pa zhi bar gyur pa de srid kyi bar du bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du bya'o/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi'i gling pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /lha mo gdugs dkar mo'i mngon spyod kyi cho ga byed par 'dod pas / nad dang gdon la sogs pa dang por sa gzhi yang gdub 4cing gas pa dang / rtsub pa la thab khung zur gsum ngos re la khru re yod pa la zabs su khru phyed pa bya ste/ dbus/ su 'khor lo la rdo rjes mtshan pa/ kha yang rdo rjes bskor ba/ sa gzhi yang dug dang khrag la sogs pa nag por byugs te/ me tog nag po dang 'bru nag pos gtor ro/ /de nas drag po'i mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ drag po'i rdzas khrag dang dug dang liṅga dang / ske tshe 38ke592

dang / rdo phye lcags phye/ zi ra bra'o nag po/ sran ma nag po/ de lta/ra rdzas bshams nas/ bdag nyid lha'i rna'/ 'byor byas 'a/ thab dang rdzas rnams/ stong par bsams te/ dze+e las thab khung gru gsum pa bskyed pa'i nang du/ cho ga gsum gyis gdugs dkar mo 'khor dang bcas nga/ drag ngo/'i lhar bskyed nga/ra bya'o/ /de'i mdun gyi nam mkha' 'a/ ye shes sems dpa' /'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol nas mchod nga/ dang bstod pa byas te/ sreg rdzas rnams yum gyi sngags kyi tha mar mā ra ya btags te/ khrag dang dug la sogs pas lan bdun nam 1nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du dbung/ bar bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la bzod par gsol ba la sogs pa 4rnams bya'o/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' gshegs pa dang / dam tshig sems dpa' basbus/ nas rang nyid la bsrung bar bya'o/ /de lta bu de yang gang zhig tshar ma chod kyi bar du lan bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du bya'o/ /mngon spyod kyi las slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //༄7/ /de bzhin du sa gzhi ser po la rdzas rnams yang las dang mthun pa 5bsags la/ thab khung gru bzhi par rgyas nga/'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de bzhin du sa gzhi dmar po la sogs par las dang mthun par rdzas bsags te/ thab khung zla gam byas te/ dbang gi sbyin sreg bya'o/ /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi'i man ngag go/ /sbyin sreg sdogs so// //38—593

༄༅/ /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i sgo nas sri'u gso ba/mi1 ༄go/ /dngos grub bsgrub 2pa'i sgo nas sri'u gso ba ni/ bud med bu 'dod pa gang dag la la gzungs 'di bris te/ gdugs sam rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags nas rang nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas de la mchod pa dang bskor 1ba bya zhing / tshangs pa dang dbang po la sogs pa la gtor ma dang mchod pa byas te gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na bu rnyed par 'gyur ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams dang stobs la sogs pa yang rnyed par 'gyur ro//dngos grub bsgrub 4pa'i sgo nas sri'u gso ba slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdogs so// //38byed595

bsdur mchan/595 51 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesgor/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrub/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1724)38wa 596

1798sngag /bzlog pa'i zor bya ba'i cho ga me༄go/ /rnal 'byor pas bzlog pa'i zor bya bar 'dod na/ dang por rdzas bsags pa ni/ kham sa'i 3mi mo'i gzugs bzhi'am brgyad dam bcu bya'o / /de nas sgo nga dang / mda' 'ug pa ma skyer pa ma mde'u can bzhi dang / khrag phor bzhir dug dang zor gyi sna du ma blugs pa'i snod bzhi dang /dmar gtor cha bzhi dang / mchod pa rnam pa lnga bsham mo/ /de rnams kyang grangs 'byor na bcu bcu/ ma 'byor na brgyad dam bzhi bsag pa ni/ de nas sngags mkhan bcu 'am brgyad dam bzhi'am mtha' 4mar rang gcig pus lus la khrag dang sol bas byugs te/ gos nag po bgos nas khros pa'i yid kyis gnas te/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor du byas te/ thun drug gam thun bzhir thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i sngags ring 5dang / 'byung po tshar gcod pa'i yungs kar dang / 'tshe 6la sngags te/ de rnams la gzer nas bar bar 38—597

du nad gdon thams cad la byo zhes bya bas gdab bo/ /de yang gdugs dkar mo can la thun bzhi'am/ drug tu mchod bstod byas te byo ba dang / bzlog par gsol ba gdab pa dang lha ma srin sde brgyad dang yul lhas sna gsol ba gdab par bsam mo/ /de ltar thun bzhi'am drug tu sngags 2pa de tshes grangs dang gza' skar brtsis te/ dus la bab pa na skyes bu sngags dang ldan pa'am/ cho ga dang ldan pas zor lam phye bar zor bskyal te/ de lta bu yang rang ngam gzhan shin tu nyan —che na/ nar mar byas pas dus ma yin par 'chi ba brgyad/ dgra dang bgegs bzlog par nges te/ byol sngags bzlas kyang 'gal ba rnged do/ /bzlog pa'i zor bya ba'i cho ga slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/597 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i rdzogs byang las blangs te bkod/ 2sna〈〈pe 〉skabam pa'i/ 〈〈snar 〉skabams pa'i—/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tha/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdengs / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zas/598 —1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra 'i/ 2—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasnga gas/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)na/38—598

1799༄ga /mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsi t+ya 2 sā dha na bi bye kra ma nā ma/ bod skad du / mchod rten sgrub pa'i cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thun mtshams las dang dang po yi/ /gang zag dag ni sgrub pa yi/ /mchod rten cho ga mdor bsdus pa/ /bla ma dam pa'i gdams pas dgod/ dang po gnas khang byi dor byas/ /mchod pa la sogs bshams de nas/ /rang gi lha yi bskyed rim sgom4/ /de nas bden pa'i tshig 'di yis/ /sa yi 5bdag bos sa blang bya/ /bdag ni gzhan don bsgrub pa la/ /lha mos mchod rten sa slang gis/ /dgyes pas bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zhes byas 6brkos te 'dag pa la/ /'od kyis sbyangs te rin chen bsam / /de nas 'bi 'bi legs byas te/ /mar gyis bskus 7la skol 8 phor stsal / /legs bton lha mo rang du bsam/ /de la mchod dang gsol ba gdab/ /38—600

de rnams 1thams cad bsgrub pa'i sngags/ /rtsa ba'i sngags nyid kho nas bya/ /de nas na bza' legs gsol la/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor la sogs kun/ /bstems te mchod bstod legs bya ste/ /rten 'brel sngags kyis brtan par bya/ /de nas mchod la gsol ba gdab/ /yon bdag la sogs smon lam gdab/ /de nas dge 'dun mchod ston bya/ /'byung ba chu rlung nam mkha' dang / /yid kyi bsgrub pa la sogs kun/ /bla ma'i gdams pa ldan pas gdab/ /de ltar mchod rten 2cho ga ni/ /mdor basbus pa yi cho ga las/ /grub pas sems can ma lus pa/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal thob nas ni/ /rim gyis gtsug tor lha mo yi/ /zhal rdzogs par ni mthong bar shog /mchod rten bsgrub pa'i cho ga'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i 4'gyur ro// //38—601

༄ / /gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ uṭī ṣa si tā ta pa tre ho ma be+e byeḥsnye /bod skad du/ gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi 4sbyin sreg gi cho ga /gdugs dkar mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan don mthar phyin lha mo ni/ /gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal te/ /lha rnams mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ /sbyin sreg gis ni tshim par bya/ /dri zhim po'i chus legs par khrus byas nas gos gsar 5pa bgos te/ rgyan khyad par can btags la bgegs srung 6ba dang / srung 7ba'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas rgyud dag par bya ste/ phyag dang mchod pa la sogs rgyud dag par bya'o/ /brtsam du rung ba'i sa phyogs su phrin las dang sbyar te/ thab dang rdzas la sogs pa rdzogs par byas la/ shing gang yin pa btser te/ mchod pa dang sreg 9rdzas tshogs pa dang / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la re zhes pas me sbar la de nas stong pa 38—603

—tshad med par bsgoms te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la sarba dharma 1badz+ra sarba dharma si te hūṃ zhes pa'i sgras stong par bsgom mo/ /de'i ngang las 'byung ba ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du rgyu 2las me thab gzhal yas khang lta bu'o/ /der a dang zla ba la sa bon gyi yi ge las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa ldan pa 'phros shing 'dus pa las gre lha dkar po rgyan kun rdzogs pa/ phyag bzhi pa ag tshom 4ser la 'khyil ba/gsus pa che la 'od 'bar ba gzi brjid can/ g.yas rdo rje dang bgrang phreng bsnams pa/ g.yon gnyis skyabs sbyin dang / gudhe 6bsnams pa'o/ /thugs ka na ram̐ dmar po gru gsum gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de nas de nyid dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ tshur byon 7tshur gshegs 'byung ba che/ /lha yi rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'bar ba'i nang du gshegs su gsol/ /e bye /asna ye ma hā rā dza ga dzaḥ9/ t+t+waṃ 'byung ba chen po me yi lha/ /lha rgyal drang srong bde ba'i mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /de nas yon chab kyis spyan drangs la/ bsang gtor byin te dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas mchod nga/ dang phyag gis mchod de/ mar gyi dgang blugs phul te/tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyur rkapa'i/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /sku bcas sku ni dpal dang ldan/ /rngam brjid rgyan ldan las la dbang / /sreg 1 blugs/ phul bas/ las rnams sgrub / /zhi la sogs pa'i lha dpal te/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i las sgrub pa/ /gzi brjid rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bsang gtor phul la/ agha ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya/ a ti pya sati pya/sarba pā paṃ shāṅgi ku ru zhes pa'am/ oṃ badz+ra agha ye swā hā/ yam shing 'od la'o/ /38—60/

oṃ agha ya 1swā hā/ mar zhal du'o/ /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ til dang yungs kar phyag tu'o/ /sarba saṃ pa de zho dang 'bras chan phyag tu'o/ /a pra ti ha ta badzā ya/ ku sha gtsug tu'o/ /badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ drur 2ba gtsug tor du'o/ /ma hā be+e gā ya/ nas zhal du'o/ /ma hā ghasma re/ gro zhal du'o/ /ma hā ba la/sran ma zhal du'o/ /ma hā puṣ+ṭa ye/ 'bras so ba zhal du'o/ /ma hā shra ya a ma po ti/ zhes bya bas/ dz+dza ti pa 4la dang / tarka 5dang / bil ba rnams zhal du6/ rdzas thams cad me lha'i sngags kyis bsreg par bya'o/ /u dusmra 7ra la sogs ming dang thog ma tha mar brgyan te bsreg par bya'o/ /dri dang / me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang mchod yon rnams ni so sor dbul bar bya'o / /oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la ya sarba bhasmi ku ru sarba dubye ma ma hūṃ phaṭa shārnyi 9ku ru swā hā/ me lha gzi brjid skyed pa'i dgang blugs phul ba/mchod pa dang bstod pa bya'o/ /de nas me lha'i thugs kar dkyil 'khor pa'am lha rnams dkar po la sogs par bskyed pa las 'od zer 'phros pa las ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung dang / rdo rje'i gdung dang / pad+ma'i gdung dang / glang po'i gdung dang / gzhon nu'i gdung dang / klu'i gdung dang / 'dus pa'i gdung dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa dang / rgyal ba'i rdo rje gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ /gtum chen stobs chen 'bar ba mo/ /bgegs tshogs 'joms ma gshegs su gsol/ /bsang gtor phul te mchod yon gyis spyan drangs la sngags dang phyag rgyas brtan par bya'o / /de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa 'byung ba'i rim pa brjod par bya'o/ /de nas gong ma bzhin du dgang blugs dang sreg blugs dbul lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā 38—605

ga tostso 1ṣa se tā ta pa tre hūṃ/ a mu shaṃ shābye ku ru swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swā hā/ zhes snying po'am nye ba'i snying po'am/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te ustso ṣā ya shud+dhi bi ra tsi 4bi ma ye 5swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags sam/ rdzas so so'i sngags rnams kyi khyad par gyis dkyil 'khor pa'am/ lha rnams tshim par bya ste/ sdig pa sreg pa'i sngags kyis bsreg par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la smon lam gdab bo/ /bdag gis bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo can phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa ji ltar tshogs pa'i mchod pa dang / sbyin sreg rnams kyis mchod pas/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dang / sems can thams cad sgrib pa gnyis byang nas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs te/ tshe 6'di nyid du bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po thob par gyur cig ces gsol ba btab la/ gdugs dkar mo can phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ phrin las su gsol ba ni/ bdag dang yon gyi bdag po rnams la nad kyi rigs su gyur pa rlung dang mkhris pa dang bad kan dang 'dus pa las gyur pa thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig /gdon gyi rigs su gyur pa gdon stong phrag brgyad cu las thar bar mdzod cig /'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ bzod par gsol ba ni/ bdag snyigs ma lnga'i dus kyi sems can du gyur pas yo byad ma tshogs pa dang / bdag las dang po par gyur pas sems la dbang ma thob ste/byeng ba dang rgod pa'i dbang gis mi gsal ba dang / cho ga nyams te lhag chad du gyur pa thams cad bzod pa chen po mdzad du gsol lo/ /de nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo gshegs te/ rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol7/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /gtan du gshegs pa ma lags pas/ /slar yang 38—606

'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /muḥgats+tsha zhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /mjug tu me lha mchod pa dang / las bsgrub pa'i sbyin sreg bya ste/ bstod pa ni/'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog gyur pa/ /ye shes mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg2 /'dzin byed me lha nyid la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gzi brjid ldan pa rnge yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad stsol mdzad pa/ /bdag gzhan don sgrub rdos la bzhugs/ /tshangs pa'i sras la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /de nas ye shes kyi me lha gshegs te/bskyed pa me 'bar ba la bltas te/ oṃ ma ma hūṃ ni sarba da ha na badzā ya che ge mo shād+dhi ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya bas brgya'am stong ngam khri'am 'bum mam/ ji srid nus pas bsreg 4par bya'o/ /bdag gi cho ga'i rim pa 'dis/ /lhag pa'i lha rnams mnyes bya ste/ /srid pa'i brtson 5rar nyam thag pa'i/ /'gro kun srid mtsho brgal bar shog /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga /slob dpon rdo rje rnon pos mdzad pa rdzogs so// //38—607

bsdur mchan/6༷3 1ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod ska da du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ra / /gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gikyi/ 'e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dgos sar/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra srung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thabs/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sreg6༷4 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dharmā/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bye/ 〈〈snar 〉〉thabs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshoms/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi'od/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngasan+de/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byen/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 hi/ 9—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ sbyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyob/ 1rdu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stegs/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sgrubs/ r+ṣa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sgrub/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/6༷5 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ཿṣe dur/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltarka/ — 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉du'o// thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dum ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉duṣ+ṭan/ḍa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shan ṭī/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga skyed/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/6༷6 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta u:/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi.oṃ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swā hā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ti/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉le/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gitshe/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasol/6༷7 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gitu/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sreg 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sgrub/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉seg5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatson/38byed608
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1727)38wa 609

1801༄ / /'phags ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma jes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga jes bya ba/ tsho༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ta thā ga toṭī ṣa si tā ta pa tre nā ma a pa rā dzi ta maṇ+ḍal bi bye nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa brgyad la sogs pa las thar zhing / /rang gi don las gzhan 'dod 2gtsor mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga phyi yi don ltar brtsam/ /de la dang por bla ma ni/ /chos bcu la sogs ldan pa la/ /slob ma dad ldan lha la gus/ /rigs ldan de yis gsol gsum gdab/ /de nas bla mas dkyil 'khor gyi/ /rdzas dang yo byad tshogs pa bri4/ /tshogs nas lhabasnyen pa la 'jug bya/ /gnas khang dbe+en zhing nyams dga' ba/ /maṇ+ḍal chag chag mchod sogs dgram/ /byang chub sems 38—610

—bskyed ldan pa yis/ /bdun po rnam dag sngon 'gro bas/ /rang nyid lha mo'i 1'khor lor bsam/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor cho ga las/ /ji ltar 'byung po bskyed par bya/ /de nas gsang sngags bzlas pa ni/ /rang gi snying gar rab bkod la/ /snying po 'bum du phrin las bzhi/ /ji ltar rigs pas bzlas par bya / /yang na dus dang mtshan ma dang / /nus ldan rigs pas sbyar bar bya/ /'khor kyi sngags kyang 'dus par bzhed/ /de ni bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o/ /da ni sa chog bya ba la/ /dang por phyi dang nang dang ni/ /phyogs dang dbyibs dang kha dog dang / /'byung khungs la sogs rigs kyis brtag /de nas 'jig rten rgyal po'am/ /blon po bdag po ci rigs par/ /mngon pa bdag po tshig gis blang / /mi mngon par gyur sa gzhi ni/ /lha dang sa yi lha mo la/ /blangs te rmi lam la sogs pas/ /brtag pa'i cho ga rgyas par bya'o/ /sa bdag la ni mi gnod par/ /rim pas brkos 4la nyes pa bsal/ /rnam lnga dang bsres 'thas par bcag /yang na 'jig rten gsum 'dul gyi/ /sngags sam las kyi bum pa'i chus/ /nyes pa ma lus dag par bya/ /yang na lha mo'i rang sngags kyis/ /dag par byas pas gdon dang ni/ /zug rngu'i nyes pa dag par bya/ /yang na 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang / /rang gi sngags kyis gzung 5bar bya/ /rak+ṣa'i sngags sam rang nyid ni/ /'phags mar byas te gsol ba gdab / /de nas cho ga rim pa yis/ /bskyed la phyogs bzhir slob ma yang / /lha mo bzhi yi bskyed rim gyis/ /tshig ni 'di skad gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun mchog la yang dag byung / /'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa gsungs/ /38—6/ /

zhes pa brjod par bya'o/ /yang na tshigs bcad brjod par bya/ /de nas bla mas 'khor lo nam mkha' la bteg la rang nyid khros pa'i gzugs/ saṃ ṭaṃ las ni mig nyi zla/ /hūṃ las rkang pa rdo rjer bya/ /'gying bcas rdo rje gsor ba 1ni/ /gar gyi tshul gyis 'di skad brjod/ /lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /srung 2ba'i 'khor lo rab spyor bas/ /gal te gang zhig 'da' 'dod na/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i lus kyis ni/ /lus gsum las gsum dag byas te4/ /'di ni de gzhom gzhan du min/ /oṃ gha gha5/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭṛ 6phaṭa/tī la ya tī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra tī la ya badz+ra dha rod 7ā dzñā pa ya ti kā ya wāñtsit+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod la/ bgegs med bya phyir bgegs dgra ni/ /phur bu'i gzugs kyis gdab par bya/ /de nas lha yi tshogs dang ni/ /gtor ma mchod pas tshim bya ste/ /rab bsrung gnas su bsrung bar bya/ /de nas sa la lag pa ni/ /lan gsum brdabs pas lha mo ni/ /lang tsho ldan pas bsams te ni/ /byin brlabs ye shes gzhug pa dang / /mchod bstod byas la 'di skad brjod/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang phar phyin lam la ni/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang gyur te/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud sde bcom pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi stobs/ /pham par bya ste dkyil 'khor bri/ /lha mos gsol te thim par bsam/ /de nas dri yi thig le dang / /mchod pa la sogs rgyas par bya/ / de rjes rabum pa rnam pa drug /gser dngul rin chen las byas pa'am//38—6/2

sa las byas pa mgrin phra ba'o/ /lto ba che la nag po yi/ /ra ri med pa'i ras kyis ni/ /kha brgyan mtshan ma legs bris te/ /'bru dang rin chen sman lnga dang / /ldan par byas te me 'od dam1/ /dri yi thig le'i steng du gzhag /de nas slob ma rgyan dang ni/ /kha dog ldan pa'i rigs bzang dang / /bde gshegs gsang sngags bsgrub brtson pa/ /don ston de la sdom pa dbog /dge bsnyen dge tshul la sogs pa/ /rim pas byang chub sems bskred bya/ /de nas sngags kyi sdom pa yang / /sbyin pas dang por 'di skad brjod/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga'i 'khor lo ni/ /'khor ni bzhi char la yang gnang / /rang rang slob dang ldan pa la/ /theg pa chen por sgrub byed pa/ /kha cig gsang sngags grub don gnyer/ /'di na dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ /de las gzhan yang bsod nams 'dod/ /gzhan dag pha rol don du gnyer/ /'jig rten phyi ma mchod bya ste/ /dad pa mang du byas nas ni/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi4/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras tsam 'dod mi bya/ /tshe 'di tsam ni don gnyer ba/ /'jig rten pha rol pa de min/ /skyes bu 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /tshe 'di'i 'bras kyang rgyas par 'byung / /zhes pas bla mas spro ba bskyed/ /rang gi lus la legs bcug ste/ /rang gi snang ba las byung ba/ /ye shes sems dpa'i snying gar gzhug5 /lan gsum bar du sbyang bar bya/ /de nas slob mas bla ma la/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /dga' chen khyod ni ston pa po/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo//dam tshig de ni bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol6/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum po yang bdag la stsol7/ /38—6/3

thar pa chen po'i tshul mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug 1par mdzod/ /ces pa lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ /de nas bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /bu tshur jeg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni/ /khyod ni bstan pa'i snod yin no/ /khrod ni yang dag bstan par bya/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gsang sngags mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seng sogs cho ga yis/ /bdud kyi sde ni drag po yang / /dpung chen ma lus bcom pa ste/ /'jig rten rjes su 'jug shes nas/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob 'dod pas/ /bu yis blo gros 'di kyis shig /ces pa lan gsum yang na gcig /brjod la yan lag bdun pa rdzogs/ /byas te byang chub sems bskyed bya/ /de yi cho ga las byung ba/ /shes par bya ste sbyin par bya/ /de nas hūṃ āḥ.oṃ gyis ni/ /rdo rje dang ldan thig les mchod/ /de nas rigs kyi sdom pa dang / /bla ma sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /lha mo'i tshogs rnams thams cad dang / /'phags pa'i dge 'dun bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba ni/ /dus 'di nas nyid bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying po la gnas par/ /sems can ma lus pa yi don/ /rdzogs par bya phyir sems bskyed bya/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges gnas pa/ /tshul khrims rnam gsum sdom pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sbud 4pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul dzams dang / /so sor bdag gis gzung 5bar bya/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnams/ /dam pa bdag gis 38—6/ /

bskyed par bgyi/ /de ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung 1bar bgyi/ /slob dpon bdag kyang gzung 2bar bgyi//rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re zhing ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog chen po la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /tshul khrims bslab pa la sogs dang / /gnyis su med pa'i tshangs 4spyod dang / /rang gi dam tshig bsrung par bgyi/ /bdag gi bya ba'i las rnams kyi/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni bsgrub bya ste/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bya/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol 5bar bya/ /dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbyung bgyi/ /thams cad bla med byang chub kyi/ /lam la myur du gnas par bya'o/ /lan gsum du ni zlos su gzhug /de nas byur bsal sdig pa dbyung / /me tog phul te sngags kyis ni/ /brtan par byas te las kyi sngags/ /rgyal la sogs pas brjod par bya'o / /so shing a shwat+tha dang ni/ /u dus+thār 6sogs mi 'khyog cing / /srin dang gas chag mi sdug med/ /sor bcu gnyis pa mthe'u chung tshad/ /me tog ldan pa 'char bcug ste/ /byang shar bltas te mi smra bar/ /ba ko tsam byugs maṇ+ḍal steng / /ltos med rang gi mdun drang bor/ /de yi rtse mo bdag dang nye/ /bltas na mchog gi dngos grub yin/ /phyogs dang mtshams su kha — bltas na/ /'bring 38—6/5

dang zhi sogs las brgyad 'grub/ /thur bltas sa 'og 'grub pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor phyir ni dngos grub med/ /de nas dri yi chu ni bzang / /blugs te 1skyor chu blud par bya/ /oṃ z-iḥbi shudhaḥ2sarba pā paṃ ni tsa saṃ sho dha ya bi kalpa a pa na ya hūṃ zhes lan gsum brjod la 'thung du gzhug /ngag gi sgrib pa thams cad 'byang / /skud pa dmar po sum bsgril 4ba/ /mdud pa gsum ldan rang lhar byas/ /sngags kyis btab la lag par bcing / /hūṃ las byung ba'i ku sha yang / /sngas dang stan du sbyin par bya/ /de nas mchod pa spro bas chos/ /legs par bshad par bya ba ste/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen pa/ /u dusmra 5ra'i me tog ltar/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /sngags kyi spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni rnyed par dka'//gang gis mnyam med sems can don/ /bla na med par byed nus pa/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod yul ni/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob byed pa'o/ /dang po bskal pa grangs med nas/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa gang dang gang / /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di mthong bas/ /de dag thams cad zad par 6'gyur/ /zhes pas kun la spyo ba bskyed/ /slob ma de rnams kun gyis kyang / /seng ge'i nyal thabs ldan pas su/ /ku sha'i stan la nyal bar bya/ /nang par langs la skal ldan rnams/ /thar pa chen po'i rang bzhin gyi/ /grong khyer dam pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /nang par dus su langs nas ni/ /rmi lam mtshan ma dri bar bya/ /des kyang bzang ngan mthong ba rnams/ /bla ma'i mdun du brjod par bya/ /mtshan ma bzang bas dngos grub 'grub/ /ngan pa bsrung ba me yi ni/ /las kyis sdig pa gzhom par bya/ /de yi cho ga sbyin sreg bzhin/ /38—6/6

de nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor spyan drangs mchod bstems la/ /mchod dang bstod pa la sogs bya/ /pus mo g.yas pa sar btsugs te/ /lag tu bdug pa'i spos thogs te/ /'phags ma gdugs dkar lha mo mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon po bri bar 'tshal lags na/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan 'das mar 1bdag ni gus/ /de ni bka' drin mdzad par rigs/ /'gro ba'i 'khor lo bya don stsol / /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gang yang gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba ma lus dang / /'byung po byang chub nyer gnas pa//gang dag rdo rje spyan mnga' ba'i/ /bstan la mngon par dga' ba kun/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge ste/ /'phags ma gdugs dkar dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa'i yo byad kyis/ /'gro ba'i don phyir 'dri 4lags na/ /thugs brtse bar ni dgongs nas su/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /dkyil 'khor lhan cig gyur pa kun/ /nye ba ru ni mdzad par rigs/ /lan gsum la sogs brjod par bya/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid bzang ldan pas/ /rnal 'byor rdzogs pas sngar langs te/ /sdig 'joms dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor bteg la thig las bya/ /ras bal la sogs nyes med la/ /tshon lngas legs bsgyur rin chen snod/ /rigs lnga'i sa bon las bsgred de/ /byin rlabs 5dbang rnams rdogs par bya'o/ /6a byo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmā7ཿpar spa ra a nu ga te 9sarba 38byed6/7

dharmāḥ1a t+yan ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ2zhes brjod lnga po gcig tu bsgril/ tshad ni nyis 'gyur la sogs bya/ /de nas dri bzangs kyis sbags te/ /ye shes thig ni mkhas pas gdab/ /bla mas slob ma dza yis sbyin/ /de nyid sum 'gyur gyis blangs te/ /thig sgras sems can don du ni/ /sangs rgyas mang po bskul bsam bya/ /bla ma nub ste shar bltas nas/ /slob ma nub bltas tshangs thig gdab / /de ltar g.yas skor gnyis btab la/ /zur dang logs sogs thig gi cha/ /bla ma'i man ngag ltar bya'o/ /phur bu btsugs la bskor bar bya/ /mtshan min pas ni dngos min 'gyur/ /thig skud chad na bla ma 'chi/ /lhag dang chad las nad du 'gyur/ /phyogs 'khrul bas ni slob ma'o/ /zur bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi/ /do shal sogs kyis spras pa ste/ /sgo khyud rin chen rdo rje dang / /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bur bcas/ /mchod cing 4bkra shis rdzas kyis brgyan/ /de ltar mdzes pas lhag chad spang 5/ /de nas tshon gyi 6las bya ba/ /rin chen lnga'am 'byung khungs sam7/ /yang na legs par byas pa yi/ /kha dog lnga ni rin chen snod/ /bzhag la rigs lnga'i sa bon snod/ /bskyed cing bsnyims la ye shes dgug /gnas gsum brlab cing mchod bstod la/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes sogs brgya la sogs pa bzlas/ /de nas bla mas dbang ldan la/ /sogs pa'i mtshams nas g.yas skor 8du/ /mdzub re snyoms par drang bar bya/ /sngo dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /dkar po nang du rim pas so/ /mnyam zhing mi yo ma chad pa / /bris te rin chen snod kyis dgab/ /me tog dor la slob mas kyang / /ci rigs par ni skyon spangs bri9/ /spom phras nad dang nor zad byed/ /chad na 38—618

byedaslob dpon slob ma 'chi/ /yon pos thams cad kyis sdang 'gyur/ /shar dkar lho ser nub byang 1ni/ /ljang gu'i rnam pa shas che'o/ /dbus kyi pad+ma'i nalte ba la//gdugs dang rdo rje bri bar bya/ /de yi phyi rim 'khor lo'i cha/ /dkar por gnas la shar rtsibs la/ /pad sdong phreng ba'i rnam pa dgod/ /lhor ni rin chen dbyug 4pa la/ /spos snod rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /nub tu rdo rje'i rnam pa la/ /byang du rgya gram dgod par bya/ /shar dang nub tu skyabs sbyin no/ /gru chad dmar po 5la sogs te/ /sgo la lcags kyu la sogs dgod/ /lha yi snam bu dag la yang / /phyogs skyong mtshan ma rim pas so/ /tshon gyi rim pa rgyas par bya/ /de nas lha ni mnyes bya dang / /slob ma'i sdig pa gzhom pa'i phyir/ /mgon 6po'i cho gas sbyin sreg bya/ /gzar bu'i tshad dang thab 7dang rdzas/ /de rnams gzhan las 'byung bzhin bya'o/ /de ltar thams cad sdogs pa dang / /lus bkrus dri zhim chus byugs te/ /rgyan ldan pas ni mchod rdzas thogs/ /bskor ba byas la slob dpon ni/ /lha mor byas te hūṃ sgra yis/ /rdor dril ldan pas nang zhugs la/ /dbus nas sgo yi rim pas su/ /dbye ba byas te bum pa sogs / /rang rang gnas su dgod par bya'o/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyang ma lus pas/ /mdzes byas bla ma dam pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams rdzogs par bskyed/ /gzhug dang byin rlabs dbang bskur gsol/ /byas la mchod bstod 7ston mo bya/ /de nas rtsa ba'i lha dang ni/ /legs ldan la sogs lha rnams la/ / mthun pa'i 11gtor ma chen po rnams/ /cho ga man ngag ldan pas sbyin/ /38—6/9

de nas slob ma dbang 'dod na/ /lha las tha dad dbye byas te/ /slob ma 'jug tshul dbang bskur rim/ /dang po dpa' bos blang bar bya/ /de nas slob ma rgyan ldan zhing / /mdzes pa'i gdong yang dar kyis ni/ /bkab ste lag par me tog ldan/ /mkhas pas khrid nas yol ba'i bar/ /bzhag ste bla mas 1ku sha yis/ /bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /dris te bdag ni skal pa bzang / /gdugs dkar lha la bdag dga'o/ /de nas slob mas 2bla ma la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sgu/ /slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi/ /gtso bor lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo thar pa chen bo'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos 4bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /de nas bla mas 'di skad brjod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi 5gnas/ /lha mo gdugs dkar can 6gyi gnas/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /de nas dkyil 'khor lha rnams la/ /dad pas phyag ni bya ba ste/ /oṃ na ma ste hūṃ/ na mā mi hūṃ/ na mo na ma hūṃ swā hā/ de nas slob ma khrus byas te/ shar gyi sgo ru gnas pa la/ /de nas me tog bcas pa yis/ /bla ma la ni gsol ba gdab/ /dam tshig de ni bdag la stsol7/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol8/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol9/ /zhes bya bla mas de la ni/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun sogs/ /gong du bshad nga/'i sdom pa sbyin/ /oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā 1 da yā mi/ /sems bskyed me tog dang bcas pa/ /snying gar bzhag ste sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ su ra ste sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sidhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ oṃ a khaṃ bī ra hūṃ zhes pas slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug ste/ slob dpon tshig 'di brjod par bya/ /deng khyod lha mo dang ri khrod 38—620

pa rnams kyi rigs su 'gyur gyis/ ngas gdugs dkar mo'i sems bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis 1de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / gdugs dkar can dang ri khrod ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur la/dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos kyi2/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ /de la 'khor lo gzhug bya ste/ /lag gis rdo rje spyir bzhag nas/ /'di ni su yang rung ba la/ /gal te khyod kyis smras gyur na/ /khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje yis/ /rang gi mgo bo 'gas par 'gyur/ /de nas bdud rtsi chu blugs te/ /'thung du bcug ste 'di skad brjod/ /lha mo chen po deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag di ring zhugs4/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /zhes bya'o/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭha oṃ āḥhūṃ/ deng nas khyod kyi gdugs dkar can nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal bar lhung bar gyur ta re zhes brjod do/ /de nas slob ma'i gtso bo des/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis zlobs mdzod la/ /rdo rje ye shes dbab tu gsol/ /de nas bla mas slob ma la//lus ngag yid gsum 'byung ba yi/ /'khor lor mdoms 5su yi ge dzha6/ /dmar ba bsams te 'od zer gyis/ /lus kyi rdul dang mnyam pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bkug la bstem 7de ni/ /oṃ badz+ra ā be+e sha ya a a a zhes bya'o/ /yang na 38—62/

ā be+e sha ya to ṣa ya ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūṃ ha a bho1/ zhes brjod 'gying ba dang bcas pas/ rdzas kyi bdug pas legs bdugs te/ /dril bu'i sgra dang a na le'i/ /sngags kyang ci mang dag tu bzlas/ /babs gyur lce la yi ge a / /dmar po bsams te dge mi dge /smros shig bu kun nyams myong zhing //dris la babs pa brtan bya'i phyir/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ zhes brtan par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rjes khrid nas su/ /shar sgo nas ni 'di skad brjod/ /'dir ni bsod nams ji lta bar/ /rigs kyi rim bzhin 'di yi lha/ /'dis ni dngos grub gang yin pa/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /de yi bsod nams gang yin las/ /dkyil 'khor du ni de bzhin 'gyur/ /slob ma'i me tog phreng ba de/ /pra ṣ+ṭṛts+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes pas me tog lha la dor/ /lha ni gang la phog pa dang / /'grub 'gyur sngags 'dis mgo la bcing / /pra ti kṛt+na 4swa mi oṃ satwa 5ma hā ba la/ /de nas lag pa nas bzung ste/ /mig gnyis su ni oṃ bsams 6la / /rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis7/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad / /phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med//oṃ badz+ra be+e tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lam̐ dīḥzhes pas gdong g.yogs bkrol nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khrod ni gdugs dkar rigs su gyur/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ /'gro ba'i phun sum tshogs pa kun/ /dngos grub kun khyod dngos su 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ /de nas me tog lhung ba'i lha/ /bstan dang lha gzhan thams cad dang / /dkyil 'khor de nyid rdzogs par bstan/ /38—622

byedade nas slob ma dad ldan pas/ /bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ /yon dbul dbang bskur gsol ba gdab/ /gdugs dkar can gyi dbang bsgur ba//'gro ba skyob 1phyir rdo rje can/ /de ltar yon tan kun 'byung ba/ /de bzhin bdag la deng sprul 2cig /ces pa byas te dbang sbyin phyir/ /yungs kar sngags kyis bgegs bzlog la/ /khrus byas rgyan ldan shar sgo yi/ /khri la 'dug la me tog ni/ /sngags kyis lha la dbul bar bya/ /o pra tre+ets+tsha ho/ blangs te mgor bcings sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ dharma kun+da a dzha ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes brjod do/ /me tog phreng ba'i dbang 'di yis/ /'dod lha'i dngos grub myur rdzogs te/ /pad+ma can kyi zhing sogs su/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang mnyam par shog /rnam rgyal bum pa la sogs nas/ /las kyi bum par chu bsdus te/ /slob ma mi bskyod par byas la/ /glu dang rol mo'i sgra dang ni/ /mchod pa'i tshogs kyis chu blugs shing 4/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhe ṣiñtsa/ lha mo rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i chu/ /bag chags thams cad dag byed pa/ /chu yi dbang bskur dam pa 'dis/ /nyon mongs thams cad dag gyur cig /lugs 'byung bris pa'i dbu rgyan la/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bcug nas ni/ /bskon la dar dpyangs kyis 5bcings la oṃ paṣ+ṭa badz+ra a ral+li 6ho/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ /bde gshegs kun gyis bsngags pa dang / /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang / /dar dpyangs dbu rgyan dbang bskur ro/ /gser sogs tshad ldan rdo rje la/ /snang ba mtha' yas bkug bstems te/ /slob ma'i lag gtad sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra a bye pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣidzi 7mi/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bsgur bas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ba/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab sgrub phyir/ /38byed623

rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis lang / /dril bu ldog pa'i tshad ldan la/ /don yod grub par byas nas ni/ /lag pa g.yon spyin sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ a bye pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhe ṣiñtsa tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang 2/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas rdobazhed/ /de tshe dril bu sgra sgrogs te/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis 4dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /mchog gi srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /kha cig ming dang phyir mi ldog /dbang yang sbyin par byed pa yod/ /de ni thun mong dbang yin no//khyad par dbang bskur bstan pa ni/ /gzungs dang 'khor lo phyag mtshan dang / /legs ldan dbang dang bkra shis kyi5/ /rdzas dang rin chen nya rin chen/ /seng ge mda' gzhu ral gri dang / /mthun par sku yi dbang yang bsgur/ /de nas byab bsrung 6bya ba dang / /mtshon 7gyis brab dang srung sgud gdags/ /phur bus gdab dang bzlas pa yi/ /snang ba bzhin dang srung 9'khor gyi/ /cho gas legs par gdags par bya/ /mchod byas lha rnams gshegs bya ste/ /brab pa'i lhag ma chu bor dor/ /rnam lngas thig dbyi la sogs bya/ /rang gis legs par rtogs pa yi/ /gdugs dkar dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di/ /bla ma'i drin gyis byung ba ste/ /bsdus byas rgyas pa ma yin pas/ /mkhas rnams lha la bzod nga/ra bya/ /de las byung ba'i dge tshogs zla ba'i 'od ltar bsil ba des/ /myos byed skye bo'i tshogs rnams gdung ba bsil bar gyur nas kyang / /rang gi 'dod pa'i lha mo nyid dang mtshungs pa'i slob mnga' rtogs gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /38—62/

slob dpon mkhas pa pad+ma'i lcags kyus mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/61༷ 1ma/tshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa/ ltar brkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ra / /'phags ma gdugs dalar mo'i dkyil chog bzhugs so// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉don/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnam//4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dri/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉ra /611 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉dngaphrin/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉donas/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thakod/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga zung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sharam/sa kyis/ tshigs/612 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ra/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉snga srung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉sbya ra/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byu ste/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ཿghaḥ/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉duṣ+ṭan/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉rdo rjes/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rdo rje/613 1〈〈sna ra 〉〉'dod ma/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rig 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgru ba/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉stanas / 5〈〈sna ra 〉〉bzhug 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsol/614 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 zhugs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉gipa// 〈〈snar 〉sngagasungs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉stan/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasdud/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung /615 1 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabazung / 4〈〈snar 〉〉tshang / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staXl/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dum bar/7〈〈snar 〉〉ga616 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ste/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉trī bhi shudha/ 〈〈snar 〉〉thung / 4(〈snar 〉〉sgril/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉dum ba/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉gipar/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yongs/617 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnam/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasol/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje'i/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'bri/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da rlabs/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 chag 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉darma/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dpa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ta/618 1 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giḥ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi btsal / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dang/'i shing dang / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉yang / 6〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gis/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga skor/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa/619 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang byang du/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/d+ma/ 3〈〈snar 〉〉phyir/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanabyugs /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉mo/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganon/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thabs/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnam ra/38—625

༄ga /'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can gyi sāts+tsha'i cho ga jes bya ba/1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+yā 2dzi ta dhā ra sāts+tsha bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma 4 gdugs dkar mo can gyi sāts+tsha'i 5 cho ga zhes bya ba/'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po'i las can rnal 'byor pas/ /lus ngag sgrib pa sbyang ba dang / /khyad par bsgrub pa'i las brtson pas / /tsha tsha bya ba'i rim pa bstan/ /dang po yid dang 6mthun pa'i sa phyogs su thang bu bstar ba dz+wabya ste/ de ru spos dang bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags sam/thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags zlos shing / gtor bas mi gtsang ba'i tshogs thams cad byang ste rin po che'i sa gzhir gyur par bsam8/ bgegs yod pa kun rang rang gi gnas su dengs par bya ste bka' bsgo ba yang bya'o/ /de nas dri bzang po la sogs pa'i chus skyang nul byas/ me tog sil ma dpag tu med pa bkram la/ mchod pa la sogs pa'i yo byad kun tshogs par bya ste/ gnas 38—627

—khang dang mchod pa la sogs pa'i bya ba'o/ /de nas bla mas/ khrus dang gtsang sbra bya ste/ sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga rdzogs panu/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar can du bsam ste/ tsha tsha'i sa brko ba der brta ga pa dang / oṃ āḥ t+t+waṃ zhes pa'am/ bkra shis pa'i phyag rgya'i lha mos gang bzari byen gyis brlab/ thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bathi/da pa dang / lha mo b.legs ldan la gtor ma byen la gsol ba gdab pa dang / sa bang) ga la gtor ma/ byin la bka' bsgo ba bya ste/ de nas ji tsam brko ba'i sa de sha5 seng sdeng la sogs pa'i phur bus phyogs bzhir btab ste/ de yang stod naleb/sa ldan nam/ lha mo bdud rtsi 'khyel pa la smad phur par 4'dug par bakhye/snad la / byin gyis/ brlabs la oṃ badz+ra shī li tī la ya/ sarba dubye hūṃ phaṭa ces/ lan gsum bzlas la gdab bo/ /de nas bu mo gtsang mas bkal ba'i tshon sgung rnam pa lnga rigs lnga'i rnam pa'am/ rin chen lnga'i rang bzhin du bsams la/oṃ ‘kudz+ra sru tra sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ste/ phur pa'i mtha' ma tshon skud kyis bsgo/ra la rang gi rkang pa gar gzhag par rdo rjer lam lam song bar bsam mo/ /yang na sngags de thams cad rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bya'o/ /de nas thams cad 'jo3 mas pa'i sngags zlos shing yungs/ kar gyis gtor ro/ /de nas sa gzhi de rin/ po cher gyur par bsams la rang ji tsam 'dod pa brkos te/ de'i sngags kyang oṃ badz+ra kha na kha na ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya'o/ /de nas phur bu dang tshon sgud bstsub/sa 'o mas bsgus te gzhag go/ /sa blang ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas blangs pa rnams stegs bu la sogs par bzhag la sa brdung ba'i las/ bya ste/ sngags kyang oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ā rko ṭa ya ā ko ṭaya hūṃ phaṭa ces brjod 28—628

——byedacing rdo rje'i tho bas brdung ngo / /de nas spos chu la sogs pa'i chu la oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa ces bzlas la/ spos chu dmigs pa las a dkar por bsam/ de las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i 'od kyis 1spos chu thams cad khyab ste/ bdud rtsir gyur par bsams te sbru'o/ /de'i sngags oṃ badz+ra pra marda ya pra marda ya hūṃ phaṭa ces byas la sbru'o/ /de nas 'jim pa de bdud rtsi thab spyor gyi phyag rgya 2bcas la sngags 'di brjod de/ oṃ susmre susmre mu ga te/ shādhe dārnye4/ nir ku li/nir ba ra ṇi/ sarba bhū ta bha yā 5nu ga te/ ya ba de ya sho dzi ni/ dharma dhā tu gabye/ dharma rā dza ya ba shi te/ sarba bud+dhā ya/ a byeṣ+ṭha nā ya/ a byeṣ+ṭha 6te swā hā/ zhes brjod pas rang gi 7thugs las ye shes lnga'i 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum sems can 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can du byas/tshur la rig sngags la sogs sangs rgyas mchod pas 'jim pa la thim/ zhu nas khyab pas rin po che rnam pa lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam ste stegs bu la gzhag go/ /de ni 'jim pa'i bya ba'o/ /de nas 'bi 'bi bya ste/ de yang oṃ ba badz+red bha ba ya swā hā/ zhes zlos shing bya'o/ /de nas rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sems can kyi sgrib pa gsum sbyangs/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar can du byas/ 'phags pa mchod/ 'dus pas 'bi 'bi la thim pas ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin kyi shel sgong dag pa'i rnam pa'i gzhal yas khang du bsams te/ de'i nang du yang gdan pad+ma dang seng ge las 'phags ma gdugs dkar can dang phyag rgya'i lha mo la sogs pa bskyed de 2/ 'di cho ga gsum gyis bskyed do / / de nas oṃ las ye shes kyi 'od phyung la gzhal yas khang du byas te/gdan nas lha rdzogs pa'i bar gye dkyil 'khor bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug /38—629

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes pas so/ /de nas rang gis kyang sbyang ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas 'bi 'bi rnams su oṃ a na le dang phyag rgya'i sngags sam sa bon rnams kyang gzhug /gzhan srog shing brtan 1pa'i gzungs la sogs pa ci rigs par gzhug /rten 'brel dang dri ma med pa la sogs pa yang gzhug go/ /de la mchod pa dang bstod pa la sogs pa yang rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ dharma 2dh+wa tu gabye dz+wa la swā hā zhes brjod la/ de las lha mo rnams bskul nas slar yang gzhug ste sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa rdul dang mnyam pas bdag dang sems can sbyangs te gzhug 4par bya'o/ /de nas mar byug pa ni oṃ a ra dze pi ra dze swā hā / zhes brjod la/ byang chus kyi sems kyis bsgom 5par bsam mo de ni 'be+e 'bi bya ba'o/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa las chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag par bzhugs par bsams te skol 6phor du bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra dharma dhā tu gabye swā hā zhes bya'o/ /de nas skol 7phor shes rab lag pa thabs su bsams te/ brdung ba ni de ni gnyis su med par bsrub par bsams te /oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ zhes pa'am/ rten 'brel lam/ snying po'am/nye snying la sogs zlos shing gdab bo/ /de nas chos kyi sgu las sprul sgu gnyis kyis sems can gyi don byed par chos kyi dbyengs las 'byung bar bsam ste/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā dha re swā hā/ zhes brjod la 'byung ngo / /de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya ma hā su kha badz+ra su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ de las gzugs sgu gnyis byung bas 'gro ba thams cad kyi don bsam gyis mi khyab pa byed par bsam mo/ /de nas gzugs sku sa ji ltar rigs pa ste/ longs 9skus dag pa'i sems can gyi don byed par bsam ste 0/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta saṃ sgo ka sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes bya'o/ /38—630

sprul skus 1ma dag pa dang po'i las can la sogs pa'i don byed par bsams la/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nirma ṇa kā ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes bya'o/ /de ni 2tsha tsha gdab pa'o / /de nas sku gsum kyi ngo bo dang rang don ni gzhung mangs kyis dogs pas ma bris so/ /de la ye shes pa nabastim pa dang mchod pa la sogs pa yang bya'o/ /de nas o badz+ra phru shi swā hā/ zhes pas srog shing gzugs par bya'o/ /de nas sems can shes bcu ldan gyur cig /bstan pa yun rings gnas par shog /sems can lhag bsam dag pa yis4/ /kun bzang smon lam 'jug par shog /ces bya'o/ /de nas oṃ pra marda na ye swā hā/ zhes bya ste/5 'khor lo gsum bskon 6la/ khams gsum sems can ma lus pa/ /stobs dang ma 'dres chos dang ni/ /dran pa nyer gzhag rnam thar brgyad/ /ye shes bzhi sogs ldan gyur shog /ces bya'o/ /oṃ pa da ka lo pa swā hā/ zhes brjod la dar kyi cod pan phul la/ sems can rnams ni ma lus pas/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la/ /dar dang lhab lhub la sogs pa/ /byang chub bar du mchod par shog /ces bya'o/ /de nas oṃ pa da ka swā hā/ zhes bya ste/ ba dan phul la/sems can rnams ni ma lus las/ /phyogs bcur bstan pa'i ba dan gyis/ /'tshe ba med cing chos ldan pas/ /grags pas rgyas par 'gengs par shog /ces bya'o/ /de nas oṃ kum+bhi ra dh+wa dza swā hā zhes bya ste/ chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan phul la/ 'khor ba ma stong 7bar du ni/ /bdud bzhi dag las legs rgyal nas / /ston pa'i bstan pa zab mo dag /mi nub 8rgyal mtshan thob par shog /ces bya'o/ /de nas oṃ pra ma na ye swā hā/ zhes pas gdugs phul la/38—63/

khams gsum sems can ma lus pa/ /nyon mongs tshad pas gdung ba 1la /thugs rje byang chub sems kyi gdugs/ /phub pas bde bas tshim gyur shog /ces bya'o/ /de nas oṃ rat+na mā 2le tram̐ zhes pas me tog phul la/ yang na na mnaḥshrī ya dha nu ga ta pra tiṣ+ṭha ta pube+e ko ta no ta thā ga tā arta te samyaka saṃ bud+dhā ya/tar+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe swā hā zhes bya ba 5ste/ 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus kun/ /mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs thob nas/ /blta bas mi ngoms gzugs kyis ni/ /sems can don rnams rdzogs byed shog /ces bya'o/ /de nas oṃ su na dha re dza ye swā hā/ zhes byas te gdan phul la/ sems can ma lus sangs rgyas te/ /stobs bcu ldan pa glang po'i gdan/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rta yi gdan/ /dbang bcu thob pa rma bya'i gdan/ /thogs med shugs ldan mkha' lding gdan/ /'dod dgu 6'byung ba rin chen gdan/ /skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i gdan/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal nyi zla'i gdan/ /gdan rnams myur du thob par shog /ces bya'o/ /de nas oṃ dha ra dha ra mi li dza le swā hā/ zhes gzhal yas khang du gshegs su gsol lo7/ /ji ltar chos dbyings dag pa yi/ /gnas su bsam shes bzhud pa ltar/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyang / /dag pa'i gnas su gshegs gyur cig /de nas oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes bzhugs su 8gsol te/ rin chen gzhal yas/ chos dbyings su// /sems can don du brtser dgongs la/ /ji srid sems can byang chub bar/ /de srid du ni bzhugs par mdzod/ /ces bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra dh+wa 1 tu sha ri ma tiṣ+ṭṛ hūṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ zhes brjod la/ dbang bskur te rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par bya'o/ /de ni brtan par bya ba'i 28———632

cho ga yin no/ /des ni phun sum tshogs pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas slob dpon byang chub sems/ /ldan pas tshigs bcad brjod bya ste//bla med sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs/ /sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung zhing / /bdud dang phyir rgol log 'dren tshogs/ /thams cad pham byas bde la dgod / /sems can nying mtshams spyor ba yi1/ /nyon mongs ma lus sbyang bar bya / /nga rgyal ri ni gzhom bya zhing / /skye ba'i ljon shing gcad par bya/ /'chi bdag srin po brlag bya ste/ /ma rig pa yi mun pa bsal2/ /lta log yang dag lta la dgod/ /las kyi chu klung bskam par bya/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho yang bskam ste / /chos sgron spar zhing byang chub lam/ /bstan 4par byas te bzod des byos/ /'dod chags me dang zhe sdang mtshon/ /phrag dog 'tshub 6ma ser sna bdud/ /'jig tshogs bdag gis gzhom par bgyi/ /sems can bde ba bla med kyis/ /byang chub lam la rab dgod phyir/ /bdag gi sdig bral mthun pa yi / /dngos grub sna tshogs bdag la stsol/ /de nas dkyil 'khor du byas pa'am/ yang na mchod rten bum par gdugs dkar can dmigs pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyag la sogs pa'i lha mos 'jig rten gyi / khams khengs par bya ste/ de dag gi sgrib pa gsum ma lus par dag par bya ste thams cad lha mo'i rang bzhin du byas la/ sgu gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor dag par bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāspyet+ta ma hā sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes bstan par bya'o / /dung phor du dri chab la sogs pa blugs te/ lag pas bzung la a las zla ba'i rnam pa 4 las 'od zer gyis yon chab bdud rtsir bsams la/ gtso mo nas 'khor la sogs pa'i snyeng po bzlas te dbul lo/ /de'i sngags/ oṃ a 38—633

mṛ ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes lan gsum du spyi bor bzhag la dgang / der ye shes sems dpa' spyan dras 1te dbang bskur bar bsam mo/ /de nas mchod pa lnga yang rang rang gi sngags kyis dbul/ sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad kyis kyang mchod de/ 'dir gzhung mangs kyis dogs pas ma bris so/ /mchod pa bsang ba dang sbyang ba ni/ oṃ sarba pū dza puṣ+pe swā hā/ zhes pas sbyang ngo / /de nas rdo rje dril bu dang ldan pas bstod pa bya ste/ de yang dang po spyir yang bstod pa ni/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gzir ba'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /thugs rjes snyug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ /sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang / /chags pas mi gos pad+ma ltar dag pa/ /'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la/ /thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur zhugs nas/ /zhi ba rin chen mchog gling byal mdzad pa/ /kun gyi ded dpon lha mo khyod la 'dud/ /sems can bkren pa chos kyis phongs gyur pas/ /ma rig thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams//'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa/ /ye shes sgron ma'i lha mo khyod la bstod/ /sems can las kyi chu bos 4'bad pa rnams/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgol mdzad pa/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad la 'god mdzad pa/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag lha mo khyod la bstod/ /ces pa dang /yang slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis bstod pa'i srid gsum ston pa lha dang mi yis mchod 'os la sogs pas kyang bstod pa bya ste5/ de nas yon bdag 'khor dang 38—634

bcas pa la bsams pas smon lam rgya chen po btab 1ste/ bdag sogs sems can skal ldan 'di rnams kyis/ /chos kyi sku yi gzugs brnyan bzhengs pas ni//dge tshogs ma lus ci yod mdun byas te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lha mo thob nga/ra shog /'khor los sgyur rgyal mchog gi lus thob shog /phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing du skye bar shog /tshe 'di nad dang gnod pa dang / /'byung po 'khrugs dang gdon kun zhi gyur shog /ces bya'o/ /shar phyogs su gzungs tshar gcig gam/ gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa nye bar bshad pa ltar bklag4/rgyas par byed na/ dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i byang du slob ma 'dug la/bkra shis kyi dbang la sogs pa bsgur bar bya'o/ /de nas bsdu gshegs gtor ma btang ba kun bya/ khyad par du legs ldan gyi 5mchod pa bya'o/ /de nas dge 'dun gyi mchod ston la sogs pa kun bya'o/ /tsha tsha'i cho ga 'di byas pas/ /khams gsum ma lus sems can kun/ /lha mo nyid dang skal mnyam nas/ /gdul bya'i don la myur brtson shog /tsha tsha'i bya ba slob dpon pad+ma'i lcags kyus mdzad pa rdzogs so// //zangs dkar lo tsā bas tho ling gi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// //28—63pya

bshad ltar klag 31〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyes/ khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1729)38wa 637

༄/ /gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar tsho can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ uspya ṣa bha ba 2si tā ta pa tre bi bye nā ma/bod skad du/ gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba / rje btsun phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam snang mdzad rigs gtsug tor grags/ /phyag stong spyan stong zhabs btud nas/ /gzungs kyi rim pa las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad par bya/ /chu klung ngam/ nags tshal lam/ chu bo'i 'gram mam/ ri'i sul lam/ phug gam/ yid dang mthun pa'i yul dben pa bas mtha'i dgon par/ slob dpon gtsug lag mkhas nga/ chos la dga' ba bslab pa bsrung ba 'grogs na bde ba/ snying rje can gyi 4 dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i las la mkhas pa rmi lam du rtags dang mtshan ma thob pa/ sgrub pa'i grogs po rigs btsun pa chos spyod pa dad pa can snying stobs che zhing brtson 'grus can/38—638

bsam pa bzang zhing mi skyo ba gzhan gyis brid kyang 'phags pa'i tshul mi gtong ba'i grogs dang lhan cig tu stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sgrub pa'i yan lag ni rdzas me tog dkar po dri zhim pa dang / rtsa ba dang sdong bu la sogs pa sbyar ba'i spos dkar po dang / tsan+dan dkar po'i dri dang / 'bras dkar gyi bshos dang / lug la sogs pa dkar ba las byung ba 1mar gyi mar me dang / 'bras yos dang / tsan+dan dkar po dang / me tog dkar po dang ldan pa'i ar+ghaṃ dang / gtsug tor dkar mo'i nye ba'i snying po bzlas pa'i khrus byas la/ snying po'i 2sngags bzlas te/ stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dkar po bgos nas/gtsug tor nas byung ba bzhin tshogs gsog pa'i lha mdun du spyan drangs la/ /bdun rnam dag byas te/ gtsug tor nas byung ba bzhin du khro mo bcu bdun bsgoms la sngags bcu gsum brjod nas thugs ka'i 'od zer las ra ba dang dra ba dang / bla re dang me 'od rnams byung ste bsrung bar bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar yi ge hūṃ bkod nas chos thams cad bdag med par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas dbyangs yig bcu drug las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor babyed la/de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ bsam mo/ /de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje dkar po rtse dgu pa bsam mo/ /de nas 'od zer spa ra ṇa hūṃ zhes pas spro ba dang / saṃ ha ra na 4hūṃ zhes pas bsdus nas/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje rdo rje dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi nā ya ka 5gdan du bting ba/sku mdog sngon po sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan tshocan/ rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa me'i phung po'i dbus na bzhugs par 7bsams la/ de'i snying ga nas nye ba'i snying po'i sngags brjod pas shar la sogs pa me 'bar ma 8la sogs pa'i khro mo 38—639

brgyad spru'/ pa hūṃ bye dī1ཿspyo gyis bdag dang khro mo brgyad byin gyis brlabs la snying po dang nye ba'i snying po bzlas nas/ de'i mdun du gdug pa can 2thams cad tshar gcod pa'i dkyil 'khor dbu stong mnga' ba/ phyag stong mnga' ba/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/ mi byed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags/ can 'grel pa nas 'byung ba bzhin bsgoms/ la/ mchod pas mchod pa dang / gtsug tor dkar mo'i gzungs kyis bstod pa dang / bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad srung 4du gsol zhes phrin las bcol la/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor phyogs skyong ba bcus bskor bar bsams la/ gtor ma bcu dbul ba dang / gdon thams cad la gtor ma gsum mkha' spyod dang / sa spyod dang sa 'og na spyod pa'i dbye bas phye ba la mchod pa phul nas gzungs 5nas 'byung ba bzhin du phrin las bcol la gshegs su gsol bar bsam par bya'o/ /de nas nye ba'i snying po'i 'khrul 'khor bris la rgyal rigs la sogs pa la gdags so/ /yang na rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags nas gong ngam grong khyer ram/ grong rdal kyi sgor btsugs te/ klog pa bzhi phyogs bzhir bzhag la mchod pa chen po byas la / bskor 6ba brgya rtsa brgyad bya ba'am/ yang na rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags nas grong ngam grong khyer ram grong rdal la/ bskor ཿ ba bya'o/ /las 'di thams cad la snying bo dang nye ba'i snying po 'bum sngon du bzlas te/ gzungs brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la tshon dkar pos dkyil 'khor bris te/ mchod nas las thams cad shes par bya'o/ /gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar mo can gyi gzungs 'don pa'i cho ga /slob dpon shu ram̐ ga barma badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //38—6/0

zangs dpo/ra 'phags pa shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/638 shematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄za/ /gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs daskadar mo can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sta'i / da〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wata / gi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wagyi/639 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngo/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉sogs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sog 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṇa/5〈〈snar 〉〉ga 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈na/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wal sogs nga/ me 'bar ma/64༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉hri/ 〈〈snar 〉〉tri/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wacan/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉phyed/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrung / ni〈〈snar 〉〉bzungs/ 6 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgor/bsdur 'bras re'u migashrīḥrngad/ (1113༷)38wa 67/1

༄khya/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo la bstod pa/sna༄4/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo la bstod pa/ /srid gsum ston pa lha yi lha/ /mtshungs med bde gshegs shākya seng ge yi/ /mthon mthing g.yas su 'khyel ba'i spyi gtsug nas/ /ya mtshan rmad byung lha mo khro rgyal gtso/ /khams gsum dag na khyod 'dra'i mgon med de/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug bkra shis mchog gi lha/ /sku mdog gangs ri'i rtse la nyi shar 'dra/ /zhal mang stong la spyan mang bye ba brgya/ /srid pa'i btson rar sems can nyam thag pa/ /dus gsum gzigs nas sems can grol mdzad de/ /zhal stong phyag stong spyan stong rnams/ kyis ni/ /kun la khyab mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs phas kyi rgol ba rnams/ /spyan mang gzigs pas khro gnyer 'ga' ston pas/ /gnod pa'i rgyun rnams gtan nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /rgol ba tshar gcod khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma rig nor bas bslus pa'i 38—6 2

1805༄khya/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa jes bya ba'i nye bar bshad pa/ 1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ta thā ga toṭī ṣa si tā ta pa tre nā ma a pa rā dzi ta u pa de sha /bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo nacan gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i nye bar bshad pa/ bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje chen pos sems badh+yad de/ maṇ+ḍal legs par byugs te thig le dang me tog gi tshom bu bkram nas spyan drangs pa dang / mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas legs pa dang ldan pa la mchod pa dang gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal 'a/ a 'a/sa zla ba la o bsams la/ 'od kyis spyo ba dang / basbu ba byas pa las bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo zhal gsum ma/ zhal gsum la spyan gsu/ma gsum yod pa'o/ /sngo ba dang dmar ba ni g.yon dang g.yas kyi zhal la'o/ /rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa phyag brgyad pa/ g.yas kyi dang po 28 —6 / /

— —— ———— ——— — —— — —na gdugs/ dkar ngo// gnyis/ nga/ na 'khor lo/ gsu/ma/ pa na ñtsa gas/ kyu /bzhi pa na gzhu'o/ /g.yon dang po na rgya'/ mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis nga/ na rdo rje rngashekar po'o/ /gsum pa mda'o/ /bzhi pa na zhags pa dang bcas nga/'i sdigs mdzub ni g.yon pa'o / /khros pa'i stangs dang bcas/ nga/sa ma rungs/ nga/ thams cad 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /'od zer lcags kyu dang 'dra bas ye shes kyi lha rnga) gug pa dang nagazhug pa dang bcing ba dang 4dbang du bya'o/ /dbang du bsgur ba la be+e ro tsa na'o/ /phyag dang mchod pa byas nas sngon 5 du byas/ te dmig‘ sa pa bcu bzhis bklag par bya'o/ /legs pa dang ldan pa la gzungs kyis bstod pa bya'o/ /yang na mdun du dmigs te bstan pa ltar kun yid kyis/ bya ba yin no/ /dmigs pa bcu bzhi ni phyag gi dmigs nga/ dang / thams/ cad zlog pa dang / ri khrod lo ma can nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ dang / bdag bsrung ba dang /bcom ldan 'das ma'i che ba dang / 'jigs pa brgyad bzlog pa dang /gdon chen po nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzlog nga/ dang / rig sngags gcod nga/ dang / ma mo brgyad dang / dam tshig can bcu bzhi'i sngags dang / thams cad bzlog pa dang / nad thams cad bsrung ba dang / thams cad bzlog pa dang /lus la gdags pa dang / 'di dang phyi mar phun sum tshogs pa dang / bu sri dang g.yul zhi ba dang / khyad par du bdag bsrung ba dang / char dbab nga/'o /gsheg/sa pa dang bsdu ba byas te/ ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /'phags/ pa de rngakuzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i nye bar bshad pa bla ma rdo rje gdan pas/ mdzad pa sgogs so// //28 —— 6 ce

༄༅/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa gdugs dkar mo can jes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ si tā ta pa tre a pa rā dzi ta nā ma maṇ+ḍa la sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ gzhan gyis 2mi thub pa gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'phags pa gdugs dkar mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /rgyal ba'i gtsug tor las byung ba/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin lha mo ni/ /sgu mdog gangs ri nyi shar 'dra/ /phyag stong spyan stong brgya phrag stong / /lha rdzas gos kyis yang dag brgyan/ /bkra shis che ba'i lha mo la/ /de la bstod de sgrub thabs bri/ /kun la phan gdags rim pa yis / /gdugs dkar dkyil 'khor rnam 4gnyis las/ /yid kyi rnam pa bkod pa yis/ /bshad kyis nyon mongs ma dad min/ /yid dga' ba yi gnas dag tu/ /sgrub po 5dam tshig grogs bcas kyis/ /sa phyogs der ni bsham pa dang / /bsag pa bum pa lnga 6sogs pa/ /nus 7dang sbyar 38—647

yin de las gzhan/ /rigs dang mi rigs tshogs par bya/ /snying rje chen po rab dmigs pas/ /sems bskyed sngon du song ba yis/ /skad cig sku yis phyogs dang mtshams/ /bsrung dang sngags dang phyag rgyas so/ /snying gar zla steng 1yi ge yi/ /'od kyis pa drang dang sprul nas ni/ /bsod nams tshogs ni rdzogs pa dang / snyan tshig dag gis bstod pa dang / /phyag 'tshal sngon du song ba yis/ /sems bskyed sdom pa gzung 4dbang bsgur/ /lha rnams bsdus pas lus bsregs te/ /rang bzhin lus su blta bar bya/ /gnas su oṃ bsam 'gro ba sbyang / /sangs rgyas mdzad pa rdzogs pa dang / /'khor lo ma lus rdzogs par bya/ /dkar mo chen mo phyag stong ma/ /dbu stong spyan grangs 5brgya phrag stong / /lha yi rgyan dang chas sdogs pa/ /bkra shis che ba'i lha mo'o/ /phyogs ni shar lho nub byang du/ /drag shul chen mo rab gtum mo/ /'bar ba chen mo stobs/ chen mo/ /blta dkar sems 6dang dmar ljang ma/ /g.yas g.yon mthun par phyag rgya ni/ /rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten dang / /bum pa bzung bas 'gying ba yi/ /nyi zla'i 7gdan bzhugs bsam par bya/ /de yi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la/ /shar phyogs 'khor lo rnam bzhi la/ /gos dkar mo dang khro gnyer can/ /phreng ba'i pad+ma rdo rje ma/ /sor mo phreng ba ut+pa la'o/ /sngo bas ngas ljang gu dmar mo'o/ /lho yi phyogs kyi 'khor lo rin8/ /gzhan gyis mi thub sgrog can mo9/ /mchod mo gzi brjid chen mo rgo/ /dkar dang ser nag ljang gu ma/ /rdo rje rin chen dbyug pa ste/ /spos dang rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /nub tu stobs chen lu gu rgyud/ /rdo rje rig 'dzin rigs gser phreng / /dmar dang ser dang dkar ljang ma/ /rdo rje dang ni bgrang phreng bsnams/ /byang du rdo rje 38— 6/8

byed—rin chen ma/ /gtsug tor bsgyings ma gser can ma/ /dmar po dkar dang ljang gu ser/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bgrang phreng can/ /sgol ma dkar mo nam mkha' la/ /babyungs pa skyabs sbyin bsam par bya/ /pad+ma'i spyan ni 'og tu bsam / /dkar mo rdo rje skyil krung bcas/ /lha mo 'di dag thams cad kyang / /yid tsam khros nas gtso la gzigs/ /sgo ma mtshams kyi lha mo ni/ /dkyil 'khor kun nas rab tu gsal/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams dang / /me yi mtshams su gnas par bya/ /thams cad pa ni sdogs pa ru/ /blo dang ldan pas bsgom par bya/ /gtso mo'i thugs kar sa bon las/ /de lta bu nyid bskyed pa yi/ /sa bon 'od kyis 'gro ba sbyang 1 / /de bzhin gshegs nga/ mchod nga/ dang //mdzad pa ma lus mthar phyin bya/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ /mnyes dang tha dad med par bya/ /yi ge gsum gyis/ byin brlabs te/ /ma 'dres rab gsal bsgom par bya/ /gtso mo chang gis mchod pa dang / /phyag so/gas sdogs nas bya ba ni/ /'dod pa kun la sbyar bar bya/ /gal te slo/ba mar dbang bsgur na/ /sngon bzhin du ni bsgo ma par bya/ /bum nga/ sbyang byas zla la oṃ/ /spro basbu lha mo bskyed nga/ dang / /dgug pa byas nas mchod so/gas bya/ /de nas legs ldan mchod pa dang / /bsgo dang las bcol de nas ni/ /sngon du lung de bklag par bya/ /bdun nam 'bum mam grangs/ re/da nga/'o/ /legs/ ldan gzungs kyis bstod pa dang / /mchod pas bsgo ba thams cad byed/ /lha mo 'od zhu bdud rtsi yis/ /khrus dang bkra shis brjod par bya'o/ /dbus/ bzhag phyogs rnams bcing ba 4dang / /skud nga/ lnga yi dra ba yis/ /tshon gyis bcad de dkri ba dang / /rus pa'am bong ba rdo ba la/ /dkris nas gtor te 28— 6 /9

byedabyur bsal bya/ /de nas gtor ma byas nas ni/ /bsrung ba lus sam mgul du gdags/ /bcings pa lus la 1dkri ba dang / /phur bu bton nas gdab par bya/ /gro ga'am ras sam shing shun la/ /gur kum dri zhim 'um 2bu yis//skar ma rgyal la bab pa na/ /sngags pas bri ba rdzogs nas ni/ /btags pa tsam gyis bshad pa yi/ /gnod pa ma lus pa las thar/ /dad ldan 'di ru dbang bsgur ba/ /bu 'dod yi dam bcas tsam gyis/ /rnyed de tshe dang bsod nams 'phel/ /bde ba can du nye bar 'gro/ /rgyal la bri ba rdzogs nas ni/ /rgyal mtshan rtse la btags nas ni/ /rim gro chen po btsugs byas nas / /mi nad la sogs zlog par byed/ /de ni char 'bab nad med pa/ /klu rnams kyis ni byen gyis rlob/ /'di dag bya ba kun la ni/ /mchod dang gtor mas legs ldan mchod/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bzod pa dang / /dge bas sku gnyis rdzogs par shog /bcom ldan 'das 4 gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi cho ga'i rim pa/ slob dpon ghi ri wa tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //28—650
