༄gyi/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/17༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sarba ta thā ga tostso ṣa se tā ta pa tre nā ma a pa rā dzi ta sā dha na dhā ra ṭ+wāṃ2/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo'i gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge slong dge tshul dge bsnyen dang / /rnal 'byor bde bzhi'i tshul ldan pas/ /sa gzhi bkra shis yid 'ong bar/ /maṇ+ḍal ba yi rnam lngas byugs/ /sa yi cho ga legs byas la/ /thig ni rab tu gdab par bya/ /'khor lo rtsibs bzhi rtsibs bcu nga/ /rdo rje phreng ba gru chad dang / /snam bu dang ni gru bzhir bya/ /pad+ma sna tshogs phreng ba dang / /rdo rje'i 4phreng bas bskor bar bya/ /tsan+dan shug pa la sogs pa/ /zhi dang rgyas pa'i shing rnams la/ gtsug tor rgyal mtshan ldan pa bya / /de la sngags rnams legs par bri/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/28—6pya2

— —— —————— — —oṃ spyo ban+dha ban+dha bdag la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ ṣ+ṭi ban+dha ban+dha bdag la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā / oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ rat+na ta thā ga toṭī ṣa a na a ba lo ki te mūrta 1ni te dzo ra ṣi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dha ka dha ka /dha ra dha ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ tshin+da tshin+da/ bhin+da bhen+da/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/oṃ karma sarba ta thā ga toṭī ṣa si tā ta pa tre thru phaṭa swā hā/ rigs lnga'i gtsug tor ro / /tat+yā 4thā/ a na le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra sau me sau me/ sarba bud+dhā/ a dhiṣ+ṭha na a byeṣ+ṭṛ te sarba ta thā ga toṭī ṣa si tā ta nga/ tre hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swā hā/ gtsug tor 5dkar mo'i 'o/ /oṃ ṛ shi ga ṇa pra shaste sarba ta thā ga 7toṭī ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūṃ dzñā8 / dzam+bha ni ka rī hūṃ dzñā/ ma hā bit+yā/ saṃ bhak+ṣa ṇa ka rī hūṃ dzñā/ pa ra bit+yā saṃ bhak+ṣa ṇa ka rī t+t+waṃ dzñā/ sarba duṭ+wā nān/ stam+bha ni ka rī hūṃ dzñā/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa gra hā nān/ bi dh+wan ཿsa na ka rī hūṃ je/ tsa tur shī dī nān/ gra ha sa ha sru ṇa ma bi dh+wan sa na ka rī hūṃ hūṃ/ aṣ+ṭa bo ྾sha dī nān/ nak+ṣa tā rde/ pra sā dha na ka rī hūṃ bye/ aṣ+ṭha t+t+waṃ ma hā gra hā rde/ bi dh+wan sa na ka rī hūṃ dzñā/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad gdan stengs su//rim bzhin gtsug tor bzhugs su gsol/ /gru chad mchod pa'i lha mo bzhim / /sgo bzhi sgo ba phur bu bzhi/ /rig sngags phreng bas bskor te gzugs/ /sgo bzhir ral gri me long dang / /bum pa mda' dang rim bzhin brgyan/ /kha dog lnga yi rgyan rnams dang / /yungs kar la sogs 'bru lnga bkod/ /de nas/ rig sngags gcod cing mtshams bcad de/ /yan lag bdun pa'i smon lam gdab/ /phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs thams cad la/ /bdag la dbang bsgur smon lam gdab / /gnang ba thob nas sngags 'di brjod/ /oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dzñā na 38—653

badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kopho1haṃ/ de yis thams cad stong pa'i ngang / /a yi 'od zer 'phro 'du hūṃ/ /de las yi ge 'bru gsum 'phros/ /phyi nang snod bcud thams cad kun/ /re gyis bsregs te yo gis gtor/ /khaṃ gis bkrus la dag par byas/ /de nas 'bru lnga 'di 'phros te/ /yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor chags/ /khaṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /lo las gser kyi sa gzhi chags/ /ram̐ las me yi dkyil 'khor 'phros/ /'byung ba lnga yi 'phro 'du las / /rin chen sna tshogs ri rab ste/ /rgyu 4las sna tshogs gzhal yas khang //gru bzhi sgo bzhi sgo khyud ldan/ /sna tshogs rdo rje pad+mas bskor/ /dbus su rgyu 5las 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs bzhi rtsibs bcu nyi zla'i bar/ /paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad de/ /ge sar dbus su bsam pa ni/ /rigs kyi gtsug tor lnga rnams dang / phyogs bcu'i gtsug tor bcu rnams dang / /sgo bzhir 6gtsug tor chen po bzhi/ /thams cad yi ge rgyu las bskyed/ /sems can sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yid kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' ste/ /gnyis su med pa'i byang chub sems/ /phyi nang sgod bcud 'jig rten khams/ /'byung lnga ye shes lnga rang bzhin/ /thams cad stong gsal rang bzhin med/ /de las 'od 'phros zla ba'i gdan/ /de yi dkyil du yi ge a/ /de dag 'phros shing 'dus pa las//thams/ cad par bu gseg shang gis/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bkang ste//slar 'dus bcom ldan shākya thub/ /sgu mdog gser 'od 'bar ba la/ /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis ldan/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan/ /gsung dbyangs/ yan lag drug cu ste/ /thugs ni ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /de 'dra bde bar 8gshegs pa'i skus/ /nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi rnams/ /38—65

—til gang bzhin du gang bar bsgom/ /de dag dbu yi gtsug tor las/ /rja las gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhi ba'i tshul/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyes brgyan/ /dang po phreng ba rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /'og ma skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag can/ /thugs kar bde gshegs gtsug tor ni//sgu mdog ser po dbu rgyan 'khor lo bsnams/ /shar phyogs rdo rje gtsug tor di//sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /lho phyogs rin chen gtsug tor ni/ /sku/ mdog sngo skya rin chen nor bu bsnams/ /nub phyogs chos kyi gtsug tor ni/ /sgu mdog dmar skya pad+ma bum pa bsnams/ /byang phyogs las kyi gtsug tor ni/ /sku mdog ljang ser rgya gram lcags kyu bsnams/ /de lnga thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas / /rgyu 2las gtsug tor chen po bcu/ /dkar sngo dmar ljang mthing ga dang / /sngo skya dmar nag kha dog bcu/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa / /g.yas pa gtsug tor g.yon bum pa/ /re rer 'khor yang bcu bcus bskor/ /'khor lo pad+ma'i lte dbus nas/ /brjed pa'i tshul du mnyam gnas te/ /phyogs bcu 5rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dbang bskur yi ge thig le bkod/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā/ spyi bo lce dang snyeng ga dang / /lte ba gsang ba'i gnas rnams so6/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon ta na phrin las lngas/ /byen gyis brlabs pa'i cho 'phrul lo/ /oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ dīḥ7ha/ spyi bo rna ba g.yas g.yon dang / /ltag pa dpral ba dag tu dgod/ /'khor lo rdo rje rin chen dang / /pad+ma rgya gram phyag mtshan sogs/ /rigs kyi bdag pos dbang bsgur ba'i cho 'phrul lo/ /rdzogs pa'i sgu mchog thugs ka nas/ /gsang ba'i yi ge 'phru bzhi 'phros/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags 38—65bye

—— —— —sgrog dril/ /tshad med sgo ba chen mo bzhi/ /byams pa snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms so/ /dhū pe puṣ+pe ā lo ke /gabye mchod pa'i lha mo bzhis/ /bde gshegs kun la mchod par dmigs/ /byams pa'i lha mos bdug 1pa dbul2/ /snying rje'i lha mos me tog dbul/ /dga' ba'i lha mos mar me dbul / /btang snyoms lha mos byug pa dbul4/ /so so'i 5sku mchog tshim nas kyang / /bsgul don byas nas 'od zer 'dus/ /lha mo de dag thams cad kyis / /mig dang rna ba sna lce lus/ /'dod pa'i lha mo lnga 'phros te/ /gzugs sgra dri dang ro reg bya/ /gzugs kyi lha mos spyan la mchod/ /sgra yi lha mos snyan la mchod/ /dri yi lha mos shangs la mchod/ /ro yi lha mos ljags la mchod/ /reg bya'i lha mos sgu la mchod/ /thams cad 'phros te bdag la thim/ /gnyis su med pa'i mchod pa'i cho 'phrul lo/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du spyan drang ba ni / phyogs bcu rab 'byams 'jig rten na/ /rgyal ba gang bzhugs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtsug tor chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /e bye hi bha ga bān/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā sarba ta thā ga toṭī ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūṃ/rgyal ba 'khor bcas tshur gshegs gdan la bzhugs/ /rin chen stegs dang seng ge'i khri/ /nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan/ /ma nyams tshul khrims brtan pa'i gnas 'dir bzhugs/ /pad+ma sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ srid gsum ston pa mi dang lha yi lha / /bcom ldan mgon po shākya seng ge yi9/ /mthon mthing g.yas su 'khyil nga/'i spyi gtsug na/ /ya mtshan rmad byung gtsug tor gdugs dkar sku/ /srid gsum 'dren pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rnam lnga rim bzhin dbulaX/ /38—6 56

—bcom ldan shākya thub pa yi/ /dbu rgyan rin chen gtsug tor las/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i gtsug tor gdugs dkar sgu/ /zhal gcig mche gabyugs ye shes gdong 1mig can/ /phyag bzhi rigs bzhi nyon mongs bdud bzhi 'joms/ /rang bzhin rgyas pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes dbu stong kha dog cir yang gsal / /phyag ni 'bum phrag sprul pa'i phyag mtshan rnams2/ /thugs rje go cha cis kyang mi thub gsal / /'bar ba'i mtshan rtags thugs rje nyi ma ltar/ /thugs rje 'bar ba'i 'od zer kun la khyab/ /rig sngags drag po phra men tshogs 'joms shing / /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad pa/ /log pa'i skyon rnams sel la phyag 'tshal lo4/ /shākya thub pa lcags kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i lte 6dbus su/ /rja las 'khor lo 8rtsibs brgyad pa//gsang sngags 'dis ni legs par bskor/ /bsnyen pa 'bum phrag drug bya'o/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/ bī re dī re/ badz+ra dha ra di / ban+dha bad+dhā/ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ hūṃ dzñā bad+dhā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā / zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod rnams/ /gsang sngags 'dis ni 'grub par gsungs/ /sngags re yungs kar re rer sprul/ /bcad dam bskrad nas phur bus rdeg /rin chen lnga sogs bum pa la/ /khro bo'i lha rnams bsgom byas te/ /khrus kyi cho ga legs nga/ra bya/ /gtsang ba'i gos kyis rab brgyan te/ /shar phyogs sgo nas phyag 'tshal bshags/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yisaḥ/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i 5sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun nyan thos kyi 38—637

—dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs nga/ dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan rgyas pa ut+pa la bsung gi tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun du bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo//bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom nga/ yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas sā la'i dbang po'i rgyal po me tog kun du rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+mo'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glang po'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo//38—658

gzhon nu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten na dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten na yang dag par spong 1ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha'i drang srong dmod pa 'dor ba dang / /phan 'dogs nus pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig sngags 'dzin grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan drag po dka' thub zlog pa'i bdag po dang lhan cig pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo /legs ldan nag po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig 2par byed pa dur khrod na gnas par mos pa ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bum pa rgyan ldan lnga rnams la/ /gtso bo'i sngags rnams legs brjod cing / /brgya rtsa brgyad du brjod par bya/ /dbang bskur bsrung ba'i tshig 'di brjod/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mos/ dus thams cad du bdag la dbang bsgur zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ dus gsum bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku/ /gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che/ /gtum pa chen mo stobs chen mo//'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid che/ /dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba gos dkar mo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ /rgyal ba'i rdo rje phreng zhes grags/ /pad+mas 4mngon mtshon rdo rjes mtshan5/ /gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can/ /rdo rje 6mkhar bsnams 7'joms pa mo/ /drag po'i lha 38—659

rnams thams cad kyis/ /bdag la srung /bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod ma / /gzugs zhi gzi brjed chen mo can/ /'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan dang / /rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin ma/ /lag na rdo rje rigs gser phreng 4/ /le brgan rtsi dang rin chen ma/ /snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags/ /rnam par bsgyings ma'i rdo rje dang / /gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma/ /rdo rje sgros dang dkar mo dang / /pad+ma'i spyan dang zla 'od dang / /phyag rgya'i tshogs de dag thams cad kyis/ bdag la srung 5bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas phyogs bcu'i gtsug tor rnams kyis dbang bskur / gsang sngags brjod/ oṃ ṛ shi ga na pra shasta ya ta thā ga toṭī ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūṃ dzñā/ a bye ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ phyi ma gong gis 'gre7/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can/ rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad pa/ kun nas bdag la bsrung du gsol/ /'jigs pa chen po nyi shu las bsrung du gsol/ /gdon nyi shu rtsa gcig las bdag rgyal bar mdzad du gsol / sha za'i gdon sum cu rtsa gcig las bdag bsrung du gsol/ gdon de dag thams cad kyi rig / sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /kun du rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab po/ /mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad 1 do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /phyug bdag chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /38—660

sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab po/ /nam mkha' lding 1dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo / /nag po chen po dang ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad 2do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /rgyal bar byed pa dang sbrang rtsir byed pa dang don kun grub pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /sring mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /byeng gi ri ti dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang / tshogs kyi bdag po dang / lhan byug pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dge spyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /gsang 4ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes byas pa'i rig sngags gcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo 5can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag la bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol / oṃ a si tā na 'dirka pra bhā sgu 7ṭa bi ka si tā ta pa tre dz+wa la dz+wa la/ khā da khā da/ dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ tshin+da tshin+da / bhin+da byen+da/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ he te phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo ghā ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha tā —ya phaṭa/ pa ra pra dā phaṭa/ a su ra bi dā ba ṇa ka rā ya phaṭa/ sarba de ba bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba nā ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba a su re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ma ru te bh+yaḥphaṭa / sarba ga ru ḍi bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba gan+dhar+bhe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kin na re 38—66/

yul phyogs bcas pa'i ming rus bris/ /cho ga bzhin du phur bus gdab/ /bud med gang zhig bu 'dod pas/ /dag cing gtsang mar khrus byas nas/ /zhi ba'i rgyan dang ldan par bya/ /gtsug tor snying po 'bum phrag brjod/ /byis pa'i gdon rnams phur bus gdab/ /yul dang grong khyer srung 'dod pas/ /phyogs bcu'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng / /phyogs bcu'i 2gtsug tor bzhengs su gsol / /mchod pa'i cho ga bcu bcu bya/ /gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad du brjod / /grong khyer gtso bo dbus su ni/ /gtsug tor gtso bo lnga bzhengs te/ /dkyil 'khor chen po rgyas par bya/ /gzungs kyang 'bum tshar gdon par bya/ /de ltar lan bdun byas gyur na/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i bsod nams 'grub/ /thams cad gcod bzlog rig sngags 'di/ /ston pas sngon sangs rgyas tshe gsungs / /gzhan yang 'di yi yon tan ni/ /bye ma snyed du brjod mi lang / /ma 'ongs 'gro ba thams cad kyi/ /bsod nams thams cad bskyed pa dang / /rkyen rnams thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje lta bu'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /shes rab ldan pas rtogs par shog /gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i sgrub thabs / slob dpon bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //38—663

༄/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra tiṣ+ṭha bi dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'phags ma 2gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rje btsun sprul pa yi/ /rang bzhin lha mo gus btud de/ /rab gnas cho ga bsdus pa yi/ /man ngag rim pa bri bar bya/ /de la gang zag thams cad la/ /rab gnas 'thad pa ma yin te/ /skye ba med pa'i ngo bo la/ /gang gis 4gang la ji ltar ni/ /rab tu gnas par bya ba 5yod/ /kun rdzob la yang gnas pas ni/ /de yi byin rlabs 6mi shes pas//rab gnas cho ga 'thad pa min/ /las dang po yi rnal 'byor la/ /rgyud sbyangs dad dang nges bskyed phyir/ /rab tu gnas pa 7bya bar gsungs/ /de la dang por slob ma yis/ /gzhi dang rdzas rnams tshogs gyur nas/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la/ /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /gnang ba byin la 38—666

bla ma yis/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga brtsam she7 par bya/ /rab 'bring rtags dang ldan pas ni/ /sta gon cho ga la 'bad bya/ /sa chog byel sogs sngon 'gro sa'isnye/ /dkyil 'khor khrus kyi stegs bu dag /bstar ba ba yi rnam lngas byug /brtan ma'i cho ga yan lag bya/ /de nas bum pa mtshan nyid ldan/ /bkru dang brgyan pa la sogs bya/ /rang rang mtshan ma bkod la gzhag /bskyed dang bzlas pa rdzogs par bya/ /rnam rgyal bum par chu bsdus la/ /gzungs thag rdo rjes bzung la gzhag /de nas mchod bstod je rgyas par bya'o/ /bum pa sta gon bya ba'o/ /zla ba drug dang gza' bzhi dang / /rgyu skar bcu bzhi la bab dang / /tshes grangs bdun gyi grangs nyid labye/ /rgyas pa'i rab gnas la sogs bya/ /de nas rab tu gnas pa'i gzhi/ /dgram dang 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan gyes/ /gnas khang brgyan dang mchod pa bsham/ /lugs ma la sogs stegs bu ste/ /ras ris la sogs byang du bsgrig /khrus dang mchod pa'i rdzas tshogs bya/ /ras ris sku la dkris byas te 6/ /byur bsal la sogs cho ga ni/ /yungs kar chu dang 'bru zan dang / /drur bas byabs te sbyang bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ba dra zhes pa'i sngags kyis so/ /de nas ba yi rnam lnga dang / /bdud rtsi lnga yis snod bkang la/ /drur ba'i pir gyis bkru bar rtsobya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ de nas til mar dri zhim pa/ /spos kyis bsgos pas gong ltar byug /de yi sngags ni 'di yin te/ /oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hri baṃ/ de nas de — bsal ba'i phyir/ /u dusmra sher shir+sha dang / /a shwaṅga dang n+ya gro dang / /parka ti yi shun pa yi/ /phye mas bskus te bkru bar bya/ /de nas skyu ru ra sogs pa/ /38—667

— — — ————byed———— ———————byed—————byed————byed——byed———— —'dag chal kun gyis byug par bya/ /de nas bum pa'i chu gtsang dang / /dri zhim bdud rtsi lnga yis bkru/ /bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /grub pa'i rig / 'dzin la sogs kun/ /bkra shis brjod dang mchod bstod bsam/ /lha mos chu ni blugs bsam/ stechi / /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs/ pa khrus/ gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gso/la lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bye ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye 4āḥswā hā/de nas/ chu yi thigs pa dag /ras bal 'jam pas phyi bar bya/ /ras ris glegs bam la so/gas nga// /dngos/ su bkru ba med pa la/ /me long sogs la khrus sogs bya/ /de ni khrus kyi cho ga yin/ /tsan+dan gnyis/ dang gur gum dang / /lang gu ldan te dri lnga yis/ /rten la thig le byas de nas/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+dha āḥhūṃ swā hā/ de nas mchod pa rnam lnga sogs / /rang rang sngags kyis dbul bar bya/ /de nas ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /nam mkhar spyan drangs mchod bstod la/ /khyad par rigs kyi lha bltas te/ /thugs ka spyi bo mgrin pa dang / /phrag pa rdo rje dang bcas pas /reg la lag tu spos thogs te/ /pus mo sar btsugs lce hūṃ las/ /rdo rje dmar por bya ste brjod/ /bcom ldan gtsug tor gdugs dkar can/ /rig sngags rgya'/ la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can khyod kyis7/ /sang rgo rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal/ /slob ma la ni brtse ba dang / /khyod rnams la ni mchod pa'i phyir/ /gus pas bdag dang de la ni/ /bcom ldan bka' drin mdzad pa'i rigs/ /'gro ba 'khor lo'i bya don phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /dgra bcom byang chub sems rnams dang / /28———668

———————— —— ————— — ——————— ——— byed—————byedabyed— byed—gang yang sngags kyi lha gzhan dang / /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /bstan pa la ni mngon dga' zhing / /byang chub la brten 'byung po dang / /rdo rje spyan ldan sems can rnams/ /rdo rje 'chang chen che ge bdag /rigs 1pa yi ni rgyal po yi / /ji ltar nus pa'i mchod pa dang / /'gro ba zhi bas rab gnas bgyid/ /slob ma mchod dang bdag la ni/ /khyod kyis thugs brtse nyer bzung nas/ /rab gnas 'di la thams cad kyis/ /thugs brtser ldan pas gnas par mdzod/ /de nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes/ /nam mkha'i lha rnams dam tshig bstim pa / /byen rlabs dbang bsgur rgyas gdab bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnam lnga dang / /sgra yi tshogs pa dpag med dbul/ /de nas bum chus slar yang bkru/ /de nas lha yi sngags dag ni/ /skyon lnga spangs la bzlas par bya/ /de nas dang por gsol btab la/ / rnam par 4byon par 'dod pa yis/ /tshigs bcad yang ni yi ge bya/ /mtha' ma muḥyis mtshan pas gshegs/ /rdzas kyis g.yogs te gzhag par bya/ /slob ma yod na sta gon bya/ /'di ni lha yi sta gon no/ /de nas/ thig tshon la sogs bya ba ni/ /rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga ltar / /mchod pa'i dngos po gser thur dang / /rgyan dang sku chings glegs shing dang / /na bza' la sogs rgyas par bya/ /dkyil 'khor babyed la bzlas sogs bya/ /dbang blang dam tshig rdzogs par bya/ /de nas gzhi ma bkru la sogs//gong gi cho ga ltar bya'o/ /de nas sa bon lha bkug la/ /nam mkha' gnas la mchod bstod bya/ /spos dang rdor dril thogs nas su/ /pus btsugs gong ltar byin brlabs te/ /sang ni rab gnas bgyid lags na/ /zhes nga/ bgyid par 'tshal du bsgyur/ /de nas ye shes spyan drangs la/ dzaḥt+t+waṃ baṃ hoḥs 38—669

— —— — —————— —— ——————byed——————dgug gzhug bya/ /de nas/ mchod bstod rol mo'i sgra/ /dpag med mchod dang gnas gsum brlab/ /dbang bsgur byas te bum chus bkru/ /rnam snang rang gi rigs kyi lha/ /gang yin pas ni rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas dbang gzhan rim pas bskur/ /oṃ badz+ra ā bha ra na rtabi ju ṣa ṇi 2 swā hā/ zhes pas rgyan gyis mchod pa 'bul/ /de nas rang rang rigs kyis bstod/ /gser thur a dza na byugs nga/sa/ /spyan dbye sngags ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ tsagru sa man+ta tsakyu bi sho dha rgo 'adz+re swā hā/ oṃ an+da sa mā bye dh+yā rgo pri ṇa cane+e swā hā/ zhes pas bza' ba bzang po dbul/ /de nas bdud rtsi 'khyel pa yi/ /sngags kyis 5zhabs bkod dbul ba ni/ /rdo rje bzung ba'i lag g.yas kyis/ /lan gsum bskor la brtan par bya/ /de nas su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes pas gnas su gzhug par bya/ /de nas mchod bstod rgyas par bya/ /de nas bla mas slob ma la/ /khyod kyis nga la gsol btab pa'i/ /sgu gzugs dag ni khyad par du/ /ji be+ed gsungs bzhin spyan dbye ba/ /de ni ngas kyang byas 'gyur te/ /khyod kyi de ni kun sdob pas/ /byu bde bar ni mchod par byos/ /zhes bya zhal khebs la sogs bya/ /de nas slob mas mchod pa dang / /bla ma yon gyis mnyes par byas / /bla mas legs ldan gtor mas mchod/ /byin chen bkra shis yun ring du/ /bzhugs par bka' yis chos skyong bsgo/ /gsol btab la sogs bla mas bya/ /slob ma'i sgrib pa gzhom pa dang / /rang gi lhag chad bskang ba'i phyir / /sbyin sreg cho gas bskang bar bya/ /basbu gshegs smon lam gdab par bya/ /mchod bstod la sogs rgyas par bya/ /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga 'di//kā ma bye nu'i rjes 'brangs te/ /pad+ma'i lcags kyus mtshan pa yi/ /dge slong gis 38——670

1809༄༅/ /'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa sgrub pa'i thabs 1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya si tā ta pa tre a pa rā dzi ta sā dha māṃ/bod skad du/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa sgrub pa'i thabs / gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por tho rangs langs te/ byang chub kyi sems dran par byas la/ rang tha mal pa'i snying ga phye ba'i steng du zla ba nya ba la oṃ dkar po bsams te/ de'i 'od kyis rang gi sdig pa dag pa dang / kha dang ba sru'i bu ga nas 'thon te/ sems can gyi don byas shing / 'og min nas gdugs dkar mo can/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor 4ba mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs te/phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / skyabs su 'gro ba dang / lam bsten 5pa dang /sems bskyed de/ yan lag lnga pa byas la/ de'i bsod nams byang chub tu bsngo 38—673

——— —sde ——— — — —— —sde—— — sde———byed————byed—byedabyed————bar bya'o/ /de nas byams/ snying rje dga' ba btang snyom/sa bsgo ma par bya'o/ /de nas sno da bcud ma/ 'u/sa/ nga/ basbus/ te/ stong nga/ nyid dmigs/ la/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dzñā badz+ra swa ghā ba āt+ma kopho haṃ zhes/ brjod do/ /de'i rjes/ su paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du a la/sa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dmigs la/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po dang bcas nga/ra gyur nga/ las/ gdugs/ dkar mo can gyi sku bsam ste/ zhal gsum nga/ la phyag drug ma/ /sku/ mdog dkar mo 'gying bag can/ /dbus dkar g.yas sngo g.yo/na dam/ra zhal/ /spyan gsu/ma khro mo'i lta stangs can/ /g.yas pa 'khor lo lcags/ kyu mda'/ /g.yon pa rdo rje dkar po gzhu/ /zhags pa dang bcas sdigs mdzub nyid/ /gza' kun 'joms/ par byed pa ma/ /skyil krung phyed nga/'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /lha yi rgyan dang na bza' ldan/ /rnam snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan 4ma/ /de ltar bdag nyid lha mor bsam/ /de'i snying gar pad+ma'i steng zla ba la/ oṃ dkar ngo/'i 'od zer gyis/ ye shes/ sems dpa' spyan drangs la gzhug 5pa dang / dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi dbu rgyan kyi bdag po rnam snang gis rgyas gdab ste/ ye ge gsum gyes byin gyes brlabs la phyag rgya bcas te/'a/ga nga/ khu tshur snying gar bca' ste/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur g.yas pa'i mdzub mo nas gyen du blta bar bya'o/ /sngas/sa bzlas pa ni/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre a pa rā dzi ta sarba gra hā na tra yā yā ya yā ha na dzñā dzñā hūṃ hūṃ 8 phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o//gtor ma/ ni yi ge gsu/ma gyis/ byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+pan na tāta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor mas sbyin par bya'o/ /'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //28——67 /

༄khya/ /bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rjam par rgyal ma la bstod pa/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga wa ti uṭī ṣa bi dza ya sto tra/ bod skad du/bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma la bstod pa/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtso mo bcom ldan 'das ma ni/ /puṇ+ḍa rī 2 ka'i me tog ltar/ /skyon gyis ma gos sgu mdog dkar/ /zhal gsum phyag brgyad spyan gsum mnga' / /dbu rgyan mgul rgyan snyan char bcas/ /rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pas brgyan/ /pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dbus dkar g.yas ser g.yon zhal sngo/ /khro mo'i cha lugs mche ba gcigs/ /phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /pad steng rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /mda' dang mchog sbyin phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang / /gzhu dang mi 'jigs phyag rgya dang / /bum pa dag ni legs par bsnams/ /rnam par snang mdzad dbu brgyan 4cing / /'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du/ /stod g.yogs 38—676

———— — — —byed—byed—————byed— —— byed——— byed— — ——— — — — ——byed— —— ——lha yi na bza' can/ /blo dang tshe 'phe'/ mdzad pa mo/ /ngu/ ri'i nang du ma/dzes/ par bzhugs// /bcom ldan 'das/ ma nyid la bstod/ /g.yas na rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /n+tu/ mdog dkar ngo/ skyon ma bros/ /g.yo/na na nga/da bsna mas/ g.yas nga/ na/ /rnga yab 'dzin 'a/ bdag phyag 'tshal/ /g.yo/na gyi gsang ba'i bdag po ni/ /ut+pal mdog 'dra rdo rje g.yo/na/ /g.yas pa rnga yab mdzes/ 'dzin pa/ /mthu sto/bas can 'a/ phyag 'tshal 'o// /shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi / /khro bo'i rgyal ngo/ bzhi ngo/ ni/ /mdun na khro rgyal mi g.yo/ ba/ /sngo bsangs g.yas na ral gri 'dzin/ /g.yon na sdigs mdzub skra brdzes/ pa/ /sbrul rgyan stag gi sham thabs can/ /nga/d+ma nyi ma'i gdan 'a/ bzhugs/ /ma rungs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni/ /sngo bsangs lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams / /ma rungs 'dul ba'i rgyan cha can/ /thams cad 'gugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro chen dbyug pa sngon po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa na/ /dbyug to g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad/ /sngo bsangs kun 'dul khyod la bstod//khro bo'i rgyal po spyobs po che/ /ut+pal mdog 'dra phyag gnyis pa/ /g.yas pa rdo rje sdigs mdzub g.yon/ /bdud 'dul drag po khyod la bstod/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgu mdog sngo/ /kun kyang stag dang sbrul gyis brgyan/ /pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /bar chad zhi mdzad khyed la bstod/ /steng gi phyogs na mdzes pa yi/ /gnas gtsang lha yi bu gnyis po/ /lha yi bu ni gnyis po yang /lha yi rgyan dang na bzas mdzes/ /phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams/ /bdud rtsi'i char 'be+ebs kun la snyoms/ /dag pa'i sgu la phyag 'tshal bstod2/ /gang zhig nangs nangs sngar langs te/ /bstod pa 'di yis dus kun du/ /38—677

༄༅/ /'phags ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo la bstod pa/ 1༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya uṭī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sto tra/ bod skad du / 'phags ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo la bstod pa/ 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid gsum ston pa mi dang lha yi lha/ /mtshungs med bde gshegs shākya seng ge yi/ /mthon mthing g.yas su 'khyel pa'i spyi gtsug nas/ /ya mtshan rmad byung lha mo khro rgyal gtso/ /khams gsum dag na khyod 'dra'i mgon med de/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug bkra shis mchog gi lha/ /sgu mdog gangs ri'i rtse la nyi shar 'dra/ /zhal mang stong la spyan mang bye bas brgyan / /srid pa'i btson rar sems can nyam thag pa'i/ /sbug bsngal gzigs nas sems can nyam 2 thag la/ /zhal stong phyag stong spyan ni stong rnams kyis / /kun la khyab mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs phas kyi rgol ba rnams/ /spyan mnga' gcig gis khro gnyer 'ga' ston pas/ /38—679

———— ——— —— — — —— byed—byed———byedabyed— byed—byed byedaganod pa'i rgyun rnams gtan nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /rgol ba tshar gcod khyod la phyag 'tsha'/ bstod/ /ma rig nor pas bslus pa'i sems can rnams/ /rang gi las kyi rnam par smin pa yis/ /'du ba rnam bzhi'i rims nad mi bzad pa/ /zhi mdzad thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ji ltar khyod kyis sems can mang po la/ /thugs rje mchog gis 'gro don nyer bzung nas/ /srid gsum 'jigs pa che las bsgral gyur cing / /sdug bsngal mang po'i nad las thar mdzad ltar/ /bdag kyang khyod bzhin 'gro ba'i mgon gyur te/ /sems can klu yi zhags pas zin pa dang / /nad kyi bskal pas nyen pa'i sems can la/ /sdug bsngal sel ba'i skyabs su bdag gyur cig /'phags pa gdugs dkar can la bstod pa / slob dpon gi ri wa tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //38 — 680

༄khya/ /'phags ma rig pa chen mo so sor 'brang ma'i 'khor lo/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ma hā pra tis re bit+yā tsakra ni baṃ dha ṭaṃ2/bod skad du/ 'phags ma rig pa chen mo so sor 'brang ma'i 'khor lo/'gro ba thams cad kyi bsam pa rdzogs par byed pa'i bcom ldan 'das so sor 'brang ma la phyag 'tshal te/ gus pas mdo yi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rgyal bas bstan pa'i lus 4bsrung ba/ /'khor lo de yi mtshan nyid brjod/ /de la dang por re zhig tshes grangs dang rgyu skar bzang po la sogs pa'i nyi ma la bab nas phyogs gtsang ma yid du 'ong bar gci bas 5byugs te/ rten bzhi dang ldan pa'i bla re bres la rdul tshon dkar po'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang ge sar bcas pa'i dbus su 'khor lo'i mtshan ma'o/ /nang dang phyi rol du 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas phyogs su nag po la sogs pa'i spyon dang bral ba/ dri zhim po'i chus yongs su bkang la/38—682

ras bzang pos mgul pa dkris pa/ tsu 1ta'i lo ma dang bcas pa 'bras bu lnga dang / shing sna lnga lto bar bcug pa'i bum pa lnga rnams yang dag par gzhag par bya'o/ /lnga pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus so/ /de rnams kyi steng du 'o thug gi phor ba gzhag par bya zhing / shar du 'o ma/ lhor sbrang rtsi/ nub tu sha ka ra—/ byang du mar me ste kham phor gang ba re re gzhag par bya'o/ /mtshams su dri zhim pos gang ba'i kham phor bzhi gzhag par bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol du phyogs bzhir sor brgyad kyi tshad tsam tsan+dan dmar pos yongs su bsgos pa'i skud pa dmar po yongs su bcings pa'i seng sdeng gi phur pa btsugs te/ yungs kar dang / oṃ gha gha ghā kyeta la sogs pa'i sngags kyis gdab par bya'o/ /bu mo gzhon nus bkal ba'i skud pas yongs su dkri bar bya'o/ /me tog dang /bdug spos dang / mar me dang / dri dang / lha bshos la sogs pa dang chu'i ro dbul bar bya'o/ /sngags shes pas mnyam par gzhag la/ bzlas pa la brtson pa/ gtsang khrus byas pa bsnyen gnas la nye bar gnas pa'i slob dpon kyis so sor 'brang 4ma'i sngags khri bzlas par bya'o/ /tsan+dan bdug pa nyid dang yang / /a ka ru ni de bzhin du/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang du ru ka /ga pur tsan+dan chus bkrus nas/ /zla ba yi ni chus bkrus te/ /bdug spos kyis kyang bdug 5byas shing / /dri zhim me tog rnams kyis dkris/ /brtse dang byams pa'i sems 'jug pas/ /shar du mngon par phyogs te/ gtsang zhing 'jam pa'i stan la nye bar 'dug ste/ rang gi lha'i nga rgyal du byas pa'i sngags pas phyogs skyong 6rnams la gtor ma byin nas/ gtor ma chen po'i tshigs su bcad pa bklag par bya'o/ /ma ni ka'i gzhi la gnas pa'i go ro tsa na dang / gur kum 38—683

dang / ga pur dang / tsan+dan dang / ma la ka rnams kyi ras dkar po'am/gro ga tshad dang ldan pa la/ kun+da dang a la ka'i myu gus 'khor lo brtsam par byas te1/ 'khor lo de'i dbus su paṃ 1yig sa bon gyi yi ge la /hūṃ brgyad kyis bskor ba'o/ /de'i dbus su oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+re ṇi ma hā pra ti sā 4re che ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pa bri'o/ /'phar ma gnyis pa la/ oṃ shi kha le shi s+t+waṃ ka re ghu ṭa gh+ra ṭa ni/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya gha ṭa ni che ge mo shādzhai ku ru swā hā zhes pa bri/ 'phar ma gsum pa la oṃ bha ya nā 5sha ni tā sa ni tā sa ni/ tā sa ya tā sa ya/ tā sa ya bi ku ṭi be+e ṭa ta she 6te she te/ dza ta ni che ge mo puje ku ru swā hā zhes pa bri'o/ /'phar ma bzhi pa la ji tsam 'dod pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi dang / de'i bar du rdo rje rtse gsum pa bzhi bri bar bya zhing / pad+ma rnams la hūṃ brgyad kyis bskor ba'i shaṃ gyi yi ge'i sa bon bri bar bya'o/ /de'i dbus su oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+re ṇi ma hā pra ti sā 7re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pa bri'o/ /shar gyi pad+ma'i phyi rol du/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo ki ni garba saṃ rak+ṣa ni ā kar+ṣa ni che ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pa bri'o/ /lho'i pad+ma'i phyi rol du/ oṃ bhā ra bhu ra/saṃ bhā ra saṃ bhā ra in+d+ra ya ba la 9bi sho dha ne+e ru ru tsa le hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pa bri'o/ /nub kyi pad+ma'i phyi rol du/ oṃ a mṛ te a mṛ te ba re ba re pra ba ra bi shudhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pa bri'o/ /byang gi pad+ma'i phyi rol du/ oṃ bi snyaphu la bi ma/ 'a/ dza ya ba re a mṛ te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pa bri'o/ /rdo rje rnams kyi ra ཿdbus ma la/ me ru oṃ bi ma le hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bden bral du/ oṃ dza ya ba re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rlung du/ o be+e sgo ṭa ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dbang ldan du/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pa bri'o/ /38—684

pad+ma dang rdo rje'i bar du gnas pa'i gzhir oṃ ni sum̐ bha badz+ra bhā 3hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pa bri bar bya'o/ /'phar ma lnga pa la byā ཿ'i 2yi ge'i phreng ba nyi shu rtsa lnga bri bar bya'o/ /'phar ma drug pa la oṃ a pa rā dzi ta ma hā de bi tra ta/ oṃ kā —la kad+ngha ku ṭa/ oṃ su ya dan tri hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ma rde ku she hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shri khaṃ le hūṃ/oṃ she te hūṃ/ oṃ ma hā she te hūṃ/ oṃ ma hā kā la hriḥ5/ oṃ ru tri ru ta/ oṃ badz+ra ru ti tra 6ṭa/ oṃ badz+ra khri 3li tweḥ/ oṃ badz+ra pā shi ho/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bye 8ta / oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā ba le twe9ཿ/ oṃ badz+ra mā le saṃ/ oṃ a mṛ ta li ri ka gya rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ 'phar ma bdun pa la/ oṃ tsun+de tweḥ/ oṃ ma ṇi tsurte 7dīḥ/oṃ su baṇ+ḍi 11ki shi kra ta/ oṃ ge nale la/ oṃ bi bhu na mā 1 li ni dza hūṃ/ oṃ shārnye hūṃ/ oṃ bu ta sā dha ne+e hā/ oṃ sum̐ bha ka ri hūṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri hūṃ/ oṃ ma hā pra ti sā re hūṃ/ oṃ ba la 2dha ni hūṃ/ o ma hā tā re dza hūṃ/ o ma ra bhu ge lo/oṃ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ pu ru pu ru/ ku ru ku ru/ hūṃ hūṃ ru ru tsa le ka su sarak+ṣa ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'phar ma brgyad pa la/ oṃ na re tram̐/oṃ rāk+ṣa si ki dzi te dze+e/ oṃ bhū ta rak+ṣi ti te haṃ/ oṃ ka li ni slodzha/ go lo sha ri lam̐/ oṃ dha bya la/ oṃ ki shi ni k+ṣ-i/ oṃ ha rī ta tram̐ k+ṣi/ oṃ pabye hūṃ/oṃ shi khi ni saṃ ru ta/ oṃ ku ta dzi 7dz+re bhi kri ṭa 8/ oṃ shi ya de bi she/ oṃ sa ra sha ri lo/ o pad+me saṃ/ oṃ mā ma tī oṃ/ oṃ bye 19ku ṭa bye/ oṃ bubye haṃ/ oṃ k+ṣi te ke bh+ra yi ge ka gya rak+ṣa ku ru māṃ2 / 'phar ma dgu pa la/ rdo rje 'greng bu sum cu rtsa gnyis bri bar bya'o/ /de rnams kyi sa bon gyi yi ge 'di rnams bri bar bya'o/ /k+ṣe/ sru shaṃ/ rja oṃ/ tram̐/ haṃ/ kā/ k+ṣ-i/ haṃ/sgo / dze+e/ yi/ tī / rī/ byā/ hūṃ/ dīḥ/ saṃ/ hūṃ/ dze+e/ sum̐/38—685

༄ga /so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/1༄4/ /so sor 'brang ma 2chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar bstan pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ a las skyes pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du yi ge shaṃ ser po 'od zer sna tshogs las sems can gyi don byed pa ste/de yongs su gyur pa las 4skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo so sor 'brang mar bdag nyid bskyed par bya'o/ /mdog ser mo zhal bzhi pa spyan gsum pa/ phyag brgyad pa ste/ zhal dang po ser po dang / g.yas pa dkar ba / rgyab sngo ba/ g.yon dmar po/ g.yas kyi phyag rnams kyis ral gri dang /'khor lo dang / rtse gsum dang / mda' rnams dang / g.yon kyi phyag rnams 5kyis gzhu dang / zhags pa dang / dgra sta dang / rdo rje rnams 'dzin pa'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la rol pas bzhugs pa/ 'od zer dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can/ rgyan thams cad kyis 38—695

brgyan 1pa/ gos sna tshogs kyi na bza' bsnams pa/ shing nga dpung chad dang /rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan can/ 'di ltar bsams la/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ dkar po dang /dmar po dang / sngon po'i yi ge gsum bsam par bya'o/ /de nas nu ma'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i yi ge rja bsams nas/ sna tshogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis 1bdag nyid mchod par bsams 4te/ ji srid du ngal bar ma gyur pa de srid du spyo bas bsgom par bya'o/ /ngal bar gyur na rang gi snying ga'i zla ba la sngags mu tig gi phreng ba'i tshul du bzlas 5par bya'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+re ma hā pra ti sā re t+t+waṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni sngags so// /so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/695 1ma tshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉lhar bkod/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyed/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉nga sa / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smar 〉rabasnam/sa/(‘96 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉rgyan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sum̐s/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sum̐/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉thasam// 〈〈nge 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉zlas / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadz+ra ṇi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sa//38——696
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1741)38wa 697

1815༄༅/ /rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/1 ༄7/ /de bzhin du sngar bstan pa'i cho gas stong pa nyid kyi rjes la sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la/ rma yig ljang gu yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags ma rma bya chen mo mdog ljang gu/ zhal gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ zhal so so la spyan gsum pa ste/ zhal g.yas dang g.yon sngon po dang dkar po'o/ /g.yas kyi phyag gsum la go rims bzhin du rma bya'i mjug sgro dang / mda' dang mchog sbyin pa'o/ /phyag g.yon pa gsum na rin po che'i snye ma dang / gzhu dang /phang par gnas pa'i bum pa'o/ /sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang sham thabs can/sgeg nga/ lang tsho la bab pa'i cha lugs can/ zla ba'i 'od dang ldan pa'i gdan can / phyed kyi skyil krung can/ /don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan can du skad cig gis bskyed la/ de'i spyi bo dang / gog ma dang / snying ga dang /lte ba rnams su zla ba la go rims ji lta bar/ oṃ āḥsaṃ hūṃ zhes pa'i yi ge bsams 38—698

te spro ba dang bsdu ba bya'o/ /de nas ngal na sngags bzlas 1par bya ste/ skyes ma hā mā 2yu ri bibyā rā rnyi lha/ lha/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ /'phags ma rma bya chen mo'i sgrub thabs cardogs so// //bsdur mchan/698 51mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod/ 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tshog/699 she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bas/ 3〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ma/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1742)38wa 699

1816༄rgya/ /stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 1rak+ṣa/ /de bzhin thams cad sngar gyi cho gas stong pa nyid kyi rjes la/stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag drug pa ste/ g.yas kyi 2phyag gsum na go rims bzhin du ral gri dang / mda' dang mchog sbyin pa'o / /g.yon gyi phyag gsum na gzhu dang / zhags pa dang sta re'o/ /sna tshogs pa'i cha byad can/ na bza' dang / rgyan dang dbu rgyan dang ldan pa/gzugs dang lang tsho dang ldan pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa / rnam/ par snang mdzad kyi dbu rgyan can/ sa bon bye yig las byung ba'o//pad+ma dang zla ba'i 'od can mo / stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //38—700

༄/ /gsang sngags rjes su 'dze+en ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/1༄7/ /gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma ni phyag bzhi pa/ zhal gcig pa nag po ste/ g.yas pa'i phyag dag na rdo rje dang / mchog sbyin pa'o/ /g.yon pa'i phyag dag na dgra sta dang zhags pa'o/ /hūṃ gi sa bon can no/ /mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can zla ba'i 'od dang zla ba'i gdan can sngar bzhin no/ /'phags pa gsang sngags chen mo rjes su 'dzin ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //38—702
bsdur mchan/7༷2 nya mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉star bkod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1744)38wa 703

1818༄khya/ /bathal ba'i tshal chen mo'i sgrub thabs ba(1gas/1༄7/ /bsil ba'i 2tshal chen mo ni/ phyag bzhi zhal gcig pa/ kha dog dmar mo/ g.yas pa'i phyag gnyis na phreng ba dang 4mchog sbyin5 /g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis na rdo rje lcags kyu dang / snying gar gnas pa'i po ti'i phyag mtshan no/ /dz+re gi sa bon can/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbu rgyan can/na bza' dang rgyan dang ldan pa/ nyi ma'i 'od dang gdan can te sngar bzhin no//bsi'/ ba'i tshal gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //oṃ āḥshaṃ ma hā pra ti sā 6re hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmo ma hā mā yu — ri hūṃ/ oṃ d+dhi 8ma hā sa/ ha sra pra marda ni hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā man+t+ra a nu sa ri hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā shī ta ba ni hūṃ/ slob dpon chen po dze ta ri ༷dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa rdzogs so / / 1dang po dbus su lngas mchod/ de nas phyogs bzhir/ yang phyogs 38—70 /

1819snga / /so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i srung ba ba(1gas/1rak+ṣa/ /so sor 'brang ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar brjod pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang po re zhig sems can skyabs med pa'i nad pa rnams la mngon 4par bltas nas snying rjes de 5rnams gso bar 'dod pas smyung bar gnas par bya ste/ nyi ma shar ba'i dus su yid du 'ong ba'i bla re bres pas mdzes par byas pas dri zhim po'i 7me tog bkram pa'i sa phyogs su/ sa dang lci ba dag gis 'dom pa'i tshad tsam gyis/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi nye bar byugs nas/ de'i dbus su pad+ma lnga rnams bri bar bya'o/ /de la dbus su/ tshon rtsi dkar ngo/sa/ 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba'i zla ba la/ 'od zer dkar po dang ldan pa'i rtsibs brgyad pa ste/ phyi rol du 'khor lo'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa dang ldan pa bri bar bya'o/ /de nas shar dang lho dang nub dang byang rnams su/ rang rang ji lta ba'i rdul tshon rnams kyis dmar po dang / nag po 38 —706

dang / dkar po dang / ser po'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa rnams la go rims ji lta tshosnabar rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / zhags pa dang / g.yas su 'khyel pa'i dung rnams dang / sngar brjod pa'i kha dog rang rang gi 'od zer dang ldan pa bris nas/ de'i phyi rol du phyogs dang rjes su mthun par khyams gru bzhi pa la/rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / zhags pa dang / g.yas su 'khyil pa'i dung gis bskor bar bri bar bya'o/ /de nas dbus su pad+ma'i steng du man ji la gnas pa'i gser la sogs pa'i snod rnams sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten dri zhim po'i chus khrus byas bzhugs su gsol nas/ de'i steng du bla re 2las me tog dkar po 'phyang du gzhug par bya'o/ /de bzhin du shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su pad+ma'i 'gram du bye go rims ji lta bar tsan+dan dang / khrag dang / 'o ma dang / gur kum gyi chus gang ba'i kham phor bzhi'i steng du/ me tog gi phreng ba ljang gu dang / dmar po chodang / dkar po dang / ser po 'phyang du gzhug snyepar bya'o/ /de'i ngos gcig tu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa 'khor lo la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan bris la/ kha rgyan dang bcas pa dri zhim pa'i chus gang ba lnga gzhag par bya'o/ /de rnams la sna tshogs pa'i me tog dang /bdug pa dang / mar me dang / dri dang / lha bshos rang rang gi sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa rnams kyis mchod rten mchod nas/ so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyis dbus kyi bum pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bsngags trepar bya'o/ /de la 'di ni sngags yin te/ oṃ a mṛ te wa ra 7wa ra wa ra pra 8wa ra bi shubye/ che ge mo rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas snga ma bzhin du me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ 'bras dkar po'i zan dang / mar dang / sbrang rtsi 38—707

dang / sha ka ra la sogs pa rnams kyis gtor ma'i snod bkang nas sngags dang tshigs su bcad pa yang brjod de/ yul 'khor bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod pa dbul bar bya'o/ /t+yād 1ya je dan/ dha ra ṇi dha ra ṇi/ pra dha na sa ni/bhañdza ni 2bi dha ma ni/ ki pu ru ṣe/ sha ka le/ sā ra ti/ shu la dha re/ shudhe tsa ra ṇi4/ sgo ṣa ba ti/ sa ra a bhe/ shādhi che ge mo shar phyogs su bde legs su gyur byug swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang / /'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che/ /gnod spyin sde dpon thams cad dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang 5/ /bdag gi 6me tog spos rnams dang / /mchod pa 'di dag blang bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang / /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang / /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo shar phyogs su 7bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā / oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo ki ni/ gar+bha saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi/ a rak+ṣa ṇi che ge mo rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis shar phyogs kyi bum pa la lan bdun du mngon par bsngags par bya'o/ /de nas lho phyogs su sngar bzhin du mchod pa byas la/ nya dang sha la sogs pa'i gtor ma 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa la dbul bar bya'o/ /s+t+rad ya je dan/ shābye/ sa ra ṭi⑩/ kāṇ+ḍi/ ka ra ṭi/ kiṅka si/ ki ran+ta/ ke ra ḍi / bar bye/ abye ni / dhu ma dha ra ṇi/ hi ma ba ngoti/ bye ti sa tsa ra ṇi/pha la a gre /che ge mo lho phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang / /'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug 1 che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa rnams/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang / /mchod pa 'di dag blang bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyi 38—708

ni brtson 'grus dang / /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang / /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig1 /che ge mo lho phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ de nas oṃ bi ma la/ bi pu le/ dza ya wa re/ a mṛ ta bi ra dze che ge mo rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis lho phyogs kyi bum pa la lan bdun mngon par bsngags par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la nub phyogs su sngar bzhin mchod pa sngon du song bas spyan mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa la zho dang 'o ma la sogs pa'i gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /myud ya je dan/ ba ra mi ba ra a gre/ ba la ba te2/ ba li ni/ ni shaṃ ge/ baṃ se/ kha ri ka bi li/ tsan+d+ra ni/ ti ri ṇi/ ni ra dza ne+e/ bi dha ri ṇi/ bar+ṇa ba ti/a tsa ni/ nub phyogs su che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang / /'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa rnams/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang / /mchod pa 'di ni blang bar gyis/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang / /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang / /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo nub phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ de nas bhā ra bhā 5ra/ saṃ bhā ra saṃ bhā 6ra/ idh+ri ya ma la bi sho dha ni ru ru tsa le/ che ge mo rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis nub phyogs su bum pa la lan bdun bzlas pa'i sngags so / /7de'i rjes la byang phyogs su sngar bzhin du mchod pa byas la/ 'bras kyi 'o thug dang / nas kyi khur ba la sogs pas lus ngan po 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod pa dbul bar bya'o / /myud ya thed na/ khaṅga gasgo bi tsak+ṣa ṇi/ tsak+ṣa rā dza ne+e/ tsaje bā tā 38—709

le / bha rma papo te/ kha ra a gre/ bye ku ṭi/ ka ra a gre/ e ga a gre/pa ra ga pha ti1/ sā raṅga pa ti/ tsan+d+ra kādhi2/ byang phyogs su che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang / /'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa rnams/ /bdag gi me tog spos dag dang / /mchod pa 'di ni blang bar gyis/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang / /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang / /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur byug /che ge mo byang phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+rī ṇi/ ma hā pra ti sa re/ che ge mo rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'dis byang phyogs su bum nga/ la lan bdun bsngags par bya'o/ /slar yang dbus su mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas te/ mtshams rnams dang steng dang 'og na gnas pa rnams la/ sna tshogs pa'i gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ myud ya je dan/ brad+me brah+ma gho ṣe brah+ma swā re/ badz+re badz+ra gho ṣe/ thi re thi re/ sā re/ a tsa le/a raṇ+ḍi/ ra ṇaṇ+ḍi/ a raṇ+ḍa/ shu ra ba ra/ a gra/ pra ba te/ sar rba te/ che ge mo phyogs mtshams thams cad dang / steng 'og thams cad du bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang / /'jig rten spyong dang dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa rnams/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang / /mchod pa 'di dag blang bar gyis/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang / /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang / /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo phyogs mtshams thams cad dang / steng dang 'og thams cad 38—7/0

du bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ de nas mchod pa sngon du song bas/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i sems kyis 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i zhes bya ba nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do zhes bya ba'i bar du so sor 'brang ma'i mdo lan cig gdon par bya'o/ /de nas shar phyogs su nad pa la sogs pa la gos gtsang ma bgos la kha byang phyogs su bstan nas bzhag ste/yungs kar la sogs pa sa bon sna tshogs kyis byur bsal nas/ seng ldeng dang rgya shug 1gi me dag la sa bon blugs par bya'o/ /de la 'di'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di yin te/ gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang / /tshangs dbang dang ni 'jig rten skyong / /gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dag /de rnams mthu dang gzi brjid kyis/ /ro langs las rnams chad gyur cig /rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang / /me yis bud shing sreg 2byed dang / /rlung gis sprin rnams 'thor ba dang / /nyi mas nags tshal skems byed pa/ /sna tshogs dri dang mar me dang / /spos kyis sdig pa nges bsal te / /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /byad stems la sogs tshig par shog /tar+ya thā/ oṃ hu me hu me/ ka ra ba ti/ ka kha li/4 hu hu ni dza ba le / ga re/ ga ri ni/ sha ba ri5/ shādhi pra shābye swā hā/ dha badhi swā hā/gan+dharbe swā hā/ ba la ga te swā hā/ sarba ka khorda tshe da ni swā hā/ sngags kyi tshig 'di rnams kyis che ge mo'i byad dang ro langs dang / sman dang sngags dang dug gi spyor ba rnams lha thams cad kyis/ tshe di ta be+e di ta/ pa ra — dzi ta swā hā/oṃ mu de mu ne+e ba ri/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rig pa'i dbang 38—7/ /

—bskur ba'i rdo rje'i go cha chen po'i phyag rgya thams cad kyis/ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i 1da ya badz+ra swā hā/ zhes brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas bum pa lnga po rnams kyis go rims ji lta bar dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo ye tiṣ+ṭhadhi/da sa su tik+ṣu/ oṃ ma ṇi badz+re dṛ da ya badz+re/ ma ma ra su n+ya bi dha ri ṇi/ ha na ha na/ sarba sha tūn4/ badz+ra gabye/ tā sa ya tā sa ya/ sarba ma ra bha ba 5ni hūṃ hūṃ saṃ ha ra saṃ ha ra/ bud+dhā ne+e tro / sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kalpa a dhiṣ+ṭṛ te/sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa a pa nā ya swā hā/ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pa sngon du song ba'i tsan+dan gyis spyi bo nas brtsams te rkang pa'i bar du byug par bya'o/ /de nas cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i 'khor lo bris te/ ske 'am dpung pa la btags nas so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i phreng ba'i sngags kyis spyi bor bsrung bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo / /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel bya'i phyir/ /de la gus par phyag 'tshal nas/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse'i phyir/ /de ni nga yis brjod par bya/ /rig sngags gzi brjid chen mo 'di/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa ste/ /rdo rje gdan la thub pa yis/ 'di ni gsungs ma thag tu yang / /bdud dang bdud kyi ris rnams dang / /gza' dang log par 'dren pa dang / /bgegs rnams ji snyed gang yod pa/ /thams cad de yi mod la brlag /tar+ya thā/ oṃ gi ri gi ri/ gi ri ṇi gi ri ṇi/ gi ri ba ti gi ri ba ti/gu ṇa ba ti gu ṇa ba ti/ ā kā sha bi shubye/ ā kā sasha ba ti/ ā kā sha bi shu/38 7/ 2

—sat+tha pra bha bi ga te/ ā kā 1she ga ga na te le/ ā kā sha bi tsa ri ṇi/ dza li ta she kha re/ ma ṇi 4mo kha ti ka /kha tsi ta mo li sa dha re/ su ke she/su bhe she/ su bste/ su brte/ su bar+ṇa 5rgo ra/ a ti ta/ a na ga te/pra trut+pan+de6/ na maḥsarba ṣ+pe bhū 7ta rgo/ dza li ti/ te dza sa/ bubye/ su bubye / bha ga ba ti/ su rak+ṣi me/ su pra ste/ su pra te/ su ta me+e/su dādhe8/ ba re ba ra te/ bha ga ba ti / bha dra ba ti/ badz+re su bha re/ bi ma le/ dza ya bha dri pra tsaṇ+ḍi/ tsaṇ+ḍi/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍi/ bha go ri bo ri/ gan+dha ri/go bhu re/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ mā tai gi /ma li ni/ brtsa ni/ su ma ti/ puk+ka se/sha ba ri sha ba ri/ shaṃ ka ri/ dra mi ḍi/ dha mi bye/ ro du tri ni/ sadz+dza gra ha bi dha ri ṇi/ sadze+e arja sā dha ni/ ha na ha na sarba shā t+t+waṃ māṃ/ da ha da ha sarba dubye/ pa tsa pa tsa sat+tha byu ta/ pre ta pi shā tsā māṃ/ ma tha ma tha sat+tha yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa/ ḍā ki nī māṃ/ ma nu byu/ a ma nu ṣ+pe nāñtsa / pra ma tha pra ma tha/z-i da yo/ tā sas ya/ jo lo bi tai/ gdon ma rungs pa thams cad kyi srog gzhom du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag gi sdig pa thams cad gzhom du gsol/bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad du 'jigs pa dang / gnod pa las bsrung du gsol/ ma rungs pa thams cad bcing du gsol/ sarba tī la bi shi nā 7sha ni/ ba ra dadhe 8/ mṛ du 1(dan+ta/ wa ra ṇi/ ma ra badhe2 / ma ṇi rna ni / ma hā ma ṇi ni/ tsi ti tsi ti/ bi ṭi bi ṭi/ bi ma le/ ṭi ti ṭi ti / ta ṭa ta ṭa/ di ru ṭi/ sha ni ri/ sha ri ni/ go bu ri/ gau 2—ri ṇi / pi ri ṇi/ pra ba re/ sa ma re/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ ma tai gi/ a ra si/25tu ba ta se/ brtsa se/ su ma ti/ puk+ka si/ sha ba ri sha ba ri/ shaṅka ri/38— 7/3

dra mi ṭi/ da ha rgo/ pa tsa ni/ marda ni/ sā ra le/ sā ra le/ sa ra saṃ bhe/hi na mad rgyod/ kiṣ+ṭa bi dha ri ṇi/ ma hi le/ ma hā ma he le/ ni ga te/ni ga ṭi1/ bhañdzi marte maste/ mat+t+waṃ ni dan+ta/ tsakre tsakra/ bā ki ni/ dza la dza le / sha ba ri sha ba ri/ sadze+e byā bye ha ri ṇi/ tsu te tsu ṭi/ tsū 4ḍi ni tsū 5ḍi ni / dri tsi tsu ni/ ni mi ni mi6/ ni min+dha ri/ tri lo ka dza na ni/ tro lo ka ka ri/ bra ma ri/ tre+e dhā tu ka /bya ba lo ka ni/ badz+ra ba ra shu/ pā sha khaṅga/shaṃ kha/ tsakra tri shu la/ byu1 ma ṇi/ ma hā bir+ya dha ra ṇi/ bdag gnas thams cad du gnas pa na/ ma rungs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung du gsol bsrung du gsol/ badz+re badz+re / badz+re ba ti/ badz+ra pā ṇi dha re/ mi li mi li/ nyi li hi li/ ki li ki li/ tsi li tsi li/ bi li be+e li/ se ri si ri/ ba ra ba ra ba ra ḍi/ sar+pā tra dza ya/ ba la dhe swā hā/ sarba pā paṃ bi dha ri ṇi swā hā/ sarba byā 8bye ha ri ṇi swā hā/ saṃ bhā ra ṇi swā hā/ sar+pā tra bha ṣa / swā hā/ sarba 7sha t+t+waṃ bha ya ha ra ṇi swā hā/ saṃ dhā ra ṇi swā hā/ swaster+bha ba swā hā/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang /sems can thams cad bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ shāṅgi swā hā/ puṣ+ṭi swā hā/ba la brti ni swā hā/ dza ya tu dza ye/ dza ya ba ti 1/ dza ya bi ma le swā hā/ bi pu le swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mu te swā hā/ oṃ bhu ta swā hā/ oṃ bhu ba swā hā/oṃ byur bhu ba swā hā/ oṃ bhu re bhu re 1 badz+ra pa ti swā hā/ sarba ta thā ga ta z-i 7 da ya pū ra ṇi san dha sar ṇi/ tsa la tsa la/ ba la ba la/ badz+ra ya bi bye7/oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes so/ /de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / lha rjes su dran pa sngon du song bas/ bden pa'i byin gyi 38——7/

———rlabs 1'di bya'o/ /lha dang brgya byin dang bcas pa/ /sangs rgyas kyis khyod bde legs shog /dus kun du ni ston par shog /'byung po thams cad bde legs shog /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dang ni/ /lha rnams kyi ni stobs kyis kyang / /don ni gang dang gang 'dod pa/ /don ni thams cad grub par shog /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /lam du zhugs rnams bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /mtshan mo bde legs nyin bde legs/ /nyi ma'i 2gung la bde legs shog /khyed cag kun kyang bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /sems can kun dang srog chags kun/ /'byung po dag ni thams cad kyang / /thams cad bde legs 'ba' zhig shog /thams cad nad ni med gyur cig /kun gyis bzang po mthong bar shog /gang yang sdig par ma gyur cig /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur zhing / /sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod pa dag /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod par shog /rgyal ba dgra rgyal gang gis 'di bden pas/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ces so//de nas sman pas bstan pa'i sman rnams sngags 'dis mngon par bsngags te nad pa la sbyin par bya'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi dha ri 4badz+re ṇi/ ma hā pra ti sā 5re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ so sor 'brang ma'i snying po 'di yang bzlas pa'i ched du bzlas 6par bya'o / /slar yang dbus nas brtsams te/ phyogs bzhi rnams su nye bar spyod pa lngas mchod nas tshigs su bcad pa lngas bzod par gsol bar bya'o/ /gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang / /38—7/5

tshangs dbang dang ni 'jig rten skyong / /gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa rnams / /gang dag bar snang spyod pa dang / /gang gzhan sa la spyod pa rnams/ /me tog dang ni spos 'di dag /ji ltar bde bas bzhes su gsol/ /sems can don phyir rnam 1kun gyis/ /rtag tu thugs rjes bzhes su gsol/ /de'i jes la mchod rten gnas ji lta bar bzhugs su gsol nas/ mchod pa'i rdzas thams cad khron pa rnying pa'am/ chu bo'i nang du dor bar bya'o/ /de ltar ji ltar nus pas nyi ma gabyug gam gnyis sam gsum mam nyi ma bdun gyi bar du bya'o//skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /bsrung ba 'di rgo yang dag bshad/ /'di ma gtogs par khams gsum na/ /bsrung ba'i rig 2sngags gzhan med do/ /de ni mi 'chi rga med de/ /nad kyis mi btab mi rgud kyi / /sdug pa dang ni 'bral mi 'gyur/ /shin tu bsgoms par byas na ni/ /de ni mi sdug pa dang yang / /phrad par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /lag na rdo rje stobs chen dbang / /bde sogs bdag po dbang po dang / /'phrog ma dang ni lngas 4rtsen dang / /'jig rten skyong ba 'phrul chen dang / /zla ba nyi ma rgyu skar bcas/ /mchog tu mi bzad gza' rnams dang / /gang yang klu chen thams cad dang / /lha dang de bzhin drang srong dang / /lha min mkha' lding dri za dang / /mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye che/ /bsrung phyir rtag tu 'brang bar byed/ /gang gis rig sngags stobs chen mo/ /rdzu 'phrul chen mo bris nas ni/ /shes rab can gyi lag la gdags / /rtag tu phun sum tshogs pa thob/ /so sor 'brang ma chen po'i srung ba/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ /38 —— 7/6

—ke——she———ke—ke— ——— —byedabyed—byedasngar gyi gabyug go/ /gnyis nga/ — de ltar rim par bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol du sor gsu/ma gye rim pa gcig go/ /de la phyogs bzhir ri mo gnyis pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i mdun la sogs pa'i phyogs kyi rim par ri mo gnyis kyi mtshams su sngags ni/ oṃ bi ma le bi pu le dza ya ba re a mṛ te dha ra rak+ṣa shāṅgi puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ g.yas su oṃ a mṛ te bi lo ki ni gar+bha saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi ā kar+ṣa ri ṇi dha ra ra ka gya rak+ṣa shādz+rī puṣ+ṭiku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rgyab tu/ oṃ bhā ra bhā ra / saṃ bhā ra saṃ bhā ra/ id+dhi ya ba la be+e sho dha ni dha ra ka l+ya rak+ṣ-i shāṅgi puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ g.yon du oṃ a mṛ ta ba re ba ra ba ra pra ba ra bi shubye 4 ra ka gya rak+ṣa shāk+ṣiṃ ngu/ṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'dab ma rnams kyi dbus su/ hūṃ yig brgyad kyis bskor ba'i shaṃ yig gi nang du/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri zhes nga/ la sogs pa'i sngags bri bar bya'o/ /phyogs bral bzhir rtse gsum pa'i rdo rje phyed pa'i nang gi me la sogs pa'i mtshams kyi rim par sngags ni/ oṃ bi sbo ṭa badz+re ni dha ra ka gya rak+ṣa shāk+ṣiṃ puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bden bral du/oṃ/ a mṛ ta bā re dha ra ka l+ya rak+ṣ-i shādhi puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rlung du/oṃ bi ma le dha ra ka su 8 rak+ṣ-i shādz+rī puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ t+t+waṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dbang ldan du/oṃ dza ya bā re dha ra ka l+ya rak+ṣ-i shīdhe puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang rdo rje phyed ma rnams kyi mtshams brgyad rnams/ su/ me'i phyogs kyi rim/ nga/ra snga/gas ni/ oṃ/ sum̐ bha badz+re ṇi dha ra ka gya rak+ṣ-i shāṅgi puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā 0/ zhes/ pa'i sngags gnyis sam gcig nang du bri bar bya'o/ /de'i phyi ru sor phyed dang gsum gyi tshad la rim pa bzhi bya'o/ /de la rim pa dang po la dīḥyi ṅga phreng gcig bri'o/ /de'i phyi'i rim pa la/ oṃ/ a pa rā dzi te ma hā de bi 38 720

— byed———byed————— —byedatraṭa / oṃ kā la kaṇ+ḍa kri ta/ pad+ma kuṇ+ḍa li paṃ/ oṃ puṣ+ṭha dadhi ni hūṃ/ oṃ ma sum̐ ku shi hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sri kha le hūṃ/ oṃ shwe te baṃ/ oṃ ma hā kā li 2 dīḥ/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi he/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bṛ ta/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā ba le byeḥ / oṃ badz+ra mā le saṃ / o a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa la swā hā/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/4 de'i phyi'i rim pa la oṃ tsun+de dhīḥ/ oṃ suṇ+ḍi ke shi kṛ ta tsho/ oṃ dzi ga le lo/ oṃ be+e byud+mā li ni dzaḥhūṃ/ oṃ shādzhai ka ri hūṃ/ oṃ puṣ+ṭi ba la brta ni haḥ/oṃ sum+bha ka ri hūṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa/ mā la dha ri dīḥ/oṃ ma hā pra ti sa ri 8shaṃ/ oṃ dhu ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ hu ru hu ru/ me ru me ru/ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ba la babye ni hoḥ/ oṃ ru ru tsa le hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+re ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re dh+wa ra ka s+thā rak+ṣ-i shāṅgi puṣ+ṭi ku ru t+t+waṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de'i phyi'i rim par oṃ ta re t+t+waṃ āḥ/ oṃ oṃ mu 4 oṃ a spyo rak+ṣa l+ya ka dza ḍiṣ+ṭi྾ / oṃ bud+dhā rak+ṣa ti ke te hūṃ/ oṃ rak+ṣa ra shaṃ sarba bha ye bya byeḥ/ oṃ de bī twe /oṃ pad+mo paṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+re ṇi hūṃ/ oṃ lo tsa ne+e dze+e/ oṃ mā ma tī māṃ / oṃ paṇ+ḍa re paṃ/ oṃ ba su dha re baṃ/ oṃ ku ru kupre dhīḥ/ oṃ z-i ku ṭi j-i/oṃ je hūṃ rgyu aḥ/ de'i phyi ru so/ra gnyis kyi parim pa gcig bya'o/ /der mgo gyen du bstan pa'i rdo rje bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi phreng sgud du bri'o/ /rdo rje gnyis kyi mtshams nub la sogs pa'i phyogs kyi rim par/ lo/ s+t+waṃ/ ṭ+wāṃ bye/i bye / haṃ kaḥ/ khaṃ haḥ/ dzā/ dzāḥ/ spye/ dīḥ/ līḥ/ dīḥ/ sum̐/khru / dzaḥ/ dhī/ ho bye/ t+t+waṃ āḥ/ phaṭa dze+e/ sme saṃ/ kai/ baṃ/ re/sum̐ / tro/ hai/ dzha/ oṃ/ a ༷ / rja/ 1/ bye heḥ/ dze+e/dh+ri dh+ri/ saṃ/ se/ ra/ de'i phyi ru sor gnyis kyi rim pa gcig gi tshad 28 ——72/
