sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra tiṣ+ṭha bi byeḥ2/ bod skad du/ rab gnas kyi cho ga /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /rab gnas cho ga brjod par bya/ /snyan grags mi snyan rnyed ma rnyed/ /bde sdug bstod dang de bzhin smod / /'jig rten chos kyis ma gos pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon dag gis bya/ /dkyil 'khor dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / phyag rgya dang / byed pa dang / gdan dang / bzlas pa dang /sbyin sreg dang / gtor ma dang / mchod pa'i las dang phab cing bsdu ba ste/de 4kho na nyid bcu rig pa rtag tu sdig pa la 5'jigs shing dran pa 6dang / lus dang srog la mi lta ba blo brtan pa/ 'jig rten pha rol la ltos pa dang bcas pa'o /nyal ba dang / gnyid dang / reg pa'i bde ba dang / bza' ba 7dang bgo ba la sogs pa'i nye bar longs spyod pa rnams la chags pa med pa/ phyin ci ma 38—780

log pa sgrub pa la snying por byed pa/ phyi rol la ma chags pa/ sangs rgyas nyid sgrub par byed pa/ 'khor bas 'jigs pa/ sems can la ltos pa dang bcas pa/ kha na ma tho ba med pa/ sdig pa thams cad spangs pa/ 'dod pa'i chags pa la sogs pa la yang dag par mi rtog pa/ mi gtsang ba dang byams pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po'i phyogs su gyur pa'o/ /dge ba dang ldan pa mtshan nyid 'di rnams dang ldan pa la/ slob mas gsol ba btab ste/ lugs ma'am 'bur du byas pa'am/ 'dus byas la sogs pa rab tu gnas par bya ba'i don du rab tu gnas pa'i sa gzhi 3snamangon par 'dus byas pa/ bla re dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa bslang zhing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te/ rgyan med na gser gyi sor gdub gcig thogs te/ de la rab tu gnas pa'i sa gzhi la sku gzugs dang / pusnyi dang / thang ga'am mchod rten la sogs pa mdun du yang dag par bzhag ste/de la sku gzugs sam/ thang ga'am/ puste dang / mchod rten la bsang ba zhe dang / kha bshal ba dang / me tog la sogs pa rnam par sbyin par bya'o/ /phyis ni nam mkha' la gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la rnam pa lngas yang dag par tshumachod de/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'i slob dpon gyis bdug spos kyi snod gzung byazhing / nam mkha'i khams pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ zhes pa lan gsum brjod do/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /dga' ldan gnas su rab gnas nas/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de yi rnam par 'dir zhugs snye shig /rtag tu mgon po 'dir bzhugs nas/ /38—781

che ge mo yi don phyir dang / /byang chub sems ni 'phel bya'i phyir/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /ces bya ba 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /phyis ni bstod cing sbyin sreg gi dus su yang ji lta ba'i bstod pa bya'o/ /sku gzugs la sogs pa'i mdun du yang / yungs kar lag pa g.yon pa dang g.yas pa gnyis su gzung thubyeste/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis g.yas skor du lan gsum du bskor zhing yungs kar de rnams me la blugs par bya'o/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis g.yon du lan gsum du bskor zhing yungs kar mer blugs par bya ste/ 'di kyeni rtog pa med pa khams gsum du skyon bsal ba'i ched du bskor bar bya ba ni/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod do—/ /de nas khyor ba dang bcas pas chu blangs te me de nyid du blugs par bya'o//de sngon du song bas sku gzugs la sogs pa rab tu gnas par bya'o zhes bya ba ni lhag par gnas pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas phyi dro'i dus su bum pa ni lnga'am brgyad dam gcig kyang rung ste/dri zhim po — dang bcas pa'i chus yongs su bkang la/ rke thul gos gnyis kyis dkris te/ saṃ 3pa'am pa la sha la sogs pa'i yal gas kha legs par brgyan la/yungs kar dang ku su ma'i me tog dang bcas pa'i gser dang / dngul dang /mu tig dang / mu men dang / byi ru dang zhes bya ba rin po che sna lnga dang /go dang / nas dang / mon sran gre'u dang / til dang / 'bras so ba dang / 'bru sna lnga dang / rnam par rgyal ba dkar bo dang / bṛ khuha ti dang /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri 3dang / ha sa de ba dang / daṇ+ḍit+pa la dang sman lnga'o/ /de rnams dang yang dag par ldan par byas la/ zlum por byas pa gzhag par bya'o/ /38—782

bum pa so sor blangs te/ oṃ ru ru sgu ru dz+wa la ༄1snasidhe lo tsa ni sadze+e arja sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags par byas pa'am yang na byin pa'i sngags yi ge gsum dang spel ba 'dis phyi dro'i dus su bum pa mngon par bya'o/ /nang par snga bar sku gzugs gos ser pos dkris 5te/ kha shar phyogs su bstan te bzhag la khrus bya'o/ /de'i khrus kyi rim pa ni 'di yin te/ba'i rnam pa lnga la/ oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ 5s+thāḥ.aḥ/ zhes bya ba'i sa bon gyis mngon par bsngags shing drur ba'i chang bus gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas dri zhim pa'i 4mar nag gis byugs ④te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne+e swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags shing gye drur ba'i chang bus gzhug par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su u dusmra 3ra dang / n+ya gro dh+ya hūṃlas skyes pa'i shing shun legs par btags pa 'khor ba'i snod kyi dbus su bzhag ste phyigayas phyogs kyi glor bzhag la/mar nag dbyung —ba'i don du sku gzugs la byug t+yapar bya'o/ /de nas bum pa re re'i chus sku gzugs la khrus gsol bar bya ste/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni / /de bzhin gshegs rnams khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo/ /zhes bya ba'i tshig brjod cing / oṃ sarba tsu5 ta thā ga ta a t+ta ṣe ka sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyang brjod par bya'o/ /nam mkha' la gnas pa'i rig pa phab ste/ bum pa'i bdud rtsi'i chus sgu gzugs la khrus byed par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon kyis de la gos kyi chu blangs shing bla na 15med par byas la gdan rang rang gi gzhag par bya'o/ /'di ni sgu gzugs kyi khrus kyi rim pa'o/ /gal te thang sku'am/ puste'am/ bris pa'i mchod rten nam sku gzugs la sogs pa khrus byed par 'dod na/ de'i tshe 38—783

puste la sogs pa khrus kyi rim pa bya ste/ mdun du sna7me long de la ba'i rnam pa lnga dang / mar nag dang / shun pa la sogs pa'i rim pas sngon bzhin du bum pa'i chus kyang bkru bar bya'o zhes bya ba ni khrus kyi rim pa'o /de nas nam mkha' la gnas pa bye bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa'i gzugs la khyad par du gzhug par bya'o/ /gal te sku gzugs sam puster byed par 'dod na/ nam mkha' la gnas pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyis — dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa'i puste yi ge'i rnam par yongs su gyur par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas gos zung brtsegs sku la bskon par byas te/oṃ badz+ra bā sa se swā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so/ /ku sha'i chang bus ni sku gzugs la sogs pa la bsang gtor yang bya zhing zhal bsil yang bya'o/ /me tog la sogs pa mchod pa rnam pa lnga sngags 'dis dbul bar bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ de ltar thams cad bya'o/ /yang de bzhin du/ chu dang thang las ④skyes pa yi/ /me tog 'di ni mchog yin te/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /ji ltar bde bas bzhes su gsol/ /lhan cig skyes dang de bzhin sbyar/ /bdug pa 'di ni mchog yin te/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na/ /ji ltar bde bas bzhes su gsol/ /lhan cig skyes dang de bzhin sbyar/ /dri zhim bde ba'i mchog yin te/ /bdag gis gus pas 'bul lags kyis/ /ji ltar bde bas bzhes su gsol/ /mar dang mar nag mar me 'od/ /lha rdzas 'od 'bar mun 'joms pa'i/ /mi shes thams cad zhi ba'i phyir/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /bza' dang bca' dang ldan pa yi/ /lha bshos thams cad yang dag ldan/ /kha dog dri dang 38—784

ror ldan pa/ /khyed la dbul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /zhes bya ba'i sngags 'dis 'di rnams kyi go rims bzhin du dbul bar bya'o/ /ji ltar sbyin sreg gi dus su yang ar+ghaṃ hūṃl sogs pa'i sngags kyis de bzhin du yang bya'o/ /de nas sgu gzugs kyi spyan thur mas dbye bar bya ste/ oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ne+e swā hā/ de nas rdo rje gzung 3zhing dril bu dkrol nas mi bskyod snyerdo rje ye shes la sogs pas bstod par bya'o/ /de nas ④nang par snga bar sngon bzhin du sbyin sreg byas la/ tsā ru'i bza' ༷snyeb sngags kyis dag byed sgrub par byedatre/ oṃ di bya ni sa mā bye dh+yā na thra 3ṇa ne+e swā hā/ tsā ru'i bza' ba dbul ba'i sngags so/ /de nas lhag ma gzhan rnams slob dpon dang slob ma dang / yon bdag gis bza' bye/bar bya'o/ /gzhan dag don du gnyer ba la yang cung zad sbyin no/ /gang yang nye bar dgos pa thams cad sbyin sreg gi dus dang / ḍarab tu gnas pa'i dus kyi rdzas ni rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang zhing yongs su brtag par bya'o/ /slob ma dang lha bzo la ni gang yang phul ba'i nor de rnams mi gnang ngo / /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang / khams pa lo tsā ba ba ris 7bsgyur ba'o// //38—785

bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1753)

1827༄7/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi spon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde'i man ngag bzhugs/ 1༄go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gye smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i mdo sde bklag cing de bzhin gshegs pa bdun mchod de smon lam gdab pa'i cho ga mdo sde las basbus te rim par bklag pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mdo bklag cing cho ga rim par mdzad pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi mdo bklag cing smon lam gdab pa la/ mgo mjug dus kun du gnod sems dang / 'khon dang / brnab sems dang / ma dad pa dang / le lo dang / yid gnyis/ la sogs te nyon mongs pa'i spyon dang /sems ma 'dres par bsdam zhing bag bya/ gzhu rdeg la sogs pa chad pa dang /gnod pa'i las ming yang mi grag par bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi yon tan dang / mthu'i khyad par la yid ches/ shing mos par bya ste/ bka' drin gzo zhing dang ba dang / dad pa dang gus nga/'i sems cher bskyed/ mdo 38— 788

sde'i phan yon la yid ches pa nges par gzung / sems can la byams pa dang /snying rje'i sems bskyed la/ khyim pa zhig yin na bsnyen gnas kyi khrims bzung /btson dang bu lon can bdag la dbang yod pa rnams thar bar bya zhing /phongs pa rnams la dpung gnyen bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad dang /'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / skyabs grol gyi sku gzugs rgyu ci 'byor pa las gsar du bya/ gsar du ma 'byor na sku gzugs rnying pa ci bzhugs spyan drangs༄kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde/ mchod pa zhag dus zin gyi bar du nyin mtshan rgyun mi 'chad par tshar bzhi bcu rtsa dgu las mi nyung bar bklag /'phags pa chos skyong ba dang gnod sbyin rnams la chos kyi sbyin pa dbul ba'i mdo sde bzang po grwa gcig kyang rgyun du bklag /dge slong gi dge 'dun la zas dang skom dang yo byad thams cad kyis ci nus su mchod pa dang rim gro bya'o/ /mchod pa bya ba'i zhag grangs ni zhag bdun nam/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ sum cu rtsa lnga'amabazhi bcu rtsa dgu'i bar du bya ste/ spyogs par byed na nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du mchod cing smon lam gdab/ dam chos bklag pa dang mchod pa gzhan rgyun mi 'chad par bya/ cho ga 'di sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa bdun po'i tsomatshan thos shing brjod pa las phan yon 'byung ba yin pas phyag 'tshal ba dang bsngo ba'i bar du skabs ci yod par mtshan lan mang du smos shing / ci nas kyang mang du thos shing brjod pa'i tshul du bya'o/ /mchod pa'i yo byad 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du bshams shing gtsang sbra che bar bya/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa la sogs pa se yi ma shing rnga dang 38—789

gar la sogs pa rol mo ci 'byor pa rgyas par bya/ yon bdag dang mchod pa'i las la gtogs pa rnams khrus bya zhing gos gtsang ma nyin shemachod pa lan du byed pa'i tshe spo 2zhing bgo'o/ /mchod pa'i rim pa ni yo byad tshul bzhin bshams kyi 'og tu dge 'dun dang yon bdag tshogs nas sems can thams cad la byams pas khyab —par bya ba'i phyir ting nge 'dzin bsgom/ de nas mchod pa'i tshogs rnams bden pa brdar zhing byin gyis brlabasgo/ de nas 'phags pa spyan drang / de nas 'phags pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom ste/ so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ de nas 'phags pa'i tshogs mngon du dmigs la gdan 'dzom pa'i spyi la phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa lnga dbul/ bskul ba'i smon lam bklag /de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad la sogs pa re re la mchod pa dbul zhing mdo las 'byung bzhin spyosmon lam gdab par tshar phyin par bya/ de nas kun gyis gzungs kyi snying po logs shig tu phyung ba bzhi bcu rtsa dgu man chad bdun yan chad ci nus su bklag /de'i rjes la spyi la rdemachod pa lan cig byas nas bsod nams bsngo ba'i smon lam gdab/ de nas bzod par gsol te slar gshegs pa'i tshogs 9bcad bklag ste gyes / mchod pa bshams pa'i thabs 'byor pa'i stobs kyis ci nus pa dang 11sbyar te/ maṇ+ḍal chen po'i steng du tshon phye'am / me tog las rin po che sna lnga'i pho brang rta babs dang / mu tig gi phreng ba dang / rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gzhi pad+ma'i gdan dang bcas pa bris pa snam bu bar ma gzhal med khang gi gung la an 'tsham pa'i seng ge'i khri dang sbyar te/ tshon sna lnga'i tshas ⑩kyis dkris 1pa'i mdo sde'i puste dang / de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad kyi sku gzugs bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon du'ang an khri 38—790

'tsham pa bzhag la/ g.yas g.yon gyi gral stod du ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'khor byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs par bsham/ g.yas gral smad du ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / phyogs skyong ba bcu dang / dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad bzhugs su gsol/ g.yon gral smad du ni gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bcu gnyis bzhugs par bsham/ shar phyogs kyi ngos su an chung ngu'am/ gzhong bu'am man 'ji las gzhi blangs pa'i steng du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / skyabs grol gdan 'dzom pa la sngon kyi thugs dam bskul zhing mdo sde'i don las 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzad pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa ltar gdan bsham zhing so so'i sku gzugs kyang bzhugs par bya/ lha bzhugs pa'i snam bu'i gzhi yang pad+mas 'khor bar bya/ dbus kyi pad+ma la'am spyan sngar dz+reng ba/ gar sdug cing bde bar gzungs chu'i bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa dgu gzhag /phyi rol gyi snam bu'i nang du bkra shis dang / shing ljon pa la sogs pa'i rgyan la 'os pa'i khol ma bkram la/ phyi tshon sna lnga'i gzhal med khang sgo khyud lkudang / rta babs su bcas pa bri zhing mu tig gi phreng ba dang / do shal gyi khol ma bkod la/de dag gi steng du lha bshos dang yon chab la sogs pa mchod pa rnams kyang dgram/tshon gyis tsobhebri bar dka' na me tog dgram pa'am/ maṇ+ḍal tsam bya/ steng du yang bla re dang gdugs ci tsa'abyor pas klubs/ ngos su yang rgyal mtshan dang /tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan bzhi bcu rtsa dgu las lhag pa yan chad ci 'byor pa rgyas par dgram/ mar me'i kha grangs ni lnga bcu rtsa bzhi man chad du bya ste/ de las kha grangs dgu yan chad 3 ci nus pa nyin mtshan du bar ma chad par gtang 5 /38—791

lha bshos ni de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad la cha re re/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / skyabs grol la cha re re/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang rgyal po chen po bzhi la cha re re/ dam pa'i chos skyong ba spyi la cha gcig /chos gnyis la cha re re/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bcu gnyis la cha re re spyi gtor chen po gcig 'di rnams so so'i spyan sngar gar 'os par dbab/ ngos gnyis su de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi mdo sde nyin mtshan du bar ma chad par thun du bklag /chos kyi sbyin pa dbul ba mdo sde grwa byusnagacig gdan khri bshams te 2ci nus su bklag /mchod pa bshams pa'i mdun du mchod pa la 'du ba rnams kyi stan bshams te/ mdun mdun du mchod pa rnam pa lnga dbul ba legs par bshams la/ rol mo dang sel snyan byed pa'i grwa ༄ gcig kyang zla ba bstar 4te phyed du gzhug /mchod pa bshams pa ni mdor na tshad nges pa med de/ bde ba can gyi zhing gi yon tan gyi bkod pa dang mthun par nus kyang rung / tha ma maṇ+ḍal byas te5/ me tog chu phor gang tsam gyis mchod kyang rung ste/ rang gi 'byor pa'i nyams kyis ci spyogs su 'bad de bya'o/ /yid kyi mchod pa ni ci nas kyang rgya che zhing bzang bar bsam zhing trebaden pa bdar te/ smon lam yang gdab/ lha bshos kyi cha dang / mar me'i grangs kyang mi 'byor na nyung ngu bsdur yang rung / 'byor na ci 'os pa mang du bskyed kyang rung ngo / /dang po mdo sde las 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rjes khyab par bsgom mo/ /mchod pa bshams te/ dge 'dun 'tshogs 7nas phyogs bcu'i 'phags pa thams cad la phyag bya/ de nas rig pa'i tshul gang la goms pa'i sgo nas chos thams cad 38—792

dmigs su me+ed par stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ci ran cig bsgom mo/ /de'i 'og tu ting nge 'dzin las langs nas 'di snyam du chos thams cad dmigs su med pa'i don de lta bu yin la/ 'phags pa rnams kyis de kho na nyid thugs su chud pas sku dang gsung dang thugs nam mkha' dang 'dra bar gyur te/ sgrib pa mi mnga' zhing mthu dang / byin gyi rlabs 3bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i go 'phang brnyes par yang rung na/ kye ma sems can 'di rnams chos kyi de kho na nyid ma rtogs te/ rmongs pas nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal mang pos gzir te/nyam thag pa'i gnas su lhung bar gyur la/ sems can thams cad kyang thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba nas 'gro ba brgyud 2pa rnams su bdag gi bshes gnyen 1dam pa drin kyi zhing du ma gyur pa 'ga' yang med de/ bdag gis kyang dang po byang chub kyi sems dam pa bskyed de/ 'gro ba mang po'i phan pa dang bde ba'i don dpag tu med pa bsgrub par dam bcas pa'i dus kyi tshe/ sems can thams cad bdag gir blangs zin pas 'di lta bu la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yal bar 'dor ba ni mi rigs na/ 'di dag ji ltar sdug bsngal las ni gdon/bde ba la ni dgod par bya snyam du snying rje dang / byams pa chen po dang ldan pa'i brtson pa'i sems drag tu bskyed par bya'o/ /yang 'di snyam du bsams te/bdag ni dus ngan pa'i sems can spyod pa dang mthu dman pa yin pas/bdag nyid gcig pus 'phral du don rlabs po che 'di lta bu ni mi spyogs kyi/ston pa bde bar gshegs pas sngon ci ltar phyi ma'i dus lnga brgya pa tha ma la dam pa'i chos 'grib pa na sems can thams cad rjes su gzung 5ba'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi thabs mkhas pa dang sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par 38—793

byedargyas pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ji skad gsungs pa las byung ba bzhin du/bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya (1 'od kyi rgyal po la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa bdun la mthu brtan dpung gnyen du 3gsol te/ de ltar ni 'phags pa rnams kyi mthu dang byin gyi rlabs kyikyis/ 'go ba rnams la phan pa bsgrub par bya la/ phyis ni bdag nyid gcig pus gzhan la ltos pa med par sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa 4bsgrub par bya'o snyam du bsam mo/ /snying rje dang byams pa'i sems phyabaskyed pa'i 'og tu/ sems can gyi don bya bar brtsam pa'i phyir 'phags pa gdan 'dzom pa'i pho brang dang /mchod pa'i tshogs bshams shing bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i yid kyis 'ubaden pa bdar zhing yid kyis bsngo ba7/ dkon mchog gsum kyi bden pa dang /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyi rlabs dang /tshogs gnyis yongs su sdogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i stobs dang / bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i rngu'od kyi rgyal po la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa bdun dang / ston pa bde bar gshegs pa dpal shākya thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor dang / mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba 'di rnams/ ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can gyis bsgrubs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan lta bu dang ldan par gyur te/ sa gzhi rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ tha gru che ba yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba dang / dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/ tsan+dan sbrul kyi 38—794

snying po'i dri bsung dang ldan pa/ lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyis nyugacal bkram pa/mtha' rin po che'i pha gus brtsigs shing gser dang mu tig gi gram bu dang bye ma bdal rkyeb dang / a la dang / ku mu ta dang / pad+ma 'gying zhing ldem pas khebs par gyur cig — /chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan pa sgrogs ④pa dga' la 'phyo zhing lding bas brgyan pa'i yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho dang sprung dang lteng ka dag gis mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che'i dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa lha'i nor bu dang / mu tig gi rgyan phreng dang / rin po che dpyangs snyepa/ /me tog gi mgo spyogs dang / 'bras bus mdzes par chags pas g.yur za zhing sdem la/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba las dam pa'i chos kyi sgra 'byung ba dang ldan pa tshar du sbrengs trepas legs par brgyan pa'i sa gzhi la gzhal med khang chen po/ rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar bar bkod pa/ 'jig rten kyi khams dpag tu med par hūṃrgyas par 'od zer chen po rab tu 'byung ba/gnas tha dad pa shin tu rnam par phye ba mtha' yas par rnam par gnas pa/ rgya yongs su ma chad pa khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul/'jig rten las 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang sgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i dge 'dun dang ldan pa/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za she7dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa mtha' yas pa rnam par rgyu ba/ chos kyi ro'i dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos brten byepa/ sems can thams cad kyi don 38—795

thams cad yang dag par thob par byed pa/ nye bar gnas pa/ nyon mongs pa'i dri ma'i gnod pa thams cad dang bral ba/ bdud thams cad yongs su spangs pa/ thams cad kyi bkod pa las lhag pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa'i gnas dran pa dang blo gros dang / rtogs pa chen pos nges par 'byung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong chen po'i nyusna bzhon pa yin pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo chen po stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa nas 'jug pa/ rin po che'i pad+ma'i rgyal po'i yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i bkod pa la brten 2pa'i gzhal med khang chen por gyur pa'i nang du/gung la de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad bzhugs par 'os pa'i rin po che'i seng ge'i gdan khye lha'i dar zab dang ras bcos bus byegayogs pa rgom zhing 'phar ba'i rlong dang ldan pa'i sku rten dang bcas pa brgyad 'byung zhing g.yas g.yon du yang 'khor gye gtso bo byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / chos skyong thugs dam can bzhugs pa'i pad+ma'i gdan brgya stong mang po dang / mdun gyi ngos su 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / skyabs grol bzhugs pa'i pad+ma'i gdan bzang po 'byung ba dang / phyi nang thams cad cha rigs dang 'tsham pa mi dang / lha'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang / na bza' dang /rgyan dang / rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogs phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang / bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las 'byung ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /'phags pa gdan 'dzom pas kyang / de bzhin du byin gyis brlabs shing bzhes te longs spyod par gyur cig /de skad lan gsum bzlas/ yang de'i rjes 57la dkon 38—796

mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs ༄1dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis de bzhin du gyur cig /ces lan gsum bzlas/ mchod pa'i tshogs bden pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'og tu 'phags pa spyan drang ba/ pus mo btsugs 3te me tog blangs thal mo sbyar nas tshig 'di skad ces/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan kyis mi thub pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po zham 'bring ba byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bye ba khrag khrig bzhugs pa dang /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che dang ldan pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po/byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa dang / shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyis yongs su gang ba rin chen bsags pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser bzangs 1 dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas kun nas bskor te bzhugs pa dang / shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams mya ngan med pa na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med mchog dpal byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor te bzhugs pa dang / shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten kyi khams chos kyi rgyal mtshan na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 38—797

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos bsgrags 3rgya mtsho'i dbyangs/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas kun nas bskor te bzhugs pa dang /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che'i rgya mtshor legs par gnas pa na/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa/byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs grangs med pas kun nas bskor te bzhugs pa dang /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bai ḍūr+ya snang ba na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po 'khor byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma ltar rnam par snang byed dang / zla ba ltar rnam par snang byed la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs grangs med pa bzhugs pa la sogs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad ma'i dus lnga brgya pa 2snatha ma la dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa 'byung ba na/ sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs /pa/nad sna tshogs kyis lus gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ phongs par gyur pa'i sems can thams cad rjes su bzung zhing lha dang mi rnams kyi 4don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa mang po dang / sngon gyi smon lam kyi khyad par rgyas pa bzang zhing rlabs che ba dang / mthu dang byin gyi rlabs 5dpag tu ma mchis pa mnga' ba la brten te/ che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du/ mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren cing mchis na/38—798

mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ da ltar bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa gdul bya'i dbang du 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par rol pa 7 sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing bzhugs pa yang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / sngon gyi smon lam chen po dang / sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can las glengs te/ bdag cag rnams mnga' ris kyi gdul bya phyag mtshan du bzhes pa'i nang du gtogs te/ bka' drin thob pa'i 'phro ma kyemachis pa tsam la brten te/che ge mo la sogs pa 'go ba mang po bskyab pa'i be+ed du/ mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren cing mchis na/ mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / dpal phyag na rdo rje dang / rgyal ba'i sras po skyabs grol la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag sngon de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde bka' stsal pa'i tshe gdan 'dzom par 'dus te/ mdo sde byin gyis brlabs shing de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' sgrub par thugs bskyed ④pa de dag thams cad kyang che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na/ mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis 38—799

brlab lkutu gsol/ /sngon de bzhin gshegs pa gdan 'dzom pa chen pos bkas gtad 1cing so so nas kyang lha'i tshig bden pas mdongs gsol du zhal gyes bzhes te/ dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong kyibar mdzad cing /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde 'di yang lhag par phyag mtshan du bzhes pa tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang / 'phags skyes bo dang /mig mi bzang dang / rnam thos kyi sras la sogs pa 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad kyang che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren cing mchis na/ mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa gdan 'dzom pa chen po'i spyan sngar/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde 'chang ba dang mchod pa la sogs pa'i sems can de dag phyag mtshan du bzhes shing bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ji 'jigs dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rdo rje dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rgyan 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin kyi sde dpon chen po gza' 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rlung dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gnas bcas dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon —chen po dbang 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin kyi sde dpon chen po ltung mi'adzin dang /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po smra 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin kyi sde dpon chen po bsam 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po g.yo ba 'dzin dang /38—800

gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rdzogs byed de/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon 1 bcu gnyis po thams cad la yang sngon gyi thugs dam bzang po las glengs te/che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du/ mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na/ mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skabs 'dir lha klu spyan drang ste/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas thugs bsgom rdudakyel po che/ /lha dang drang srong gshin rje srin po klu/ /rlung lha gnod sbyin bgegs gza' rgyu skar bcas/ /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /sa mā dza1ཿ/ de ltar spyan drangs pa thams cad kyang rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la byon par bsam mo/ /spyan drang ba'i cho ga rdzogs pa'i rjes la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa dang / 'phags pa lha'i snyan dang spyan rnam par dag pa mnga' ba rnams kyi gsol tshig 'das ma thag tu rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' nas gshegs te/gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi seng ge'i khri chen bo brgyad la de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon gyi gral stod ngudu 'khor byang chub sems dpa' rnams bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon gyi gral smad du tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon 5bcu gnyis bzhugs/ gdan 'dzom pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i gdan la byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / skyabs grol gsum ldan 538—801

'dzom pa la/ sngon gyi thugs dam bsgul zhing gsol ba'i phrin las mdzad cing bzhugs par sngon tedu dmigs shing bsam/ pho brang gi dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa'i tshogs kyang sngar bden pa bdar ba'i tshul dang 'dra bar gyur par bsam zhing mos pa bskyed de bye snaspyan drangs pa'i rjes la/ 'phags pa gdan 'dzom pa la spyir phyag 'tshal zhing mchod nas bsgul zhing gsol ba/ de nas mchod pa'i tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i pho brang na/ 'phags pa gdan 'dzom pa bzhugs par mngon du dmigs bzhin du/ mchod yon la sogs pa mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul zhing rol mo bya/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba 'greng phyag bdun bdun bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po zham 'bring ba —byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor bye ba khrag khrig dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs nga dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che dang / zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal bo byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser bzang dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas kun nas bskor ba dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med mchog dpal byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra 38—802

bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs grangs med pas kun nas bskor ba dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po 'khor byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma ltar rnam par snang byed dang / zla ba ltar rnam par snang byed la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs grangs med pa dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa 'a sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / skyabs grol la sogs pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshangs pa dang /lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ji 'jigs la sogs te/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang byug pa/ me tog dang bdug spos/ zhal zas dang mar me—/ rol mo dang sil snyan/ gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa dngos su ci 38—803

'byor ba 'di dag dang / phyogs bcu na bdag pos ma bzung zhing skyalha dang mi'i rdzas dam pa bde ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang gzungs dang / rigs pa'i mthu dang / mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las 'byung ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i mthas klas pa/ chos kyi dbyings su gtogs pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste/ dbul lo mchod do/ /ming 'di zhes bkyi ba dang / bdag cag gis thog ma ma mchis pa nas 'khor ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mdor na mi bgyi bar rigs pa'i las ni bgyis/ bgyi bar ༄ / 'os pa'i las ni ma bgyis pa la sogs pa'i dngos sngusdig ci mchis pa thams cad yang dag par 'chags so/ /dus gsum gyi 'phags pa dang skye bo'i dge ba mtha' dag gi 5bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo/ /'jig rten gyi sgron ma gang dag mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten gyi don mdzad cing yun ring du bzhugs par gsol ba 4'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das gdan 'dzom pa chen po dgongs su gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po rnams kyis slad ma'i dus lnga brgya pa tha ma la dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa 'byung ba na/rngu/ sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis lus gzir ba/mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ phongs par gyur pa'i sems can thams cad rjes su bzung zhing lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du/ sngon bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 38—804

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun gyi thabs mkhas pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa rlabs po che ji ltar btab cing byin gyis brlabs pa dang / don de nyid de ltar bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pas ji ltar bka' stsal cing byin gyis brlabs pa dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / skyabs grol la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de dag gi bka' lung yang dag par bsgrub pa dang / so so'i dgongs spyod rgya chen po rdzogs par bskang ba'i slad du/ mdo sde'i don bsgrub pa'i phrin las mdzad par 'phags pa'i bka' btags pa'i zhal gyis bzhes shing ji ltar byin gyis brlabs pa dang / tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis la sogs te/ lha'i dge bsnyen chen po thams cad kyis gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar mdo sde dang / mdo sde 'dzin pa'i sems can bsrung ba dang bskyab par zhal gyis bzhes pa la sogs pa—/ sngon 'phags pa rnams kyis ji ltar byin kyis brlabs shing bka' pa pa/mdo sde las 'byung ba bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa de rnams gdan 'dzom par mdzad pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor bshams / 'byor pa'i stobs ci mchis pas rngusbyar nas/ gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar mtshan nas brjod de mchod pa 'bul/ bsgul zhing smon lam gsol te bka' drin nod cing mchis na/ gdan 'dzom pas sngon ji ltar byin gyis brlabs shing bka' lcag pa bzhin du/ mdo sde'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par mdzad cing phan yon ji skad 'byung ba'i bka' drin thams cad che ge mo la 38—805

sogs pa bdag cag gis 7'phral du thob par mdzad du gsol/ de'i 'og tu 'phags pa rnams la re re nas mchod pa 'bul zhing smon lam gdab ste/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun brjod de ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa phul la smon lam 'di skad ces gdab bo/ /deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po'i mtshan thos te/ yid la dran zhing sde /lan bdun brjod pa dang / phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po de'i ston thugyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir zhing / rims dang gshed byed dang / byad dang ro langs dang / 'jigs pa sna tshogs kyis gtses pa de dag thams cad kyi 4 gnod pa dang / nad thams cad 'phral du byang zhing gtan du rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du rims dang sdig pa can gyi gdon rnams med par gyur cig /rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag long ba dang / 'on pa dang / thrun srepa dang /sha bkra dang / nad tshabs po ches btab par gyur pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbang po thams cad yongs su tshang bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang nad thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug 38—806

gis bsgribs pa/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa/ bya ba ma yin pa'i spyod pa mang ba—/ dam pa'i chos spong ba/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las sna tshogs byed pa/ngan song gsum dang / sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang /sems can dmyal ba nyu༄chen por skyes nas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba de dag thams cad kyi mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang zhing zad par gyur cig /sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi rgyun 'phral du chad cing bde ba mchog dang ldan par gyur cig /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du su yang sems can dmyal ba dang ngan 'gror 'go bar ma gyur cig/lha yul ba'i bde ba dang / mi'i bde ba stsong bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dbul por gyur te/ zas dang / skom dang /nor dang / 'bru dang / mal cha dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang /yo byad mi bdog pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbyig dang / gos dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / mal cha dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / yo byad 'phel bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag bcing ba dang / brdeg pa dang / go rar bzhug tsobhepa dang / mtshon cha'i tshogs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir ba de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bcing ba dang /brdog 1pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lus kyi gdung ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mgon med par gyur pa lus la gdung ba'i me 'bar ba dang / seng ge dang /stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / sbrul gdug chopa'i nang du chud de/ srog 38—807

la 'bab cing nyam nyuthag pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du lus la gdung ba'i me thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /seng ge dang /stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / sbrul gdug pa de dag kyang byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag phan tshun 'thab rtsod cing 'gyed la/ 'khrugs shing 'jigs skrag nas sngangs pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du 'thab rtsod dang 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /phan tshun byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag chu'i nang du son te grur zhugs pa/ gling med par phyin pa/ srog 'dod pa/ chu klung dang / rgya mtsho'i nang du son te/ smre sngags sna tshogs 'don pa/ de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du chu klung chen po de dag las dbugs 'byin pa sbyin par gyur cig /'jigs pa med par rgal bar gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye zhing skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ ston pa bla na med pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod pa dang /thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /gzhan yang bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /38—808

sangs rgyas kyi byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa snga ma bzhin du byas te/ smon lam 'di skad ces gdab bo/ /deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i mtshan yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod pa dang / phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/bcom ldan 'das rin bo che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par/bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag zhing las kyi mtha' dang tshong la dga' ste/ g.yeng ba sna tshogs mang bas dge ba'i chos rnams dang / byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las yongs su nyams te 'khor ba na 'khyams 1la/so sor 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgal 2ba dang / na ba dang / rgud pa dang /'chi ba dang/ sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / mya ngan dang /sme sngags 'don pa dang / 'khrug pa sna tshogs so sor myong ba de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du bsams ma thag tu bza' ba dang / bgo ba dang / btung ba dang / longs spyod dang / nor dang /'bru dang / dbyig dang / gser rnams 'byung zhing 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par gyur cig / dge ba'i chos rnams kyis rnam par 'phel bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /ngan song 38—809

gsum dang / sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag grang ba dang / tsha ba dang/ bkres pa dang / skom tsosna pas lus yongs su gdungs shing sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas nyam thag pa de dag thams cad kyi sngon kyi las kyi sgrib pa de dag yongs su byang bar gyur cig /skye ba de yang tha mar gyur cig /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du skye ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lha'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /bud med gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gang zhing 2bud med kyi skye gnas la smod pa dang / sems can gang dag btsas pa'i dus kyi sdug bsngal kyi tshor ba myong ba de dag thams cad dang sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /skye ba de yang tha ma par ( — gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du skyes pa nyid thob par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag 'chi ba dang / dgra dang dgon pa'i gnod pas gtses pa dang / phan tshun du pha ma dang / sring mo dang / mdza' bshes dang / nye du'i mya ngan myong zhing sdug bsngal ba dang / mya ngan gyi zug rngus lus la zug pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du 'chi ba dang /dgra dang / dgon pa'i gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /mya ngan dang sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa ④sems can gang dag mtshan mo mun pa mun nag na rnam par rgyu ba/ las kyi mtha' rnam pa sna tshogs la zhugs pa/ sdog pa can gyi gdon sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ 'jigs pas smre pyesngags sna tshogs 'don pa dang me/ de dag 38—810

thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du mun pa mun nag 7 thams cad med par gyur cig /sdig pa can gyi gdon thams cad byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba sna tshogs la mngon par brtson par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dman pa la 2snamos shing shes rab chung la dran pa rmongs te/ dge ba'i chos rnams dang stobs dang /byang chub kyi yan lag dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun rjes su dran pa las yongs su nyams pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du ting nge /'dzin dang / dran pa dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang /gzungs kyi sgo rnams mngon du gyur cig /shes rab chen po rjes su rgyu bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dman pa la rīmos shing nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la 'dod pa bskyed de/de la gnas shing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rgyab kyis phyogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las yang dag par 'da' bar gyur cig /byang chub 5yid la byed pa dang / mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bskal pa chen po zad pa'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling kun du 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar bar 'khrugs /thupar gyur te/ ngu zhing mya ngan byed la sngon gyi mi dge ba'i las kyi rgyus sdug bsngal myong zhing skyabs med mgon med pa de dag thams cad snyug bsngal dang / mya ngan dang bral bar gyur cig /38—811

bsil ba'i dngos po thob par gyur cig /de nas shi 'phos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan kyepa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag par pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye bar gyur cig /skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ ston pa bla na med pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal bo la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod pa dang /thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /gzhan yang bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dgongs par gyur cig /sdig pa dang las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig /'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug bsrabs par gyur cig /yun ring du 'tsho zhing nad med par gyur cig /gang bsams pa'i bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang /'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser bzangs snyedri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa la phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa snga ma bzhin du byas te smon lam 'di skad ces gdab bo/ /deng rgyal ba sras 38—812

dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs 7 dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa'i mtshan yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod pa dang / phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs 2grub pa de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag srog gcod pa/ srog gcod pa'i mi dge ba'i las rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa/ srog chags rnam pa sna tshogs kyi srog gcod par co byas pas tshe thung zhing nad mang ba dang / chu dang / dug dang / mtshon dang /me dang / nad sna tshogs kyis 'chi bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad las kyi sgrib pa de yongs su byang ste tshe ring bar gyur cig //5 su yang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par ma gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sdig pa mi dge ba sna tshogs bya saste/ gzhan gyi rdzas brkus phrogs pas dbul po'i khyim du skyes te/ sgren mo dang / bkres pa dang / skom pas lus yongs su gdungs shing sdug bsngal myong ba de dag thams cad 'phral du sdig pa thams cad byang ste/ byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbang phyug 6phun sum tshogs shing ma tshang ba med pa thob par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gcig la gcig gnod sems dang ldan zhing phan tshun srog gcod par byed pa dang / 'thab pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du phan tshun pha ma ltar byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gti mug gis bsgribs te/ tshul khrims 'chal bar gyur nas/ sdig pa kun 38—813

byed ketu spyod cing bslab pa dral la dad pas byin pa longs spyod kyipas ngan song gsum du ltung zhing sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad 'phral du las kyi sgrib 2pa thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams dang bral bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du tshul khrims yang dag par 'dzin cing lus dang ngag dang yid sdom pa la gnas par gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /tar+ya thā/ sedhe sidhe tsa/ su sedhe/ mo tsa ni mok+ṣa ni/ muste/bi muste/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ maṅga phye/ hi ra bye gasgo/ rat+na gasgo/ sar+pārja sā dha ni/ pa ra mārba sā dha ni/ ma na se/ ma hā ma na se/ ad budhe/a t+yang bud+dhi4/ bhi ta bha ye/ su brte brah+ma gho ṣe/ brah+ma byu ṣi te/ saṭ+wābe+e shā ṣā pa rā dzi te/ sarba tra a pra ti ha ta/ tsa tuṣ+ṭi budha/ ko ṭi bha ṣi te/ na maḥ6sarba ta thā ga ta tri mān 3swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa des byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs te/ sems can 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gti mug gis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis lus gzir ba/ 'ching ba dang / dgra dang / dgon pas gnod par gyur pa/ tshe bskal par thub 9pa'i sems can dmyal bar gzhol ba'i sems can rnams gzigs nas/ de dag gi ༄ don dang / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la dgod pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa thams cad zad par bya ba'i phyir/ gzungs sngags kyi gzhi gsungs pa 'di dag bzlas pa'i mthu dang / bcom ldan 'das gser bzangs dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa'i byin kyi rlabs 11kyis bdag cag la sogs pa 38—814

sems can thams cad kyi mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa spyig pa thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig /nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /'chi ba dang / dgra dang / dgon pa'i gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /re ba dang bsam hūṃ pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /'chi ba'i tshe yang bcom ldan 'das gser bzangs dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pas dgongs par gyur cig /shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs 3dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po'i 1seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye zhing / skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te / ston pa bla na med pa gser bzangs dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod pa dang / thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sgogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med mchog dpal la gus par phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa snga ma bzhin du bya ste/ smon lam 'di skad ces gdab bo/ /deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal gyi mtshan yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod pa dang /phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mya ngan dang / snyug bsngal dang / yid 38—815

mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa mang ba sdug bsngal sna tshogs stsong ba de dag thams cad mya ngan dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /su yang sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar ma gyur cig /tshe ring bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sdig pa mi dge ba rnam pa sna tshogs byas te/ mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen po mun pa mun nag 7chen po can du skye bar 'gyur ba'am / skyes pa de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal gyi sku las 'od zer gyi snang ba 'phros pa byung bas reg cing mthong bar gyur te/ de ma thag tu sdig pa thams cad byang nas sems can dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal de dag las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal kyi tshor ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sngon sdig pa mi dge ba bgyis te/ gzhan gyi rdzas phrogs 5pas dbul po dman pa'i khyem du skyes nas/ gos dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / mal cha dang / rgyan mi bdog pa grang ba dang / tsha ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba/ bkres pa dang / skom pas lus gzir cing mdog ngan par gyur pa'am 'gyur ba de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bgo ba dang / bza' ba dang /btung ba dang / mal cha thams cad la yid bzhin du longs spyod par gyur cig /lus la lha'i lus kyi kha dog gis brgyan par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za rnams kyis gtses shing mdongs phrogs te/ nad kyi sdug bsngal 38—816

sna tshogs myong ba de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za rnams kyis mdongs phrogs rtepa de dag thams cad rab tu zhi zhing byams pa la gnas par gyur byug /nad kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye zhing skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ston pa bla na med pa mya ngan med mchog dpal la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod pa dang / thugs gnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /gzhan yang bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du nam yang su yang log par ltung bar 'gro bar ma gyur cig /skye ba dran par gyur cig /lha thams cad kyis rjes su gzung bar gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la gus par phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa snga ma bzhin du byas te/ smon lam 'di skad ces gdab bo/ /deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar—/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi mtshan thos te yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod de phyag btsal 4ba dang / mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs de'i 38—817

sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par/ bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag log par lta ba can gyi khyim du skyes pas/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la sems ma dad pa byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las ring du gyur pa de dag thams cad kyi las kyi sgrib pa de zad par gyur nas/byang chub kyi mthar thug gi hu bar du yang dag pa'i lta ba can du gyur cig /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la dad pa mi phyed pa dang ldan par gyur cigabyang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gang na sangs rgyas kyi sgra mi grag pa/ chos kyi sgra mi grag pa/ dge 'dun gyi sgra mi grag pa'i ༄ 7yul mtha' 'khob tu skyes te/mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen kyi dbang gis sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag /de nas shi 'phos nas ngan song 5du ltung zhing / dge ba'i chos rnams las yongs su nyams par gyur pa de dag la/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi mtshan rna lam du grags cho par gyur cing / chos kyi sprin dang / rgya mtsho'i sgra 'byung bar gyur cig /de dag gis chos kyi sgra de thos nas sngon gyi las zad par gyur terī/ byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag /gos dang / rgyan dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang /byug pa dang / mal cha dang / na ba'i gso sman dang bral zhing mi ldan pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal myong zhing sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag thams cad gos dang / rgyan dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / mal cha dang / na ba'i gso sman dang / yongs su spyad pa dang / longs spyod 38—818

rnams bsags lkum thag tu 'byung zhing mi ldan pa med par gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du su yang ci la yang mi ldan pa med de/ dpal phun sum tshogs pa la dbang 'byor bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas phan tshun 'thab mo dang 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed par gyur cing gcig la gcig gnod par bya ba dang / gsad 2par bya ba'i phyir brtul ba mtshon dang mda' dang dbyug pa dag 1gis bsnun pas sdug bsngal bar gyur pa'am 'gyur ba de dag thams cad mda' dang mtshon dang dbyug pa la sogs pa slar log cing phyir phyogs par gyur cig /dgra thams cad kyang byams pa la gnas par gyur cig/su'i srog gi dbang po yang 'gag par ma gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du rang rang gi rdzas dang / longs spyod dang dbang phyug dag gis chog shes par gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la rdzus te bye zhing skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i 4yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ ston pa bla na med pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la sogs pa/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod pa dang / thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /gzhan yang bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas kyi byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig /38—819

skye ba thams cad du tshe rabs dran par gyur cig /tshe rabs thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa dang phrad par gyur cig /rtag tu nad med cing tshe ring bar gyur cig /log par ltung bar nam yang 'gro bar ma gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa snga ma bzhin du byas te/ smon lam 'di skad ces btab 1bo/ /deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar / de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa'i mtshan thos te yid la dran zhing len —bdun brjod de phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par/ bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag zhing las dang sa bon 'debs pa dang / tshong byed pa dang / 'thab 4mo dang rtsod pa la spro ba/ sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag thams cad bsams ma thag tu 'tshog chas thams cad 'byor par gyur cig /gnod sems med par gyur cig /rtag tu dge ba'i sems spyod par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par blangs pas sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can gang yang dmyal bar 'gro bar ma gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gzhan gyi dbang du song ste/ chad pas bcad 5pa dang / brdeg pa dang / go rar gzhug pa dang / bsad 38—820

pa'i 'os su gyur pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bcing ba dang brdeg pa la sogs pa las thar bar gyur cig /bla na med pa'i rang dbang phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag tshe thung 1bar 'gyur ba'i sdig pa mi dge ba rnam pa sna tshogs byas te/ 'chi bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad sdig pa'i las thams cad yongs su byang ste tshe ring zhing dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur bas nam yang 'ga' yang 'chi bar ma gyur cig /'chi kar yang de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa'i mtshan rna 2lam du grags shing 3rjes su dran nas/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 4'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye zhing / skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ ston 5pa bla na med pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod pa dang /thugs mnyas par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa snga ma bzhin du byas 38—821

te smon lam 'di skad ces gdab bo/ /deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i sbyan sngar de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po'i mtshan thos te/ yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod de phyag btsal ba dang /mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i rngu 'od kyi rgyal po de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus legs par brgyan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ci 'dra ba rngo de bzhin du/ sems can thams cad kyang de 'dra bar gyur cig /lus kyi 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med dpag gis mi lang ba/ lham me / lhan ne+e/ lhang nger gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad lus nor bu rin po che be+e ḍūr+ya ci 'dra ba de 'dra — bar phyi nang shin tu yongs su dag pa dang / dri ma med la 'od gsal ba dang / kho lag yangs shing che ba dang / dpal dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang / legs par gnas pa dang /nyi ma dang zla ba las lhag pa'i 'od zer gyi dra ba rnams kyis legs par brgyan par gyur pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa sman kyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar gyur cig /sems can gang dag 'jig rten gyi bar dag tu skyes pa dag dang / mi'i 'jig rten na mtshan mo mun pa mun gnag gi nang na/phyogs tha dad par 'gro ba de dag de bzhin gshegs pa de'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i 4dga' dgur 'gro zhing las kyang byed par gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de shes rab dang thabs dpag tu med pas/ bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gyi khams dpag gis mi lang ba 38—822

dag longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang ldan par gyur te/ su yang cis kyang brel ba med par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag lam ngan par zhugs pa dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam du zhugs pa de dag thams cad theg pa chen po 1bla na med pa'i lam la zhugs par gyur byug /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa de'i 2drung na tshangs par spyad pa spyod pa dang / sems can dpag tu med cing dpag gis mi lang ba de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du/ sdom pa gsum gyis bsdoms pa dang / tshul khrims nyams pa med par gyur cig /su yang tshul khrims log par zhugs te ngan 'gror 'gro bar ma gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag lus ngan pa dang / dbang po ma tshang ba dang /mdog mi sdug pa dang / bems po dang / yan lag skyon can dang / sgur po dang / sha bkra can dang / zhar ba dang / long ba dang / 'on pa dang /smyon pa dang / lus la nad kyis btab pa de dag thams cad las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang nas dbang po tshang zhing yan lag yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig/bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis lus gzir ba/skyabs med pa/ mgon med pa/ 'tshog chas dang / sman mi bdog pa/dpung gnyen med pa/ dbul ba/ sbug bsngal ba de dag gi 4nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du nad med cing gnod pa med la/ yo byad phun sum tshogs pas gnas par gyur cig /bud med gang dag bud med kyi skyon brgya dag gis kun nas nyon mongs par gyur pa/bud med kyi dngos po la mi dga' ba/ bud med kyi skye gnas las thar bar 38—823

'dod pa de dag thams cad bud med kyi dngos po las log par gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du skyes pa'i dbang po dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bdud kyi zhags pa las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lta ba tha dad pa mi mthun pa gzing gzing bas mi mthun pa dag spangs te/ yang dag pa'i lta ba la gnas par gyur cig /byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs po che sdogs par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag rgyal pos 'jigs skrag pa bcing ba dang / brdeg pa dang / go rar gzhug pa dang / bsad par 'os pa rgyu 3du mas kun du gtses pa/ nga rgyal dang bral ba/ lus dang ngag dang / sems sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa de dag thams cad gnod pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bkres pa dang / skam 3 pa'i me rab tu 'bar b.ri / kha zas tshol ba la rab tu brtson pa/ sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag thams cad kha dog dri dang ror ldan pa'i bza' btung gis tshim par gyur cig /dam pa'i chos kyi ros shin tu bde ba la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sgren mo bgo ba med pa/ dbul ba/sdug bsngal ba/ grang ba dang / tsha ba dang / sbrang bu dang / sha sbrang dag gis nyin mtshan du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba de dag thams cad gos sna tshogs dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / spud pa dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / rol mo sna tshogs kyis bsam pa thams cad yongs su sdogs shing 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims kyi rnyidaga' ba dang yang ldan te/ nyon mongs pa sna tshogs kyi gnod pas mi brdzi ltabar rnam par krol ba'i bde ba la gnas par 38—824

gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la rdzus 1te skye zhing / skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ ston pa bla na med pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 2 'od kyi rgyal po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las/bka' lung yang dag par nod pa dang / thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /gzhan yang bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag chags pa dang /ser snas zil gyis non pa'i dbang gis yi dwags sam/ dud 'gror skyes pa'am/skye bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad mi'i 'jig rten du skye zhing tshe rabs dran pa dang / ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pas skrag nas 'dod pa'i yon tan don du mi gnyer ba dang / sbyin pa la dga' ba dang / sbyin pa'i bsngags /pa brjod pa dang / bdog pa thams cad yongs su btang 4ste/ nor gyi phung po gzhan lta ci smos te/ rang gi mgo dang yan lag dang sha khrag kyang slong ba rnams la rab tu sbyin par 'gyur ba'i ngang tshul can du gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i bslab pa'i gnas log par 'dzin te / tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ tshul khrims tsam srung gi/ mang du thos pa yongs su mi tshol ba rnams chodang / mang du thos pa mdo sde rnams kyi don zab mo mi shes shing lhag pa'i nga rgyal can du gyur pa6/ gzhan dag la phrag dog byed cing / dam pa'i chos la dbang za zhing spong ba'i dbang gis sems can dmyal ba mi bzad sngopar ltung ba'am/ 'gro bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad ngan 38—825

'gro'i gnas nas thar la/ mi'i 'jig rten du skye zhing yang dag pa'i lta ba can dang / brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'i ①dge ba'i bsam pa can du gyur cig /khyem spangs te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag bdag la bstod cing gzhan la smod pa'i dbang gis ngan song gsum po dag tu lo stong phrag mang por sdug bsngal zhing de las thar nas kyang / ba lang dang /rta dang / rnga mo dang bong bu la sogs pa dud 'gro dbyug lcag gis thu/brdeg pa dang / bkres skom gyis nyen pa dang / khal chen pos gzir bar gyur pa dang /brgya la mir skyes na yang rtag tu rigs dma' ba dang / bran du 'gyur zhing gzhan gyi dbang du 'gyur bar skye bar 'gyur ba'am/ skyes pa de dag thams cad sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur nas dbang po rno ba dang / mkhas pa dang / gsal ba dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / dge ba yongs su btsal rngo ba la brtson pa dang / rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'grogs pa dang /bdud kyi zhags pa gcod pa dang / ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs gcog pa dang /nyon mongs pa'i chu klung skems par gyur cig /skye ba dang / rga shi dang /mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug ༄ pa rnams las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /sems can gang dag phra ma la dga' zhing phan tshun 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa'i sems su gyur pas phan tshun gnod par bya ba'i phyir lha tha dad pa dang / 'byung po tha dad pa dag 'gugs par byed pa(lta/ dud 'gro dag gi srog gcod cing sha dang khrag za ba'i srin po rnams mchod nas dgra bo'i ming nas brjod de/ gzugs 38—826

byas nas rig sngags drag po bsgrub cing byad dang ro langs kyi spyor bas srog gi bar chad bya ba dang / lus rnam par gzhig par 'dod pa de dag thams cad gang gis kyang gcig la gcig bar chad byed mi nus te/ phan tshun byams pa dang / phan pa'i sems su gyur cig /gnod sems med par gyur cig /lha 'dre dang / byad dang / ro langs dang / phra men gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad rang zhig cing rang lkuzhi bar gyur cig /rang rang gi bdog pas chog shes par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar smon pa de dag thams cad 'chi kar byang chub sems dpa' brgyad rdzu 'phrul gyis lhags nas lam ston cing bde ba can du rdzus te skye bar gyur cig /de las gang dag lhar skyes pa dag gi sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba zad par mi 'gyur zhing ngan 'gror mi ltung ba dang / 'di nas shi 'phos nas mi'i 'jig rten 'dir gling bzhi pa'i dbang phyug 'khor los 2snasgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur nas/sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la 'god par gyur cig /gzhan du na yang rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / khyem bdag shing sā la chen po lta bu'i khyim dag dang / nor dang / 'bru dang bang ba mang po 'byor pa'i khyim dag tu skye zhing / gzugs dang dbang phyug dang /g.yog 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang / dpa' ba dang / brtul phod pa dang /tshan po che gachen po'i stobs kyi shugs dang ldan par gyur cig /bu 'dod pa thams cad bu rnyed par gyur cig /sdog pa can gyi rmi lam rmis pa dang /ltas ngan sna tshogs mthong ba dang / gnas gang du bkra mi shis pa brgya snyed 38—827

gnas pa de dag thams cad kyang rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dang /bkra mi shis pa'i dbang shepo thams cad mthong bar mi 'gyur zhing zhi bar gyur cig/chu dang / me dang / mtshon dang / dug dang / g.yang sa dang / glang po che gtum po dang / stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / sbrul gdug pa dang / sdig pa dang / rkang lag brgya pa dang / pha rol gyi nadamag tshogs dang / rkun po dang / tshom —/ po'i 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag skyabs gsum mam/bslab pa'i gzhi lnga'am/ bcu'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa bzhi brgya po'am / dge slong gi bslab pa nyis brgya lnga bcu'am/ dge slong ma'i bslab pa'i gzhi lnga brgya po yongs su 'dzin pa de las/ bslab pa'i gzhi gzung ba gang yang rung ba zhig nyams te/ ngan song ngan 'gros 'jigs skrag pa de thams cad ltung ba dang sdog pa dang sgrib pa de dag thams cad byang zhing bsal bar gyur byug /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gtan nas ④mi 'byung bar gyur cig /bud med gang dag bu btsa' ba'i sdug bsngal drag po myong ba de dag sdug bsngal de rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /bu yang yan lag yongs su tshang bar btsas shing shā gzugs bzang ba 5blta na sdug pa dang dbang po rno zhing blo dang ldan pa dang /nad med cing gnod pa med par gyur cig /de la mi ma yin pas mdangs phrogs 7mi nus par gyur cig /tar+ya thā/ bhu me ghu me/ i me ne+e mi hi ma ti ma ti sabe+e ta thā ga ta sa mā dh+ya dhiṣ+ṭṛ te/ a te ma te/ pā le pā paṃ 1sho dha ni/sarba pā pan+d+ra sha ya/ ma ma bud+dhi burnyot+ta me/ u me ku me/ budhe k+ṣe tra pa ri sho dha ni dha me ni ra dha me/ me ru me ru me ru shi kha re/ sarba a kā la/ mṛ bhetru ni 38—828

ba ra nitsho/ budhe su budhe/ budha a byeṣ+ṭṛ te na rak+ṣan+tu me sarba de bā/ sa me a sa me/ sa ma nā ha ran+tu me/ sarba budha bo bye satwa/ sha me sha me/ pra sha man+tu tshume/ sarba i kyu pa dra ba byā dhā ya/ pā skyar ṇi pū ra ṇi/ pū ra ya me/sarba ā sha bai ḍūr+ya pra ti bha se/ sarba pā pak+ṣa yi ka ri swā hā/ bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis dgongs par gyur cig /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyis 5 yang dag par bsrung bar gyur cig /lha dang brgya byin dang / tshangs pa thams cad dang / rgyal po chen po bzhis yongs su bskyangs par gyur cig /mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig /nad thams cad kyis mi thebs par gyur cig /yun ring du 'tsho zhing dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar gyur cig /'chi ba dang / dgra dang / dgon pa'i gnod pa dang / 'thab pa dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /dgra thams cad kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar gyur cig /ci bsams pa dang / gang smon pa'i bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa nas bzung ste/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bcu gnyis kyi bar du phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa snga ma bzhin du byas la so sor zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / thugs dam bcas pa bzhin du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dpal shākya thub pas bdag cag 38—829

la sogs pa sems can gang dag las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis kyegatses pa/phongs par gyur pa thams cad rjes su bzung zhing lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang /sman pa dang bde ba'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi thabs mkhas pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam khyad par rgyas pa'i byin gyis brlabs shing dpal kyi mgur nas 'di skad du/ 'jam dpal de lta bas na yon tan don du gnyer ba rnams kyis 2nyon mongs pa dang ma 'dres par de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po de'i mtshan gzung bar bya/ bklag par bya / rab tu gus pas mchod par byas nang/ de'i sdig pa thams cad dang / las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dang / grund thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur7sgo/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro zhes ji skad bka' sprul pa dang / yang 'di skad du 'jam dpal de lta bas na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi ṣ+ṭabarjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum yid la bya/ gus 8par gzung zhing dad par bya/ sku gzugs bya/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang /spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / mar me rnams kyis mchod par bya/ yan lag brgyad pa'i bsnyen gnas la nye bar gnas la nyin bdun gtsang mar shebyas te/ sa phyogs gtsang mar byas shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar smon lam gdab/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang /snying rje ba'i sems su byas nas/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla 38—830

ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po des dgongs par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang sems par 'gyur—/ sdig pa thams cad dang las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur/byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug dang bral bar 'gyur/ yun ring du 'tsho zhing nad med par 'gyur/ gang bsams pa'i bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur—/ 'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang sdig pa thams cad zad par 'gyur lkunas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing der pad+ma'i snying po'i 2—seng ge'i khri la rdzus gte skye bar 'gyur zhing skyes ma thag tu ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams mngon du 'gyur ro zhes ji skad bka' sprul pa dang / yang 'di skad du grogs po dag de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa'i mtshan dang / gzungs kyi tshig 'di dag nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du sems can thams cad la snying rje ba'i sems kyis me tog la sogs pas mchod de/gtsang mar byas nas 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dang ldan par byas na/de'i mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa sdig pa thams cad yongs su byang bar 'gyur/'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams der pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye bar 'gyur/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ 'chi ba dang / dgra dang / dgon pa'i gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/38—831

'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe yang de bzhin gshegs pas dgongs par 'gyur/ re ba dang bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro zhes ji skad bka' byed pa dang / yang 'di skad du 'jam dpal gang dag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal de'i mtshan thos te/ nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum brjod pa dang / sems can thams cad la byams pas gnas par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal de la mchod pa byed pa de dag gi las kyi sgrib 2pa thams cad yongs su byang bar 'gyur / mya ngan dang / sbug bsngal dang / 'khrug pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur/ byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du log par ltung bar 'gro bar mi 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du rin po che sna bdun gyi pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye bar 'gyur/ lha thams cad kyis rjes su gzung 4bar 'gyur ro zhes ji skad bka' byed pa dang / yang 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs de'i mtshan thos pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / dad par byed pa dang / rab tu gus pas mchod par byed pa de sdig pa thams cad yongs su byang nas sangs rgyas kyi byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ tshe rabs thams cad du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ nam du yang byang chub kyi sems dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur/ skye ba thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa dang phrad par 'gyur/ rtag tu nad med cing tshe ring bar 'gyur/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar 'gyur/ gzhan yang log par thong bar 'gro 38—832
