bar mi 'gyur/ gang dang gang du skyes par bsams ma thag tu gos dang /rgyan dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / mal cha dang / na ba'i gsos sman dang / yo byad dang / longs spyod dang / dbang phyug dang ldan par 'gyur ro zhes ji skad bkal stsal pa dang / yang 'di skad du/ 'jam dpal gang la la zhig gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun po de dag gi mtshan thos la thos nas kyang 'dzin pa dang / nang par langs nas yid la byed pa dang / dad par byed pa dang / me tog dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / sil snyan dang / pheb 1rdob pa dag gis mchod pa dang / glegs bam du bris te 'chang ba dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'dri 2ba dang / yi ger 'drir 'jug pa dang /sems btud de gzhan las nyan pa dang / chos smra ba de dag la yang 'tshog chas dang / yo byad thams cad kyis mchod pa byed pa de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyi bar du mngon par sdogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes ji skad bkal stsal pa dang /yang 'di skad du/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa sman kyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 4 'od kyi rgyal po de'i smon lam dang thabs mkhas pa tshad med cing bskal pa bas lhag par yang brjod mi nus so/ /'jam dpal so so'i skye bo gang dag dge ba dang mi dge ba mi shes pa dag yod de/ de dag ni chags pas zil gyis non cing / sbyin pa dang sbyin pa'i 'bras bu mi shes te/ nor sog cing bsrung ba la brtson gyi sbyin pa yang dag par 'gyed pa la sems mi 'gro ste/ sbyin pa'i dus nye bar gnas pa na rang gi lus kyi sha las bcad pa bzhin du yid mi dga' 38—833

—bar 'gyur ba ༄1 / bdag nyid kyang du ma yongs su mi spyod na/ pha ma dang /bu be+ed dang / g.yog 'khor la lta ga la ster/ gzhan slong ba rnams la lta smos kyang ci dgos pa'i sems can de lta bu dag ni shi 'phos nas yi dwags sam dud 'gror bye bar 'gyur ro/ /de la gang dag sngon mir gyur pa snyen de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan thos pa de dag ni yi dwags sam/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas gang yang rung ba der de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i zu'od kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan mngon du 'gyur zhing dran ma thag pa tsam gyis tshe 'phos nas kyang chomi'i 'jig rten du skye zhing tshe rabs dran par 'gyur / ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pas skrag nas 'dod pa'i yon tan don du mi gnyer ba dang / sbyin pa la dga' ba dang / sbyin pa'i bsngags pa brjod pa dang / bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtor ltabar 'gyur ri / rim gyis rang gi mgo dang yan lag dang / sha khrag kyang slong ba rnams la rab tu sbyin par 'gyur na/ nor gyi phung po gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'jam dpal gzhan yang sems can gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bslab pa'i gnas log par 'dzin pa dag yod de/ gang dag tshul khrims dang ldan pa de dag ni tshul khrims tsam srung 7gi mang du thos pa yongs su mi tshol/ mang du thos pa dag ni mdo sde rnams kyi don zab mo mi shes shing lhag pa'i nga rgyal can du gyur te/gzhan dag la phrag dog byed cing dam pa'i chos la dbang za zhing spong bar 'gyur ro / /mi blun po bdud kyi phyogs rang yang lam ngan par zhugs la/ gzhan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du ma dag kyang g.yang 8sa chen por thong rngubar byed pa de lta bu de dag ni sems can dmyal ba mi bzad par 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /38—834

gang dag sngon de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i mtshan thos pa de dag ni sems can dmyal ba'i gnas der/ de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 1'od kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan mngon du 'gyur te/ de nas shi 'phos nas kyang mi'i 'jig rten du skye zhing yang dag pa'i lta ba can dang /brtson 'grus dang ldan pa dang / dge ba'i bsam pa can du 'gyur/ khyim spangs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang sems can gang dag bdag la bstod cing gzhan la smod pa de dag ni ngan song gsum po dag tu lo stong phrag mang por sdug bsngal myong zhing 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang / ba lang dang / rta dang rnga mo bong bu la sogs pa dud 'gor skyes 3te/ dbyug lcag gis brdeg pa dang / bkres skom gyis nyen pa dang / khal chen pos gzir bar 'gyur ro/ /brgya la mir skyes na yang rtag tu rigs dma' ba dang /bran du 'gyur zhing gzhan kyi dbang du 'gyur ro/ /gang dag sngon de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i mtshan thos pa de dag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba des sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyurakyi/ dbang po rno bar 'gyur/ mkhas pa dang gsal ba dang / yid gzhungs pa dang /dge ba yongs su btsal ba la mngon par brtson pa rtag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'grogs pa rnyed par 'gyur/ bdud kyi zhags pa gcod pa dang / ma rig pa'i sgo nga'i sbubs gcog pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i chu klung skems par 'gyur / skye ba dang / rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams las 38—835

yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang sems can gang dag phra ma la dga' zhing phan tshun 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang 'gyed par byed du 'jug pa dag yod de/ sems can de dag rtsod pa'i sems su gyur pas/lus dang ngag dang yid kyis mi dge ba rnam pa sna tshogs 'du byed de/ phan tshun gnod par bya ba'i phyir/ nags tshal gyi lha dang / shing gi lha dang / ri'i lha dang / dur khrod kyi 'byung po tha dad pa 'gugs par byed/ dud 'gro dag gi srog gcod cing / sha dang khrag za ba'i srin po rnams mchod par byed de/dgra bo de'i ming nas brjod de gzugs byas nas der rig sna sngags drag po sgrub cing byad dang ro langs kyi sbyor bas srog gi bar chad bya ba dang / lus rnam par gzhig par 'dod pa la gang dag gis de bzhin bshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan thos par gyur pa de dag la gang gis kyang bar chad bya bar mi nus te/ de dag phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang / phan pa'i sems dang / gnod sems med pa'i sems su gnas par 'gyur/ rang rang gi bdog pas chog shes par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang 'khor bzhi po rnams dang / gzhan yang dad pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang dag yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bsten gnas ༷ —pa gang dag bdag gi ④ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis nub phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar shog shig zhi—ces smon lam btab pa de dag las/ gang dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i ༄ ༷mtshan thos pa de dag 'chi kar yang byang chub sems dpa' brgyad rdzu 'phrul gyes lhag dzanas lam ston te/ bde ba can der pad+ma 38—836

tshon hūṃsna tshogs can la rdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gang la la lha'i 'jig rten du skyes pa de dag ni sngon kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba zad par mi 'gyur zhing / ngan 'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur te/ de nas sho 'phos nas kyang mi'i 'jig rten 'dir gling bzhi pa'i dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur te/sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la dgod par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan du na yang rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / khyem bdag gi rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i khyem dag dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang / bang ba mang po 'byor pa'i khyim dag tu skye bar 'gyur te/gzugs dang dbang phyug dang / g.yog 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang /dpa' ba dang / rtul 4phod pa dang / tshan po che chen po'i stobs kyi shugs dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /bud med gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i mtshan thos pa de'i 3bud med kyi dngos po de tha ma yin par shes par bya'o/ /'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 5'od kyi rgyal po de'i sku gzugs byas te/ nyin zhag bdun du bsnyen gnas la gnas la kha zas gtsang ma bza' zhing lus legs par bkrus te/ gos dri ma med pa bgo zhing phyogs gtsang mar me tog sna tshogs kyi sil ma bkram pa/ spos sna tshogs kyis bdugs pa/ ras 7dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i sa phyogs su dri ma dang / rnyog pa dang / gnod sems med pa'i sems dang byams pa dang btang snyoms dang mnyam pa'i sems su bya/ rol mo'i sgra dang sil snyan dang / glu dbyangs blang zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs de la bskor ba byas te/ de'i sngon gyi smon lam yang yid la bya zhing mdo 38—837

'di yang bton na gang bsam pa dang / gang smon pa'i bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ tshe ring bar smon na ni tshe ring bar 'gyur ro//longs spyod dang ldan par smon na ni longs spyod 'byor par 'gyur ro/ /dbang phyug dang ldan par smon na ni tshegs chung ngus 7rmye rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /bu 'dod na ni bu rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gang dag sdig pa can gyi rmi lam rmis sam/gang du bya khwa'am ltas ngan mthong ngam/ gnas gang du bkra mi shis pa brgya dag gnas par gyur pa la/ gang dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de la mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bkur ster byed na rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa'i dbang — po thams cad mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang dag me dang / chu dang / mtshon dang /dug dang / g.yang 1 sa dang / glang po che gtum po dang / seng ge dang /stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / sbrul gdug pa dang / sdig pa dang /rkang lag brgya pas 'jigs pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang / rkun po dang / chom po'i ④'jigs pa de dag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa sman kyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de la mchod pa byas na 'jigs pa de dag thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal gzhan yang gang dag skyabs gsum zhe'adzin pa dang / bslab pa'i gzhi lnga po dag dang / bslab pa'i gzhi bcu po dag dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa bslab pa'i gzhi bzhi brgya po dag dang / dge slong gi bslab pa'i gzhi nyis brgya lnga bcu po dag dang /dge slong ma'i bslab pa'i gzhi lnga brgya po dag 'dzin pa de dag ji ltar yongs su bzung ba'i bslab pa'i gzhi gang yang rung ba zhig nyams te/ ngan 'gro ngan 38—838

song gis 'jigs skrag pa de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de la mchod pa sna tshogs byed na/ de dag la ngan song gsum po'i sdug bsngal med par shes par bya'o/ /bud med gang bu btsa' ba'i dus na sdug bsngal drag po myong ba des/ de bzhin gshegs pa sman kyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de la mchod na/ de sdug bsngal las myur du thar bar 'gyur/ bu yang yan lag yongs su tshang bar btsa' zhing gzugs bzang la (1 lta na sdug pa dang /dbang po rno zhing blo dang ldan pa dang / nad med cing gnod pa med par 'gyur ro / /de la mi ma yin pas mdangs 'phrog par mi nus so/ /gzhan yang kun dga' bo ma dad cing yid mi ches te spong du zin kyang de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan su'i rna lam du grags par gyur pa de ngan 'gro ngan song du 'go bar 'gyur ba ni gnas ma yin te go skabs med do/ /kun dga' bo sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul ni yid ches par dka' ba'o zhes ji skad bka' sprul ②pa dang / snye tar+ya thā/ gh+ra me ghu me/ i mi ne—/ mi hi/ ma ti ma ti/ sap+ta ta thā ga ta sa mā dh+ya byeṣ+ṭṛ te/ a te ma te/pā le pā paṃ dze+esho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ na 4nā sha ya/ ma ma bud+dhi/ busgot+ta me/u me ku me/ budha/ k+ṣe tra pa ri sho dha ni dha me nir dha me/ me ru me ru/ me ru shi kha re/ sarba a kā la mṛ spyotru ni/ bha ra ṇi/ budhe su budhe/ bud+dhā dhiṣ+ṭṛ te na rak+ṣ-i tu me/ sarba de bā/ sa me a sa me/ sa ma nā ha ran+tu me/ sarba budhe bo dhi 3/satwa/ sha me sha me/ pra sha man+tu me/ sarba i kyu pa dra ba byā dha yaḥ9 /pūrte kwa pūrte/ pū ra ya me/ sarba ā sha bai ḍūr+ya shā(pra ti bha se/ sarba pā paṃ k+ṣa yi ka ri swā hā/⑫ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 38—839

stobs bskyed pa bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od ces bgyi ba'i gzungs 'di gang la la zhig sems can thams cad la mchog tu snying rje ba'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa bdun bo de dag gi sku gzugs byas te/ me tog la sogs pas mchod pa byed cing 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ mchod dam/ nyin zhag bdun du gso sbyang 37yan lag brgyad la gnas te/ gzungs kyi tshig lan stong rtsa brgyad du bton na de la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dgongs par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sems par 'gyurazhe/ rdo rje 'dzin pa 1thams cad kyang yang dag par bsrung bar 'gyur/ lha dang brgya byin dang tshangs pa thams cad dang /rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gis yongs su bskyang bar 'gyur/ mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ nad thams cad kyis chomi jebs par 'gyur/ yun ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba dang / dgra dang / dgon pa'i gnod pa dang / 'thab pa dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ dgra thams cad kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar 'gyur5/ ci bsams 4pa'i bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro zhes ji skad bka' sprul pa 'di ltar nyi zla ni dog sar thong yang gda'/ ri rab ri'i rgyal po ni gnas nas 'pho yang gda'/ rgya mtsho chen po ni dus las yol yang gda'/ nam mkha' ni dog sar 'gyur/dog sa ni nam mkhar 'gyur/ chab ni zhugs su 'gyur/ zhugs ni chab tu 'gyur/ bser ma ni zhags pas bzung du rung bar 'gyur yang gda'idzo /lha dang mi'i ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 38—840

thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs pa sgu dang gsung dang / thugs kyi kun du spyod pa la yongs su ma dag pa mi mnga' ba de bzhin gshegs pas legs par gsungs pa'i bka' ni gzhan du 'gyur ba ma mchis pa lags na/ che ge rta la sogs pa'i don du dpal gyi mgur nas gsungs pa'i mdo sde las 'byung ba'i tshul bzhin du nyade bzhin gshegs pa bdun dang / ston pa bde bar gshegs pa rnams gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar mchod pa ci 'byor pa bshams te/mchod nas smon lam du gsol ba rngo ci thogs pa'i nyams kyis dpags te bgyis pa 'di tsam zhig sngon ji ltar byin gyis brlabs shing bka' stsal pa bzhin du/da yang gdan 'dzom pa chen pos cho ga yongs su rdzogs par bskangs te/ byen gyis brlab cing phan yon ji skad bka' sprul pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis 4'phral du thob par mdzad cing stsal du gsol/de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa tshad mar gyur pa 'gyur ba mi mnga' ba'i bden pa mngon sum du bstan du gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa thugs dri ma dang skyon thams cad dang bral ba 5sku yon tan dri ma med pa'i tshogs kyi 'od zer gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rten gyi pad+ma la lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang /klu dang / rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi thor tshugs dang / cod pan gyis gtugs pa/ ngan song gi 'gro ba sna tshogs 'joms 6pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal dus ngan pa'i sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/38—841

lta ba ngan pa sna tshogs kyis bklags pa/ lam dang sa dman par 'og nas 'og tu thong bar 'gyur ba'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs te/gang thos pa tsam gyis ci nas kyang sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba dang / sdog pa dang las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang zhing bas par 'gyur ba dang / bdud sdog can gyis mi brdzi tsho༄ bar 'gyur ba dang / gnod pa dang mi bde ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / 'dod dgu'i re ba rdzogs shing bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ba 3—de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan dang sngon kyi smon — lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa la dmigs kyis zhu ba mdzad cing gdan 'dzom pa'i dbus su 'di skad ces bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na/ gang dag mdo 'di 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / 'chad pa dang / gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par ston pa dang / yi ger 'dri ba dang / yi ger 'drir stsol ba dang / glegs bam la bris te me tog dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan rnams kyis bkur ster bgyid pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag la/ bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan rnam pa sna tshogs bsgrag par bgyi'o / /tha na rmi lam du yang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rna lam du nye bar bsgrag bye par bgyi'o/ /tshon sna lnga pa'i ras rnams kyis dkris te/ phyogs gtsang mar bzhag na gang na mdo sde 'di gnas pa der rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang / lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gzhan yang mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /38—842

mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa de dag dus ma lags par 'gum par mi 'gyur/ sus kyang mdangs phrogs yopar mi nus te/ phrogs na yang be+er 'phrog par 'gyur ro zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa gsungs shing / 'phags pa'i bka' yang dag pa /ru) tshad mar gyur pas zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs te mchod pa bzhes shing /de bzhin gshegs pa gdan 'dzom pa la thugs dam las glengs te bskul ba dang /mdo sde'i cho ga rdzogs par bskang ba'i phrin las mdzad de/ mdo sde'i phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis thob par byin gyis brlab cing stsal du gsol/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po skyabs grol la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa skyabs grol dus ngan pa'i sems can phongs shing sdug bsngal ba rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs nas/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ 'di skad du btsun pa bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na/ sems can bro nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir te/yun ring po'i bro nad kyis lus kyi sha bas shing / bkres pa dang / skom pas gre ba dang mchu ni bskams/ 'gum lcepa 'a/ ni mngon du phyogs/ mdza' bshes dang / nye du dang / snag pegi gnyen mtshams ngu ba rnams kyis ni bskor/phyogs rnams ni mun par mthong / gshin rje'i mi rnams kyis ni sgor drangs te/de'i lus 'di na nyal yang rnam par shes pa chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i mdun du khrid cing / mi de dang lhan cig skyes pa'i lha slad bzhin du 'brang ba gang lags pa de ni dge ba dang mi dge ba bgyis pa de dag thams cad legs par yi 38—843

ger bris nas chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje la phul ba dang / chos kyi rgyal po gshin rjes de la dris shing brtags nas/ dge ba'am mi dge ba ji ltar bgyis pa de bzhin du bsgo ba la/ gang dag nad pa de'i don du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de la skyabs su mchi zhing /'di 'dra ba'i spyor bas mchod pa bkyis na/ de'i rnam par shes pa slar ldog —1 cing rmi lam rmis pa bzhin du/ bdag nyid kyis 'tshal bar 'gyur ba'i gnas der mchis te/ yang na ni gdugs bdun/ yang na ni gdugs nyi shu rtsa gcig /yang na ni gdugs sum cu rtsa lnga/ yang na ni gdugs bzhi bcu rtsa dgu la/ de'i rnam par shes pa slar bzlog cing dran pa rnyed la/ de dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rnam par smin pa bdag nyid kyis mngon sum du 'gyur te/srog gi slad du yang sdig pa'i las mi bgyid do/ /mchod pa'i spyor ba ni btsun pa kun dga' bo gang dag nad chen po las yongs su thar bar 'dod pa de dag gis / nad pa de'i don du nyin bdun kyedu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong gi sdom pa blang bar bya/ dge slong gi dge 'dun la zas dang skom rnams dang /yo byad thams cad kyis ci nus su mchod pa dang rim gro bya/ nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan yid la bya/ mdo sde 'di lan bzhi bcu rtsa dgur gdon par bya'o/ /zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgur mar me bud par bya'o//sgu gzugs bdun bya'o/ /sku gzugs re re'i spyan sngar mar me bdun bdun gzhag go/ /mar me re re'i tshad kyang shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam du bya ste/ ci nas kyang zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgur mar me mi zad par bya'o/ /tshon sna lnga pa'i ba 38—844

dan bzhi bcu rtsa dgu las lhag par bya'o/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo gzhan yang rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bsgur ba rnams la nad kyis 1gnod pa'am/rang ngam pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis gnod pa'am/ rgyu skar ram/ gza' zla ba'am/ gza' nyi ma'i gnod pa'am/ dus ma yin pa'i rlung ngam/ char ram than pa'i gnod pa yang rung ste/ gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang /'khrug pa zhig nye bar gnas par gyur 2na rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bsgur ba des sems can 1la byams pa'i sems su bya/ btson du bzung ba rnams gtang 4bar bya zhing gang 5du smos pa bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de la de lta bu'i cebhemachod pa byas na/ rgyal po de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dang / bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par gyis3/ yul bde ba dang lo legs par 'gyur / rlung dang char dus su ldang zhing lo tog 'grub par 'gyur/ yul de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyang nad med pa dang / bde ba dang /mchog tu dga' ba mang bar 'gyur ro/ /yul der gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / sha za ma rungs pas sems can rnams la gtse par mi 'gyur ro/ /ltas ngan thams cad mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po de'i tshe dang mdog dang stobs dang / nad med pa dang dbang phyug rnams 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa gsungs shing 'phags pa'i bka' yang dag pa tshad mar gyur pas zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs te/ mchod pa bzhes shing de bzhin gshegs pa gdan 'dzom pa la thugs dam las glengs te 38—845

bskul ba dang / mdo sde'i cho ga rdzogs par bskang ba'i phrin las mdzad de/mdo sde'i phan yon ji skad bka' sprul pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis 'thob par byin kyis brlab ①cing 6) du gsol/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang /rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 27dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / ku be+e ra la sogs pa dam pa'i chos song ba'i ④lha'i dge bsnyen ④thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje dang / tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byen dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung skyedang / 'phags skyes bo dang / mig mi bzang dang / ku be+e ra la sogs pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba lha'i dge bsnyen chen po rnams kyis/ ji ltar sngon gdan 'dzom pa chen po'i spyan sngar/lha'i tshig bden pas mdangs phyogasol du gsung gcig kho nar 'di skad ces/bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi musmon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa yang thos/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang mngon sum du mthong ste/ mchod pa bgyis so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das sa phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan dang / gzungs kyi tshig 'di dag spyod pa der bdag cag g.yogs sgo'akhor dang bcas te mchi bar bgyi'o/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang zhig 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / mchod pa bgyid pa dang / ye ger 'drir stsod ba der bdag cag mthun par lhan cig tu mchis te/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'am/ rgyal po'am/ rgyal po'i 38—846

blon po mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa dang / 'dri ba de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs lkukyis bsrung bar bgyi/ grong dang grong khyer dang / phyogs kyang yongs su bskyang bar bgyi/ 'chi ba dang / dgra dang dgon 2pa dang nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /bdag cag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang / sems can thams cad la byas pa gzo ba lags te/ dus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad bzlog par bgyi/ 'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi/ ji ltar bsams pa bzhin du 'grub pa dang / sems dang lus bde zhing longs spyod dang / dbang phyug dang / nor dang / 'bru rnams 'phel bar bgyi/ thams cad du bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis rang gi bro bor ba dang dam bcas pa 'di dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo des rjes su dran par bgyi'o/ /tar+ya thā/ a ghu/ ma ghu/ ta ra ghu/ ma ma bhu/ ghu re/ ha hu he/ mra mra mra mra dzu dzu re dzu re swā hā/ gang la la zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rnams dang /gzungs kyi tshig 'di dag 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / yi ger 'dri ba dang / yi ger 'drir pyastsol ba dang / rab tu gus par mchod par bgyid pa de dag ngan song gsum du mi mchi bar rig par bgyi ste/ de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las slar mi ldog par 'gyur/ ji ltar 'tshal ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu skye bar 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mthong bar 'gyur/ tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyang 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs shing zhal kyis bzhes pa dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyog thun rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la 'di skad 38—847

ces / gang mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag gi don du bdag gis 1 gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams rab tu sprul bar bgyi/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun po dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ badz+ra pā sha dha ri ṇi /sa ma sa ma/ sa man+ta a pra ti ha ta badz+re/ sha ma sha ma/ pra sha man+tu/sarba byu dha yaḥ4/ ku ru ku ru/ sarba karma ṇi/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra bha ga wān badz+ra pā ṇi/ sarba ā 5shaṃ me pa ri pū ra ya swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag gi mtshan dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ba dang / klog pa de'i re ba thams cad bdag gis yongs su bskang bar bgyi/ don thams cad kyang bsgrub par bgyi'o//gal te des bdag mthong bar 'tshal na chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'drir 6stsal bar bgyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag gi sku gzugs bdun yang bgyi/rdo rje 'dzin yang sku gdung dang bcas par bgyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la yang ji skad gong du smos pa bzhin du spos dang / bdug pa dang / mar me dang / phreng ba dang / rgyan dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / sil snyan dang /pheg rdob pa rnams kyis mchod de bskor bar bgyi/ gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag kyang gdon par bgyi/ sems can thams cad la yang phan pa'i sems dang / byams pa'i sems su bgyi/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i bsnyen gnas la gnas te lan gsum khrus bgyi zhing gos lan gsum brje bar bgyi/ tshes brgyad nas brtsams te zla ba phyi'i bco lnga'i nya'i bar du nyin 28—8 8

gcig bzhin du rig sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na de la bdag gis rmi lam du mthong bar sprul bar bgyi/ 'phel ba'i bka' mchid kyang bgyi/ re ba thams cad yongs su bskang bar bgyi'o zhes 'phags pa'i bka' mi 'gyur ba tshad mar gyur par zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'bo/ ra 'dir bzhugs shing mchod pa bzhes te/gdan 'dzom pas mdo sde'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par bskang ba'i phrin las mdzad de/ phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lhag par yang de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo la sogs pa gsung —rab dam pa'i chos yun ring du rgyas par bgyi ba dang / sgo thams cad nas chos spyod pa rnams la bar chad dang bgegs su gyur pa bdud kyi phyogs thams cad dang / yul phyogs su mi nad dang phyugs nad gtong ba dang /than pa dang sad dang ser ba la sogs pas lo thog ma rungs par bgyid pa dang /gnod pa dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa mang po ston cing /sems can la sdang bar sems pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs tha dad pa yul phyogs 'di na rgyu zhing gnas pa ci mchis pa thams cad dang / che ge mo la sngon gyi las kyis bsangs 6pa'am/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'am/ yul phyogs dang pha tshan dang rigs rgyud kyi sri can du gyur pa yang rung ste/ che ge mo'i lus dang / srog dang / chus 7srid dang / dbang phyug dang / 'khor dang /yo byad la sogs pa gang yang rung ba la ci yang rung ba'i sgo nas gnod pa bgyid pa'i gdon bgegs ci mchis pa thams cad gang la gang 'tsham pa'i thabs kyis 38—849

gdul zhing 'khon dang gnod pa'i bsam pa 'dor du zad te zhi ba dang dge ba dang byams pa'i bsam pa can du 'gyur sna zhing / sngon chad bkra mi shis pa dang gnod pa'i spyor ba bgyis pa rnams kyang 'jig cing 'dor du pa / slan chad kyang gnod pa'i bag ci yang mi bgyid par so so'i rigs kyi bro dam pos bsgag cing gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar dam tshig chen po sruX ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol / mthu dpal dang ldan pa'i lha'i dge bsnyen dam pa gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bcu gnyis po la 'di lta ste/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ji 'jigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin kyi sde dpon chen po rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rgyan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gza' 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rlung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gnas bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen 2po dbang 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin kyi sde dpon chen po btung 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po smra 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bsam 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po g.yo ba 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen bo rdzogs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /38—850

mthu dpal dang ldan pa'i dge bsnyen dam pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis po re re la yang g.yog gnod sbyin bdun 'bum 1dang bcas pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gdan 'dzom pa chen po'i spyan sngar lha'i ngag bden pas gsung gcig tu 'di skad ces/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus bdag cag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan thos te/ bdag cag la yang ngan 'gror mchi ba'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bdag cag lhan byug tu mthun par ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i slad du spro bar bgyi'o/ /bye brag tu ni grong ngam gong khyer ram / grong rdal lam/ dgon pa'i gnas gang na mdo sde 'di spyod pa dang /gang 2bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de'i mtshan 'chang ba dang / mchod pa dang / rim gro byed pa'i sems can de dag la bdag cag gis bsrung bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyang bar bgyi/gnod pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar bgyi/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o zhes 'phags pa'i ngag brtags pas zhal gyis bzhes shing thugs dam du glengs te/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gang gi phyir khyod de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de la byas pa gzo zhing rjes su dran la/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir zhus pa legs so 5zhes rjes su gnang ba de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir dul zhing zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par byams 38—85/

pa dang thugs brtso 1bas mchod pa bzhes shing mdo sde'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par bskang ste/ phan yon ji skad bka' sruX pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis 2thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lhag par yang de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo la sogs pa/ gsung rab dam pa'i chos yun ring du rgyas par bgyi ba dang /sgo thams cad nas chos spyod pa rnams la bar chad dang bgegs su gyur pa bdud kyi phyogs thams cad dang / yul phyogs su mi nad dang naphyugs nad gtong ba dang than pa dang sad ser la sogs pas ma rungs par 4bgyid pa dang /gnod pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa mang po ston cing /sems can la sdang bar sems pa'i gdon 5bgegs rigs tha dad pa mang po khams dang yul phyogs 'dir rgyu ba mchis so 'tshal dang che ge mo la sngon gyi las kyis 'das pa'am6/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'am7/ yul phyogs dang / pha tshan 8dang / rigs rgyud kyi sri can du gyur pa yang rung ste/ che ge mo'i lus dang srog dang / chab srid dang / dbang phyug 'khor dang / yo byad la sogs pa / gang yang rung ba la ci yang rung ba'i sgo nas gnod pa bgyid pa'i gdon bgegs ci mchis pa thams cad gang la gang 'tsham pa'i thabs kyis gdul zhing 'khon dang gnod pa'i bsam pa 'dor du sruX te/ zhi ba dang dge ba dang byams pa'i bsam pa can du bgyi zhing sngon chad bkra mi shis pa dang / gnod pa'i spyor ba ngan pa ci bgyis pa rnams kyang 'jig cing mdor du stsaX/ slan chad gnod pa'i bag ci yang mi bgyid par so so'i rigs kyi bro dam pos dgag cing / gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar dam tshig chen po sruX ba'i phrin las mdzad 28—852

du gsol/ re re nas mchod pa 'bul zhing smon lam gdab pa rdzogs pa'i skabs 'dir/ gzungs kyi snying po logs shig tu byung 1snab lan bdun yan chad bzhi bcu rtsa dgu man chad ci nus su bklag /ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa snga ma bzhin du byas te/ mdor bsdus pa'i gsol ba 'di skad gdab bo/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dpal shākya thub pas bdag cag la sogs pa sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis 5gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ phongs par gyur pa thams cad rjes su bzung zhing / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi thabs mkhas pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam rngo khyad par rgyas pa byin gyis brlabs shing dpal gyi mgur nas yang dag par gsungs nas / phan yon dpag tu ma mchis pa rgyas par bka' sprul pa 'di ltar nyi zla ni dog sar lhung yang gda'/ ri rab ri'i rgyal po ni gnas nas 'pho yang gda' / rgya mtsho chen po ni dus las yol yang gda'/ nam mkha' ni dog sar 'gyur/ dog sa ni nam mkhar 'gyur/ chab ni zhugs su 'gyur/zhugs ni chab tu 'gyur/ bser ma ni zhags pas gzung cidu rung yang gda'i/lha dang mi'i ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen nyid zhe thams cad gzigs pa/ sgu dang gsung dang thugs kyis 6kun du spyod pa la yongs su ma dag pa mi mnga' ba/ de bzhin gshegs pas legs par gsungs pa'i bka' ni gzhan du 'gyur ba ma mchis pa lags na/ che ge mo la sogs pa'i don 38—853

du dpal gyi mgur nas gsungs pa'i mdo sde las 'byung ba 1ba'i tshul bzhin du/de bzhin gshegs pa bdun dang / ston pa bde bar gshegs pa rnams gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar mchod pa ci 'byor pa bshams te/ mchod nas smon lam gsol ba rngo ci thogs pa'i nyams kyis dpag ste bgyis pa 'di tsam zhig /sngon ji ltar byin gyis brlabs shing bka' byed pa bzhin du/ da yang gdan 'dzom pa chen pos tshog 4yongs su rdzogs par bskangs te/ byin gyis brlab 5cing phan yon ji skad bka' byed pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi don 6'phral du mdzad cing byed du gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa tshad mar gyur pa/ 'gyur ba mi mnga' ba'i bden pa mngon sum du bstan du gsol/ 'phags pa rnams la so sor re re nas mchod pa phul zhing smon lam btab pa dang / gzungs kyi snying po bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i 'og tu/ spyir mchod pa dbul zhing bsod nams dmigs kyis bsngo ba'i smon lam gdab pa/ 'phags pa gdan 'dzom pa'i spyir mchod pa ci 'byor pa phul ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi 7smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde las 'byung ba bzhin du mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs 8dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags 9rgya mtsho'i dbyangs 38—85

dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i thu༄'od kyi rgyal po dang / ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa sbyan drangs nas mtshan nas brjod de phyag btsal ba dang / mchod cing 'phags pa de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang / bka' lung dang mthun par smon lam gsol ba dang / gzhan yang 'phags pa de dag gi srun sngar —/sdig pa bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba phul ba dang bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams ci mchis pa'i stobs dang / 'phags pa de dag gi mthu dpal dang byin gyi rlabs ( kyis/ lha sras kyi zhal snga nas kyis thog ma ma 5mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas bsags pa'i dngos sdig dang / sgrib pa ci mnga' ba thams cad ge byang bar gyur cig /sgu la bsnyun mi mnga' zhing sgu tshe dpag tu med pa ring ba dang / dbu rmog btsan dza pa dang / chab srid 'byam par rgya che zhing / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig /mthar yang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i g.yung drung gi sku chos kyi rgyal po chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang brnyes par gyur cig /chab 'og tu gtogs pa'i 'bangs thams cad kyang phyi nang gi tsuganod pa thams cad rab tu zhi zhing bde zhing skyid pa dang / 'phral yun du legs pa'i chos bzang po la gnas par gyur cig /mnga' ris kyi yul khams thams cad du yang mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / lo nyas tsodang dgra'i tshogs la sogs pa'i gnod pa dang / bkra mi shis pa'i bag ci yang mi 11 'byung ba dang / char chu dus su bab ste/ lo phyugs 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang /38—855

bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas shing / sgo thams cad nas dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur cig /sgo'i bsod nams bgyid pa la ni mjug gi bsngo bas so so nas ji ltar dad pa bzhin du bris te 'debs su 6) lo/ /smon lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'og tu/ gyes khar bzod par gsol zhing slar gshegs par gnas par bgyi ba/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal bo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs lku dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po dang / ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa spyan drangs nas mtshan nas brjod de/ phyag btsal zhing mchod pa dang / mdo dang mthun par smon lam gsol ba dang / che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang bo'i don mdzad par gsol ba'i skabs 'dir/ bdag cag dus ngan pa'i sems can spyod pa dman zhing ma dag par gyur pas ma 'tshal ba dang / bag ma mchis pa la sogs pa'i dbang gis lus dang ngag dang / yid kyi spyod pa thams cad nyon mongs pa rnams dang 'dres pa dang / mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing 3ngan la gtsang sbras ma phyed pa dang / mdo las 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du ma spyogs pa la 38—856

sogs pa 'khrul zhing nongs par gyur pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thams cad la bzod par gsol zhing mchis na/ thugs brtse bar mdzad de bzod par bzhes shing / 'phral yun gnyis su bdag cag la sgrib pa dang gnod par mi 'gyur bar byin kyis brlab tu gsol/ 'phags pa rnams kyis kyang deng ngam dgung 'di'i bar du bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba phongs shing nyam thag pa'i sems can thams cad kyis ༄1phan pa dang bde ba'i don mdzad cing bka' sprul pa yang / da dung yang bdag cag la thugs brtse bas yang dang yang du gdan 'dzom par mdzad par dgongs shing / so so'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa rnams su 'gro ba'i don la gshegs su gsol/ mjug 'dir bsngo phyaba'i tshigs bcad kyang bklag go/ /rdzogs so// //dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag dpal lha btsan po lha sras khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku tshe bsring ba dang / dbu rmog btsan pa dang / chab srid mtho ba dang / las sgrib sbyang ba dang / tshogs gnyis spel ba'i ched du/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde'i man ngag /slob dpon bo bye satwas mdzad // //38—857
