༄/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i gzungs bklag pa'i cho ga mdo sgo las btus pa/ )༄go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gye smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i gzungs bklag pa'i cho ga mdo sde las btus pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ lus legs par bkrus la gos bzang po dri ma med pa bgo zhing / kha zas/ gtsang ma bza' bar bya/sems nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i dri ma med par bya ste/ dkon mchog gi yon tan dang mdo sde'i phan yon la yid ches shing dad pa dang gus pa bskyed/ tshad rnged pa bzhi bsgom/ khyim pa yin na bsnyen gnas kyi khyems gzung / / dus bzang po tshes brgyad lta bu la brtsam4 / gnas yid du 'ong ba gtsang mar byas 'a//gdugs dang rgyal mtshan mang bos legs par brgyan pa'i nang du spos kyi maṇ+ḍal chen po byas la/ tshon phye'am me tog gis dgram par bya'o/ /lugs sgu'am ras ris sam 'jim pa las byas pa yang rung ste/ ring bsrel dang bcas nga/ bya/28 863

'khor 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gdan yang bsham/ mchod pa byu 'byor pa yang bsham ste/ sku gzugs re re'i spyan sngar mar me bdun bdun dang / tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan bdun bdun gzhag /gzhan yang spos dang /me tog dang / dri dang / lha bshos dang / rol mo'i bye brag dang / rin po che sna bdun dang / bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad dang / bum pa la sogs sta gon bya'o/ /mdo sde 'di dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs mdo sde zab cing rgya che ba gzhan yang ci nus kyis bklagathu /gzungs kyi cho ga 'di zhag bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gam bzhi bcu rtsa dgu sted du bklag 2par bya'o/ /de ltar mchod pa bshams pa dang / dge 'dun tshogs nas stan bde ba la 'dug nas stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ci nus su bsgom/ de nas langs nas sems can thams cad kyi don du tshad med pa bzhi sgom zhing byang chub kyi sems yid la bya/ de ltar rang gi nus pa dang phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pas de ltar byin gyis brlabs par yang bsam/ de nas gnas byin kyis brlab pa ste/dkon mchog gsum kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs /dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ de gigashegs pa bdun kyi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas nga/ dang / 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzom pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor dang / mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba 'di rnams ji ltar sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can gyis bsgrubs 38—864

pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan lta bu dang ldan par gyur te/ sa gzhi rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa tha gru che ba/ yangs pa reg na 'jam zhing bde ba dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/ tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i dri bsung lkudang ldan pa/ lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyis gcal du bkram pa/ mtha' rin po che'i pha gus brtsigs pa/ gser dang dngul dang mu tig gi phye ma gram bur bdal 3ba/ a la dang / ku mu ta dang pad+ma 'akying zhing ldem pas khebs par gyur cing / chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan pa sgrogs pa/ dga' zhing 'phyo ba lding bas brgyan pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho dang / rdzing dang / lteng ka dag gis mdzes par byas pa rin po che'i dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa lha'i nor bu dang /mu tig gi rgyan phreng dang rin po che dpyangs kyipa/ me tog gi mgo spyogs dang 'bras bu mdzes par chags pas g.yur za zhing ldem pa/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba las dam pa'i chos kyi sgra 'byung ba dang ldan pa tshar du sbrengs pas legs par brgyan pa'i sa gzhi la/ gzhal med khang chen po rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med par rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen po rab tu 'byung ba/ gnas tha dad pa shin tu rnam par phye ba/ mtha' yas pa rnam par gnas pa/ rgya yongs su ma chad pa/ khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul 'jig rten las 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba/ shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang bsgyur 4ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang ldan pa/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za 38—865

dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen bo dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa mtha' yas pa rnam par rgyu ba/ chos kyi ro'i dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos brten rngupa/ sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad yang dag par thob par byed pa nye bar gnas pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba/ bdud thams cad yongs su spangs pa/thams cad kyi bkod pa las lhag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa'i gnas/dran pa dang blo gros dang rtogs pa chen pos nges par 'byung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi bzhon pa yin pa/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa nyid dang / smon pa med pa nas 'jug pa/ rin po che'i pad+ma'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i bkod pa la brten pa'i gzhal med khang chen por gyur pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma'i gdan rin po che'i seng ge'i khri'i stan la/de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po dang /de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sogs saphyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phags pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzom pa'i bzhug gnas/ 'phags pa so so'i 38—866

smon lam khyad par can dang / mnga' thang dang 'tsham par grub pa/ mdzes pa sha stag 'byung bar gyur cig /phyi nang kun du yang cha rigs dang 'tsham par yang lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang / na bza' dang rgyan dang /rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogs phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /'phags pa thams cad kyang lha'adzom nas de bzhin du byin gyis brlabs shing bzhes te longs spyod par gyur cig /ces lan gsum bzlasashe/ yang dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang /chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de bzhin du gyur cig /ces lan gsum bzlas/ mchod pa'i tshogs byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'og tu 'phags pa spyan drangs te/ pus mo btsugs te me tog blangs/thal mo sbyar nas tshig 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags snyedapal gyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs nidri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal dang / de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs dang /de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 7'od kyi rgyal po dang /38—867

ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs 3pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad ma'i dus lnga brgya tha ma la dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa 'byung ba na/ sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ phongs par gyur pa'i sems can thams cad rjes su bzung zhing lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang phan pa bde ba'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa mang po dang / sngon gyi sgron lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa bzang nazhing rlabs che ba/mthu dang byen gyi rlabs 1dpag tu ma mchis pa mnga' ba la brten te che ge la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab 3snapa'i slad du/ mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren cing mchis na/ mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing / gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab hūṃpar ci gnang / de 7ltar bdag cag gi 7ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa gdul bya'i dbang du 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan kyang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par rol pa sna tshogs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing bzhugs pa yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / sngon kyi smon lam khyad par can las glengs te/ bdag cag rnams mnga' ris kyi gdul bya phyag mtshan du bzhes pa'i nang du gtogs te/ bka' drin thob pa'i 'phro mchis pa tsam la brten te/ che 38—868

ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab snapa'i slad du/ mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / rgyal ba'i sras po skyabs grol dang /phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag sngon de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo bka' stsal pa'i tshe gdan 'dzom par 'dus te/ mdo'i don byin gyis brlabs shing de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' bsgrub 1par thugs bskyed pa de dag kyang / che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang bo bskyab ri pa'i slad du/ mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na yang / mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin kyis brlab par ci gnang / sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa gdan 'dzom pa chen pos bkas gtad cing so so nas kyang lha'i tshig bden pas mdongs gsol ltadu zhal gyes bzhes te/ dam pa'i chos dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong bar mdzad cing / de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde 'di yang lhag par phyag mtshan du bzhes pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 6dang /'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / rnam thos kyi sras la sogs pa 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad kyang / che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du/ mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na/38—869

mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang /sngon de bzhin gshegs pa gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde 'chang ba dang / mchod pa la sogs pa'i sems can de dag phyag mtshan du bzhes shing bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ji 'jigs dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rdo rje dang / gnod sbyin kyi sde dpon chen po smra 'dzin dang /7 gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rgyan 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gza' 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rlung dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gnas bcas dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po dbang 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po btung 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po smra 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bsam 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin kyi sde dpon chen po g.yo ba 'dzin dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rdzogs byed de/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po thams cad la yang sngon gyi thugs dam bzang po las glengs te/ che ge mo la sogs pa 'go ba mang po bskyab pa'i slad du mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na/ mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang /skabs 'dir spyan drang ba'i tshigs bcad bklag /spyan drangs pa'i 1rjes la/so so'i zhing khams nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la gshegs te/ gzhal med khang gi dbus su seng ge'i khri chen po brgyad la de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad 38—870

bzhugs / chos po ti yang bzhugs/ bar kyi snam bu la byang chub sems dpa' gleng gzhi las 'byung lhaba'am/ yang na byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa'i gdan bsham/ de'i mdun du byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal dang / skyabs grol dang / phyag na rdo rje gsum gdan 'dzom pa la sngon gyi thugs dam bskul zhing phrin las mdzad cing bzhugs par bsam / gsum pa la g.yon gral du gnod sbyin kyi sde dpon chen mo bcu gnyis kyi gdan bsham/ g.yas gral du tshangs pa dang / brgya byin gyi gdan bsham/sgo bzhi la rgyal po chen po bzhi rang gis 3dam bcas pa bzhin sgrub cing bzhugs par bsam/ mchod pa dang dkyil 'khor sngar bden pa bdar ba'i tshul dang 'dra bar mos par bya'o/ /de ltar bsams pa'i rjes la spyir phyag 'tshal zhing mchod de/ mchod yon la sogs pa ci 'byor bas so/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po zham 'bring ba byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs du mas kun nas bskor ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o—/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser bzangs dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa byang chub sems 38—871

dpa' 3snabye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas kun nas bskor ba dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med mchog dpal byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor du mas kun nas bskor ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pas bskor ba dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i (ge'od kyi rgyal po 'khor byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma ltar snang byed dang / zla ba ltar snang byed la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'khor byang chub sems dpa' sum khri drug stong dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / skyabs grol dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ji 'jigs la sogs te/38—872

gnod spyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs su mchi'o//'phags pa'i tshogs de dag thams cad la mchod yon dang byug pa/ me tog dang bdug spos/ mar me dang zhal zas/ rol mo dang sil snyan/ gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa dngos su ci 'byor pa 'di dag dang / phyogs bcu na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i lha dang mi'i rdzas dam pa bde ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang mos pa'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyis nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' thuklas pa thams cad rgyas par bkang ste/ 'bul lo mchod do/ /ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dang / bdag cag gi zhe)thog ma ma 2mchis pa nas 'khor ba nas 'khor ba'i tshe rabs thams cad du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mdor na mi bgyi bar rigs pa'i las ni bgyis/ bgyi bar 'os pa'i las ni ༄ma bgyis pa la sogs pa'i dngos sdig ci mchis pa thams cad yang dag par 'chags so/ /dus gsum kyi 'phags pa dang / so so'i skye bo'i dge ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bskul lo/ /'jig rten kyi sgon ma gang dag mya ngan las bzla ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de dag thams cad la mya ngan las 3'da' bar 'jig rten gyi don mdzad cing yun du bzhugs par gsol bar 6'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das gdan 'dzom pa chen po dgongs su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad ma'i dus lnga brgya pa tha ma la dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa 'byung ba na sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs la/ mya 38—873

ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ phongs par gyur pa'i sems can thams cad rjes su bzung zhing lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i slad du sngon bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun gyi thabs mkhas pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa rlabs po che ji ltar btab khyecing byin gyis brlabs pa dang /don de nyid da ltar bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pas ji ltar bka' stsal cing byin gyis brlabs pa dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / skyabs grol dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das de dag gi bka' lung yang dag par bsgrubs pa dang / so so'i dgongs spyod rgya chen po sdogs par bskang ba'i be+ed du mdo sde'i don bsgrub pa'i phrin las mdzad par 'phags pa'i bka' btags pas zhal gyis bzhes shing / ji ltar byin gyis brlabs pa dang / tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / gnod sbyin kyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis la sogs te/dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i dge bsnyen chen po thams cad gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar mdo sde dang rdumado sde 'dzin pa'i sems can bsrung ba dang bskyab par ji ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa la sogs pa/ sngon 'phags pa rnams kyis ji ltar byin gyis brlabs shing bka' sprul pa'i mdo sde las 'byung ba bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa/ de rnams gdan 'dzom pa mdzad pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor bshams/ 'byor pa'i stobs ci mchis pas mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar nas gdan 'dzom pa'i srun sngar mtshan nas brjod de/38—874

mchod pa 'bul/ bka' drin nod cing mchis na/ gdan 'dzom pas sngon ji ltar byin gyis brlabs shing bka' stsal pa bzhin du mdo sde'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par mdzad cing phan yon ji skad 'byung ba'i bka' drin thams cad che ge mo la sogs pa bdag cag gis 'phral du thob par sprul bar ci gnang / de'i 'og tu 'phags pa rnams la re re nas mchod pa dbul zhing smon lam gdab par bgyi'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po'i mtshan nas brjod de mchod nas smon lam du gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs par yongs 4bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun bzlas la/ skabs 'dir mchod pa 'bul5/deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po'i mtshan thos te/ yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod pa dang / phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus—/ de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir te/ rims dang /gshed byed dang / byad dang / ro langs dang / 'jigs pa sna tshogs kyis gtses pa de dag thams cad gnod pa dang / nad thams cad 'phral du zhi bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du rims dang sdig pa can gyi gdon dang / nad thams cad med par gyur cig /rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag long ba dang / 'on pa dang /38—875

smyon pa dang / sha bkra dang / nad tshabs chen pos btab par gyur pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbang po thams cad yongs su tshang bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang nad thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gti mug gis bsgribs pa/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa/ bya ba ma yin pa spyod pa mang ba/ dam pa'i chos spong ba/ sdog pa mi dge ba'i las sna tshogs byed pa/ngan song gsum dang sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba de dag sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes nas/ sdug bsngal gye tshor ba myong ba de dag thams cad kyi mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang zhing zad par gyur cig /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bar du/ su yang sems can dmyal ba dang /ngan 'gror 'gro bar ma gyur cig /lha yul ba'i lha'i bde ba dang / mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dbul por gyur te/ zas dang / skom dang / gos dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / mal cha dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / yo byad mi bdog pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbyig dang / gos dang / nor dang /'bru dang / mal cha dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / yo byad 'phel bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bcing ba dang /brdeg pa dang / go rar gzhug pa dang / mtshon cha'i tshogs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir ba de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bcing ba dang / brdeg pa thams cad las thar bar gyur cig /lus kyi gdung ba 28—876

thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mgon med par gyur pa lus la gdung ba'i me 'bar ba dang / seng ge dang /stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / sbrul gdug pa'i nang du chud de/srog la bab cing nyam thag pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du lus la gdung ba'i me thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /nyuseng ge dang / stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / sbrul gdug pa de dag kyang byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /'jigs pa med pa dang / zhi ba'i gnas la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag phan tshun 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed par gyur te/ 'khrugs shing 'jigs skrag nas sdangs pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /phan tshun byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag chu'i nang du son pa grur zhugs pa gling med par phyin nas 5srog 'dor ba chu klung dang /rgya mtsho'i nang du son te/ smre sngags sna tshogs 'don pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du chu klung chen po de las dbugs 'byin pa phyin par gyur cig/'jigs pa med par rgal bar gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan legs rnguyongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye zhing / skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ ston pa bla na med pa mtshan legs par yongs bsgrags dpal gyi rgyal po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 38—877

sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod/ thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin bo che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo mchod do / /skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa 'bul/deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i mtshan yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod pa dang /phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ bcom ldan 'das rin po che dang zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag zhing las kyi las kyi mtha' dang / tshong la dga' ste g.yeng ba sna tshogs mang bas dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs rnams dang / byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las yongs su nyams te/ 'khor ba na 'khyams shing 1so sor 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams myong ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /rgud pa dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang /snyug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa sna tshogs so sor myong ba de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du bza' ba dang / bgo ba dang / btung ba dang / longs spyod dang / nor dang /'bru dang / dbyig dang gser rnams 'byung zhing / 'byor pa phun sum 38—878

tshogs par gyur cig /dge ba'i chos rnams ni hūṃrnam par 'phel bar gyur cig/byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /ngan song dang sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i 2'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag grang ba dang / tsha ba dang / bkres pa dang / skom pas lus yongs su gdung zhing / sdug bsngal kyi tshor bas nyam thag pa de dag thams cad kyi sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa de dag thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig /skye ba de yang tha ma par gyur cig /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du skye ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /bud med gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir cing bud med kyi skye gnas la smod pa dang / sems can gang dag btsa' ba'i dus kyi sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba de dag thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad thu rgyun chad par gyur cig /skye ba de 9yang tha mar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du skyes pa nyid thob par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag 'chi ba dang / dgra dang dgon pa'i gnod pas gtses pa dang / phan tshun pha ma dang / sring mo dang / mdza' bshes dang /nye du'i mya ngan myong zhing sdug bsngal ba dang / mya ngan gyi zug rngu lus la zug pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du 'chi ba dang / dgra dang dgon pa'i gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /mya ngan dang /sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mtshan mo 3mun nag na rnam par rgyu ba las kyi mtha' rnam pa sna tshogs la 38—879

zhugs pa/ sdig pa can gyi gdon sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ 'jigs pa dang /smre sngags 'don pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du mun pa mun nag thams cad med par gyur cig /sdig pa can gyi gdon thams cad las thal bar gyur cig /mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba sna tshogs la mngon par brtson par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dman pa la mos shing / shes rab chung la dran pa rmongs te/ dge ba'i chos rnams dang /stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun rjes su dran pa las yongs su nyams pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du ting nge 'dzin dang / dran pa dang / stobs dang / gzungs kyi sgo dang /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mngon du gyur cig /shes rab chen po rjes su rgyu bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag dman pa la mos shing nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la 'dod pa bskyed de/ de la gnas shing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rgyab kyis kyiphyogs par gyur pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig/nyan thos dang / rang 5sangs rgyas kyi sa las yang dag par 'das par gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bskal pa chen po zad pa'i tshe/'dzam bu'i gling kun du 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar bas 'khrugs par gyur te ngu zhing mya ngan byed la sngon mi dge ba'i las kyi sdug bsngal 'byung zhing skyabs med 38—880

mgon med pa de dag thams cad sdug bsngal kyedang mya ngan las rtebral bar gyur cig /bsil ba'i dngos po thob par gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos/ nas kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che dang / zla ba dang pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa'i pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye bar gyur cig /skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i yon tan sna tshogs mngon du gyur te/ ston pa bla na med pa rin po che dang zla ba dang / pad+mas rab tu brgyan pa mkhas pa gzi brjid sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod/ thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du kun du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser bzangs 5dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul / deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs gyedri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa'i mtshan yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod pa dang / phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs 3dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa de'i sngon kyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par/ bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag srog gcod pa mi dge ba'i las kyi 8rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa/ srog chags sna tshogs kyi srog 38—881

gcod pa'i las byas pas tshe thung zhing nad mang ba dang / chu dang / dug dang / mtshon dang / me dang / nad sna tshogs kyis 'chi bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad las kyi sgrib pa de yongs su byang ste/ tshe ring bar gyur cig /nad med par gyur cig /dus ma yin par 'chi 1snadus byed par ma gyur byug /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag spyig pa mi dge ba'i las sna tshogs byas te/ gzhan kyi rdzas rkus 3phrogs pas dbul por skyes te/ sgren mo dang /bkres pa dang / skom pas lus yongs su gdungs shing / sdug bsngal myong ba de dag thams cad 'phral 5du sdig pa thams cad byang ste/ byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbang phyug phun sum tshogs shing ma tshang ba med pa thob par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gcig la gcig gnod sems dang ldan zhing phan tshun srog gcod par byed pa dang / 'thab pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du phan tshun pha ma ltar byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang gti mug gis bsgribs te/ tshul khrims 'chal bar gyur nas sdig pa kun du spyod cing bslab pa dral la dad pas byin pa longs snispyod pas ngan song gsum du lhang zhing sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ba pede dag thams cad 'phral du las kyi sgrib 76pa thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du tshul khrims yang dag par 'dzin cing / lus dang / ngag dang / yid sdom pa la gnas par gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /tar+ya thā/38—882

sid+dhi sid+dhi/ su sidhe/ mo tsa ni mo k+ṣa ṇikye/ muste/ bi muste/ a ma le/bi ma le/ oṃ ga bye/ hi ra ju/ gabye/ rat+na gabye/ sar+pārba/ sā dha ni/pa ra mārba/ sā dha ni/ mā na se snye/ ma hā ma na se pya/ ad bhut+t+waṃ/ a t+yad jubye / dz+rī ta bha ye/ su brte/ brah+ma gho ṣe/ brah+ma byu ṣi te/ sarba tra thu.abe+e 6/ sarba ā ba ra thu.a pa rā dzi te/ sarba tra a pra ti ha ta 7tsa tuḥ ṣadze+e bhū 8/ta ko ṭi/ bhā ṣi te/ na maḥ‘ta thā ga tā māṃ khuswā hā/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs 13dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa des / byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs te/ sems can 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ 'chi ba dang / dgra dang dgon pas gnod par gyur pa/ tshe bskal par thub pa'i sems can dmyal bar gzhol ba'i sems can rnams la a+yo gzigs nas/ de dag gi don du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la dgod pa dang /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad zad par bya ba'i phyir gzungs sngags kyi gzhi gsungs pa 'di bzlas pa'i byin gyi rlabs thukyis/ bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa'i sdig pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig /re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /'chi ba'i tshe yang bcom ldan 'das gser bzangs thudri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pas dgongs par gyur byug /'di nas shi 'phos 8nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa gser bzangs ⑩dri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye zhing / skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/38—883

ston pa bla na med pa gser bzangs hūṃdri med rin chen snang brtul zhugs grub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod cing / thugs mnyes par byed cing / skad cig skad cig la yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mya ngan med mchog dpal la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul / deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal gyi mtshan yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod pa dang / phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par/ bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mya ngan dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa mang ba dang / sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs myong ba de dag thams cad mya ngan dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa mang ba de dag rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /su yang sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal myong bar ma gyur cig /tshe ring bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag sdig pa mi dge ba sna tshogs byas te/ mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen po mun pa mun nag chen po can du skye bar 'gyur ba'am/ skyes pa de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal gye sku las 'od zer gyi snang ba byung bas reg cing mthong ba / gyur te/ de ma thag tu sdig pa thams cad byang nas sems can 38—884

dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal de dag thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /byang chub kyi snying po la thug gi bar du lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sngon sdig pa mi dge ba bgyis te/ gzhan gyi rdzas phrogs nas dbul por dman pa'i khyim du skyes nas gos dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / mal cha dang / rgyan snyemi bdog pa grang ba dang /tsha ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba dang / bkres pa dang / skom pas lus gzir zhing mdog ngan par gyur pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bgo ba dang /bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / mal cha thams cad la yang longs spyod par gyur cig /lus la lha'i lus kyi kha dog gis brgyan par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang /'byung po dang / sha za rnams kyis gtses shing mdangs phrogs te/ nad kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / sha za rnams kyis mdangs phrogs pa thams cad rab tu zhi zhing byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /nad kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye zhing byeskyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ ston pa bla na med pa mya ngan med mchog dpal la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod/ thugs mnyes par byed cing skad byug skad cig la sangs 38—885

rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa dbul/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi rngumatshan thos te/ yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod de phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rngu rgya mapa'i dbyangs de'i sngon kyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag log par rngulta ba can gyi khyim du skyes pas/sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la ma dad pa/ byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las ring du gyur pa de dag las kyi sgrib pa de zad par gyur nas/ byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du yang dag pa'i lta ba can du gyur cig /sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la dad pa mi phyed pa dang ldan par gyur cig /byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa las phyir mi ldog par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gang na sangs rgyas kyi sgra mi grag pa dang /chos kyi sgra mi grag pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sgra mi grag pa/ yul mtha' 'khob tu skyes te/ mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rgyus sdog pa'i las byed pa de dag de nas shi 'phos nas ngan song gsum du ltung zhing dge ba'i chos rnams la thu nyams par gyur pa de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi mtshan rna lam du grags par gyur cing chos thusprin dang rgya mtsho'i sgra 'byung bar gyur cig /de dag gis chos kyi sgra de thos nas sngon gyi las zad par 38—886

gyur te/ byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du byang chub kyi sems yid la byed pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag gos dang / rgyan dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang /mal cha dang / na ba'i gsos sman dang bral zhing mi ldan pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal myong zhing sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag gos dang / rgyan dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / mal cha dang / na ba'i gsos sman dang / longs spyod rnams bsams ma thag tu 'byung zhing mi ldan pa med par gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du su yang ci dang yang mi ldan pa med tshopar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pas phan tshun 'thab mo 'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang 'gyed par gyur cing gcig la 2gcig gnod par bya ba dang / gsad 7par bya ba'i phyir btung ④/ba dang / mtshon dang / mda' dang / dbyig pa dag gis bsnun te/ sdug bsngal bar gyur pa de dag la 'a mda' dang / mtshon dang / dbyig pa la sogs pa las slar log par gyur cig /phyir phyogs par gyur cig /dgra thams cad kyang byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /su'i srog gi dbang po yang 'gag par ma gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du rang rang gi rdzas dang / longs spyod dang / dbang phyug dag gis chog shes par gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye zhing skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ ston pa bla na med pa chos bsgrags rgya 38—887

mtsho'i dbyangs la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod/ thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /ri1bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho'i zumachog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun bzlas/skabs 'dir mchod pa dbul/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho'i — mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa'i mtshan thos te/ yid la dran zhing ④lan bdun brjod de phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang zhemathun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag zhing las dang /sa bon 'debs pa dang / tshong byed pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag thams cad kyis bdag gi 6ming thos nas bdag gi mthus bsams ma thag tu 'tshog chas thams cad 'byor par gyur cig /gnod sems med par gyur cig /rtag tu dge ba'i chos spyod par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mi dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par blangs 4 pas/ sems can dmyal bar zhu'agro bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can gang dag (snadamyal bar — ma gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa 38—888

sems can gang dag gzhan gyi dbang du song ste/ chad pas bcad pa dang /brdeg skyepa dang / go rar gzhug pa dang / bsad pa'i 'os su gyur pa de dag thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bcing ba dang brdeg 2 pa la sogs pa las thar bar gyur cig /bla na med pa'i rang dbang phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur sbug /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag tshe thung 8 bar 'gyur ba'i spyig pa mi dge ba sna tshogs byas te/ 'chi bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad sdig pa'i las thams cad yongs su byang ste/ tshe thung zhing dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur bas/ nam yang 'ga' yang 'chi bar ma gyur cig /'chi kar de bzhin gshegs pa chos rgya mtsho 4mchog gi blos rnam par rol pas shemangon par mkhyen pa'i mtshan rna lam du grag thucing rjes su dran nas/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du lha dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos rgya mtsho mchog gi blos rnam par rol pa mngon par mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po'i seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye zhing / skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa 3yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ ston pa bla na med pa chos rgya mtsho mchog gi 3blos rnam par rol pas mngon par mkhyen pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod/ thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par 38—889

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 6)'od kyi rgyal po'i mtshan thos te/yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod de phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus—/ de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i (kye'od kyi rgyal po de'i sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mthun par bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad skyes bu chen po'i mtshan 1sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus cho lus legs par brgyan par gyur te/ bdag ci 'dra ba de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang de 'dra bar gyur cig /lus kyi 'od zer gyis phya'ajig rten gyi khams grangs med pa dpag gis mi lang pa lham me/ lhan ne+e / lhang nger gyur cig /lus nor bu rin po che bai ḍūr+ya ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar phyi nang shin tu yongs su dag pa dang / dri ma med la 'od gsal ba dang /kho lag yangs shing gsal ba dang / dpal dang gzi brjid 'bar ba dang /legs par gnas pa dang / nyi ma dang zla ba bas lhag pa'i 'od zer gyi dra ba rnams kyis legs par brgyan par gyur byug /de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar gyur te/ sems can gang dag 'jig rten gyi bar du skyes pa dag dang / gang dag yang mi'i 'jig rten 'di na mtshan mo mun pa tremun nag gi nang na/ phyogs tha dad par 'gro ba de dag gi dz+wabadag gi 'od kyis zuphyogs dga' mgur 'go zhing las rnams byed par gyur cig/de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od de'i shes rab dang thabs dpag tu 38—890

med pas/ bdag cag la sogs pa sems can kyi khams dpag gis ༄(mi lang ba dag /longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang ldan par gyur te/ su yang cis kyang brel ba med par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag lam ngan par zhugs pa dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam du zhugs pa de dag thams cad theg pa chen po bla na med pa'i lam la zhugs par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du sdom pa gsum gyis kyebasdams pa dang / tshul khrims nyams pa med par gyur cig/su yang tshul khrims log par zhugs te ngan 'gror 'gro bar ma gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag lus ngan pa dang / dbang po ma tshang ba dang / mdog mi sdug pa dang / bems po dang / yan lag skyon can dang / sgur po dang / sha bkra can dang / zhar ba dang / long ba dang /'on pa dang / smyon pa dang / lus la nad kyis btab pa de dag thams cad las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang nas/ thams cad dbang po tshang zhing yan lag yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /sems can gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba—/ skyabs med pa/ mgon med pa/ 'tshog chas dang / sman mi bdog pa / dpung gnyen med pa/ dbul ba sdug bsngal ba de dag gi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du nad med cing gnod pa med pa dang / yo byad phun sum tshogs par gnas par gyur cig /bud med gang dag bud med kyi skyon brgya dag gis kun nas nyon mongs par gyur pa bud med kyi dngos po la mi dga' ba bud med kyi skye gnas las thar bar 'dod pa de dag thams cad bud med kyi dngos po las log par gyur cig /38—891

byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du skyes pa'i dbang po dang ldan par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad bdud kyi zhags pa las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lta ba tha dad pa mi mthun pa zang 1zing pas mi mthun pa dag spangs te yang dag pa'i phyalta ba la gnas par gyur cig /byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs po che rdzogs par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa segs can su dag rgyal po'i 'jigs pas skrag pa dang / gang dag bcing ba dang / brdeg pa dang / go rar gzhug skyepa dang / bsad par 'os pa rgyu du mas kun du gtses pa / nga rgyal dang bral ba/ lus dang / ngag dang / sems sdug bsngal kyis nyen pa de dag bdag gi bsod nams kyi rngumathus/ gnod pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bkres pa dang / skom pa'i me rab tu 'bar ba/ kha zas tshol ba la rab tu brtson pa/ sdig pa'i las byed pa de dag gi kha dog dang / dri dang / ror ldan pa'i bza' btung gis tshim par byas te/ phyis chos kyi 1ros shin tu bde ba la 'god par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag sgren mo bgo ba med pa dbul ba sdug bsngal ba grang ba dang / tsha ba dang / sbrang bu dang / sha sbrang dag gis nyin mtshan du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba de dag gis gos yongs su sbyad par 'os pa tshon sna tshogs su kha bsgyur ba dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / spud pa dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa rnams kyis sems can rnams kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur byug /'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims kyi dga' ba dang ldan par gyur cig /nyon mongs pa'i gdung bas 38—892

mi brdzi 7 bar rnam par grol ba'i bde ba la gnas par gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad+ma'i snying po seng ge'i khri la rdzus te skye zhing skyes ma thag tu gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa yon tan kyi tshogs thams cad mngon du gyur te/ ston pa bla na med pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi 2rgyal po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad las bka' lung yang dag par nod/thugs mnyes par byed cing skad cig skad cig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug par gyur cig /1 ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun bzlas / skabs 'dir mchod pa dbul/ deng rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i mtshan yid la dran zhing lan bdun brjod de/ phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa la sogs pa'i mthus / ston pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas bdag cag la sogs pa'i sems can gang dag las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/phongs par gyur pa thams cad rjes su gzung zhing / lha dang mi'i don dang /sman pa dang bde ba'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi thabs mkhas pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa byin gyis brlabs shing / dpal gyi mgur nas 'di skad du 'jam dpal de lta bas na/ yon tan thams cad don du gnyer ba rnams kyi nyon mongs pa dang ma 'dres par de bzhin gshegs pa 38—893

bdun gyi mtshan gzung ①bar bya/ nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du yid la bya—/ gus pas dad par bya/ sku gzugs kyang bya/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / mar me dang / byug pa dang / zhal zas dang / rol mo'i sgra la sogs pas mchod par bya/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bsnyen gnas la nye bar gnas par bya/ nyin bdun gtsang mar byas te/ sa phyogs gtsang mar gnas shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar smon lam gdab par bya/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang / snyeng rje'i sems su bya zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang / tar+ya thā/ ghu me ghu me/ i mi rgo/ mi tshu hi/ ma ti ma ti / sap+ta ta thā ga ta/ sa mā khye (snyedhiṣ+ṭṛ te/ a te ma te/ pā le pā paṃ sho dha ni/sat+tha pā paṃ nā sha ya/ ma ma budhe burnyot+ta me/ u me ku me/ budha k+ṣe tra pa ri sho dha ni/ dha me ni dha me/ me ru me ru/ me ru shi kha re/ sat+tha a kā la mṛ kyu/ nī pā ra ṇi 7/ budhe su bud+dhi/ budha ⑤a byeṣ+ṭṛ te na/ rak+ṣan+tu me/ sarba de bāḥbye /sa me a sa me/ sa ma nā ha ran+tu me/ sarba budhe/ bo bye satā/ sha me sha me3/pra sha man+tu me/ sarba ā+o kyud hūṃpa dra ba byu dh+wa yaḥ pū ra ṇi pū ra byeṇi pū ra ya me/sat+tha ā sha yā bai ḍūr+ya pra ti bhā se/ sat+tha pā paṃ k+ṣa yi kā r+shari swā hā/ bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i gzungs 'di rigs kyi bu'am yerigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis 'di 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ mchod dam/ lan stong rtsa brgyad du bton na/de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sems par 'gyur/ rdo rje 'dzin thams cad kyis yang dag par bsrung bar 'gyur/ lha thams cad dang / tshangs pa dang /brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dag gis yongs su skyong bar 'gyur/38—894

mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad kyang yongs su byang bar 'gyur / nad thams cad kyis mi btab par 'gyur/ ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur/dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs kyepa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur/'chi ba dang / dgra dang / dgon pa'i gnod pa dang / 'thab pa dang /rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ dgra thams cad kyi dbang du 'gro bar mi 'gyur/ ci bsams bhepa'i bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro zhes ji skad bka' stsal pa de dag thams cad che ge mo la sogs pa'i don du mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa bdun dang / ston pa bde bar gshegs pa rnams gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar mchod cing smon lam gsol pa dang / gzungs sngags bzlas pas ji ltar byin gyis brlabs thushing bka' stsal pa bzhin du byin gyis brlab cing phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis 'phral du thob par mdzad cing zad bar ci gnang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa tshad mar gyur pa/ 'gyur ba mi mnga' ba de bdag cag la bden pa mngon sum du bstan par ci gnang / ma rig mun sel sgron ma mchog /sdug bsngal nad sel sman gyi phul/ /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan bdun bzlas/ bar 'dir chos la bstod pa dang / mchod pa bya/ dam pa'i chos dkon mchog thams cad kyi bden pa'i byin rlabs 5kyis/ bdag cag tshe rabs nas tshe rabs thams cad du dam pa'i chos 'dzin par gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ thugs dri ma 38—895

dang skyon thams cad dang bral ba/ sku yon tan dri ma med pa'i tshogs kyi 'od zer gyis 1brgyan pa/ zhabs rten gyi pad+ma la lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang /klu dang rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi thor tshugs dang / cod pan gyis gtugs pa—/ ngan song gi 'gro ba sna tshogs 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul / bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa 'jam dpal dus ngan pa'i sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshog/sa kyis bsgribs pa/ nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba/ mya ngan dang sbug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gtses pa/ lta ba ngan pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa/ lam dang sa dman par 'og nas 'og tu ltung bar 'gyur ba'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ gang thos pa tsam kyis ci nas kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba dang / sdig pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang zhing dag par 'gyur ba dang /bdud sdog can gyis mi brdzi bar 'gyur ba dang / gnod pa dang mi bde ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba dang / 'dod dgu'i re ba thams cad dang bsam 4pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan dang / sngon gyi smon lam khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde ston pa'i bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la dmigs kyis zhu ba mdzad cing /gdan 'dzom pa'i dbus su 'di skad ces bcom ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na/ gang dag mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang / gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par ston pa dang / yi ger 'dri ba dang / 'drir stsol ba dang /glegs bam la bris te/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / phreng ba dang /38—896

byug pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan rnams kyis bkur ster bgyid pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag la bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i mtshan rnam pa sna tshogs su bsgrags 1par bya'o / /tha na rmi lam du yang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rna lam du nye bar bsgrub par bgyi'o—/ /tshon sna lnga pa'i ras kyis dkris te/ phyogs gtsang mar bzhag na gang na mdo sde 'di gnas pa der rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang /lha bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gzhan yang mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /mdo sde 'dzin pa de dag dus ma lags par 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sus kyang mdangs 'phrog sa7par mi nus te phrogs na yang slar 'phrog —par 'gyur ro zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa gsungs shing / 'phags pa'i bka' yang dag pa tshad mar gyur pas zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs te/ mchod pa bzhes shing de bzhin gshegs pa gdan 'dzom pa la thugs dam las glengs te bskul ba dang / mdo sde'i cho ga rdzogs par bskang ba'i phrin las mdzad de/ mdo sde'i phan yon ji skad bka' sprul pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis 'phral du thob par byin gyis brlab cing stsal bar ci gnang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa skyabs grol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun bzlas/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul / bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa skyabs grol/ dus ngan pa'i sems can phongs shing sdug bsngal ba rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs nas/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das gdan 'dzom pa'i sbyan sngar/ 'di skad du btsun pa bcom 38—897

ldan 'das slad ma'i tshe slad ma'i dus na sems can bro nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir te/ yun ring por bro nad kyis lus kyi 3sha bas shing bkres pa dang skom pas gre ba dang mchu ni bskams/ 'gum pa la ni mngon du phyogs/mdza' bshes dang nyetsho du dang snag gi gnyen mtshams ngu ba rnams kyis ni bskor/phyogs rnams ni mun par mthong / gshin rje'i mi rnams kyis ni drangs te/de'i lus 'di na nyal yang rnam par shes pa chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i mdun du 'khrid rtecing / mi de dang lhan cig byes pa'i lha slad bzhin 'brang ba gang lags pa des dge ba'am mi dge ba bgyis pa de dag thams cad legs par yi ger bris nas chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje la phul ba dang / chos kyi rgyal po gshin rjes de la dris shing brtags nas dge ba'am mi dge ba ji ltar bgyis pa de bzhin du bsgo ba la/ gang dag nad pa de'i don du/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po de la skyabs su mchi zhing 'di 'dra ba'i sbyor bas mchod pa bkyis thu na de'i rnam par shes pa slar ldog cing / rmi lam rmis pa bzhin du bdag nyid kyang 'tshal ba'i gnas ma ④mchis te/ yang na ni gdugs bdun/ yang na ni gdugs nyi shu rtsa gcig /yang na ni gdugs sum cu rtsa lnga/ yang na ni gdugs bzhi bcu rtsa dgu la de'i rnam par shes pa slar ldog cing / dran pa rnyed la dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa bdag gi phyamangon sum du gyur te/ srog gi lan du yang sdig pa'i las mi bgyid do/ /mchod pa'i sbyor ba ni btsun pa kun dga' bo gang dag nad las yongs su thar bar 'dod pa de dag gis nad pa de'i don du nyin bdun mtshan bdun du yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong gi sdom pa blang bar bya/ dge 38—898

slong gi dge 'dun la zas dang skom rnams dang yo byad thams cad kyis ci nus su mchod pa dang rim gro bya/ nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od de'i mtshan yid la bya/ mdo sde 'di yang lan bzhi bcu rtsa dgur gdon par bya'o/ /zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgur mar me bud par bya'o/ sku gzugs bdun bya'o/ /sgu gzugs re re'i spyan sngar mar me bdun bdun gzhag /mar me re re'i tshad kyang shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam du byas te / ci nas kyang zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgur mar me mi zad par bya'o/ /tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan bzhi bcu rtsa dgu las lhag par bya'o/ /btsun pa kun dga' bo rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba rnams la nad kyi gnod pa dang / rang ngam pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi gnod pa'am/ rgyu skar ram/ gza' zla ba'am/gza' nyi ma'i gnod pa'ang/ dus ma yin pa'i rlung ngam/ char ram than pa'i gnod pa'ang rung / gnod pa dang 3sna'ago ba'am 'khrug pa zhig nye bar gnas par gyur na/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba des sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems su bya/ btson du bzung ba rnams gtang ra chibar bya zhing gong du smos pa bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla be+e ḍūr+ya'i 'od de la de lta bu'i mchod pa byas na/ rgyal po de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang /bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od de'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par gyis yul bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / char chu dus su ldang zhing lo tog 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / nad med pa dang / bde ba dang / mchog tu dga' ba mang bar 'gyur ro/ /yul de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyang yul der gnod sbyin dang / srin bo dang / 'byung po dang / sha za ma 38—899

rungs pas sems can rnams la gtse bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ltas ngan pa thams cad mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po de'i tshe dang mdog dang stobs dang /dbang phyug rnams mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes bkyi ba la sogs pa bka' pa pa gsungs shing 'phags pa'i bka' yang dag pa snasnatshad mar gyur pas zhal gyis bzhes bzhin du deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs te/ mchod pa bzhes shing de bzhin gshegs pa gdan 'dzom pa la thugs dam las glengs te/ bskul ba dang / mdo sde'i cho ga rdzogs par bskang ba'i phrin las mdzad de/ mdo sde 'di las phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis thob par byin gyis brlab cing 30 bar ci gnang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o / /tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 2dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / ku be+e ra la sogs pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i lha'i dge bsnyen thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan bdun bzlasazi/ skabs 'dir mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje dang / tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang /rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 5dang / 'phags skyes po dang / mig mi bzang dang / ku be+e 6ra la sogs pa tsodam pa'i chos skyong ba'i lha'i dge bsnyen chen po rnams kyis ji ltar sngon gdan 'dzom pa chen po'i sbyan sngar/ lha'i tshig bden par mdongs sagasol du gsung gcig kho nar 'di skad ces/ bcom 38—900

ldan 'das bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam 1khyad par rgyas pa yang thos/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang mngon sum du bgyis te mchod pa bgyis so/ /yang bcom ldan 'das sa phyogs gang na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan dang / gzungs kyi tshig 'di dag spyod pa der bdag cag g.yog dang bcas te mchi bar bgyi'o/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang zhig 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / mchod par bgyid pa dang /yi ger 'drir stsal bye ba der bdag cag mthun par lhan cig mchis te/ rigs kye bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'am/ rgyal po'am rgyal po'i blon po mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa dang / 'dri ba de la de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyi rlabs kyis bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang / phyogs kyang yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /'chi ba dang / dgra dang / dgon pa dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /bdag cag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dang sems can thams cad la byas pa gzo ba lags te/ dus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad bzlog par bgyi'o/ /'thab pa dang / 'thab mo dang / rtsod pa dang / 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ji ltar bsams pa yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang / sems dang lus bde zhing longs spyod dang / dbang phyug dang / nor dang 'bru rnams 'phel bar bgyi'o/ /thams cad du bsrung bar bgyi'o—/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag rang gi bro bor ba dang / dam bcas pa 'di dag rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo des rjes su dran par bgyi'o/ /tar+ya thā/ a gh+ra ma ghu/ ta ra ghu/ ma ma gh+ra ghu re/ hā byu te/ mra mra mra mra/dzu 4dzu dzu re swā hā/ gang la la zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rnams dang /38—90/

gzungs kyi tshig 'di dag 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / yi ger 'dri ba dang / yi ger 'drir stsol ba dang / rab tu gus par mchod pa bgyid pa de dag ngan song gsum du dzosnamachi bar rig snapar bgyi'o/ /de ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las slar mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar 'tshal ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur1/ tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyang thob par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs shing zhal gyis bzhes pa dang /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la 'di skad ces gang mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa de dag chogis gzungs kyi 5gsang sngags sprul bar bgyi/ dgongs su gsol/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun po zhwal phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re badz+ra dz+wapā sha dha ra ṇi/ sa ma sa ma/ sa man+ta a pra ti ha te/ ha ha badz+re/ sha ma sha ma/ pra sha man+tu me sadze+e byā dhā yaḥku ru ku ru/ sat+tha ka ṇi 9sa ma ya ma nu sma ra bha ga wān/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ saza ā shī me pa ri pū ra ya swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das gang la la zhig de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag gi mtshan dang / sngon kyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa dang / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chang ba dang / klog pa de'i re ba thams cad bdag gis yongs su bskang bar bgyi'o/ /don thams cad yongs su bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /gal te des bdag mthong bar 'tshal na/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'drir sprul bar bgyi'o11/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag gi sku gzugs bdun yang bgyi/ rdo rje 'dzin yang sku gdung dang bcas pa bgyi/ de bzhin gshegs 38—902

pa de dag la yang ji skad gong du smos pa bzhin du/ spos dang / bdug pa dang / mar me dang / phreng ba dang / rgyan dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa rnams kyis mchod de bskor bar bgyi/gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag kyang gdon par bgyi/ sems can thams cad la yang phan pa'i sems su bkyi/ 'phags pa'i lam /yan lag brgyad pa'i bsnyen gnas la gnas te/ lan gsum khrus bkyi zhing / tshes brgyad nas brtsams te/ zla ba phyi ma'i bco lnga'i nya'i bar du nyin gcig bzhin du rig sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ de la bdag gis rmi lam mthong ba stsal bar bgyi/ 'be+el ba'i bka' mchid kyang bkyi/ re ba thams cad kyang yongs su bskang bar bgyi'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'phags pa'i bka' mi 'gyur ba tshad mar gyur pas zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs te/ mchod pa bzhes te gdan 'dzom pas mdo sde'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par bskang ba'i phrin las mdzad de/ phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams can kyis thob par byin gyis brlab par byu gnang /lhag par yang de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo la sogs pa'i gsung rab dam pa'i chos yun ring du rgyas par bgyi ba dang /sgo thams cad nas chos spyod pa rnams la bar chad dang bgegs su gyur pa dang /bdud kyi phyogs su gyur pa thams cad dang / yul phyogs su mi nad dang /phyugs nad gtong ba dang / than pa dang / sad dang ser ba la sogs pas lo tog ma rungs par bgyid pa dang / gnod pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa 38—903

dang / bkra mi shis pa mang po ston cing sems can la sdang bar sems pa'i gdon bgegs rigs tha dad pa yul phyogs 'di na rgyu zhing gnas pa ci mchis pa thams cad dang / che ge mo la sngon gyi las kyis 'das 3pa dang / 'phral kyi rkyen las byung ba'am/ yul phyogs dang / pha tshan dang / rigs rgyud kyi sri can du gyur pa yang rung ste/ che ge mo'i lus dang / srog dang / chus srid thu dang / dbang phyug dang / 'khor dang / yo byad la sogs pa gang yang rung ba la ci yang rung ba'i sgo nas gnod pa bgyid pa'i gdon bgegs ci mchis pa thams cad gang la gang 'tsham pa'i thabs kyis 'dul zhing khon dang / gnod pa'i bsam pa 'dor du stsal te/ zhi ba dang / dge ba dang / byams pa'i bsam pa can du 'gyur zhing / sngon chad bkra mi shis pa dang / gnod pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa bkyis pa rnams 'jig cing 'dor du pa / slan chad kyang gnod pa'i bag ci yang mi bgyid par so so'i rigs kyis bro dam pos 4bsgag cing / gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar dam tshig chen po pa ba'i phrin las mdzad par ci gnang / mthu dpal dang ldan pa'i dge bsnyen bcu gnyis la gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ji 'jigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod spyin gyi sde dpon chen po rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o / /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rgyan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gza' 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rlung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po gnas bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o//38byed904

gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po dbang 17'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po btung 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gye sde dpon chen po smra 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bsam — 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po g.yo ba 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rdzogs byed la phyag 'tshal lo//mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /skabs 'dir mchod pa dbul/ mthu dpal dang ldan pa'i dge bsnyen gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis po re re la g.yog gnod sbyin bdun 'bum —dang bcas pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar/ lha'i ngag bden pas gsung gcig tu4 /'di skad du sangs rgyas kyi mthus bdag cag gis 5de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od kyi rgyal po'i mtshan thos te/ bdag cag la yang ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /des na bdag cag lhan cig tu mthun par ji srid 'tsho'i bar du sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi don dang / sman pa dang / bde ba'i slad du spro bar bgyi'o/ /bye brag tu grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ dgon pa'i gnas gang na mdo sde 'di spyod pa dang / gang na de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od de'i mtshan 'chang ba dang / mchod pa dang rim gro byed pa'i sems can de dag la / bdag cag gis bsrung bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyang bar bgyi/38—905

gdon thams cad las yongs su thar bar bgyi/ bsam 1pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes te thugs dam du bzhes shing /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang gang gi phyir/ khyed de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od de la byas pa gzo zhing rjes su dran la sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir zhugs pa legs so legs so zhes rjes su gnang ba ston pa de bzhin du / deng 'dir yang mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir dul zhing zhi ba'i 'khor dang ldan par byams pa dang thugs brtse bas mchod pa bzhes shing mdo sde'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par bskang ste/ phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyis thob par byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / lhag par yang de bzhin gshegs pa bdun byu smon lam kyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo la sogs pa gsung rab dam pa'i chos yun ring du rgyas par bgyi ba dang/ sgo thams cad nas chos spyod pa rnams la bar chad dang bgegs su gyur pa dang / bdud kyi phyogs thams cad dang / yul phyogs su mi nad dang / phyugs nad gtong ba dang /than pa dang / sad dang ser ba la sogs pas lo thog ma rungs par bgyid pa dang / gnod pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa mang po ston cing / sems can la sdang bar sems pa'i gdon bgegs rigs tha dad pa mang po khams dang yul phyogs 'dir rgyu ba mchis so 'tshal dang / che ge mo la sngon gyi las kyis 'das /pa'am/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'am/ yul phyogs dang pha tshan dang / rigs rgyud kyi sri can du gyur pa yang rung ste/ che ge mo'i lus dang srog dang / chus 4srid dang / dbang phyug dang / 'khor 38—906

dang yo byad la sogs pa gang yang 7rung ba'i sgo nas gnod pa bgyid pa'i gdon bgegs ci mchis pa thams cad gang la yang gdul ba'i thabs kyis 'dul zhing /khon dang gnod pa'i bsam pa 'dor du stsal te/ zhi ba dang dge ba dang /byams pa'i bsam pa can du bgyi zhing / sngon chad bkra mi shis pa dang /gnod pa'i spyor ba ngan pa bgyis pa rnams kyang 'jig cing 'dor du stsal/slan chad kyang gnod pa'i bag ci yang mi bgyid par so so'i rigs kyi bro dam pos bsgag cing gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar dam tshig chen po stsal ba'i phrin las mdzad par ༄ snaci gnang / re re nas mchod pa dbul zhing smon lam gdab pa —rdzogs pa'i skabs 'dir/ gzungs sngags bzlas la khrus bya/ 'phags pa gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar 5mchod pa ci 'byor pa 'bul/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo sde las byung ba bzhin du mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun dang / ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas mtshan nas brjod de/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam 6 khyad par can dang mthun par smon lam btab pa dang / de dag gi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa dang dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang / bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams ci mchis pa'i stobs dang / de dag gi mthu dpal dang byin rlabs 7kyi stobs kyis che ge mo la sogs pa'i zhal snga nas/thog ma ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa mnga' ba thams cad byang bar gyur cig /sku la bsnyun mi mnga' zhing sku tshe ring ba dang /38—907

dbu rmog btsan 1pa dang / chab srid 'byam dar che ba dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig /mthar yang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs nas g.yung drung gi sku chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang brnyes par gyur cig /chabs 3'og tu gtogs pa'i 'bangs thams cad kyang phyi nang gi gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi zhing bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang / bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po thob par gyur cig /yul khams thams cad du yang mi nad dang /phyugs nad dang / lo nyes pa dang / dgra'i gnod pa dang / bkra mi shis pa'i bag ci yang mi 'byung /ba dang / char chu dus su bab ste/ lo phyugs 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyang bde ba thams cad dang ldan zhing 'jig rten gyi khams de dag tu skyes nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi zhal mthong ste gdams ngag thob nas tshogs gnyis sdogs nas sangs rgyas par gyur cig /khyad par du yang dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas shing sgo thams cad nas dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /de nas bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun 'khor dang bcas pa dang / ston pa bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa'i spyan sngar che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad par gsol ba'i skabs 'dir / bdag cag dus ngan pa'i sems can spyod pa dman zhing ma dag pas ma 'tshal ba dang / bag ma mchis pa'i dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod 38—908

pa nyon mongs pa dang 'dres pa dang / mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing ngan pa dang / gtsang sbras ma phyed pa dang / mdo las 'byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa 'khrul zhing nongs pa thams cad 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la bzod par gsol zhing mchis na thugs brtse bar dgongs te bzod pa bzhes shing 'phral dang yun du bdag cag gi sgrib par mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab par byu gnang / de nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang thugs rjes 'byon 1 par mdzod/ /mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis/ bdag cag dang sems can gyi don mdzad pa lags kyis/ so so'i zhing khams su rdzu 'phrul gyis 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ rdzogs so// //sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs pa dang / 'di ltar brjod de/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi —dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang / /lag mthil ltar mnyam bai ḍūr+ya'i/ /rang bzhin bzang por gnas gyur cig /bde ldan 'jig rten bkod pa ltar/ /rin chen sa gzhi me tog bcas/ /ljon shing chu mtsho ma tshang med/ /chos sgrogs —rgya chen ldan par shog /'jig rten 'das pa'i dge las byung / /rin chen bdun las grub pa yi/ /tshad mar 5'od zer 'gyed pa'i gnas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs gyur cig /gshegs byon skye 'bri med pa'i sku/ /ji ltar smon bzhin yod pa dag /dkar po 'char ba'i tshul bzhin du/ /'jig rten skyabs su gshegs su gsol/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gis 38—909

phul ba'i mchod yon 'di/ /bzhes nas bdag la mnyes par mdzod/ /khyed ni rang bzhin yongs dag par/ /srid 1sogs nyes pa mi mnga' yang yon bdag sgrib ri2pa sbyang be+ed du/ /gtsang ma'i chu yis sku khrus gsol/ /chos don dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /dpal ldan dag pa'i ⑦ gnas bshams par/ /ting 'dzin mi g.yo mnyam gzhag pas/ /dge bar dgongs pas gdan la bzhugs4—/ /gtsang dwangs gdan khri yangs pa la/ /thogs dang dog pa med pa'i sku/ /mnyam nyid tshul gyis 'dir bzhugs shing / /bde bar sbyar ba thubazhes su gsol/ /zhes de ltar yon chab dang sku khrus gsol/ gdan dbul/de'i 'og tu ston pa bdun po 'khor dang bcas pa 4la spyi'i phyag byas te/ 'di ltar / 'go ba nyon mongs dug gis gzir ba la/ /thugs rje 3dug sel sman mchog bdud rtsi ni/ /smon lam chen pos grub par gyur pa yi 3 / /bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las dang nyon mongs dbang gis sbug bsngal sna tshogs kyis/ /gzir ba'i 'go ba gzigs nas spyod tshe thugs rje yis9 / /sdug bsngal zhi byed smon lam sna tshogs sgrub sbyimadzad pa'i/ /bde gshegs bdun po 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas spyir mchod pa rnam pa lnga 'bul/ smon lam gdab/ rgyun bshags bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu re re nas mchod pa ni/ /mtshan gyi —1me tog rgyas pas dag pa la/ /dpe byad bzang po'i 'bru chags mdzes pa'i sku/ /gang gis mthong thos dran pa'i dpal gyur pa'i/ /ston pa mtshan legs dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen zla dang pad+mas rab brgyan zhing mu/ /shes bya kun la chags pa'i 0thugs mnga' la/ /rgya mtsho lta bur zab pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /sgra dbyangs rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /38—910

'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar lhang nge ba/ /nyi ma stong bas lhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar / /dri med gser gyi mchod sdong lta bu'i sgu/ /gser bzangs 1dri med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mya ngan 'das shing bde ba'i mchog brnyes pa/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gdung ba sel mdzad pa/ /'gro drug mgon dang dpal du gyur pa po/ /mya ngan med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sgra chen pos pha rol rgol ba 'joms/ /rgya mtsho lta bur dwangs pa'i 2sku mnga' zhing / /'gro ba'i dug gsum ma lus sel mdzad pa/ /chos bsgrags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi blo gros gting dpag dka' ba'i tshul/ /rnam dag chos kyi dbyings la rol mdzad de/ /shes bya ma lus mngon sum gzigs pa po/ /mngon mkhyen rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i nad gso mdzad pa sman pa'i mchog /bai ḍūr+ya ltar dwangs pa'i 4sgu mnga' zhing / /sku yi 'od kyis 5 'gro ba sgol mdzad pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sman gyi rnam pa 'di dag ni/ /nad rnams ma lus bsal bya'i phyir/ /bde gshegs sman kyi bla la 'bul/ /yon bdag don du bzhes su gsol/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje 6shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing / /gzhan kyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bur 7mdzes pa'i sku/ /shākya'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma rig mun sel sgon 9ma'i mchog /sdug bsngal nad sel sman gyi phul/ /dam chos sgron ma thams cad la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /ye shes sgu yi 7ngo bo nyid/ /ngag gi dbang phyug gzugs mdzes ldan/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro drug 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob 3rtamadzad cing / /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che 38—911

las sgrol ba'i gru/ /mya ngan 'das par phyin pa'i ded dpon mchog /sems dpa' skyabs grol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi / /sgu gsung thugs kyi 1gsang 'dzin pa/ /ma rungs 'dul zhing rig sngags 'chang / /rdo rje bsnams 2snal phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems dpa' nyi ma snang byed ni/ /sku mdog dkar ser gangs ri'i gdan/ /phyag gnyis bdud rtsi'i sa gnon tshul/ /de la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ /sems dpa' zla ltar snang byed ni/ /sku mdog dkar po pad+ma'i gdan/ /phyag gnyis chos 'chad bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /'dod khams 'dam las rab tu tshangs sgo// /gzugs khams tshangs pa'i gnas na bzhugs/ /tshangs chen rgyal po mi mjed gtso/ /tshangs chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dbu gsum phyag drug lha min 'dul/ /kun la khyab cing snyoms par 'jug /lha yi 4gnas gsal stobs po che/ /lha chen khyab 'jug mchod pa 'bul/ /mtho ris lha yi gnas mchog na/ /mi pham mgon gyi zhal mthong ba/ /dga' ldan lha yi sras rnams la5/ /yon bdag gus pas mchod pa 'bul/ /lha mi treganyen po lha yi rje/ /spyan gsum mnga' bas dus gsum gyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i 'khor gzigs pa/ /lha dbang brgya byin mchod pa 'bul/ /lhun po'i rtser gnas lha dbang dang / /thabs dang tshul bzhin spyod mdzad pa/ /lha rnams 'khor dang bcas pa yang / /mchod bzhes yon bdag re skong 3mdzod/ /shes pa'i dad pa tshan po che/ /nga rgyal bsnyems pa'i brag bsnyil te/ /ston pa'i zhabs 'bring bka' sdod pa/ /sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas la mchod/ /shar phyogs dpal ldan rgyal chen yul 'khor srung / /sku mdog nadakar po phyag 38—9/2

na pi wang 'dzin/ /dri za'i 'khor tshogs smin pa'i thugs dam can/ /de la phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /lho phyogs dpal ldan rgyal chen 'phags skyes po/ /sku mdog sngon po phyag na ral gri bsnams/ /grul bum gdon tshogs smin phyir thugs dam can1/ /de la phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /nub phyogs dpal ldan rgyal po mig mi bzang 2/ /sku mdog dmar po phyag na zhags pa bsnams/ /klu yi gdon tshogs smin phyir thugs dam can 7/ /de la phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /byang phyogs dpal ldan rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /sku mdog ljang gu phyag na ne+e'u le bsnams/ /gnod sbyin gdon tshogs smin phyir thugs dam can/ /de la phyag 'tshal bsnyen bkur mchod pa 'bul/ /bde gshegs bstan 4pa bsrung ba'i dge bsnyen mchog /'jigs pa'i gzugs can rngom 5pa'i cha lugs can/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon ji 'jigs la sogs pa/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /de nas gtor ma gtang 6/ gzungs rnams mang du bzla/ spyir mchod pa lnga 'bul / 'dod pa'i don la gsol bar bya zhing khrus bya'o/ /bzod pa gsol/gshegs su gsol/ rdzogs so// //38—9/3
