1832༄༅/ /grub thabs thams cad kyi las ka zhes bya ba/ 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sā dha rgo sarba karma nā ma/ bod skad du/sgrub thabs thams cad kyi las ka zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum mgon po 'gro don mdzad/ /ston pa de la gus btud de / /sgrub pos nang dang nub sogs su/ /tshogs chen dag ni bsags pa dang //sgrub thabs kun na mi gsal ba'i/ /bdun po rnam dag gsal bar bstan/ /bde gshegs mtha' dag mkha' la dmigs/ /dus gsum gyi ni bla ma dang / /phyogs rnams kun gyi bde gshegs dang / /phyag 'os kun la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mi mjed 'jig rten 'di 'am ni/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad na/ /mchod pa bla na yod pa dang / /mchod pa bla na med pa yis/ /de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /nyon mongs srad bus bcings gyur pas/ /mi shes dbang gis bgyis pa yi/ /lci dang yang ba'i sdig 38—976

bsags pa/ /mgon po'i tshogs la so sor bshags/ /'das dus sangs rgyas ji snyed dang / /da ltar phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs/ /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas de dag gis/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos bstan gsol/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas de dag gis/ /'khor bar 'khyams 1pa'i sems can rnams/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis gzigs mdzod la/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas dge ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal dge ba dang / /'jig rten dge ba ci spyod pa/ /de dag la yang yi rang ngo / /zag bcas dge ba ci bsags pa/ /de bzhin zag med dge ba gang / /dge ba'i tshogs ni ci bsags pa/ /byang chub sems dpar bsngo bar gyis / /bdun po rnam dag re re la/ /se gol gyi ni 4sgra yang bsgrags/ /de ltar bsod nams tshogs bsags nas/ /ye shes tshogs ni 'di lta ste/ /mu stegs skye bo tha mal bzhin/ /stong pa tsam gyis bsgyur 5nas ni/ /phyal bar bya ba'i 6ma yin te/ /dman pa yi ni byang chub bzhin/ /'ga' zhig stong pa'i tshul la ni/ /'ga' zhig yod pa ma yin te/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa bzhin/ /gzugs las stong pa gzhan mi btsal/ /'khrul ngor bstan pa'i gzugs su snang / /gzugs dang stong pa dbyer med na7/ /gzugs ni rnam par dag pa yin/ /gzugs nyid stong par shes par bya/ /dper na chu yi zla ba bzhin/ /de ltar ye shes tshogs bsags bya/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pas sgrib gnyis byang / /bskyed rim 'byung ba'i dgos pa yin/ /de nas so so'i sgrub thabs bzhin/ /bskyed tshul lha de gsal bar bskyed/ /bskyed rim bsgom pa'i rnam gnyis te/ /38—977

—rtogs pa can dang rtogs pa dman/ /rtogs pa can kyis 'di ltar bsgom/ /gang bskyed pa yi lha de ni/ /nam mkha' yi ni 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /gsal la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ /chu la zla ba shar ba bzhin/ /snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom/ /rtogs pa dman pas 'di ltar bsgom/ /yod par rag 1pa'i rnam pa dang / /'bur btod ris su bris bzhin du/ /gong ltar gsal ba'i rnam par bsgom/ /de ltar bskyed rim bsgoms nas ni/ /bzlas pa'i tshul ni rnam pa gnyis/ /don dam dang ni kun rdzob dang / /don dam bzlas pa 'di lta ste/ /rtogs pa can gyi bskyed rim bzhin/ /yengs med gsal bar bsgoms nas ni/ /yul gzung 'dzin pa yongs spangs nas/ /rtogs pa thams cad bkag nas ni/ /nam mkha' stong 4las sgra 'byung zhing 5/ /sgra de yang ni rang bzhin med/ /chos nyid kyi ni rang sgra'o/ /kun rdzob phrin las bzhi bzlas pas/ /zhi ba'i bzlas pa 'di lta ste/ /sngags brjod sngags kyi 'od zer ni/ /nyi zer lta bur phyogs bcur 'phro/ /ma lus kun la phog pas ni//kun gyi gnod sems zhi byas te/ /phan sems byams sems ldan gyur nas/ /sgrub po nyid la 'dug par bsam/ /rgyas pa'i bzlas pa 'di lta ste/ /sngags 'od nyi zer lta bu ni/ /'dom gang tshad nas khugs 6pa'i tshul/ /rang gi lus la phog pas ni/ /lus kyi tshe bsod rgyas par bsam/ /dbang gi bzlas pa 'di lta ste/ /sngags 'od lcags kyu lta bus ni/ /phyogs bcur 'phros te ma lus bkug /sgrub pa'i las ka ci bya zhes/ /phyag dang bcas pas 7'dud par bsam / /drag po'i bzlas pa 'di lta ste/ /sngags 'od me lce lta bus ni/ /phyogs bcu kun du 'phros pa ste/ /rang gnod bgegs rnams thams cad bsreg /38—978

mi bzad skad ngan chen po yis/ /sgrub pa po la skyabs gsol bsam/ /de skye thun mtshams 'di lta ste/ /gtor dbul ye shes nam mkhar dbyung / /yid kyis phar mchod byin gyis tshur brlabs bsam/ /se gol sgra dang bcas pa yis/ /ye shes mchog 'byung 1mgon po khyod kyis ni/ /dngos grub chen po sprul du gsol / /slar gshegs slar yang 'byon du gsol/ /bstan bcos brtsam pa rnam gnyis te/ /sgra tshad dag las phul byung bas/ /lung dang mi 'gal don de gtan la 'be+ebs/ /mdo rgyud lung dang —bstan bcos nas drangs te/ /de nas zhirten dang de dang mi 'gal ba/ /des kyang 'ga' zhig brtsam 6par rigs pa yin/ /sgo drug gis ni 7bstan bcos brtsam 8pa ni/ /yi dam lha yi zhal mthong dang / /de yis 9gnang ba byin pa dang / /dngos grub kun la dbang thob pas/ /mdo rgyud lung dang bstan bcos las drangs nas/ /de la rten dang de dang mi 'gal bas/ /des ni brtsam par rigs pa yin/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi bka' las kyang / /bskyed rim gsal bar ma bstan te/ /bskyed rim gsal bar ma gyur na/ /don rnams 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /de bskyed gsal bar bstan gyur nas/ /shes rab 'chal ba'i gang zag gis/ /slob dpon med par zhugs gyur nas/ /bdag nyid phung ba kho nar zad/ /yang na de dus 'khor rnams kyis/ /bde gshegs kyi ni byin rlabs 7kyis/ /de ni gsol ba kho na yin/ /bde gshegs mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /blo chung sems can mang gyur te/ /mdo sde rnams las lung bstan te/ /da ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /blo chung sems can mang gyur te/ /de la dgongs te bde gshegs kyis/ /nga dang 'dra ba'i gang zag gis/ /nga yi lung rnams 'grol rta 38—979

bar bya/ /de skad lung nas 'byung ba ste/ /mtshan nyid ldan gyis bstan bcos brtsam / /mtshan nyid mi ldan brtsams gyur nas/ /kun kyang dgongs par ma gyur pas/ /de don gzhan du bstan byas nas/ /sdug bsngal chen po myong bar 'gyur / /slob dpon chen bo rat+na tīrtis mdzad pa sgrub thabs thams cad kyi las ka gsal byed ces bya ba sdogs so// //bsdur mchan/976 1mtshan byang 'di'i chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉dag/ /sgrub thabs thams cad kyi las ka 'es bya ba bzhugs so// 2〈〈snar 〉ra / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra stod/977 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shams/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chen ngo ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra kyi/ 4〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zo nga /5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgyur/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rang / 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/978 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngags/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazungs/ 4〈〈snar 〉〉steng / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhin/ 6〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skathug 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mir/979 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaragyur/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zam/ rnyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thob/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartsams/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkani/ 〈〈pe 〉zan/ 〈〈snar 〉zam/9〈〈pe 〉gran/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rlabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉byedagrol/38byed980
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1759)

༄ga /rten cing 'azel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo/lha༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra tī t+ya sa mut+pā da z-i da ya kadze+e②/ bod skad du/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos gang rgyus 'byung 1/de dag gi/ /rgyu dang de 'gog gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal te/ /de skad gsungs pa ④dge sbyong che/ /tshigs bcad 'di yi cho ga ni/ /sems can rnams la phan byed pa/ /las kun 'grub par bya ba'i phyir/ /cho ga bzhin du bshad par bya/ /de la re zhig sgrub pa po'i skyes bus dang por sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la sems rab tu dang ba chen pos bskyed par bya'o/ /'di snyam du yang sems bskyed par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'dis sems can rnams kyi rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lugs dang mthun pa dang / lugs dang mi mthun pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa dang / ldog pa gsungs te 38—982

'di ltar las dang nyon mongs pa yod na ni sems can rnams 'khor bar 'jug par 'gyur la/ las dang nyon mongs pa med na ni sems can rnams 'khor ba las ldog go zhes bya ba'i bden pa'i tshig 'dis bdag gi cho ga zhib mo zhig grub par gyur cig ces sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu 'di skad ces tshig brjod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo /dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod par bya'o/ /rim pa 'dis de dag gi las thams cad /bhetshigs su bcad pa 'di'i cho ga bzhin du sbyar bar bya ste/ de lta bu ni cho ga zhib mo dang po yin no/ /de nas rang gi lag mthil lam lus la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa me'i khams la snyoms par bzhugs —par bsam par bya ste/ de lta bu ni lha rjes su dran pa'i cho ga yin no/ /da ni sbyor ba bri bar bya ste/ rims kyis btab pa dang / klad pa na ba dang mig na ba la sogs pa rngo ji ltar 'dod pa thutshigs su bcad pa 'dis lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur kyis dbyung ba'i tshul du byab par bya'o/ /rims nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / rtag pa dang / rims mi bzad pas jebs 38—983

pa rnams la bu mo gzhon nus bkal ba'i skud nga la bzlas brjod brgya byas pa gdags par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rims sel ba'i bdug pa'i ri lu dag ji ltar 'dod par bzlas brjod byas nas bdug par bya'o/ /snying nad dang rtsib skya logs na bas jebs pa rnams la chu la bzlas brjod bcu'am bcu gnyis bzlas nas blud par bya'o/ /yang na nad de la phan pa'i sman dang bcas la bzlas brjod byas la blud do/ /g.yen /3pa dang / rdo dang / 'brum bu dang / phol mig la sogs pa dang / rma red pa la grog tshang gi sa la snga ma bzhin du bzlas brjod byas nas bsku bar bya'o/ /gzhang 'brum mam pho mtshan 'brum bus thebs pa rnams la skyer khaṇ+ḍa'i 4ri lu'am byang chub sems dpa'i ri lu la bzlas brjod byas nas bsku bar bya'o/ /mdor na nad kyi rnam pa gang gis thebs pa de la bdag nyid kyis tshab ༄che chung shes par byas la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis bzlas brjod mang ba'am nyung ngu nyi shu sum cu bzlas pas byug pa'am bsku bar bya'o/ /'khru bas jebs pa rnams la sman khu'am ri lu'i rdzas kyi rigs gzhan la bzlas brjod lnga'am drug bzlas nas zar gzhug 6ste/ de lta bu'i 3nad gso ba'i cho ga yin no/ /de nas lo tog nas dang / gro dang / 'bras dang / sram muṅga dang /mon sran dre'u 8dang / ras bal 9gyi shing dang 7/ rgun 'brum dang / a ru ra la sogs pa la za ba'i srin bu dang sbyar ba dang / phye ma leb dang / byi ba dang / ne+e tso dang / ri skegs la sogs pa kha bcing ba'i phyir zhing gi khyen shes par byas nas bye ma'am thal ba bye gang ngam/ de las lhag tsam la bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad byas nas zhing la gtor bar bya'o nyu1/ /de lta bu ni lo thog 38—984

la phan pa'i cho ga yin no/ /de bzhin du ha cang char ches na bcom ldan 'das la phul ba'i me tog dman ma re re la bzlas brjod nyi shu rtsa gcig byas nas/ bla gab med pa'i phyogs su ba lang gi lci bas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa zhig byas la/ dbus su bum pa bzhag nas steng du kham phor gzhag par bya'o/ /kham phor gyi nang du me tog dman pa 7 bzlas brjod byas pa bsregs pas 'chad par 'gyur te/ 'di ni tshar bcad 3snapa'i cho ga'o/ /de bzhin du ser ba bzlog pa la se'u'i lcug ma'am nya phyis lcug ma la bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad byas nas sprin bzlog par bya'o/ /yang na yungs kar la bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad byas nas thum 7por byas te/ se'u'i lcug ma'i thor tho la bcings nas bla gab med par gzugs te/ de lta bu ni sprin bzlog pa'i cho ga yin no/ /de bzhin du 'byung po dang / sha za dang / brjed 4byed kyi gdon gyis zin pa rnams thubum pa'am zangs kyi ril bar yungs kar yang blugs/ dri'i rdzas ga pur dang / tsan+dan dang / gla rtsi la sogs pa yang bcug nas bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad byas te/ sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten nam/dri gtsang khang ngam/ sa phyogs bde ba zhig tu bzhag la/ phyis sa phyogs gzhan par ba lang gi lci bas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas te/ me tog gis gtor la phyogs bzhir bum pa gang ba bzhag ste/ gu gul gyi bdugs 6pas bdug par bya'o/ /de nas bkru bar bya ba de gos dkar po bskon nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du bzhag la/ bum par sa bon thams cad dang rin po che thams 38—985

cad bcug la/ rje btsun sangs rgyas la reg par byas pa'i chu'i rgyun gyis bkrus na/ nad thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /nad 'go ba thams cad dang 'tshe ba thams cad thag ring por 'gyur ro/ /rim pa de ltar byas na 'byung po'i gdon dang / brjed thubyed dang / sha za la sogs pas kyang glags rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ de lta bu ni bum pa'i cho ga yin no/ /de bzhin du sbyor ba gzhan yang byis pas 'jigs pa rnams la gi wang la bzlas brjod lan nyi shu rtsa gcig byas pas/ 'phags pa stobs po che bris la gtsang sbra byas la mgul bar gdags so/ /de bzhin du yungs kar la bzlas brjod byas nas mgul du gdags so/ gu gul gyi bdug pa la yang dag par (5bzlas brjod gnyis sam gsum byas nas bdug go/ /mkha' 'gro mas zin pa la yungs kar dang gu gul kyi bdug pa la de bzhin du bzlas brjod byas pas bdug par bya'o/ /yang na skud pa la snga ma de bzhin du bzlas brjod byas nas mgul du gdags te/ de lta bu ni byis pa gso ba'i cho ga yin no/ /de bzhin du bud med bu thogs pa la chu la bzlas brjod lnga'am drug byas nas blud na legs par btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du bud med mo gsham la rje btsun sangs rgyas kyi sku bsil ba'i chu la bzlas brjod nyi shu rtsa gcig byas te/khrus byas pas lus gtsang mar gyur pa la blud na bu tsha byung zuzhing phan par 'gyur te / de lta bu ni rigs rgyud spel ba'i cho ga yin no/ /lam du zhugs pa rnams kyis skud pa la bzlas brjod lan bdun byas nas re re bzhin thumadud pa dor bar bya'o/ /yang na gos kyi mtha' la lan gnyis sam gsum bzlas brjod byas te/ mdud pa bor na bde bar 'gro bar 'gyur te/38—986

de lta bu ni lam du nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i cho ga yin no/ /shu dag tshon gang tsam lo gcig gi nyi ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa blangs nas grangs de tsam du bzlas brjod byas la/ /mar yang srang de tsam zhig la bzlas brjod byas nas bum pa gcig tu blugs te/ bkrus 1nas nyi ma re re zhing shu dag gi dum bu dang / mar srang gcig la 3bzlas brjod byas nas zos na yid gzhungs pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du ba ser skya'i 'o ma dang mar dang bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad byas pa'i 'o thug sna ma'i mgo spyogs kyis dkrugs te zos na yid gzhungs pa'i mchog tu 'gyur te/ de lta bu ni yid gzhungs pa'i cho ga yin no/ /de bzhin du me tog dang / 'bras bu'am/ rtswa'am/ shing ngam 'jim pa lag pa g.yas pa'i chang par bcug la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig chang par bcug pa byin pa de dang mdza' zhebar 'gyur ro/ /de ni mdza' bar 'gyur ba'i cho ga yin no/ /de bzhin du ba lang dang rta la sogs pa phyugs 'chi bar nye bar gnas pa'i tshe chu yungs kar dang bcas pa la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas pa'i thum po gdags so/ /de bzhin du mi rnams 'chi ba'i gnod pa 'byung ba la/yungs kar la de bzhin du bzlas brjod byas pa'i thum po mgo skyob kyi thog tu gdags par bya ste/ 'di lta bu ni re zhig mi ngas dang phyugs ngas gso ba'i cho ga yin no/ /re zhig nerban rak+ṣ-i ta/ bdag gis rang gi bla ma las tshigs su bcad pa mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sbyor ba brgya thos so/ /de yang yun rings pas kha 38—987

cig ni brjed de/ che long kun bsdus pa yin no/ /'di thams cad 'grub pa la the tshom gye mi bya'o/ /nangs na yang gang la yid ches pas dad pa yod pa de la lhag par 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes bya bar nges so/ /bzlas brjod 'bum byas nas dgos pa ci yang mi 'grub pa med do/ /tho gar zuyul nas skyes gyur pa//dge slong ne+erban rak+ṣi tas/ /cho ga bzang po tshul bzhin du/ /rab tu 'bad nas bshad pa yin/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga zhib mo//mkhan po ne+erban rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/982 3mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉da / /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kalpa/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byung / je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kusung ba/983 tshosna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 la/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhugs/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 la/ pya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mir/984 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mchibs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉khiyan/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra da/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skab 'da'i/3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshabs/ ḍartse7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazar bzhug ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ni/ she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gre'u/ 9 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉ra la/ tso〈〈pe 〉〉gidang / kye〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉byu ste/985 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tham/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagacad/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉thun/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rjed/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7la/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thadug986 /tsobhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ad/ (bye sna〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7dag par/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kubyung / thu/〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉lkeng /987 lku〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dkrugs/ khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gil/ pa —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'dza'/988 1〈〈pe 〉〉tsom/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kar/38byed988

sngag /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga7 ༄yi/ /rgya gar skad du/ pra tiṣ+ṭha bi byeḥ2/ bod skad du/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la re zhig pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i sgor byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed thob pa'i dge bsnyen nam/ dge tshul lam/ dge slong gi dge 'dun nam/ gang zag gi 4mchod rten nam/ bris sgu la sogs pa rab tu gnas pa byed pas gang rab tu gnas par bya ba mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 5de'i nye 'khor byug skyang nul byas te/mthar tsan+dan la sogs pa'i dzidri zhim po'i chus byugs nas/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa khru gang yan chod nas ji tsam nus par byugs nas/ der pad+ma bdab 3ma brgyad pa tshon gyis bri bar bya'o/ /de'i steng du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa gser la sogs pa'i rgyu las byas pa kha rgyan dādang / mgul dkris dang bcas par rin po che dang / sman dang / 'bru rnams gzhug cing tsan+dan dang /38byed990

ga bur la sogs pa dri zhim po dang sbyor 3ba'i chu klung gi chu gtsang mas dgang zhing /grangs kyang gcig nas brtsams te ji snyed 'byor pa gzhag par bya'o/ /me tog la sogs pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa rnams kyang mdun du sta gon du (7byas la/nang par snga dro'i dus su yid du 'ong ba'i bla re byes pas mdzes pa'i gnas su sgrub pa pos stan bde ba la skyil mo krung la sogs pa mnyam par gzhag pa'i spyod lam gyis gnas te/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la gtor ma byin la/ / gser ram dngul gyi gzhi'am gro ga la'ang rung / tsan+dan dkar pos/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā te tudhe ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ de ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ④ zhes pa tshar bdun du bris la/ tshar re re zhing lan bdun bdun bklags te/ bum pa'i chus bkrus la bum pa de nyid du bzhugs 5 par bya'o/ /de nas bum pa'i steng du zla ba la sngags kyi phreng ba dkar po 'od dang bcas pa skad cig gis bsams te/ de'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nas lha'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun rnams bkug la bum pa'i chu de sngags kyi phreng ba zhu ba dang lhan cig ro gcig tu gyur pas bum pa gang bar dmigs nas/ de kyelag pas reg nas brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la mchod rten la sogs pa'i nang ngam snying gar zla ba la snga ma ltar sngags kyi phreng ba dmigs la/de'i 'od kyis 'jig rten khyab par bltas te/ des sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskul nas/ gang zhig rab tu gnas par bya ba mchod rten la sogs pa de'i gzugs kyis byon nas de dang de la thim pa dang / sngags la sogs pa thams cad ro gcig tu gyur par bsams nas/ lugs su blugs pa rnams la ni dngos su khrus bya'o/ /glegs bam la sogs pa rnams tsal ni me 38—991

long la bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang / glu dang / sgra dang bcas pas sngags bzlas 5rtebazhin du sngar gyi bum pa'i chus khrus gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas dri zhim pos bsgos pa'i gos kyis sku phyi ba byas pa'i rjes la ci 'byor pa'i na bza' dang rgyan rnams dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor pa rnams dbul lo/ /de'i rjes la lag pas reg nas snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas mchod rten nam lugs sku'i nang du gro ga la snying po bris te gzhug go/ /glegs bam zhebris sgu'i ni mtha' zumar bri'o/ /de ltar byas nas slar yang me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod cing rol mo'i sgra yang bsgrags te/ 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur cing / /sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod pa dag /skye dgu kun 4la rtag tu byams byed cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod gyur cig /rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden pa'i byin gang gis/ /bden 'di gsungs pa cho'adi la sdig med cing / /lhar bcas lha min gyis rtag mchod 'os pa'i/ /bden pa des ni deng 'dir bde legs shog /dam chos bdud rtsi thams cad mkhyen pa yis/ /zhal nas gsungs pa bsil ba'i ro 'di yi6/ /nyon mongs 'bar ba'i me yis gdungs pa yi7/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal rtag tu zhi byed shog /ces brjod 8cing sngar gyi bum pa'i chu'i lhag mas rab tu gnas pa'i sa gzhi dang / gnas khang dag tu nyung zad gtor bar bya'o/ /bya ba rnams rdzogs pa na rdul tshon la sogs pa rnams chu bo chen po'am/ khron pa rnying par dor nas sa gzhi lci ba sar pas byugs te/ rab gnas byed pa'i slob dpon dang / dge slong la mchod ston dang / yon dbul ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas rten de la mchod pa phul te/38—992
